title: Account Executive, Platforms (Grower) - German Speaking
description: <h1><strong>Who we are</strong></h1> <h2><strong>About Stripe</strong></h2> <p>Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.</p> <h2><strong>About the team</strong></h2> <p>The Platform Sales team works with B2B Software Platforms to help them facilitate payments for their customers using our Stripe Connect product. Software Platforms, also known as B2B Indirect, are software platform businesses who serve other businesses. Platforms already using Stripe include Shopware, Jimdo, Eversports and Shopify.</p> <p>As a key member to the Stripe Platforms team, you will manage and elevate relationships with a named account list while identifying new growth opportunities and ways Stripe can exceed expectations. </p> <p>If you’re motivated, smart, persistent, and a great teammate, we want to hear from you!</p> <h2><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h2> <p>As an Account Executive (Grower), you will create partnerships between Stripe and the most innovative and fastest-growing software platforms in the world by helping them to understand how Stripe’s online commerce infrastructure can make payments a competitive advantage for their businesses.</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li>Directly manage and nurture a named account list and develop account plans for winning and expanding business with upper middle market and enterprise SaaS Platform companies</li> <li>Build and maintain key relationships with C-level executives, while orchestrating the right executive touch points as well</li> <li>Own the full sales cycle from lead to close for upper middle market and enterprise companies</li> <li>Work with company leaders from multiple functions (e.g., Engineering, Product, and Finance) to lead complex product workshops and financial analyse</li> <li>Craft and lead complex, bespoke commercial & contractual negotiations</li> <li>Contribute to shaping our platform partnership strategy and building repeatable processes and scaled engagement models</li> <li>Lead and contribute to team projects to develop and refine our sales process</li> <li>Engage with Product and Engineering teams to help drive product strategy</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Who you are</strong></h2> <p>You are an adept salesperson and relationship manager capable of engaging in business-level and technical conversations at multiple levels of the organization, including the CTO, COO, and CFO. You have experience working with upper middle market and enterprise companies. You have an in-depth understanding of the buyer journey and can lead a complex, multi-party sale in a highly consultative manner. You are used to building value in competitive situations and enjoy working on products that require deep product understanding, combined with technical knowledge. You are naturally analytical and enjoy digging into business models and helping customers quantify their investment decisions. You get excited about prospecting, and are capable of independently leading a sales cycle from start to finish. Finally, you enjoy building – you like to actively participate in the development of our sales process, the articulation of our value proposition, and the creation of key tools and assets.</p> <p><strong>Minimum requirements</strong></p> <ul> <li>7+ years of sales experience, preferably selling a technical product, with a track record of top performance</li> <li>Extensive experience directly selling a technology product or service, preferably at an API-first company, with a record of top performance</li> <li>A proven track record of moving sales processes forward from inception to close by leading complex, multi-party sales in a highly consultative manner, understanding strategies and applying value proposition</li> <li>Great listening skills and ability to quickly become a trusted resource for decision-makers across technology and finance orgs within software companies</li> <li>An ability to understand complex technical problems and understand how Stripe’s solutions can address them</li> <li>A positive attitude and tireless work ethic when encountering blockers to success, whether external or internal</li> <li>Strong presentation skills</li> <li>Proven ability to lead complex negotiations involving bespoke commercial agreements</li> <li>Superior verbal and written communication skills</li> <li>Ability to operate in a highly ambiguous and fast-paced environment</li> <li>Strong interest in technology and a deep understanding of the space</li> <li>Experience in or excitement in learning about financial technology infrastructure</li> <li>Fastidious approach to CRM hygiene and experience utilizing thorough sales forecasting metrics on a weekly/quarterly basis and communicating them in a succinct manner</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>In-office expectations</strong></p> <p>Office-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in our Bucharest, Romania site have an 80% in-office expectation, and those in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico and Bengaluru, India work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible.<br><br></p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: (Senior) Operational Risk Manager (f/m/d)
description: <div class="content-intro"><p class="sc-gEkIjz cjtSrT MuiTypography-root MuiTypography-body1 sc-hoLEA">Raisin is the world’s leading platform for savings and investment products. Founded in 2012, the <strong>FinTech</strong> connects consumers with banks in the EU, the UK and the US. This gives consumers <strong>better interest rates</strong> and banks a <strong>diversified form of refinancing</strong>. Our vision is to offer savings and investments without barriers and thus open up the global 160 trillion euro market.</p> <p class="sc-gEkIjz cjtSrT MuiTypography-root MuiTypography-body1 sc-hoLEA">Raisin currently employs more than 800 people from over 75 countries worldwide. Today, the platform holds over 80 billion euros in assets from <strong>more than one million investors</strong> which have accrued over 5 billion euros in returns.</p></div><p><span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);"><strong>Team</strong></span></p> <p>The Risk Controlling team shapes Raisin Group’s resilience by establishing and maintaining the group-wide risk management framework in line with regulatory standards such as Basel. The team defines risk policies and controls and is responsible for identifying and assessing material risks across the group, including operational, credit, market, and liquidity risk, using methods such as risk assessments, stress testing, and scenario analysis.</p> <p>In addition, Risk Controlling continuously monitors the group’s risk profile through risk metrics, key risk indicators, and early warning signals. The team prepares risk reporting for senior management and regulatory authorities and supports capital and liquidity adequacy assessments in line with regulatory requirements, ensuring the business model is backed by appropriate risk-bearing capacity and liquidity strength.</p> <p><strong>Your Responsibilities</strong></p> <p data-start="329" data-end="560">The Operational Risk Manager identifies, assesses, monitors, and reports operational risks in line with internal frameworks and regulatory requirements, including MaRisk and Basel III, as part of the second line of defense.</p> <p data-start="562" data-end="583">Key responsibilities:</p> <ul> <li data-start="587" data-end="712">Perform operational risk identification and assessment, including RCSA, scenario analysis, and loss database management</li> <li data-start="587" data-end="712">Proactively follow up on operational risk events and conduct lessons-learned analyses with business units</li> <li data-start="829" data-end="920">Provide independent operational risk input to projects and New Product Approval Processes</li> <li data-start="923" data-end="988">Monitor risk indicators and oversee incident and loss reporting</li> <li data-start="991" data-end="1093">Maintain and enhance the Operational Risk Management Framework in line with MaRisk and Basel III</li> <li data-start="1096" data-end="1178">Prepare operational risk reports for senior management and governance committees</li> <li data-start="1181" data-end="1244">Support development of risk appetite and control enhancements</li> </ul> <p><strong>Your Profile</strong></p> <p>You bring strong analytical capability, sound judgment, and a structured approach to operational risk management in a regulated banking environment.</p> <p data-start="839" data-end="860">Key requirements:</p> <ul> <li data-start="864" data-end="956">Degree in Business Administration, Finance, Risk Management, Economics, or a related field</li> <li data-start="959" data-end="1092">3–5 years of experience in operational risk management, internal audit, or risk consulting within banking or financial services</li> <li data-start="1095" data-end="1172">Hands-on experience with RCSA, incident management, and risk indicators</li> <li data-start="1175" data-end="1255">Solid knowledge of regulatory requirements, including MaRisk and Basel III</li> <li data-start="1258" data-end="1352">Experience with risk management systems and tools, including loss database and RCSA tracking</li> <li data-start="1355" data-end="1438">Ability to balance operational execution with an enterprise-wide risk perspective</li> <li data-start="1441" data-end="1540">Strong communication skills to work across functions and present risk topics to senior management</li> <li data-start="1543" data-end="1627">Proactive, independent working style with strong ownership and attention to detail</li> <li data-start="1543" data-end="1627">Professional certifications are a plus</li> </ul> <p><strong>Join our mission, join our team – and grow with us!</strong></p> <p>At Raisin, we care about each other and it is one of our top priorities to foster an open and caring environment in which everyone feels welcome and comfortable. Our culture is strongly driven by our ambitious team, which connects more than 75 different nationalities.</p> <p>As part of our team, you will benefit from:</p> <ul> <li>Employee Development Budget of €2,000 and four full training days per year.</li> <li>Flexible working hours, home office and 30 vacation days.</li> <li>A company pension scheme (Betriebliche Altersvorsorge), which we support with 20%.</li> <li>Enjoy more than 50+ different sports with Urban Sports Club: We subsidize your membership with more than €20 per month. </li> <li>Do you miss being in the office? The Deutschland Ticket gets you there, which we subsidize with €25 per month.</li> <li>Love cycling? With JobRad, lease the bike of your choice and enjoy tax savings, plus Raisin covers your monthly insurance costs.</li> <li>Hungry all the time? Snacks, daily fresh fruit as well as drinks provided at the office.</li> <li>You are moving from another country or city to join us? We may support your relocation.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><a href="https://www.raisin.com/corporate/raisin-applicant-privacy-policy/"><em>Raisin Applicant Privacy Policy</em></a></p> <p data-start="728" data-end="900">We value diversity and the unique experiences each individual brings. title: Senior Product Designer, K4B
description: KAYAK, part of Booking Holdings (NASDAQ: BKNG), is a leading travel search engine. With billions of queries across our platforms, we help people find their perfect flight, stay, rental car and vacation package. We’re also transforming business travel with a new corporate travel solution, KAYAK for Business ( K4B ). As an employee of KAYAK, you will be part of a travel company that operates a portfolio of global metasearch brands including momondo, Cheapflights and HotelsCombined, among others. From start-up to industry leader, innovation is at our core and every employee has an opportunity to make their mark. Our focus is on building the best travel search engine to make it easier for everyone to experience the world. We are seeking a Senior Product Designer with experience designing for digital consumer products to help shape and elevate the user experience for our corporate travel shopping experience. As a senior member of the product design team, you will create, test, and deliver web and mobile experiences within an agile software development team. You will be working with a diverse team of Product Managers, Engineers and Designers to influence the strategic direction for your product area(s) by translating insights into ideas that balance business goals, technical constraints, and voice of our customer end-users. This role will be required to work from our Berlin office at least 3 days per week. In this role, you will: Be autonomous and collaborative. Take full ownership of your design work and full responsibility for communication with your teammates. Own the success or failure of your projects. Interface directly with cross-functional teams and customers to collect the insights and constraints that inform your design decisions. Rapidly produce multiple concepts and prototypes for design solutions that drive user and business impact. Apply systems thinking to approach scalable design solutions and the areas they impact, both now and in the future. Conduct qualitative user research, analyze findings, and translate insights into actionable improvements to your product area. Facilitate alignment within cross-functional teams and senior stakeholders by clearly communicating design rationale, scope, and measurable success criteria. Influence strategic direction for your product area while synthesizing feedback from across the organization and iterating thoughtfully on proposed solutions. Please apply if you have: 6+ years of experience in a B2B or B2C product design organization Mastery of user experience and interaction design principles, with demonstrated ability to solve complex product challenges end-to-end. An understanding of the entire product development process and the ability to ship features inside an ever-growing and experimenting company. Excellent communication skills, together with analytical thinking and problem-solving capability. Able to break down and simplify sophisticated problems and confidently present to a mixed audience of different levels in the organization. A human-centered design mentality, with experience conducting usability studies, performing user research, or crafting options for experimentation. Experience working in a dynamic design process where quantitative and qualitative customer data guide decisions. Strong time management skills and the ability to be self-directed and prioritize effectively. Demonstrated attention to detail that teammates can rely on. Proficiency using modern design, user research, prototyping, and AI tools, with experience in testing interactive prototypes and contributing to shared design systems. A positive demeanor toward your work, including curiosity to learn and a willingness to adapt as new and different challenges constantly emerge. Strong understanding of accessibility standards and inclusive design practices, including experience designing for screen readers, color contrast, and adaptable text sizes. Bachelor’s degree or foreign equivalent in Design, Human-Computer Interaction, or a closely related field. Benefits and Perks: 6 weeks of paid vacation Work from (almost) anywhere for up to 20 days per year Focus on mental health and well-being: Company-paid therapy sessions through SpringHealth Company-paid subscription to HeadSpace Company-wide week off a year - the whole team fully recharges (and returns without a pile-up of work!) No meeting Fridays Paid parental leave Paid volunteer time Focus on your career growth: Development Dollars Leadership development Access to thousands of on-demand e-learnings Travel Discounts Employee Resource Groups Free lunch 2 days per week Pension plan contributions Public transportation subsidies Bike leasing program Monthly social events, massages, Thursday happy hours, sports teams An awesome office in Friedrichshain, Berlin Inclusion At KAYAK, we want everyone to have the space to grow, share ideas and do great work. That’s why we’re focused on hiring the best talent from all walks of life and experiences, supporting them well and making sure no one feels like they have to fit a mold to belong here. Need any adjustments for the interview, application or on the job? No problem - just give us a heads-up. We’ve got you. #LI-AS1 Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Data Engineer
description: Your role at Veezu: As a Data Engineer, you'll build and maintain the data platform that powers reporting, analytics and data science across Veezu. Reporting into the Director of Data Engineering, you'll work hands-on with Microsoft Fabric, SQL, Python/PySpark and Power BI, bringing data in from our booking systems, databases and third-party APIs and shaping it into trusted, well-modelled datasets that the business relies on every day. Who are Veezu? Veezu is the UK's fastest growing taxi and private hire technology business operating across hundreds of UK towns and cities. We are a tech-driven on-demand mobility service that supports our hyper-local communities, helping them thrive and so much more! What you’ll do: Design, build and maintain ETL/ELT pipelines in Microsoft Fabric using Pipelines, Notebooks, Lakehouses, Warehouses and OneLake. Write PySpark notebooks to ingest and transform data from SQL Server databases, REST APIs, SaaS applications and file-based exports. Develop and optimise SQL transformations, stored procedures and Kimball-style star-schema data models. Build and support Power BI semantic models and the datasets behind dashboards used by teams across the business. Implement data quality, validation and reconciliation checks so numbers match across systems. Monitor production pipelines and troubleshoot data, performance and refresh issues. Use Git, automated testing and CI/CD to support reliable, repeatable deployments. Maintain clear documentation, data lineage and engineering standards. Work with analysts and business stakeholders to turn requirements into practical data solutions. Be committed to maintaining our ISO27001 certification and set high standards for Information Security compliance. What you’ll need: Essential 2-4 years' experience in a data engineering role. Strong SQL skills, including complex transformations and performance tuning. Hands-on experience with Microsoft Fabric (or Azure Synapse / Data Factory and a willingness to move to Fabric). Python and PySpark for data ingestion and transformation. Experience integrating data from APIs and other external sources. Good knowledge of data warehousing and dimensional modelling (Kimball). Experience with Power BI and semantic models. Understanding of data quality, testing and reconciliation, and experience with Git / source control. Confidence communicating with technical and non-technical stakeholders. Nice to have CI/CD and automated testing for data pipelines. Microsoft Fabric certification (e.g. DP-600 or DP-700). Lakehouse / medallion architecture design patterns. Experience with data governance, security and lineage. Experience with high-volume transactional data, ideally in transport, mobility or on-demand services. Where you’ll be: This role is hybrid, based out of our Cardiff HQ, with 3 days per week in the office. Veezu is committed to fair and inclusive recruitment, welcoming applications from all backgrounds, experiences, and communities. Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: IT Support Specialist (f/m/x)
description: Our goal is to have a solar system on every roof, a storage unit in every house, and an electric car in every garage. description: <p>This is a <strong>full-time, permanent opportunity</strong> for candidates <strong>based in the UK.</strong></p> <p>This position also requires <strong>frequent travel to client sites within Europe</strong>, with<strong> travel expenses covered by the company</strong>.</p> <p><strong>About Nearform</strong></p> <p>Nearform is an independent team of data & AI experts, engineers, and designers who build intelligent digital solutions and capability at pace. We'll also share more details about Nearform and the potential projects you may join.</li> </ul> <p><em>There may also be an additional interview with the client depending on the project</em></p> <p> </p> <h3><strong>Ready to Join Us?</strong></h3> <p>If you're passionate about building high-quality applications, solving complex challenges, and driving innovation in enterprise development, we’d love to hear from you.</p> <p>Apply now via our careers page at Nearform and be part of a team that values technical excellence, collaboration, and continuous learning.</p> <p><br><em>Nearform is committed to shaping a better world in all that we do. “say-do” ratio in executing and delivering impact </li> </ul> <p><strong>Compensation & Rewards:</strong></p> <p>In the UK, the base compensation range for this role is GBP 91,755 - GBP 110,106. title: Projectontwikkelaar
description: Ben jij een projectontwikkelaar met een passie voor vastgoed en gebiedsontwikkeling? Heb je al de nodige vlieguren gemaakt met complexe projecten en voel je je thuis in samenwerkingen met diverse partijen? Wil je zowel zelfstandig als in teamverband werken aan uitdagende projecten, van haalbaarheid tot realisatie? Dan zijn wij op zoek naar jou! Dit wordt jouw baan Als projectontwikkelaar leid je vastgoedprojecten van concept tot realisatie. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de ontwikkeling, verkoop en het volledige procesmanagement. Van haalbaarheidsstudies tot de start van de bouw: jij houdt het overzicht. Je onderhoudt relaties met partners, beleggers, woningcorporaties en overheden en zorgt voor een vlotte samenwerking tussen alle betrokkenen. Daarnaast ben je een echte teamspeler die bij gebiedsontwikkelingen bijdraagt aan het realiseren van impact op jouw (deel)project. Dankzij je ervaring met complexe projecten (appartementen en binnenstedelijke ontwikkelingen) weet je snel te schakelen tussen belanghebbenden en bewaak je het totaalplaatje, inclusief conceptontwikkeling, duurzaamheid, budget en planning. Wat ga je doen? Markt & Klant: Analyseren van de marktvraag en het ontwikkelen van passende product-marktcombinaties. Opstellen van grond- en vastgoedexploitaties en coördineren van verkooptrajecten. Onderhouden en uitbouwen van relaties met beleggers en woningcorporaties. Locatie & RO: Begeleiden van RO-procedures en vergunningstrajecten. Organisatie: Coördineren van het ontwikkelings- en ontwerpproces, inclusief de financiële en commerciële aspecten. Tijd & Geld: Opstellen en bewaken van exploitaties en planningen, uitvoeren van risicoanalyses en voeren van onderhandelingen om de beste resultaten te behalen. Jij hebt als geen ander gevoel voor het sluiten van goede deals. Meer bij Dura Vermeer Dura Vermeer is een onafhankelijk familiebedrijf. En dat merk je. In hoe we samenwerken, naar elkaar omkijken en bouwen met oog voor de volgende generaties. Al sinds 1855 bouwen we aan Nederland, in woningbouw, utiliteitsbouw, infrastructuur en techniek. Onze onafhankelijkheid en lange termijn visie vormen daarbij de basis. Met een omzet van € 2,6 miljard en ruim 3.700 collega’s behoren we tot de top van de Nederlandse bouwsector. Maar uiteindelijk draait het bij ons niet om die cijfers. Het draait om mensen. Om collega’s die samen werken aan projecten waar je trots op bent – iconisch én dichtbij – en bijdragen aan oplossingen voor maatschappelijke vraagstukken. Onze ambities zijn groot. En die maken we alleen waar met betrokken mensen. Daarom investeren we in goed werkgeverschap en een werkomgeving waarin jij je thuis voelt. Waar je jezelf kunt zijn, je veilig voelt en je uitspreekt. Zodat jij het beste uit jezelf haalt en samen met ons meer maakt. Focus op vastgoed bij Dura Vermeer Dura Vermeer heeft grote ambities als ontwikkelaar. In onze portefeuille vind je uitdagende (gebieds)ontwikkelingen met onderscheidende concepten, veelal op binnenstedelijke locaties. Ons werkgebied beslaat Zuid-Holland, waar we de stedelijke uitdagingen omarmen en maximale waarde willen toevoegen in onze plannen. Dit resulteert in projecten waar je echt impact kunt maken op gebieden als stedenbouw, architectuur, duurzaamheid en sociale cohesie. Als organisatie groeien we naar een vestiging waar jaarlijks 800 woningen risicodragend worden geacquireerd en verkocht. Dit betekent dat we zelf het risico dragen van de aankoop tot verkoop van de woningen. Jij speelt een belangrijke rol in onze complexe ontwikkelingen. Dura Vermeer onderscheidt zich op het gebied van samenwerking. We werken nauw samen met gemeentes, partners en stakeholders binnen onze projecten, en zeker ook met onze collega’s in Rotterdam. We staan bekend om onze intensieve en oprechte samenwerking, die leidt tot innovatieve en duurzame oplossingen in elk project. Op nationaal niveau heeft Dura Vermeer een sterke vastgoedorganisatie waar je op kunt terugvallen. Regelmatig ontmoet je collega’s van andere vestigingen om kennis uit te wisselen en expertise te ontwikkelen. Met onze interne gebiedsstudio, ID, bieden we een expertisecentrum voor ruimtelijke ontwikkeling, marktadvies en verkoopmanagement, acquisitie en gebiedsontwikkeling, dat je ondersteunt bij jouw projectopgaven. Met recent gewonnen tenders zoals Sportcampus Rotterdam , WijCK Pijnacker en De Werf in Oegstgeest en de aankoop van het Hunter Douglas terrein in Rotterdam laten we zien dat we meedraaien op het hoogste niveau van gebiedsontwikkeling. Hier zit je op je plek Dura Vermeer Bouw en Vastgoed Rotterdam is een grote werkmaatschappij binnen de Dura Vermeer Groep en opereert als een ontwikkelende bouwer in de regio Zuid-Holland. We zijn gespecialiseerd in het ontwikkelen van gebieden en buurten en het bouwen van woningen, zowel gestapeld als grondgebonden, en utilitaire gebouwen. Ons team is verdeeld in zes zelfstandige teams, elk met hun eigen expertise. Binnen deze teams, die uit ongeveer 35 collega’s bestaan, werken we met alle benodigde disciplines samen. De structuur is plat en zonder overbodige hiërarchie, wat zorgt voor een prettige, efficiënte samenwerking. Zo combineren we de voordelen van een groot bedrijf met de warme, persoonlijke sfeer van kleinschaliger teams. Bij ons heerst een informele sfeer met een typisch Rotterdamse mentaliteit: hard werken, maar ook hard lachen. We helpen elkaar waar nodig en dankzij de veilige en inclusieve werkomgeving waar iedereen zichzelf kan zijn, staan we bekend als een fijne plek om te werken! Dit breng je mee Een afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding, in de richting Bouwkunde, Vastgoedkunde, Vastgoed en Makelaardij, Technische Bedrijfskunde of Real Estate Studies; Je bent minimaal 32 uur per week beschikbaar; Minimaal 5 jaar recente, relevante werkervaring als ontwikkelaar en/of projectontwikkelaar binnen de woningbouw (appartementen). Ruime ervaring in het ontwikkelen van projectlocaties in de provincie Zuid-Holland, waarbij jij ook een sterk netwerk hebt opgebouwd in deze provincie; Als persoon denk je out-of-the-box, kom je met nieuwe initiatieven en neem je de verantwoordelijkheid om duurzaam te ontwikkelen. Je bent op technisch en commercieel vlak creatief ingesteld en communicatief zeer vaardig. Door jouw enthousiasme en duidelijke manier van communiceren weet jij mensen te adviseren en te overtuigen; Tot slot ben jij leergierig, ambitieus en ondernemend. Dit bieden wij jou Het salaris voor deze functie ligt bij een medior profiel tussen € 5.639,- en € 7.049,- bruto per maand (op basis van 40 uur) en bij een senior profiel tussen € 6.512,- en € 9.512,- (op basis van 40 uur), exclusief 8% vakantiegeld. Het exacte salaris is afhankelijk van jouw kennis, niveau en werkervaring. Voor deze functie geldt een individuele bonusregeling, waarbij de hoogte van de bonus afhankelijk is van de behaalde resultaten. Bovenop salaris komt een vast bedrag Budget Duurzame Inzetbaarheid voor zaken die eraan bijdragen gezond en gemotiveerd te blijven (2,3% volgens cao Bouw & Infra). Met oog op een langdurige relatie bieden we je na 2 maanden proeftijd een onbepaalde tijd contract. 43 verlofdagen volgens de cao Bouw & Infra. Van deze dagen worden er 13 uitbetaald in je individuele budget, je kunt ervoor kiezen om deze dagen terug te kopen; Een laptop en een smartphone. Uitstekende secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden zoals een standaardverzekering van alle werknemersrisico's, pensioenregelingen, een extra aanvulling bij arbeidsongeschiktheid en een bijdrage voor het vakbondslidmaatschap. Je hebt de keuze tussen een elektrische leaseauto, een mobiliteitsbudget of NS Business Card. Bij een contract voor onbepaalde tijd kun je een gloednieuwe (elektrische) fiets uitzoeken dankzij onze samenwerking met lease-a-bike. Veel aandacht voor jouw groei dankzij onze eigen Dura Vermeer Academie met volop opleiding- en trainingsmogelijkheden binnen je vakgebied, maar ook op het gebied van vitaliteit. Bedrijfsfitnessregeling met keuze uit een sportaanbod van ruim 3.500 sportlocaties door heel Nederland. Een goede werk-privébalans dankzij een flexibel werken beleid en soepele regelingen voor arbeidsduur, werktijden, calamiteiten, mantelzorg of sabbatical. Voor verse vaders en partners: 100% doorbetaling van je salaris tijdens de 5 weken van het aanvullend geboorteverlof, in plaats van de standaard 70%. Wil jij ook meer uit je werk halen? Dan zijn wij nieuwsgierig naar jou! Solliciteren kan direct via onze website middels de solliciteerbutton onder de vacature. Meer weten? title: Senior Projectmanager
description: Jouw Missie bij CCS Geen dag is hetzelfde in deze rol. Samen met je collega’s zorg je ervoor dat wij succesvol onze softwareoplossingen bij klanten implementeren en dat onze klanten een excellente dienstverlening krijgen! Voor deze complexe systeemimplementaties en integratieprojecten zoeken we een zeer ervaren projectmanager. Je leert de verzekeringsbranche kennen en klanten helpen. Dat doe je niet alleen: je werkt samen met enthousiaste collega’s in een projectteam. Voordelen voor de sollicitant Als projectmanager krijg je veel verantwoordelijkheid, help je klanten en samen met je projectteam zet je mooie resultaten neer. Je kunt deels thuiswerken, deels op ons kantoor in Woerden en bij verschillende klanten in Nederland. Tijdelijk werken vanuit het buitenland kan ook dankzij onze workation-regeling (maximaal 30 dagen aaneengesloten per jaar). Bij ons draait het om klantgericht werken én werkplezier. Daarom is er volop ruimte voor ontspanning en plezier. Denk aan een levend tafelvoetbaltoernooi, pubquiz en een bier- & wijnproeverij. Ons actieve Fun-team zorgt elke maand weer voor iets leuks. En als je reislust nog niet is gestild met 25 vakantiedagen en een workation, dan kun je zelfs tot 20 extra verlofdagen bijkopen. Genoeg redenen om verder te lezen en te ontdekken of deze functie iets voor jou is, toch? Een voorbeeld van je werkdag Opstarten: Aan het begin van je werkdag heb je een dagstart met zowel collega’s als projectteamleden van de klant. Hierin bespreken jullie de voortgang, resultaten en eventuele hulpvragen. Na de dagstart: Allereerst neem je nog wat tijd met een van de consultants naar aanleiding van de dagstart. Je coacht en begeleidt de consultant en helpt deze met een hulpvraag. Vervolgens ga je aan de slag met het opstellen van de voortgangsrapportage. Hiermee zorg je voor proactieve en transparante rapportage over het project aan de klant. De stuurgroep met de klant is volgende week, vandaag spreek je samen met de delivery manager deze stuurgroep voor. Wat zijn de belangrijkste punten voor de klant en voor CCS en hoe vliegen we die aan. Na de lunch: Je checkt nog een paar tickets qua voortgang op het planboard, waarbij je de samenhang met de planning checkt. Vervolgens ga je naar de werksessie met het CCS projectmanagement guild. Hier werken jullie aan tickets om de CCS Prince2Agile projectmethodiek verder te verbeteren. Opdrachtgevers zijn overheden (ministeries, provincies, gemeenten), netbeheerders, energiebedrijven, uitvoeringsorganisaties en woningbouwcorporaties. Daarbij werken we niet alleen voor, maar vooral ook mét onze opdrachtgevers. Een aantal voorbeelden van opdrachten waaraan wij werk(t)en: Het uitdenken en opbouwen van grote nationale uitvoeringsprogramma’s van het Klimaatakkoord, zoals het Nationaal Programma RES, het Nationaal Programma Lokale Warmtetransitie, het Nationaal Plan Energiesysteem, en programma’s rondom hernieuwbare opwek (zon op dak, wind op land, etc.). Het begeleiden van (grote) gemeenten bij het ontwikkelen van een warmte(net)strategie. Het ondersteunen van netbeheerders en provincies bij de ontwikkeling en programmering van het energiesysteem van de toekomst (Energievisies) en het verminderen van netcongestie. Overheden helpen met het opstellen van effectief klimaatbeleid met behulp van prognoses op basis van onze eigen Regionale CO2-routekaart. Het ontwikkelen van een alternatief nettariefstelsel voor netbeheerders, waarmee de netbelasting wordt gespreid en netcongestie wordt beperkt. Overheden helpen met het opstellen en uitvoeren van beleid en plannen om de energietransitie rechtvaardiger te maken (bijvoorbeeld door bestrijding van energiearmoede, de inzet van fix-teams, het sturen op isolatie, etc.) Tijdens jouw stage krijg je de kans om mee te werken aan adviesopdrachten en lever je een bijdrage aan interne projecten, zoals bijvoorbeeld evenementen. title: Senior Mechanical Engineer (OptiArray)
description: As a Senior Mechanical Engineer at Optics11, you are responsible for the development and engineering realization of the OptiArray system. Your primary objective is to develop robust, structural, easy to manufacture solutions that ensure the array can be easily manufactured, deployed, and operated throughout their intended service life. You translate allocated product and system requirements into engineering solutions that provide structural integrity, mechanical robustness, corrosion resistance, manufacturability, and reliable offshore deployment. You work closely with Product System Engineering, Product Integration, Verification & Validation, Lifecycle Engineering, manufacturing partners, offshore contractors, and specialized suppliers to ensure the array is successfully developed and realized as part of the overall product. Key Responsibilities: Develop and realize robust, manufacturable mechanical and structural solutions for the OptiArray system throughout the product development lifecycle. Translate product and system requirements into mechanical designs suitable for offshore deployment and long-term subsea operation. Design and integrate structural components, interfaces, mounting features, lifting arrangements, and corrosion protection solutions into the overall product. Produce engineering drawings, specifications, calculations, interface documentation, and design records. Perform structural engineering analyses and testing, including lifting loads, fatigue, hydrodynamic behavior, environmental loads, and mechanical robustness. Develop and evaluate prototypes and engineering models to validate structural performance and manufacturability. Drive design improvements focused on manufacturability, assembly, maintainability, reliability, and lifecycle performance. Support product integration, verification, qualification, FAT, and industrialization activities, resolving mechanical and structural issues where required. Perform engineering trade-offs considering structural integrity, weight, cost, manufacturability, corrosion resistance, offshore installation, and lifecycle performance. Work closely with fabrication suppliers, offshore contractors, and technical partners to ensure designs can be successfully manufactured, deployed, and operated. Identify technical risks, investigate root causes, and implement effective design improvements and mitigation measures. Provide technical guidance within the marine structures domain and collaborate across engineering disciplines to support sound technical decisions and successful product delivery. Why Join Us? Join one of Europe’s most promising deep-tech scale-ups. Shape the future of a rapidly growing multidisciplinary R&D organization. Competitive salary and benefits package. Enjoy regular team activities and company events. Fresh team lunches provided 5 times / week. Qualifications: BSc or MSc in Mechanical Engineering, Structural Engineering, Marine Engineering, Offshore Engineering, Naval Architecture, or related engineering discipline. Minimum 5 years of experience developing offshore, marine, mechanical, or structural systems. Proficiency in working with SolidWorks or equivalent CAD systems to develop and review mechanical designs, assemblies, engineering drawings, and technical documentation. Experience designing marine products, offshore equipment, or subsea mechanical systems. Experience performing structural calculations, load analysis, fatigue assessment, and mechanical interface design. Experience working with fabrication suppliers and manufacturing partners. Experience working within multidisciplinary product development teams. Strong analytical and structured engineering problem-solving skills. Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English. Eligible to obtain EU/NATO security clearance. Preferred Experience with corrosion protection, cathodic protection, offshore coatings, or subsea structural design. Hands-on experience with SolidWorks for mechanical design, assembly modelling, and detailed production drawings. Experience taking ownership of a system or significant technical workstream within multidisciplinary engineering projects. Familiarity with systems engineering, product lifecycle management, verification, and configuration management. Screening You will work with clients in the defense and security sectors. title: Productowner

Je brengt focus in het team, stimuleert samenwerking en zorgt voor energie tijdens demo's en retrospectives. description: We are looking for someone to join us as an early member of the Web team, to build and own web platforms that turn large amounts of data into products people love to use. High proficiency in TypeScript and Node.js, and in modern web frameworks (React, Next.js…). Strong experience with Postgres and data warehouses (BigQuery, Snowflake, or similar). Solid understanding of data modeling for analytics and for visualizing large volumes of data. A privacy-aware approach to handling sensitive data, such as aggregation and anonymization. Comfortable working autonomously across frontend and backend. Experience with workflow orchestration and long-running processes (Restate, Temporal, or similar) is a big plus. Expertise in map rendering and geospatial data visualization (Mapbox GL, MapLibre, deck.gl , or similar) is a big plus. Experience with WebGL or GPU rendering is a plus. Comfortable working closely with backend and data teams across a polyglot stack is a plus. Knowledge of infrastructure (Bazel, GCP, Kubernetes) is a plus. Passion and experience building great products. We’d love to hear about things you’ve shipped! AI as a multiplier AI is part of how we build every day. The bar We’re looking for exceptional engineers, and we set the bar high on purpose. In return, you’ll get real ownership from day one, products used by millions of people, a team that ships in days rather than quarters, a modern stack with top-tier tooling, and colleagues who will push you to grow. We wanted to make sure coming to the office was as comfortable as possible for you: We chose a location in central Paris, near Opera (Metro lines 3,8,9 and RER A). We have a beautiful Parisian-style office with high ceilings, balconies, and huge windows. So a lot of natural light! Because life outside of work should also be stress-free, we cover: Health care (100% coverage). Maternity Leave, Paternity Leave, Second Parent Leave (salary maintained at 100%). Vacation days: 8-9 weeks (total) per year - (European summer? 🥹😎). 5 weeks of paid time off (by the state); 1-2 additional weeks (RTT, based on our company contract); ~11 bank holidays. We shut down entirely twice a year, two weeks in summer and one week in winter to allow everyone to truly recharge and to avoid prolonged slowdowns (especially in the summer). These pauses are part of your total vacation time, giving everyone a real chance to unplug and recharge. No Slack, no email, no FOMO. Relocation We love the diverse perspectives we get from having people from all over the world join us (68% of our team is international), and so we of course support relocation to Paris with: Help and sponsored visa process. 1 month of Airbnb 100% covered by amo upon arrival. Assistance from a trusted relocation agency to find your permanent home. As our Quantum Hardware Assembly Technician at QuantWare, you are the hands that turn a quantum chip into a working, measurable product. You package our chips into their housing and onto a PCB, and you will assemble and mount the new devices into their cryo fridge in the test facility. Your precision, discipline and reliability directly keep our production and measurement pipelines moving, and ensure our quantum hardware meets the highest quality standards. This is a hands-on execution role . You carry out chip assembly and fridge loading according to technical drawings and documented work instructions (SOPs), to a consistent quality standard and pace, and you record your work in our production systems. You report to the Production Manager , who holds formal line-management responsibility (1:1s, performance reviews, absence and leave). What you'll be doing Core Responsibilities Assemble quantum chips into their packaging , working from technical drawings and work instructions to place and mount the chip in its housing and mount the chip in its housing with the PCB. Make the electrical connections , wirebonding (manual and automatic) will be a significant part of the daily activities, as well as manual soldering. Measure and test your work , performing the defined electrical and mechanical checks and recording the results, so issues are caught before a device moves on. Finish and close the package , including sealing, inspection, laser engraving and preparing for transportation to the measurement location. Safeguard quality , handling fragile, high-value parts with care and following handling and ESD procedures, because a single scratch, particle or ESD event can ruin a chip. Supporting Responsibilities Flag deviations early , stopping and raising it with the Assembly Tech Lead when something does not match the instruction or does not look right, rather than improvising a fix. Help improve how we work , giving practical feedback on work instructions, fixtures and tools while our processes are still maturing. title: Operations & Automation Associate
description: About Nous Nous is a household AI agent. It takes over the bills and admin people don't have time for and acts for them: switching energy, buying insurance, cancelling forgotten subscriptions, managing the family calendar. Nearly 250,000 UK households have signed up, and another joins every minute. We think the real value of AI isn't writing amazing cover letters, it's doing useful things in the real world for real people. That's the hard part, and a brilliant product is only half of it. An energy switch takes weeks, so our agents run on long-running workflows, not a single chat turn. Cancelling a subscription means a browser agent handling the code Apple sends to your phone. Buying insurance meant getting our regulatory principal comfortable with an agent doing it end to end (a UK first), which comes down to knowing exactly when the LLM should hand over to rules because a mistake would cost someone real money. We're about 30 people running one agent across energy, broadband, mobile, insurance, mortgages and subscriptions (with more being added), each with its own suppliers, rules and ways of going wrong. With far more problems than people, a person or small team owns each one end to end, from spotting it in the data or a customer conversation to shipping the fix. And because the agent acts, you find out quickly whether the fix worked. Everyone builds here: a product engineer launched our subscription cancellation product within a couple of months of joining, and a PM rebuilt our WhatsApp agent. And it's working. We're growing more than 20x year on year, with a market-leading NPS above +80, and we manage well over half a billion pounds of household spending. We've raised more than $30M from Heartcore, Mosaic and a who's who of entrepreneurs who founded Monzo, GoCardless, lastminute.com and Onfido. But the real draw is the team - ask anyone here why they joined and you'll get some version of "to do great work with really smart people". The goal is household life that's simpler, cheaper and fairer, and most of that is still to build. The role What Nous does for members can feel simple: helping them understand their bills, save money, and avoid admin. Delivering that reliably at scale is much harder. You’ll join the Operations team at the heart of the business, working on the difficult real-world problems that sit between our members, our product, external suppliers and the systems that make Nous work. This is not a traditional customer operations role. You’ll spend time close to our members, understanding their questions, investigating things that have gone wrong and learning in detail how our service works. We think that matters: the best systems are usually built by people who have seen the underlying problems first-hand. But we don’t want you simply to get faster at doing manual work. We want you to spot the pattern, understand why the problem exists, and help build a better way of doing it. That might mean redesigning a process, building an automation, using AI to remove repetitive work, querying data to understand what is happening, improving an internal tool, or working with Product and Engineering on a more fundamental fix. You don't need to arrive knowing all of the tools we use. We care much more about how quickly you learn them. We’re looking for someone early in their career who is unusually curious, quick to learn and good at figuring things out. You might already have built automations or small products yourself. You might instead have worked in operations, consulting, product, analytics or another demanding environment and found yourself constantly looking for better ways to do things. Either way, we want someone who gets excited by a problem they don't immediately know how to solve. You’ll have a lot of support from experienced operators, engineers and product people, but also be given a lot of responsibility unusually early in your career. The aim is for you to quickly become someone who can take an undefined operational problem, understand it properly and build a robust solution. It’s a rare chance to learn how a fast-growing technology company actually works from the inside while building the systems that allow it to scale. About you You’re smart, curious, ambitious and unusually high-agency. You don't need a long list of technical tools on your CV. We care much more about how you think, how quickly you learn and what you do when you encounter something you don't understand. You’ll probably thrive here if you: Have roughly 1–3 years of experience in a demanding environment such as a startup, operations, consulting, product, analytics or similar Learn unusually quickly and enjoy tackling problems you haven't seen before Are technically curious and actively experiment with AI and new tools to make yourself more effective Have evidence that you like building things, whether that's automations, side projects, spreadsheets, scripts, internal tools, processes or something completely different Are comfortable getting into the detail and tracing a problem until you understand what is really happening Can take something messy and ambiguous and impose structure on it Are naturally empathetic and enjoy understanding what a customer actually needs Communicate clearly and directly Are comfortable working directly with customers and frontline problems, and see that as a source of insight Take ownership rather than waiting to be told exactly what to do This role is ideal for someone early in their career who wants a steep learning curve, real responsibility and the chance to work as part of a team solving difficult problems. title: Analytics Engineer (m/f/d)
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>Allow us to introduce ourselves</strong></p> <p>Hello there! We’re Appinio, a global market research company that combines an AI-powered insights platform with expert consultancy. On a mission to make the world a little more fact-based, we help companies understand how consumers think and make smarter decisions.</p> <p>We started out in Hamburg back in 2014, but we’re now humbled to call the world our playground, with over <strong>260 employees</strong> spread across <strong>13 countries </strong>(we’re remote-first), 2600+ international clients, delivering research from <strong data-stringify-type="bold">+190 markets,</strong> globally.</p> <p>Want to be a part of the Appinio movement? <strong>🚀</strong></p> <p><span data-preserver-spaces="true">Here at Appinio, we value <strong>transparency</strong> <strong>in our recruitment process</strong>, and we've created a blog to share what to expect during each step of our journey together:</span><strong><span data-preserver-spaces="true"><em data-stringify-type="italic"> </em></span><span data-preserver-spaces="true"><a class="c-link c-link--focus-visible" href="https://www.appinio.com/en/blog/life-at-appinio/appinio-recruitment-process" target="_blank" data-stringify-link="https://www.appinio.com/en/blog/life-at-appinio/appinio-recruitment-process" data-sk="tooltip_parent">here</a></span></strong></p></div><div class="role"> <div class="job-ad-editable job-ad-editable job-ad-editor" data-content="6454830"> <p><strong>Your mission as an Analytics Engineer</strong></p> <p>We are looking for an Analytics Engineer (m/f/d) with strong data engineering skills to join our Data team and help build a scalable, reliable, and well-structured data foundation across Appinio.<br>In this role, you will design and maintain clean, scalable data models that make data easy to access, understand, and use across the organisation. You will use SQL, dbt, and Python to transform raw data into meaningful datasets, develop automated workflows, and ensure consistency and reliability across our data warehouse.<br>Beyond data modelling, you will contribute to building, maintaining, and optimising data pipelines and integrations. You will work with APIs, databases, and third-party data sources to ensure reliable data ingestion, troubleshoot pipeline issues, and improve the overall stability and performance of our data infrastructure.<br>Working closely with Analytics, Product, Engineering, and business teams, you will help define and standardise key business metrics such as revenue, bookings, and churn, ensuring a single source of truth across the company. You will also take ownership of data quality through automated testing, validation, and monitoring across the data lifecycle.<br>You will explore and leverage AI-powered tools to improve development workflows, automate repetitive tasks, and enhance data engineering and analytics processes. You will also help prepare our data foundation for AI-driven analytics by ensuring that data models, business definitions, and documentation are structured, consistent, and accessible.<br>You will contribute to documentation, performance optimisation, and the continuous improvement of our data stack, helping us build a robust and scalable data platform that enables teams across Appinio to make faster, more informed decisions.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>What you’ll be doing</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Data Modeling:</strong> Design, build, and maintain clean, scalable data models in the data warehouse using SQL and dbt, making data accessible and reliable for analysts and business users.</li> <li><strong>Data Transformation:</strong> Develop and maintain data transformation workflows, turning raw data from multiple sources into structured, analytics-ready datasets.</li> <li><strong>Data Pipelines & Integration:</strong> Build, maintain, and troubleshoot data pipelines and integrations, ensuring reliable data ingestion from APIs, databases, and third-party systems into the data warehouse.</li> <li><strong>Data Quality & Testing:</strong> Ensure data accuracy and reliability by implementing automated tests, validations, monitoring, and proactive issue resolution across data pipelines and models.</li> <li><strong>Documentation:</strong> Document data models, pipelines, business definitions, and transformation logic to ensure transparency, maintainability, and knowledge sharing.</li> <li><strong>Business Logic Ownership:</strong> Define, implement, and standardize key business metrics (e.g. revenue, bookings, churn) to ensure consistency across reporting and analytics.</li> <li><strong>Collaboration:</strong> Work closely with analysts, business stakeholders, and engineering teams to understand data requirements and deliver reliable, scalable data solutions.</li> <li><strong>Performance & Infrastructure Optimization:</strong> Optimize SQL queries, dbt models, and data pipelines for performance, scalability, and efficient use of data warehouse resources.</li> </ul> <p><strong>You will thrive in this role if</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Strong SQL & Data Modeling Skills:</strong> You have excellent SQL skills and hands-on experience designing, building, and maintaining scalable data models in a modern data warehouse.</li> <li><strong>Experience with dbt: </strong>You have practical experience using dbt to develop, test, document, and maintain reliable data transformation workflows.</li> <li><strong>Data Engineering & Python:</strong> You are proficient in Python and have experience building, maintaining, and troubleshooting data pipelines, including integrations with APIs, databases, and third-party systems.</li> <li><strong>Data Warehousing Knowledge: </strong>You understand modern data warehouse architectures and have experience working with cloud-based solutions such as Amazon Redshift, Snowflake, or BigQuery.</li> <li><strong>Data Quality & Reliability:</strong> You have a strong understanding of data quality principles, automated testing, validation, and monitoring, with a proactive approach to identifying and resolving issues.</li> <li><strong>Business Understanding:</strong> You can translate business requirements into reliable data models and clearly defined metrics, balancing technical quality with practical business needs.</li> <li><strong>Problem-Solving & Ownership:</strong> You are analytical, detail-oriented, and comfortable taking ownership of technical challenges, investigating root causes, and developing sustainable solutions.</li> <li><strong>Collaboration & Communication:</strong> You communicate technical concepts clearly, work effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders, and enjoy collaborating across teams.</li> <li><strong>AI & Automation Mindset:</strong> You are curious about AI-powered development tools and actively explore opportunities to automate repetitive tasks, improve workflows, and increase productivity.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What’s in it for you?</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong><span data-preserver-spaces="true">Flexibility</span><span data-preserver-spaces="true"> Policy</span></strong><span data-preserver-spaces="true"> - Average is 30 days taken, however, we do not have a hard cap of number of vacation days as we know life happens</span></li> <li><strong><span data-preserver-spaces="true">Temporary work from abroad - </span></strong><span data-preserver-spaces="true">If you're based in the EU, you can work outside your country of residence for up to 180 days per year</span></li> <li><span data-preserver-spaces="true">All the hardware you need and </span><strong><span data-preserver-spaces="true">your own MacBook</span></strong></li> <li><span data-preserver-spaces="true">If you are located in Hamburg or Berlin, you'll get a </span><strong><span data-preserver-spaces="true">Deutschland ticket</span></strong><span data-preserver-spaces="true"> or access to a mobility budget with the </span><strong><span data-preserver-spaces="true">NAVIT app</span></strong><span data-preserver-spaces="true"> to get you to and from the office space</span></li> <li>Subsidised <strong>Urban Sports Club </strong>or <strong>ClassPass</strong> membership based on location</li> <li><span data-preserver-spaces="true">In case</span><span data-preserver-spaces="true"> you’re located in one of the cities where most of our fellow Appinioneers are (Hamburg, Berlin, Munich, London, Madrid, Barcelona, or New York), you can get access to our </span><strong><span data-preserver-spaces="true">Co-working spaces</span></strong></li> </ul> <p><strong><span data-preserver-spaces="true">Additional role details</span></strong></p> <ul> <li>This is a <strong>fully remote position</strong> open to candidates based in Germany, the UK, Portugal, the Netherlands, and Spain</li> <li>This role will report directly to our Team Lead, Business Intelligence</li> </ul> <p><strong><span data-preserver-spaces="true">Our interview process</span></strong></p> <ul> <li>Screening Call with the Talent Acquisition team</li> <li>Hiring Manager interview</li> <li>Case Study </li> <li>Executive Interview</li> <li>References</li> </ul> title: Software Engineer (Java) - Logistics
description: <section class="section vacancy-detail-intro-section"> <div class="section-inner"> <div class="entry-intro"> <h2><strong>In a nutshell</strong></h2> <p>Our Java teams in the Logistics domain make sure that our products travel all the way from the suppliers in our electronic vehicles, and arrive at our customers’ houses with a smile. From optimizing our routes, to making our drivers’ lives easier, to planning and executing all inbound and outbound products: there’s a wide range of products to work on. Through designing, developing, and testing new features, or improving the scalability and security of our platform: you’ll be owning a product together with your team, while finding yourself fully immersed in an engaging scaleup culture.  </p> <h2><strong>Tricks of the trade</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Ownership</strong>: Take ownership of projects from concept to delivery, aligning technical solutions with business goals with a product engineering mindset</li> <li><strong>Problem solving</strong>: You see a problem, you tackle it with technology - with your users always in mind</li> <li><strong>Contribution</strong>: Design, test, evolve, and evaluate the systems that underpin our Logistics operations, offering a creative and analytical approach</li> <li><strong>Our Tech: </strong>Java 21/25 (Spring 6 with Spring Boot 3.5, Reactor, Immutables, Maven), React, Angular, RabbitMQ, Kafka, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Git, Docker, AWS, Helm, Terraform, Kubernetes, Vault, Datadog, Python 3.x</li> </ul> <h2><strong>We’re looking for</strong></h2> <ul> <li>You have a Master’s Degree (in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Information Technology, Computer Engineering or a related technical field) or equivalent experience.</li> <li>You have a product mindset: you own and solve business problems through tech</li> <li>You have 1-5 years of professional experience in programming and software development</li> <li>You have a profound understanding of software development principles and are ready to have hands on backend and frontend alike</li> <li>Your English skills are on point (no Dutch required)</li> <li>You're based in or happy to relocate to the Netherlands*</li> </ul> <p>* We work from our office in Amsterdam. Being present makes a genuine difference to your team and the work. There's flexibility to work from home when needed, but if remote or hybrid-first is what you're after, this probably isn't the right fit.</p> <p><strong>Please send your CV in English for complete consideration.</strong></p> <h2><strong>Picnic Perks</strong></h2> <p><strong>✍🏼 Mastery is a journey! </strong></p> <p>You’ll get plenty of opportunities to challenge yourself and grow, including the Picnic Tech Academy, Lunch & Learn sessions, and tailored soft skills training.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>💡 Make a difference</strong></p> <p>You will work on real-world problems, seeing the impact of your work every day in our warehouses and in our satisfied customers. Plus, our fully electric vehicles and sustainable business model mean you’ll also be contributing to making the world a better place! </p> <p> </p> <p><strong>🫱🏼‍🫲🏾 Teamwork makes the dream work</strong></p> <p>With more than 80 nationalities across 3 countries, you’ll be part of a diverse company with plenty of cool stuff to get involved with, from board game evenings, to after-work drinks, to our company ski trip and more!</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>🍎 You are what you eat</strong></p> <p>You’ll get freshly prepared, healthy lunches and snacks (with plenty of vegetarian, vegan, and halal options). Coffee snob? Don’t worry, our amazing Picnic barista has you covered.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>🚴🏽 Stay healthy </strong></p> <p>Mental health is important. As well as having the option to speak with Picnic colleagues who act as confidential advisors, our collaboration with OpenUp gives you easy access to professional psychologists, along with workshops and materials. There are plenty of sports communities and events to get involved with, from tennis to yoga, to climbing! </p> <p> </p> <p><strong>🔋 Attractive package</strong></p> <p>We offer competitive compensation and a pension plan that looks out for your future self, as well as 25 vacation days per year, so you can recharge your batteries </p> <p> </p> <p><strong>🌍 Benefits for expats </strong></p> <p>It can be daunting starting a new job AND moving to a new country. That’s why we offer lots of support for our many expat colleagues, if you want to find our relocation benefits, see <a href="https://jobs.picnic.app/en/relocation">here</a>.</p> </div> </div> </section> Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Graduate Operations Supervisor (m/w/d)
description: <h2><strong>Kurz und knapp</strong></h2> <p>Du hast dein Studium in der Tasche, sprühst vor Energie und willst nicht nur zuschauen, sondern echte Verantwortung übernehmen?<br><br>Bei Picnic startest du direkt in einer Führungsrolle durch! Als Graduate Operations Supervisor (m/w/d) in unserem Fulfillment Center (FC) in <strong>Kabelsketal</strong> bist du der Motor des Standorts. Unterstützt von Investoren wie der <em>Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation</em> bauen wir gemeinsam das modernste, 100 % elektrische Liefersystem Europas.</p> <p><iframe src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/o1FOzeb4YYs" width="560" height="314"></iframe></p> <h2><strong>Das erwartet dich </strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Teamleitung: </strong>Du bist Coach und Vorbild – mit deinem echten, intrinsischen Interesse an Menschen führst und inspirierst du dein Team aus 3 Teamleitenden und über 30 Lagermitarbeitenden.</li> <li><strong>Schichtleitung: </strong>Im FC behältst du stets den Überblick, priorisierst Aufgaben im Tagesgeschäft und sorgst dafür, dass jede Bestellung pünktlich rausgeht.</li> <li><strong>Abwechslung:</strong> Du erlebst den perfekten Mix aus Action direkt auf der Lagerfläche (3–4 Tage pro Woche) und strategischem Deep Dive im FC Office (1–2 Tage pro Woche).</li> <li><strong>Prozessoptimierung: </strong>Stillstand gibt es bei uns nicht. Du hast Ideen? Hier entwickelst du eigene Logistikprojekte und hebst unsere Abläufe durch deinen Tatendrang aufs nächste Level.</li> <li><strong>Ownership:</strong> Du hast Lust, Verantwortung zu übernehmen, auch wenn Dinge mal außerhalb deines unmittelbaren Bereichs liegen. Du schaust über den Tellerrand hinaus und nimmst die Dinge proaktiv selbst in die Hand.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Das bringst du mit</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Ein abgeschlossenes Studium (Bachelor oder Master) in Logistikmanagement, Supply Chain Management, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen oder einem vergleichbaren Bereich.</li> <li>Du brennst für die Logistik und bringst idealerweise erste Einblicke aus dem Lagerbereich mit (z. B. durch Praktika oder ein Werkstudium).</li> <li>Du kommunizierst sicher auf Deutsch & Englisch und bringst die nötige Flexibilität für die Arbeit in zwei Schichten (6:00 – 14:30 Uhr & 14:30 – 23:00 Uhr, auch samstags) mit.</li> <li>Ein extrem hohes Maß an Eigenantrieb. Du siehst Dinge von selbst, nimmst sie proaktiv in die Hand und übernimmst Verantwortung – auch über deinen eigenen Tellerrand hinaus.</li> <li>Ein echtes, intrinsisches Interesse an Menschen. Du bist empathisch, nahbar und liebst es, dein Team zu motivieren und weiterzuentwickeln.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Darauf kannst du dich freuen</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Starte durch - mit uns:</strong> Werde Teil unseres internationalen Teams in einem Umfeld, das echtes Wachstum und eine „Act like an Owner“-Mentalität fördert. Bei uns hast du die Chance, Projekte eigenverantwortlich voranzutreiben, neue Ideen zu testen und direkt miterleben zu können, wie deine Arbeit in unserem schnell wachsenden Unternehmen Wirkung zeigt.</li> <li><strong>Nachhaltigkeit als Kern:</strong> Werde Teil der Revolution. Du trägst zu einer grüneren Zukunft bei – durch unsere 100 % elektrische Flotte und eine Lieferkette, die Lebensmittelverschwendung reduziert.</li> <li><strong>Die Basics:</strong> Wir stellen dir alles für deinen Erfolg bereit – inklusive Laptop und Handy sowie Zugang zu exklusiven Mitarbeiter-Rabatten (Corporate Benefits) für Reisen, Technik und vieles mehr.</li> <li><strong>Zeit zum Auftanken:</strong> Mit 30 Urlaubstagen pro Jahr (bei einer 40-Stunden-Woche) sorgst du für den perfekten Ausgleich zwischen Arbeit und Erholung.</li> <li><strong>Verpflegung für Gewinner:</strong> Wir kümmern uns um dich. Genieße jeden Tag ein frisches, kostenloses Frühstück, Mittag- und Abendessen in unserem Fulfilment Center, dazu gibt es reichlich Snacks und Obst für den Energiekick zwischendurch.</li> <li><strong>Unvergessliche Momente:</strong> Wir sind mehr als nur ein Team. Von unserem legendären jährlichen Ski-Trip über Weihnachtsfeiern bis hin zu Auftritten unserer eigenen Picnic-Band: Wir feiern unsere Erfolge gemeinsam.</li> <li><strong>Individuelle Mobilität:</strong> Du erhältst einen Firmenwagen (auch zur privaten Nutzung) und kostenlose Parkplätze an den Picnic Standorten stehen dir zur Verfügung.</li> <li><strong>Lebensmittelretter:</strong> Hol dir unsere exklusiven "Too-Good-To-Go"-Tüten und rette leckere Lebensmittel – nur für unsere Mitarbeitenden!</li> <li><strong>Lerne & wachse:</strong> Profitiere von internen Lern- & Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten durch spannende Workshops und intensive Bootcamps, um deine Skills ständig zu erweitern.</li> <li><strong>Absicherung für morgen:</strong> Wir unterstützen dich mit einem überdurchschnittlichen Zuschuss zur Betrieblichen Altersvorsorge, damit du auch an später denkst.</li> </ul> Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

Over 40,000 buyers from more than 20 countries trade on our platform — and 85% of inventory is exclusive to us. We connect software, pricing intelligence, logistics and financing in one layer — as the operating system for an entire industry.</p> <p><em><strong>One Platform. One Profit Engine.</strong></em></p> <h3> </h3> <h3>The platform you build in</h3> <p>Our machine learning runs on one shared, central platform — not a separate pipeline per model. Five canonical stages: data extraction, validation, transformation, training and evaluation. A Snowflake data warehouse feeds a SageMaker managed feature store, and models reach production through governed CI/CD promotion lanes on Terraform-managed AWS infrastructure. Your job is to build inside it and make it stronger, so the next model costs less to ship than the last one.</p> <h3> </h3> <h3>Your responsibilities</h3> <ul> <li>You own models from handoff through to production: packaging, deployment, monitoring, and the decision on whether a model is ready to serve</li> <li>You keep production models reliable — drift detection, performance monitoring, alerting and incident response when something moves</li> <li>You own the serving and inference path: fitted pipeline artifacts, inference entry points, monitoring hooks and feature-store parity</li> <li>You review model design and evaluation methodology before anything ships, and catch data leakage, backward-window errors and weak evaluation during development, while they are still cheap to fix</li> <li>You extend the shared platform so it stays useful for every model, without project-specific logic leaking into shared code</li> <li>You set the engineering standards the platform runs on as it scales across the organisation</li> </ul> <h3> </h3> <h3>What you bring</h3> <ul> <li>4+ years in production machine learning engineering, with real ownership of models after handoff — not only training them</li> <li>Strong Python: typed, tested, production-grade code, and you review the work of others</li> <li>Enough machine learning depth to challenge a pipeline on problem framing, feature engineering, model selection and evaluation methodology</li> <li>Hands-on experience with a managed ML platform — SageMaker, Vertex AI, Databricks or Azure ML — plus feature stores, CI/CD for machine learning, AWS and Terraform</li> <li>An AI-native way of working: you use tools like Claude, ChatGPT or Copilot actively in your daily work</li> <li>English at C1 level, written and spoken. German is not required — we work in English</li> </ul> <p><strong>Nice to have</strong></p> <ul> <li>Snowflake and dbt — you can pick both up here</li> <li>Experience mentoring colleagues or reviewing their work</li> <li>Comfort operating where the answer is not defined yet</li> </ul> <h3>What to expect from us</h3> <ul> <li>Hybrid working: 3 days in office, 2 days remote – plus 25 "Work from Anywhere" days per year</li> <li>28 days annual leave</li> <li>2× annual career & development conversations</li> <li>Company pension with 20% employer contribution</li> <li>Fully paid Deutschlandticket (public transport)</li> <li>FitX membership or Urban Sports Club subsidy</li> <li>Virtual stock options — share in the upside</li> <li>Modern IT setup for your day-to-day work</li> <li>Structured onboarding with buddy programme and social events</li> <li>Lived diversity: active women's network, meditation & prayer room</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Apply now — your CV is enough.</strong></p> Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Backend Engineer (Golang) - Draft Showdown
description: About Voodoo Voodoo is a consumer tech company founded in Paris in 2013, with one mission: entertain the world. Today we are 1,000 people, generating $1b+ in annual revenue, profitably. Our games and apps have passed 7 billion downloads and reach 200 million+ active users every month, making Voodoo the #3 mobile publisher worldwide in downloads, after Google and Meta. We were backed by Goldman Sachs, Tencent and GBL along the way. This position is Paris-based, with relocation support available. Team For this position, you will be an integral part of a newly established internal studio, a dynamic and focused team dedicated to one of our most promising prototype in scale. This studio is specifically chartered to improve this high-potential game up to the successful and market-ready title it is meant to become. You will be part of the team building Draft Showdown, a turn-based multiplayer game, working alongside its client engineers and game designers as a full member of the game team. You will be part of a small group owning the backend that this game needs as its requirements become more specific and demanding. You’ll also be plugged into Voodoo's shared gaming backend platform - the same architecture and patterns that power titles like Mob Control and Block Jam 3D - building on it and contributing back, in close collaboration with the wider backend team. You get the focus and ownership of a dedicated game engineer with the leverage and support of a battle-tested platform behind you. This is a pivotal hire: Draft Showdown is moving towards competitive multiplayer, which means moving game logic from the client to the server. They are also implementing cheat detection safeguards to the game. You will be central to that transition. Role You will design and build the server-side foundation that takes Draft Showdown from a client-authoritative game to a competitive, server-validated one. The current game computes everything on the device - progression, economy, and match outcomes alike, which won't hold up for competitive PvP. Your job is to change that. Working closely with client developers and game designers from feature design through delivery, validation and iteration, you will: Build server-side validation for the metagame - currency, card upgrades, chest opens, and progression - staged by risk, replicating economy and reward logic on the server. Move toward server authority for competitive features, where game state lives in one place and can be trusted. Implement and improve matchmaking and cheat detection safeguards for a Deterministic lockstep PvP architecture Design APIs and player-state management that the Unity client integrates against, and help shape how client and server split responsibilities. The responsibilities are cross-functional, ranging from infrastructure, API design & coding all the way to client-side integration (we are using Golang). To succeed in this role, you will need to have passion for everything you do. You love to write code that scales to millions of users, are skilled at requirements gathering, champion new tech initiatives & leverage existing solutions. Profile 5+ years of backend development experience Strong knowledge of computer science fundamentals Extreme fluency in Golang (at least 1 year in a professional environment) Mastery of SQL and NoSQL Background in high-scale systems Understanding of Unix-like environments AI-first mindset: Comfortable using AI daily and building custom agents or reusable automations to speed up your work Experience working in cross-functional agile teams Strong analytical skills with a track record of solving complex problems related to scalability, performance, and integration in high-stakes environments. Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, capable of influencing teams and interfacing effectively with various stakeholders. Ability to be self sufficient and work autonomously. A deep interest in game development is a plus. Based or willing to relocate in Paris Benefits Best-in-class compensation Other benefits according to the country you reside Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow
