title: IT-Support-Spezialist (m/w/d)
description: Dein Einstieg bei Deeken Technology Du hilfst gern, behältst auch bei kniffligen Problemen die Ruhe und erklärst Technik so, dass sie jeder versteht? Dann bist du bei uns richtig. Deeken Technology ist ein etabliertes IT-Systemhaus aus dem Oldenburger Münsterland - seit über 10 Jahren am Markt, mit einem motivierten und engagierten Team. Wir betreuen mittelständische Unternehmen ganzheitlich: IT-Infrastruktur, IT-Sicherheit, Digitalisierung und Telekommunikation. Dabei verkaufen wir keine Einmal-Lösungen, sondern sind langfristiger IT-Partner unserer Kunden - wir kennen ihre Systeme, ihre Abläufe und ihre Ansprechpartner. Für unser Team in unseren neuen Büros im ecopark Emstek suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt einen Systemadministrator (m/w/d) als Support-Spezialist - unbefristet, in Vollzeit mit 39 Stunden und hybrid. Deine Aufgaben Als Support-Spezialist bist du die freundliche und kompetente Stimme von Deeken Technology für alle Anwender unserer Kunden. Du kümmerst dich um sämtliche IT-Support-Anliegen - und sorgst dafür, dass niemand mit seinem Problem allein bleibt. - Du bist im First- und Second-Level-Support die erste Anlaufstelle: Du nimmst Anfragen telefonisch entgegen und löst sie nach Möglichkeit direkt im ersten Gespräch. - Du bearbeitest schriftliche Anfragen per E-Mail über unsere Service-Plattform Hindeo. - Du analysierst Probleme gemeinsam mit den Anwendern per Fernwartung und findest Lösungen. - Bei Bedarf besprichst du Supportthemen in kurzen Teams-Meetings direkt mit unseren Kunden. - Du gibst Anwendern Tipps, wie sie ihre Systeme besser und sicherer nutzen. - Du stellst die Erreichbarkeit unseres Supports sicher, dokumentierst sauber in Hindeo und gibst komplexe Themen strukturiert an unsere Spezialisten weiter. - Erkennst du beim Kunden Bedarf, übergibst du die Vertriebschance an unsere Kollegen im IT-Vertrieb. Das bringst du mit Verlässlichkeit ist uns extrem wichtig: Wenn du etwas zusagst, hältst du es ein. Dazu kommunizierst du klar und freundlich - am Telefon genauso wie schriftlich - und übernimmst Verantwortung für die Anliegen unserer Kunden. - Eine abgeschlossene IT-Ausbildung, z. B. als Fachinformatiker für Systemintegration, oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation - Erfahrung im IT-Support oder Service Desk, idealerweise in einem Systemhaus - Ein gutes Grundverständnis in einem möglichst breiten Spektrum: Microsoft 365, Nextcloud, Terminalserver, Drucker, Smartphones, Tablets und Thin Clients - Sicherer Umgang mit Fernwartungs-Tools und Ticketsystemen - Freude am Kontakt mit Menschen, Geduld und eine lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise - auch wenn es mal hektisch wird, behältst du den Überblick - Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift Du erfüllst nicht jeden Punkt zu 100 Prozent, aber passt menschlich und fachlich im Kern? Dann bewirb dich trotzdem - wir sprechen lieber einmal mehr miteinander. Warum Deeken Technology - Dein eigener Firmenwagen: Nach der Probezeit stellen wir dir einen Firmenwagen zur Verfügung. - Dein Fitnessstudio-Abo: Für deinen Ausgleich zum Job bekommst du von uns ein Fitnessabo. - Dein perfekter Support-Arbeitsplatz: Cloud-Telefonie-Arbeitsplatz, mehrere Monitore, Firmenlaptop, Firmenhandy und modernste Ausstattung - alles, was du für einen reibungslosen Support brauchst. - Software, die wir selbst bauen: Wir arbeiten mit Hindeo, unserer eigenen IT-Service-Plattform. In den letzten zwölf Monaten komplett neu entwickelt, gehört sie zu den modernsten Lösungen für Systemhäuser - und dein Feedback aus dem Support fließt direkt in die Weiterentwicklung ein. - Sicherheit mit Anspruch: Als eines der wenigen IT-Unternehmen der Region sind wir nach ISO 27001 zertifiziert. Du arbeitest nach Standards, auf die du stolz sein kannst. - Deine Perspektive: Im Support lernst du die gesamte IT-Landschaft unserer Kunden kennen. Mit Weiterbildungen und Herstellerschulungen kannst du dich bei uns gezielt weiterentwickeln - bis hin zum Spezialisten in einem unserer Fachbereiche. - Neues Büro im ecopark: Knapp 500 m² im OM-Medienhaus - hell, klimatisiert, mit kontrollierter Belüftung, barrierefrei und mit Mensa im Haus. Getränke, Snacks und ein frischer Obstkorb stehen für dich bereit. - Ankommen ohne Stress: Kostenlose Parkplätze direkt am Haus. Für Elektrofahrzeuge stehen E-Ladesäulen bereit. - Hybrid & flexibel: Flexible Arbeitszeiten, Home-Office-Ausstattung und nach der Einarbeitung ein Tag mobiles Arbeiten pro Woche. - Extras: Edenred und Mitarbeiterrabatte. - Familie & Beruf: Über die Kita-Kooperation im ecopark stehen in einem benachbarten Kindergarten reservierte Plätze für Kinder von Beschäftigten im ecopark zur Verfügung. - Sicherheit & Miteinander: Unbefristeter Vertrag, 28 Urlaubstage, flache Hierarchien, kurze Entscheidungswege, lockerer Dresscode sowie gemeinsame Teamevents - vom Stoppelmarkt über das Cityfest bis zur Weihnachtsfeier. Deine ersten Monate - Ankommen: Du lernst dein Team, unsere Prozesse, Hindeo und unsere ISO-27001-Standards kennen und bearbeitest deine ersten Supportfälle an der Seite erfahrener Kollegen. - Loslegen: Schritt für Schritt übernimmst du eigene Anfragen am Telefon und per E-Mail und lernst die Umgebungen unserer Kunden kennen. - Verantwortung übernehmen: Nach der Einarbeitung bist du für die Anwender unserer Kunden die erste Anlaufstelle - und sorgst dafür, dass ihre Anliegen zuverlässig gelöst werden. Klingt nach dir? Dann bewirb dich über den Button - ein Lebenslauf reicht für den Anfang. Versprochen: Innerhalb von 3 Werktagen bekommst du eine persönliche Rückmeldung von uns. title: Stage assistant chef de projet évènementiel (H/F/X) - Lyon
description: Le stage se déroulera au sein du service Sensibilisation-Communication de Handicap International, au siège de Lyon, du 1er avril au 30 septembre 2027. Il contribuera à la préparation et à l’animation des Pyramides de chaussures 2027, ainsi qu’à l’organisation d’autres événements de l’association.Les Pyramides de chaussures c’est le temps fort de sensibilisation et de mobilisation citoyenne pour Handicap International. Depuis plus de 30 ans, tous les citoyens, scolaires, salariés d’entreprises, sympathisants de Handicap International ou encore politiques sont invités à venir : - Lancer leurs chaussures pour témoigner de leur soutien aux causes portées par Handicap International, la chaussure symbole du poids de l’engagement citoyen pour protéger les civils ; - S’informer à travers une exposition interactive, ludique et pédagogique sur Handicap International, ses champs d’intervention et ses combats ; - Rencontrer et échanger avec nos experts terrain. Pour en savoir plus sur les Pyramides : https://www.handicap-international.fr/fr/pyramides-de-chaussures Le stage associe coordination événementielle, relations avec les partenaires et prestataires, recrutement et animation de la communauté de bénévoles, préparation de supports et de matériel, animation et participation aux événements. En complément, nous vous invitons à prendre connaissance des actions de sensibilisation et mobilisation en consultant : l’Espace du bénévolat et de la sensibilisation pour Handicap International . La mission se déroulera du 1e avril au 30 septembre 2027 (6 mois). Vos missions sont les suivantes Activité 1 : Vous appuyez l’organisation et la coordination des Pyramides de chaussures de Villeurbanne et Paris avec · La participation à la conception et à la logistique opérationnelle des Pyramides (scénographies, matériel, présence sur événement, montage/démontage). · L’appui au recrutement, à l’animation et au suivi des bénévoles, ainsi qu’à leur formation et fidélisation. · La coordination de la Journée des Scolaires et l’organisation des visites guidées pour tous les publics. · La recherche de prestataires. · La contribution aux bilans : recueillir les retours des équipes et partenaires, documenter les résultats et proposer des améliorations pour les prochaines éditions. Activité 2 : Vous participez à l’organisation d’autres événements de Handicap International · Congrès des Notaires : contribuer à la définition et à l’adaptation des messages clés, à la conception du stand et du parcours de sensibilisation, à la préparation des supports, du matériel et d’un kit d’animation, ainsi qu’à l’organisation. · Vœux 2028 : participer à la recherche et à la sélection d’un lieu insolite adapté à l’événement, imaginer des propositions d’animation et contribuer à l’identification, à la consultation et au suivi des prestataires. · Plus largement, apporter un appui à la coordination, à la logistique et au suivi des événements transversaux de l’Association Nationale France. Activité 3 – Participer à la vie quotidienne du service Sensibilisation-Communication · Contribuer à la gestion de boîtes mail et au suivi des sollicitations, au suivi d’actions solidaires et à la préparation de nouvelles actions ou événements de mobilisation. · Contribuer à l'animation et au déploiement du défi de Damien Seguin pour l'inclusion et la solidarité internationale, avec un focus sur le volet scolaire : mobilisation et accompagnement des établissements scolaires, diffusion des outils pédagogiques, appui à l'organisation d'actions de sensibilisation et de défis solidaires, suivi des établissements participants et valorisation de leurs initiatives. ACCESSIBILITE DU LIEU DE TRAVAIL : Le poste est situé en Open Space, des box sont mis à disposition pour plus de calme si nécessaire et l’espace de travail est très lumineux. Le poste est facilement accessible en transports en commun (bus, métro). Un parking est également à disposition. Concernant le bâtiment, des ascenseurs et des rampes d'accès sont mis en place. Requirements Profil recherché: - Vous êtes en formation en gestion de projet évènementiel - Vous avez une première expérience dans la gestion de projet évènementielle - vous avez une aisance relationnelle avérée (public adulte et enfants) - Vous avez un excellent niveau en français à l’écrit ainsi qu’à l’oral - Une expérience dans le bénévolat serait la bienvenue Benefits CONDITIONS Duree: 6 mois Type de contrat: Stage Salaire: - Gratification mensuelle de 693€ - Tickets restaurant d’une valeur faciale de 8,96 euros (60 % à la charge de l’employeur, 40% à votre charge) - Participation de 50% à votre abonnement au titre des transports - Des déplacements sont à prévoir - De nombreuses activités sportives et sociales sont proposées dans nos locaux Vous devez disposer d’une convention de stage obligatoire délivrée par un établissement d’enseignement ou de formation français. Les stages proposés chez HI donnent l’occasion aux étudiants d’évoluer dans une organisation internationale et de prendre part à l’action d’Humanité & Inclusion. Nous considérons que les stagiaires pour qui l’expérience s’est bien passée sont nos talents de demain ! Merci d’envoyer votre CV et Lettre de motivation à : ----- Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Ingénieur Conception & Instrumentation - Équipements et bancs d’essais (H/F)
description: Ingénieur Conception & Instrumentation – Équipements et bancs d’essais (H/F) À propos de notre client Notre client est une TPE basée au nord de Lyon, spécialisée dans les énergies du sous-sol : pétrole, gaz, géothermie et stockage de CO2. Son activité repose entièrement sur la R&D : essais sur géomatériaux, géomécanique et développement d'équipements d'essais pour des clients internationaux. Son équipe pluridisciplinaire et multiculturelle développe des solutions technologiques innovantes au service de l'efficacité, de la protection de l'environnement et de la maîtrise des coûts. L'entreprise est certifiée ISO 9001 et toutes ses activités respectent sa démarche QHSE. Le poste Votre rôle : mettre au point de véritables méthodes d’essai. À partir d’un besoin de mesure (température, pression, déplacement, déformation, ultrasons…), vous concevez, instrumentez et validez des cellules d’essais haute température et haute pression. Vous commencez par fiabiliser une cellule existante : simplifier son montage et son démontage, puis la valider à plus haute température. Vous lancez ensuite les cellules suivantes. Vous travaillez avec l’équipe qui conçoit aujourd’hui les équipements, et avec le bureau d’études d’un fabricant partenaire qui réalise la conception détaillée et les plans de fabrication. Environ 70-80 % conception et développement, 20-30 % laboratoire. Rattachement à la direction des opérations. Ce que le poste n’est pas : ni dessinateur ou calculateur (le détail et les plans sont externalisés), ni management d’équipe. Vos missions Définir le besoin, le cahier des charges et le pré-dimensionnement fonctionnel de nouvelles cellules. Choisir les capteurs adaptés et les intégrer ; résoudre les enjeux d’étanchéité, de tenue en température et en pression. Consulter fournisseurs et sous-traitants, suivre la fabrication des pièces. Monter, instrumenter et tester vous-même vos équipements au laboratoire ; interpréter les mesures et améliorer. Améliorer l’ergonomie des équipements existants et transférer les équipements validés à l’équipe d’essais. Rédiger la documentation technique et contribuer à la protection de la propriété intellectuelle. Requirements Indispensable Conception mécanique d’équipements, avec une CAO 3D (aucun logiciel imposé). Instrumentation, capteurs et techniques de mesure physique et physico-chimique : choisir et intégrer, pas fabriquer. Goût du terrain : vous aimez monter, démonter et intervenir vous-même sur les équipements. Important Gestion de projet : planning, budget, fournisseurs. Rigueur, autonomie, communication proactive des difficultés. Un plus Anglais technique (échanges écrits avec des fournisseurs étrangers). Mise en plan, notions de matériaux et d’isolation thermique. Expérience en pression ou température. Formation et expérience Diplôme d’ingénieur (bac +5) en mécanique, génie physique, instrumentation ou mesures physiques. Un parcours associant mécanique et mesures physiques (BUT Mesures physiques puis école d’ingénieurs en mécanique) est particulièrement apprécié. Environ 5 ans d’expérience en conception d’équipements, bureau d’études ou R&D ; profils plus juniors étudiés. Poste orienté conception et terrain : une thèse n’est pas requise. Conditions Sur site. Manutention occasionnelle de pièces métalliques lourdes avec moyens de levage. Intéressement Rémunération : 36 – 48 k€ brut annuel selon expérience Benefits Vous rejoindrez une entreprise à taille humaine où chaque développement compte : vos équipements seront directement utilisés pour des projets de R&D menés pour des clients internationaux. Vous travaillerez au sein d'une équipe dynamique et multiculturelle, sur des sujets techniques exigeants au service des énergies du sous-sol et de la transition énergétique. title: Senior Product Designer - Move-in & Staying
description: We're on a mission to become the go-to destination for students across Europe to find a trusted home away from home. We make every step of the rental journey simple and seamless, so students can focus on what really matters: studying, exploring, and growing. With HousingAnywhere, Kamernet, and Studapart under our roof, we're Europe's largest student rental platform. You'll find us in Rotterdam, Paris, and Cergy, always guided by our four core values: Ownership, We are enablers, We are changemakers, and We are connectors. Your role Help people find their next home with absolute certainty. Moving to a new country is an adventure, but finding a home shouldn't be the hardest part. At HousingAnywhere, we're revolutionizing renting by building a platform that helps people confidently rent a home abroad. Design isn't here to polish screens. It's here to shape the product. We are looking for a Senior Product Designer to own the Listing & Finding experience. You will define what discovering a home feels like: fast, relevant, trustworthy, and human. As the design owner for one of the most important journeys in our marketplace, you will: Shape the long-term vision for the search and discovery experience. Lead projects from early discovery through launch and iteration. Use qualitative research, behavioural data, and experimentation to make decisions, not opinions. Define success, measure impact, and continuously improve your solutions. Raise the quality bar across the design team through thoughtful critique and craft. Contribute to our design principles, design system, and the way we build the product. Your team Collaborate deeply. Design with absolute purpose. You'll work alongside Product, Engineering, Research, and Data as an equal partner to challenge assumptions, validate ideas, and turn ambiguity into a product that genuinely improves people's lives. We move fast, we think ahead, and we focus on what our audience truly needs. You'll have the freedom to influence your team's strategy in an environment that values: Elegant interaction design and meaningful micro-interactions Clear design principles and consistent systems Accessible experiences Quality over shortcuts Shipping fast matters. Shipping something we're proud of matters even more. If you thrive on autonomy and solving complex puzzles, we want to hear from you. Your profile At least 7+ years of experience designing complex digital products. Strong product thinking and problem framing skills. Excellent interaction and visual design craft. Experience in marketplaces, search or discovery products. Experience running discovery and validating ideas. Confidence working with data, metrics and experiments. Experience collaborating closely with engineers and product managers. A portfolio showing not only what you designed – but why. What's in it for you Unlimited paid holidays, minimum-based not maximum! Position based in our Rotterdam office with hybrid working policy (2 office days). Gym membership discount with GoVital or OneFit. Dutch/English classes budget. Variable pension scheme. Diverse international community (46+ nationalities). Pet-friendly office in Rotterdam city centre. Team-building events and after-work drinks every Friday. What can you expect from our hiring process? Read more here . title: Inside Solutions Engineer
description: <p>BeyondTrust is a place where you can bring your purpose to life through the work that you do, creating a safer world through our cybersecurity SaaS portfolio.</p> <p>Our culture of flexibility, trust, and continual learning means you will be recognized for your growth, and for the impact you make on our success. You will be surrounded by people who challenge, support, and inspire you to be the best version of yourself.</p> <p><u>The Role</u></p> <p>As an Inside Solutions Engineer, you will collaborate with sales representatives and partners to showcase the value of BeyondTrust’s products, services, and solutions. Acting as a technical specialist within the sales cycle, you will provide foundational support to highlight the capabilities of the BeyondTrust suite. This role is ideal for individuals looking to develop their technical expertise and customer-facing skills in a supportive, team-oriented environment.</p> <p><u>What You’ll Do</u></p> <ul> <li>Assist with marketing campaigns, including webinars and product demonstrations.</li> <li>Support lead qualification by validating technical environments and understanding business problems.</li> <li>Contribute to RFP/RFI responses, ensuring accurate and timely submissions.</li> <li>Participate in discovery and opportunity engagement by conducting background research, qualifying questions, and understanding customer needs.</li> <li>Articulate the business value of BeyondTrust solutions to prospects and customers.</li> <li>Demonstrate how BeyondTrust solutions address customer challenges and deliver on the value proposition.</li> <li>Assist in developing written proposals to complement financial proposals for prospects.</li> <li>Play a key role in securing the technical win for opportunities by effectively presenting solutions and value.</li> </ul> <p><u>What You’ll Bring</u></p> <ul> <li>3+ years of experience, including help desk and/or technical support of applications, server infrastructure, desktops, virtualization, and directories.</li> <li>Good understanding of common operating systems and network topologies.</li> <li>Familiarity with foundational security concepts and practices.</li> <li>Ability to assess technical requirements and recommend appropriate solutions.</li> <li>Strong collaboration skills and the ability to thrive in a team-selling environment.</li> <li>Comfortable delivering presentations to audiences of varying sizes.</li> <li>Security+, Network+, or equivalent industry certifications.</li> </ul> <p><u>Nice To Have</u></p> <ul> <li>Pre-sales experience is advantageous but not required.</li> <li>Basic working knowledge of Linux and Azure Active Directory.</li> <li>Familiarity with BeyondTrust products (Privilege Management for Desktops, Remote Support, Privileged Remote Access).</li> <li>Security-focused qualifications or certifications are a plus.</li> <li>Experience with security solutions such as anti-malware, data protection, firewalls, and mobile/email/web security.</li> </ul> <p><u>Better Together</u></p> <p>Diversity. Inclusion. They’re more than just words for us. They are the guiding values of how we build our teams, cultivate leaders, and create a culture where people feel connected.</p> <p>We take care of our employees so they can take care of our customers. Customers who come from all walks of life just like us. We hire incredible people from diverse backgrounds because when we are different together, we are stronger together.</p> <p><u>About Us</u></p> <p>BeyondTrust is the global identity security leader protecting Paths to Privilege™. Our identity-centric approach goes beyond securing privileges and access, empowering organizations with the most effective solution to manage the entire identity attack surface and neutralize threats, whether from external attacks or insiders.</p> <p>BeyondTrust is leading the charge in transforming identity security to prevent breaches and limit the blast radius of attacks, while creating a superior customer experience and operational efficiencies. We are trusted by 20,000 customers, including 75 of the Fortune 100, and our global ecosystem of partners.</p> <p>Learn more at <a href="http://www.beyondtrust.com/">www.beyondtrust.com</a>. </p> <p>#LI-KP1</p> <p>#LI-Remote</p> Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Conversion Rate Optimisation Manager
description: At Jellyfish, we believe in the power of diverse perspectives and inclusive collaboration. We welcome individuals who excel in collaborative, varied teams and value the unique contributions that each person brings to the table. Jellyfish is a global digital marketing agency; a unique fusion of tech enthusiasts, creative minds, and media and data experts all united to empower our clients along their digital journey. Our commitment to embracing diverse perspectives fuels our innovation and strategies that challenge the status quo, reinvent media activation, and craft influential stories for our global clients and their customers. Join us in shaping a future where business growth and personal fulfilment go hand in hand. Job Description Reporting to the Experience Optimisation Director, you will play a key role in developing and implementing experience optimisation and conversion rate optimisation (CRO) strategies for a French multinational holding company specialising in luxury goods. We take pride in delivering data-led experimentation, personalisation, and deep analytical insights for premier global brands, setting us apart in the industry. At Jellyfish, we are committed to fostering professional growth. Your career path could lead to progression into a CRO Senior Manager position with future potential to lead the practice. This is a hybrid position, based out of our Paris office. The gross annual salary range for this position is between EUR 38,000-42,000, and the final offer is dependent on experience. Responsibilities Lead client meetings with a key luxury account to translate their business needs into strategic optimisation roadmaps aligned with their goals, driving measurable value and high client satisfaction. Be the subject matter expert in conversion rate optimisation (CRO), experience optimisation, measurement, and marketing analytics across the client's brands. Execute full-lifecycle user journey audits, research, continuous experimentation, and cross-channel activation campaigns to deliver actionable insights. Define custom reporting and data-mapping requirements, collaborating cross-functionally to align technical solutions and timelines with strategic rationale. Provide mentorship and escalation support for junior team members to foster professional growth and resolve operational challenges. Qualifications Fluency in French and professional-level English is required given the scope of work and the client teams. Over 2 years of experience in end-to-end experience optimisation or CRO, including defining, launching, and evaluating A/B and Multivariate Testing (MVT) Campaigns using A/B testing platforms or website optimisation tools. The ability to analyse user behaviour and map customer journeys from initial discovery to final measurement, ideally within the luxury, beauty or fashion industries. Proficiency in web, app and product analytics combined with qualitative research tools (heatmapping, form analytics, live user testing) to uncover user behaviour insights. Analytical and strategic mindset, with the ability to translate complex quantitative and qualitative data into actionable findings, recommendations, and optimisation roadmaps. You love getting to know your clients, developing long-lasting relationships and adding value to their business. When faced with a problem, you collaborate with the appropriate people to evaluate different options find practical solutions. Note: We emphasise skills, expertise and behavioural attributes over years of experience and traditional degrees. If you want to join our collaborative team, we invite you to apply today with your resume in English. Additional Information Join Jellyfish and experience a workplace where we prioritise your growth, celebrate your contributions, and empower you to tailor your work environment to suit your needs. 💰 Reward: You'll be eligible to join our discretionary annual bonus scheme. 💫 Custom Work Environment: Work remotely for up to 60% of your days and shape your day between 8am. and 6:30pm with flexible working hours. 👪 Family Support: Enjoy 14 weeks of paid leave for primary caregivers and 4 weeks of paid leave for secondary caregivers. We also provide £1000 (or equivalent) towards courses for returning primary caregivers to support your transition back into work. Unfortunately, there has been an increase in fake recruiters impersonating Jellyfish and unlawfully using our brand name. If you are unsure if an email with a job offer you have received is genuinely from Jellyfish, or if you suspect any fraudulent activity, please report it to • €38K – €42K Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer - Team Agent
description: About the role Taktile empowers financial institutions to transform into truly AI-native organizations. We’re growing rapidly with enterprise customers across banks and insurance companies, and we’re looking for a Senior Full-Stack Engineer to join our Agent team. We are building a platform for creating, publishing, and executing AI-powered agents that help teams automate complex workflows in financial services. The Agents team owns the agent execution runtime, tool orchestration, and platform infrastructure that makes this possible, including the conversational copilot experiences built on top of it across the product. We are hiring a Full-Stack Engineer to help build and ship production features across this entire stack, from the agent runtime and tool orchestration layer in the backend, to the conversational copilot experiences users interact with every day. You'll work alongside experienced engineers, contribute to real product impact from day one, and grow your skills in a fast-moving, high-ownership environment. What You'll Do Build and ship features end-to-end for Taktile's AI agent platform: backend in Python (FastAPI) on AWS serverless infrastructure, and frontend in React and TypeScript. Build conversational copilot experiences end to end: chat UI components, streaming responses, rich in-chat interactions, and human-in-the-loop approvals. Improve how agents run, how they connect to external tools, and how they behave when something goes wrong. Own your work end-to-end: collaborate on scope, implement, test, release, and iterate based on real usage and customer feedback. Use leading-edge AI tools (e.g. Claude) on a daily basis to move faster, improve quality, and build AI-native capabilities where it makes sense. Review pull requests with depth, improve test coverage and CI/CD, and raise the bar on reliability and engineering excellence. Engage actively in team rituals such as daily syncs, planning sessions, demos, and technical deep-dive discussions. Grow as an individual and accelerate your career by learning from experienced team members, contributing to a foundational layer of the product, and joining cross-team learning groups. For career growth at Taktile, this role will involve daytime ops duty and at some point joining an on-call rotation, so you need to have passion for owning systems end to end and grow your DevSecOps skills as well. Team's tech stack Backend: Python (FastAPI, Pydantic) Frontend: React, TypeScript Data: DynamoDB, Postgres Cloud: AWS serverless (Lambda, API Gateway) AI: LLM orchestration, tool-use frameworks, streaming execution Requirements Strong engineering fundamentals with a passion for simplicity and precision. Fluency in English, both written and spoken, is essential as we operate in an hybrid environment requiring clear and effective communication. Strong English skills are also crucial to efficiently interacting with AI. Prior industry experience building full-stack web applications (this is not an entry-level position). Proficiency with React and TypeScript, and experience building rich, interactive user interfaces. Experience with Python back-end development, building and operating RESTful APIs, and working with databases. Experience integrating into AWS or similar cloud providers. Nice but not required Experience building chat or conversational UIs, real-time/streaming interfaces, or data visualization. FastAPI and Pydantic experience. DynamoDB or Postgres, SQLAlchemy. Exposure to LLM application development, agent frameworks, MCP, or building developer tools. Prior ops or on-call experience. Experience with distributed systems, async task processing, or observability tooling (tracing, metrics, logging). Our Offer Work with colleagues that lift you up, challenge you, celebrate you and help you grow. We come from many different backgrounds, but what we have in common is the desire to operate at the very top of our fields. If you are similarly capable, caring, and driven, you'll find yourself at home here. Experience a truly flat hierarchy and communicate directly with founding team members. Having an opinion and voicing your ideas is not only welcome but encouraged, especially when they challenge the status quo. Learn from experienced mentors and achieve tremendous personal and professional growth. Get to know and leverage our network of leading tech investors and advisors around the globe. Receive a top-of-market equity and cash compensation package. Get access to a self-development budget you can use to e.g. attend conferences, buy books or take classes. Receive a new Apple MacBook Pro, as well as meaningful home office set-up. Our Stance We're eager to meet talented and driven candidates regardless of whether they tick all the boxes. We're looking for someone who will add to our culture, not just fit within it. We strongly encourage individuals from groups traditionally underestimated and underrepresented in tech to apply. We seek to actively recognize and combat racism, sexism, ableism and ageism. We embrace and support all gender identities and expressions, and celebrate love in its many forms. We won't inquire about how you identify or if you've experienced discrimination, but if you want to tell your story, we are all ears. title: Senior Growth Marketing Manager
description: Wir bauen humanoide Systeme: Full Stack, von Hardware und Elektronik über Software bis zur Fertigung, alles in-house in Berlin. Bei Cell Labs verschieben wir die Grenze dessen, was Robotik leisten kann. Unser Ziel ist klar: Systeme bauen, die Menschen stärken statt sie zu ersetzen. Unsere Technologie ist bereits bei führenden Industriekunden und Partnern im Einsatz. Jetzt steht unser eigenes Produkt kurz vor dem Launch. Die leise Phase ist vorbei. Wir suchen Menschen, die früh dabei sein wollen, Verantwortung übernehmen und das bauen, worüber andere nur reden. Ort: Berlin · Start: Ab sofort · Arbeitsmodell: Vor Ort · Anstellung : Vollzeit Deine Aufgaben Marketingstrategie & Produktlaunch: Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit den Gründer:innen unsere Marketingstrategie und gestaltest den Launch unserer Produkte aktiv mit, von Messaging über Kampagnen bis zu Events. Partnerschaften & Kooperationen: Du identifizierst, verhandelst und steuerst Marketing-Kooperationen mit Technologiepartnern, Industriekunden und Hochschulen, von der ersten Ansprache bis zu gemeinsamen Projekten und Kampagnen. Go-to-Market: Du planst und steuerst Kampagnen entlang des gesamten Funnels. Über Website, SEO und Content baust du eine Inbound-Maschine, die qualifizierte Leads aus der Industrie bringt, und du unterstützt Outbound mit Zielkundenlisten und passenden Kampagnen. Events: Du entscheidest, welche Messen und Konferenzen für unser Wachstum zählen. Die Marketingseite von Industrieevents liegt bei dir, von Messaging und Lead-Erfassung über das Follow-up bis zu Speaking Slots für das Team. Markt & Wettbewerb: Du beobachtest den Robotik-, Automatisierungs- und Deep-Tech-Markt, erkennst Lücken in der Positionierung und bringst sie in Strategie und Produkt ein. Marketing-KPIs: Du definierst, misst und berichtest die Kennzahlen, die zählen: Pipeline-Beitrag, Conversion, Cost per Lead und Funnel-Entwicklung. Daraus leitest du Entscheidungen ab, statt nur Reports zu verwalten. Sales Enablement: In enger Abstimmung mit den Gründer:innen unterstützt du Vertrieb und Business Development mit Pitch-Material, Use Cases, Case Studies und Produktkommunikation für konkrete Verkaufssituationen. Investorenkommunikation: Du verfasst regelmäßige Investor-Updates und gestaltest die Storyline unseres Pitch Decks mit. Das bringst du mit Erfahrung: Du hast mindestens fünf Jahre im Marketing gearbeitet, davon einen Teil in einem Startup oder Scale-up, in dem du Marketing mit aufgebaut hast. Du hast mindestens einen größeren Produktlaunch begleitet und kannst erzählen, was funktioniert hat und was nicht. Neugier: Interesse an komplexen Technologien und die Motivation, tief in die Robotik einzutauchen, technische Zusammenhänge zu verstehen und verständlich zu vermitteln. Zahlen: Du setzt dir messbare Ziele und weißt, wie du sie nachhältst. Google Analytics, CRM-Software und A/B-Tests gehören zu deinem Arbeitsalltag, nicht in fremde Hände. Verhandlung auf Augenhöhe: Du bist sicher im Gespräch mit potenziellen Partnern und Kunden. Du findest heraus, was sie brauchen, und schätzt ein, ob ein Lead es wert ist, weiterverfolgt zu werden. Arbeitsweise: Du übernimmst gerne Verantwortung und arbeitest gleichzeitig eng mit anderen zusammen. Du wechselst zwischen Strategie und Umsetzung, ohne eines von beidem aus dem Blick zu verlieren. Schreiben: Du schreibst gut und gerne selbst. Aus einem technischen Gespräch mit einem Engineer machst du eine Case Study oder Website-Copy, die Einkäufer:innen in der Industrie verstehen. Sprachen: Deutsch und Englisch verhandlungssicher. Vorteile Marketing von Grund auf: Es gibt kein Playbook und keine Altlasten. Du gestaltest gemeinsam mit den Gründern, wie Cell Labs an den Markt geht, und siehst die Wirkung deiner Arbeit direkt in der Pipeline. Alles unter einem Dach: Büro, Werkstatt und Teststände liegen im selben Gebäude in Kreuzberg. Wenn du eine Story für eine Case Study brauchst oder den Roboter in Aktion sehen willst, ist der Engineer ein paar Schritte entfernt, kein Ticket. Room to Fail & Grow: Bezahlte Lernzeit mit persönlichem Budget für Kurse, Marketing-Konferenzen und die Tools, die du brauchst. Du bekommst Raum, Neues auszuprobieren, und bringst ein Produkt an den Markt, das bisher kaum jemand gesehen hat. Benefits: Ein Leistungspaket, das du dir selbst zusammenstellst und das Mobilität, Gesundheit, Ernährung oder Fitness abdeckt. Dazu gibt’s einen zusätzlichen bezahlten freien Tag im Jahr für ehrenamtliches Engagement oder ein Projekt, das dir am Herzen liegt. Bewerbung Schick uns deinen Lebenslauf und ein paar Zeilen zu einer Kampagne oder einem Launch, den du verantwortet hast. Was war das Ziel, was hast du getan, was kam dabei heraus? Ein Anschreiben brauchen wir nicht. Der Prozess: Intro Call, Deep Dive in deine bisherige Arbeit, Besuch bei uns mit einer kleinen Case Study, Angebot. Wir bauen Roboter für alle, deshalb wollen wir ein Team, das das abbildet. Wir stellen nach Fähigkeiten ein und freuen uns ausdrücklich über Bewerbungen von Menschen, die in Marketing und Tech unterrepräsentiert sind. Wenn du nicht jeden Punkt erfüllst, aber denkst, das ist dein Job: bewirb dich. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Mechanical Engineer
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.</p></div><p>At Anduril Australia we are developing unmanned systems for subsurface and other domains that will leverage unsupervised autonomy for the delivery of long endurance, multi-mission capability to our customers. These projects, including but not limited to the Extra Large Autonomous Undersea Vehicle (XL-AUV) Program, require Mechanical Engineers with broad experience to drive the delivery a variety of software enabled hardware capabilities to our customers. Anduril Mechanical Engineers rapidly develop expertise in new domains in order to architect, design, deliver, support, and evolve next generation capabilities through the entire product life-cycle.</p> <h3>WHAT YOU'LL DO</h3> <ul> <li>Creating detailed plans and specifications for new designs, or derivatives of the Anduril Extra Large Autonomous Undersea Vehicles (XL-AUVs).</li> <li>Creating detailed mechanical designs, prototypes and build of complex structures and mechanisms.</li> <li>Simulation and analysis of mechanical designs including modal/spectral response analysis.</li> <li>Ensure all designs meet internal and external maritime standards.</li> <li>Act as a subject matter expert for your areas of expertise as they relate to the delivery of Anduril technology capabilities, including areas such as part design, analysis and material selection.</li> <li>Inspecting parts, sub-systems and vehicles to meet design specifications and regulations.</li> <li>Design and implement integrated systems, including advanced and sensitive platforms and payloads, that rapidly delivers capability beyond the scope of current systems, with a clear path for both architecture and capability evolution over time.</li> <li>Empathise with end-users and drive solutions that balance their needs with external constraints, restrictions and requirements in a multi-stakeholder environment.</li> <li>Contribute to the design and development of technology components across Anduril, with the aim of developing components that are re-usable across multiple Anduril product lines.</li> <li>Contribute to the design, implementation and execution of development processes for the initial delivery and subsequent iteration of structural hardware, including full lifecycle testing, monitoring and operation.</li> <li>Support vehicle and payload manufacturing, testing and deployment. Including DVT (Design Validation Testing) of parts and sub systems.</li> <li>Travel to co-locate with end-users, vendors, or the integration and test team up to 20% of the time.</li> <li>Work as a member of a multi-disciplinary engineering team, including as a mentor for more Junior Engineers from differing backgrounds.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <h3>REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS</h3> <ul> <li>Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace, Naval Architecture, a relevant field, or equivalent experience.</li> <li>Professional experience working as a Mechanical Engineer with one or more domains and/or technologies of expertise.</li> <li>Capacity to work holistically on complex mechanical systems and structures across design, implementation, operation and sustainment.</li> <li>Capacity to act as the technical owner for a complex structural components and assemblies, including stakeholder engagement, requirements definition, roadmap management, team co-ordination, design, implementation, sustainment and evolution.</li> <li>Capacity to learn and grow individually while being part of a dynamic team, building cohesion and capacity.</li> <li>Ability to obtain and maintain an Australian Government Security Clearance.</li> </ul> <h3>PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE</h3> <ul> <li>Experience with the design, analysis, testing, implementation and support of mechanical parts and assemblies.</li> <li>Experience working within the maritime defence domains or similar industry e.g. Aerospace or Automotive.</li> <li>Experience with NX, FEMAP and Teamcenter or similar CAD, FEA and PLM systems.</li> <li>Experience developing Finite Element Method (FEM) models for the purposes of part stress and strain evaluation, and modal analysis.</li> <li>Experience with welding, machining, sheet metal, injection molding, composites and/or additive manufacturing.</li> <li>Experience within the product delivery lifecycle including manufacturing, system acceptance, deployment, and sustainment.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><span data-contrast="auto">The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Today, Mirakl's operating system combines an enterprise marketplace solution (Mirakl Platform) that enables retailers and B2B organizations to launch, scale, and operate marketplaces and dropship, AI-powered multichannel selling (Mirakl Connect), retail media (Mirakl Ads) and an agentic commerce infrastructure (Mirakl Nexus). With dual headquarters in Boston and Paris, Mirakl helps a global ecosystem of 450+ marketplaces (B2C and B2B) and a network of over 100k third-party marketplace sellers. Brands like Macy's, Decathlon, Carrefour, Asos, and Airbus Helicopters use Mirakl to grow their businesses in new and remarkable ways. For more information, visit www.mirakl.com . Mirakl in Numbers: 🗓️ Founded in 2012 | Member of French Tech Next40 👥 750+ employees in 9 offices worldwide: Paris, Barcelona, Bordeaux, Boston, London, Munich, New York, Sydney, Tokyo Our Values: Working at Mirakl means accelerating your career alongside ambitious, passionate, and supportive colleagues. We're proud of the diversity of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences that make our teams unique. Our 5 values guide how we collaborate: 💡 Work Hard Together: Teamwork and collaboration are the foundation of our success 🏆 Get Things Done: We prioritize action and efficiency for impactful results 🚀 Go Above & Beyond: We tackle challenges proactively and always aim for excellence 🎓 Succeed Through Expertise: Knowledge sharing and continuous learning are core to our culture 🤝 Satisfy & Empower Clients: We're committed to our clients' success The Team You'll Join You'll be part of the Connect Sales team led by Louise, Director of Sales Connect. The team consists of 8 Account Executive covering EMEA Scope. As the SMB Account Executive for the DACH region , you'll be driving new business growth by expanding Mirakl Connect's reach across the SMB segment and bringing more sellers and brands onto the platform in Germany, Austria, and Switzerland. Your Impact Proactively identify, prospect, and engage new SMB sellers and brands — owning the full sales cycle from discovery and solution presentation through to negotiation and close. Serve as a subject matter expert on Mirakl Connect's Channel Management solution, consulting with SMB clients to understand their needs and clearly articulate platform value. Collaborate with onboarding, customer success, and product teams to ensure smooth integrations and accelerated time-to-value for new customers. Consistently meet or exceed individual sales targets, track pipeline metrics, and surface market feedback to sharpen go-to-market strategy. Stay ahead of SMB landscape trends, competitive dynamics, and evolving customer challenges to continuously refine your sales approach and inform internal stakeholders. What You'll Bring to the Role Experience: 3+ years of experience in a closing sales role with a proven track record in the SMB segment Demonstrated success in building and managing a sales pipeline, negotiating deals, and achieving or surpassing revenue targets Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Finance or a related field; advanced degree is a plus Skills: Full-cycle sales execution: pipeline management, negotiation, and closing Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders at all levels Analytical thinking: turning data and market signals into actionable insights Deep understanding of SMB dynamics and customer needs Entrepreneurial mindset with a strong drive to perform in a high-growth environment Languages English: Full professional proficiency (required) German: Full professional proficiency (required) French (a plus) Our Hiring Process We warmly encourage you to apply to any of our roles, even if you think you're not an exact match. Please click the "Apply" button to submit your application — this helps us make the best possible assessment and get back to you as quickly as possible. Screening call with Talent Acquisition Interview with Louise, Director of Sales Connect Values interviews with team members Case study We welcome collaborators with their diverse perspectives and experiences to power us forward. These often far exceed conventional job requirements and help us create a culture of continuous learning. If you're ready to join a global leader powering digital transformation for 450+ of the world's most innovative retailers and B2B organizations. As part of our recruitment process, Mirakl processes your personal data to review and manage your application and, where appropriate, to consider your profile for future opportunities. You can exercise your data protection rights at any time, and as further detailed in our policies. For more information about how we process your personal data and your rights, please consult our Recruitment Privacy Notice, here in English and here in French. We may use Artificial Intelligence (AI) solutions to help streamline our hiring process, including screening applications, analyzing resumes, and assessing responses. While AI helps us work efficiently, all final hiring decisions are made by humans. For more information, visit our AI Guidelines for Candidates and Interviews . Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Software Engineer – Cloud Services – Rust
description: About Tensordyne AI is transforming our world. It can perform cognitive functions that previously only humans could do, such as perceiving interactions across different modalities and environments - with the ability to quickly learn and then solve complex problems. Tensordyne is an AI system solution company that builds very high-performance, low-power generative AI inference systems. Our mission, through the creation of custom silicon, hardware and software, is to enable multimodal Generative AI inference acceleration at scale, with safe, sustainable, high-performance systems for our hyperscaler and neocloud data center customers. We are at the leading edge of advancing the latest research and product improvements for generative Al inference solutions that will make Al even more advantageous for compelling new generative AI applications.Tensordyne is a well funded, fast-paced startup company with headquarters in both Sunnyvale, CA, and Munich, Germany. We also have many talented team members working remotely across North America and Europe. We take care of our people and their families with comprehensive benefits, competitive compensation, flexible spending options, and recognition programs, because building category-defining technology starts with a healthy, supported team. Come join us as we shape the future of multimodal generative artificial intelligence! About the role Tensordyne builds high-performance, power-efficient inference hardware, backed by our novel AI math approach. You will work within a team working on the inference backend software. Your focus will be on a part of a software stack of a future Tensordyne product. In this role, you will Design and develop distributed cloud services in Rust Maintain Rust software developed in-house, as well as work with external frameworks Build APIs for generative AI Collaborate across different teams to derive design specifications and decisions Orchestrate agent teams to implement features Preferred qualifications Experience with modern Rust Experience with agentic tools and workflows Knowledge of common Rust design patterns, including patterns for asynchronous code General awareness of network technologies and high-level protocols like HTTP General awareness of Kubernetes and other related technologies is a plus Tensordyne's culture was built on the following values Put people first. We only succeed when our people succeed. Ethics and integrity always; Being open, honest, and respectful of everyone. Think Big. Be ambitious and have audacious goals of global scale. Aim for excellence. Quality and excellence count in everything we do. Own it and get it done. Results matter! Make each person better together, than they would be as an individual. Embrace each others' differences, and embrace that there will be differences. Tensordyne is an equal opportunity employer. We believe that a diverse team is better at tackling complex problems and coming up with innovative solutions. title: iOS Engineer - Design System
description: About the team: As an iOS Engineer on the Design System team, you'll translate SumUp's design language into a reusable, easy-to-use library of UI components and experience patterns — empowering product teams to build cohesive, accessible user experiences at scale. The Design System team works hand-in-hand with the Mobile Platform team to set standards and provide guidance across all product teams at SumUp. As we expand our ecosystem of merchant and consumer-facing products, this role offers a rare opportunity to shape the foundation that helps developers build faster and ship higher-quality experiences to millions of users worldwide. What you'll do: Shape the core experience for both users and developers interacting with SumUp's iOS ecosystem Collaborate closely with product and design teams to build components that are maintainable, consistent, and beautiful Embed accessibility best practices into every component — from content descriptions and touch target sizing to color contrast and dynamic type Provide hands-on technical guidance to product teams to deliver on company priorities, including the upcoming support for landscape orientation Review code contributions, enforce design system conventions, and mentor engineers on best practices for reusable UI development Lead the migration of legacy UIKit-based components to SwiftUI while maintaining system stability Proactively identify and address technical debt to uphold a high bar for engineering excellence and codebase health You'll be a great fit for this role if you: Bring 3+ years of professional iOS development experience, ideally on large-scale or consumer-facing applications Are fluent in Swift, with deep hands-on knowledge of both SwiftUI and UIKit — and a clear view on when and how to use each Bring experience building or contributing to a design system, component library, or shared UI framework, and understand what it takes to make components truly reusable and scalable Take pride in crafting accessible user experiences — you know your way around VoiceOver, dynamic type, color contrast, and touch target standards, and treat accessibility as a first-class concern, not an afterthought Bring a strong grasp of testing best practices for UI components, including unit tests, snapshot tests, and UI automation Are comfortable reviewing code and mentoring peers — you enjoy sharing knowledge, giving constructive feedback, and raising the bar for the whole team Are self-motivated and structured in your working style — you manage your own priorities, communicate clearly in English, and thrive in a cross-functional, collaborative environment Stay genuinely curious about the iOS ecosystem — you follow Apple's releases closely, experiment with new APIs, and are excited to bring fresh ideas back to the team Why you should join SumUp: 🌎 Opportunity to work with SumUppers globally on large-scale fintech products used by millions of businesses worldwide, from our Berlin office. This involves an office-first setup 🌈 Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion: be part of a workplace that values and promotes diversity, fostering an inclusive environment where everyone's perspectives are respected and embraced 🚀 Enrolment onto our Virtual Stock Option programme: you will own a stake in SumUp's future success 📚 A dedicated annual L&D budget of €2000 for your individual development, which you can be used to attend conferences and/or advancing your career through further education 💶 A corporate pension scheme where we match up to 20% of your contributions 🏖️ Generous time off: enjoy 28 days of paid leave plus public holidays and special leave days 🚵🏾‍♂️ Numerous other benefits such as Urban Sports Club subsidy, Kita placement assistance, subsidised office lunches 🌴 Break4me: 1-month sabbatical after 3 years of service 🔗 Referral Bonus: earn additional rewards by referring talented individuals to join the SumUp team About SumUp We believe in the everyday hero. Small business owners are at the heart of all we do, so we're creating tools that help them run their businesses. With a founder's mentality and a 'team-first' attitude, our diverse teams across Europe, South America and the United States work together to ensure that the small business owners we partner with can be successful doing what they love. SumUp is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer that proudly pursues and hires a diverse workforce. SumUp does not make hiring or employment decisions on the basis of race, colour, religion or religious belief, ethnic or national origin, nationality, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, age or any other basis protected by applicable laws or prohibited by company policy. SumUp also strives for a healthy and safe workplace and strictly prohibits harassment of any kind. SumUp will not accept unsolicited resumes from any source other than directly from a candidate Job Application Tip We recognise that candidates feel they need to meet 100% of the job criteria in order to apply for a job. title: DACH Enterprise Account Executive – SAP Ecosystem & Digital Transformation (m/f/d)
description: DACH Enterprise Account Executive – SAP Ecosystem & Digital Transformation (m/f/d) Position Summary: We are looking for an Enterprise Account Executive, reporting to the VP of Global GTM. We are seeking an elite, high-performing Enterprise Account Executive to drive new business acquisition across top-tier accounts. Combining large-enterprise sophistication with an aggressive, entrepreneurial hunting mindset, you will architect transformational security deals, engage C-level stakeholders, and position business resilience for the world's most mission-critical ERP environments. Key Responsibilities Drive Strategic Revenue: Own the full sales lifecycle for Global 2000 accounts, positioning the Onapsis Platform as the essential security layer for SAP and Business Critical Applications. The SAP "Triple Threat": Direct Sales: Manage complex, high-value "land and expand" cycles. SAP Co-Sell: Partner with SAP Account Executives (AEs) and Enterprise Architects to attach Onapsis to S/4HANA and RISE migrations. GSI Alignment: Orchestrate go-to-market strategies with Global Systems Integrators (Accenture, Deloitte, IBM, PwC) who are leading the world's largest SAP transformations. C-Suite Advisory: Act as a trusted advisor to CISOs and CIOs, translating technical vulnerabilities into business risks (e.g., SOX compliance, financial downtime, and data integrity). Territory Orchestration: Develop and execute an annual territory plan focused on "White Space" analysis within the SAP installed base. Forecast Accuracy: Maintain a high level of "Sales Hygiene" within CRM, delivering predictable weekly and monthly forecasts aligned with SAP's rigorous reporting standards. Required Skills/Experience: Proven Enterprise Track Record: 7–10+ years of enterprise software sales experience, with a proven history of selling complex software solutions within the SAP ecosystem (either at SAP or a top-tier partner). Cloud Transformation Expert: Deep understanding of the RISE with SAP framework, Clean Core strategy, and the SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP) . Consistent High Achiever: Consistent record of quota over-achievement, regularly closing seven-figure ARR deals across Global 2000 accounts with complex buying committees. Alliance Savvy: Demonstrated success in "partner-first" selling, particularly with GSIs and SAP's regional field teams. Communication: Exceptional executive presence; ability to move seamlessly from a technical discussion with a Basis Lead to a strategic ROI pitch with a CFO. Ability to travel: We believe that our business is a people business and that trust is built in person. Between 25-50% travel required. Entrepreneurial Mindset: Proactive self-starter with the drive to build a territory from scratch and take full ownership of business growth.Languages: Professional fluency in both German and English (written and spoken). What You will get: You can expect a job with responsible tasks and creative opportunities, an attractive salary and extensive benefits (including JobRad, Focus Friday and much more). You have flexible working hours with us. In addition, you can work remotely from other EU countries by arrangement. We support our employees with 5 fully paid sick days per child and subsidize childcare up to primary school age. In addition to an individual onboarding and buddy program, we offer comprehensive training opportunities and english language classes. We offer 30 days of paid vacation per year (based on a 5-day workweek) for optimal work-life balance. Furthermore, you can expect an innovative and attractive workplace with flat hierarchies and respectful and solution-oriented communication. Equity in a late-stage, high-growth leader backed by top-tier VC/PE firms. The chance to represent the only cybersecurity solution endorsed by SAP. About Onapsis: Onapsis protects the business applications that run the global economy. The Onapsis Platform delivers vulnerability management, change assurance, and continuous compliance for business applications from leading vendors such as SAP, Oracle, and others. The Onapsis Platform is powered by the Onapsis Research Labs, the team responsible for the discovery and mitigation of more than 1,000 zero-day vulnerabilities in business applications. Onapsis is headquartered in Boston, MA, with offices in Dallas, TX, Heidelberg, Germany, Bucharest, Romania, and Buenos Aires, Argentina, and proudly serves hundreds of the world's leading brands, including close to 30% of the Forbes Global 100, six of the top 10 automotive companies, five of the top 10 chemical companies, four of the top 10 technology companies, and three of the top 10 oil and gas companies. title: Account Director, Central Banks & Regulators (EMEA)
description: Build a Safer World. TRM Labs provides AI-powered intelligence solutions that help public and private sector agencies investigate and disrupt crime. TRM's platforms enable investigators to trace illicit activity, build cases, and construct operating pictures of threat networks. Leading agencies and businesses worldwide rely on TRM to make the world safer and more secure. TRM helps governments and financial institutions detect and disrupt illicit finance, and this role brings that mission to central banks, financial regulators and financial intelligence units across EMEA. You will own the relationships and the revenue in a territory where digital asset supervision is growing fast, setting account strategy and closing six- and seven-figure deals with institutions that have long, careful buying processes. What makes this seat unusual is the chance to shape how TRM serves supervisors as MiCA and the EU AML package reshape their work. The impact you will have: Map your territory’s central banks, supervisors and FIUs, using AI tools to identify budget holders, decision-makers, champions and regulatory triggers so your first outreach reaches the right person. Win six- and seven-figure deals by turning each institution’s supervisory and enforcement challenges into a clear business case, with AI-drafted account plans that you sharpen with your own judgment. Build and maintain 3x qualified pipeline through targeted outreach, regional events and campaigns with Marketing, and measure what converts. Navigate tenders, frameworks and call-offs with Solutions Architecture, Legal and Deal Desk, so each response is accurate and on time. Grow live customers through renewals, expansion and referrals, using AI summaries of usage and call notes to spot expansion signals early. Bring supervisory and customer insight back to Policy, Product and Marketing so the next release reflects how regulators in your region work. What we’re looking for: 6+ years selling SaaS, data intelligence or investigative solutions into central banks, financial regulators, FIUs or comparable government accounts in EMEA. A record of closing six- and seven-figure deals and meeting quota across long, multi-stakeholder cycles. Existing relationships within EMEA central banks, supervisors or FIUs, and credibility with senior officials. Working knowledge of MiCA, the EU AML framework and how public sector buyers procure. Hands-on use of AI for account research, planning and call preparation, with clear examples of time or revenue gained. Credible, clear communication with senior executives, in person and virtually, and a knack for storytelling. Fluent English; additional European languages are a plus. Based in France, Belgium, Spain, Netherlands, willingness to travel regularly across the region. About the Team: TRM’s EMEA Sales team gives each Account Director real ownership of a territory and the room to choose how to win it. The team is fast-paced, positive and collaborative, with shared pipeline insight and open sharing of what works. The work is hard in a useful way: senior public sector buyers, several countries, long procurement cycles, and a category that is new to many supervisors. You will work with Partnerships, Legal, Marketing, Policy and Product, who move quickly to back your deals. Learn about TRM Speed in this position: Within your first 30 days, you profile and stack-rank every central bank, regulator and FIU in your territory and start outreach to the top tier, so pipeline grows before onboarding ends. When a regulator sends an urgent request late on a Friday for a same-day conversation and demo, you and TRM’s Solutions team make it happen that day. When a government RFx lands with only a few days to respond, you rally Solutions Architecture and Deal Desk to deliver a high-quality response on time. Team Operating Rhythms: Distributed, not distant: the team works across UK and CET time zones, with occasional later calls for US-EMEA opportunities. Slack is the center of day-to-day communication. @mention colleagues for timely responses. Weekly 1:1 with your manager, a weekly team call, a weekly pipeline call, a weekly forecast call, and fortnightly pod calls. Company-wide all-hands and founder Q&A sessions keep everyone connected to the mission. Required online and collaboration hours: Schedule: UK and CET core hours, with flexibility for occasional US-EMEA calls. Application Instructions If you’re interested in joining TRM, we encourage you to apply directly. Every application is reviewed by our Talent team. Before applying, review the job description carefully and highlight the experience and impact that best demonstrate the required qualifications. Please also provide thoughtful and accurate answers to the application questions, as these will be used to evaluate your skills and qualifications for the role. If you send your resume directly to someone at TRM, we can’t guarantee it will reach the appropriate hiring team. Applying directly is the best way to ensure your application will be considered. Interviewing with TRM Our process is designed to understand how you think, solve problems, and deliver impact, while allowing you to evaluate TRM. Most interview processes include a case study, an AI skills assessment, and a Leadership Principles interview. Recruiter Intro: Qualifications, motivations, and alignment with the role. Hiring Manager: Deep dive into your relevant experience, skills, and impact. First Round: 1–2 interviews focused on the skills most critical to the role. Final Round: Hands-on case study. This is usually a panel-style session where we go deeper into your craft, problem-solving, and alignment with TRM. References: Former colleagues who can provide insight into your work and impact. Offer: Congrats! Your recruiter will present the offer and compensation details. Welcome to TRM: We're excited to build a safer world with you! Your recruiter will share your specific interview plan and preparation guidance along the way. AI Fluency at TRM AI fluency is a baseline expectation at TRM. We believe AI meaningfully changes how top performers operate. We expect every team member to use AI to accelerate and reimagine their craft, not just automate surface tasks. At TRM, AI fluency means you are among the top 10 percent of operators in your function in how you apply AI to: Accelerate repeatable workflows Structure and solve problems Improve output quality Increase speed and leverage You will be evaluated on applied AI fluency during the interview process. Life at TRM We are building a safer world. That promise shows up in how we work every day. TRM moves FAST. We are a high-velocity, high-ownership team that expects clarity, follow-through, and impact. People who thrive here are energized by hard problems, experimentation, and continuous feedback. If something takes months elsewhere, it will ship here in days. Our work sits at the intersection of AI, national security, and fighting crime. The problems are complex, the stakes are real, and the environment evolves quickly. The pace and intensity of the work reflect the importance of the mission. As a result, the way we operate requires a high level of ownership, adaptability, collaboration, and creative problem-solving. At TRM, you should expect: Priorities and targets to change quickly Operating with a high degree of ambiguity A high level of personal ownership and accountability Close collaboration across teams and functions Frequent, high-touch communication Creative problem-solving and out-of-the-box thinking A pace that rewards urgency, adaptability, and outcomes This environment is energizing for people who enjoy building, solving hard problems, and making progress in situations that are not always fully defined. It also requires thriving in ambiguity, adjusting course as new information emerges, and maintaining focus and positivity in a fast-moving and intense environment. We also recognize that this style of operating is not for everyone. If you are primarily optimizing for predictability or a consistently balanced workload, we encourage you to use the interview process to pressure-test whether this environment is truly the right fit. We want teammates who thrive here, not just survive here. If you are excited by meaningful problems, motivated by ambitious goals, and energized by working alongside mission-driven colleagues, there is a good chance you will find TRM to be an exceptional place to grow and contribute. Leadership Principles We hire and grow against three leadership principles. They’re the standards for how we operate, treat each other, and make decisions. Impact-Oriented Trailblazer: We put customers first and move with speed, focus, and adaptability. We treat every plan like an experiment – test, ship, measure, and iterate quickly. Master Craftsperson: We care deeply about our craft. We balance speed with high standards, own outcomes end‑to‑end, and invest in getting better everyday. Inspiring Colleague: We add clarity and energy, not noise. We bring humility, candor, and a one‑team mindset — giving and receiving feedback to make the team stronger. Join our Mission At TRM, we care deeply about our craft. We are looking for individuals who want their work to matter, who experiment with speed and rigor, and who take pride in building a safer world for billions of people. If you’re excited by TRM’s mission but don’t check every box, we encourage you to apply — we hire for slope, judgment, and the will to learn fast. TRM is a Series C company with $220M in total funding, backed by Goldman Sachs, Bessemer, Y Combinator, Thoma Bravo, and others. Headquartered in San Francisco, TRM operates as a distributed-first company with hubs in Los Angeles, San Francisco, New York, Washington D.C., London, and Singapore. Privacy Policy and Additional Information By submitting your application, you agree to allow TRM Labs to process your personal information in accordance with our Privacy Policy . We collect the information you provide (such as your resume, work history, and contact details) solely for the purpose of evaluating your candidacy for current and future roles at TRM. title: Account Director, Southern Europe - Public Sector
description: Build a Safer World. TRM Labs provides AI-powered intelligence solutions that help public and private sector agencies investigate and disrupt crime. TRM's platforms enable investigators to trace illicit activity, build cases, and construct operating pictures of threat networks. Leading agencies and businesses worldwide rely on TRM to make the world safer and more secure. TRM helps governments and law enforcement trace and stop illicit finance. This role brings that mission to investigators, financial intelligence units, tax and customs agencies, and regulators across Italy and Southern Europe. You will own TRM’s public sector business in a territory where we are building coverage, setting account strategy and closing six- and seven-figure deals through direct sales and partners. What makes this seat unusual is a large greenfield territory plus the freedom to shape your own go-to-market, procurement approach and partner network with AI-assisted research. The impact you will have: Map every priority agency in Italy and Southern Europe, using AI tools to identify budget holders, investigators, procurement offices and upcoming tenders so your first outreach reaches the right people in week one. Win six- and seven-figure deals by turning investigative pain points into a clear business case, using AI-assisted segmentation and local-language messaging, and measure what converts. Build a 3x qualified pipeline each quarter through targeted outreach, agency training days and events, and measure what converts. Decide how TRM reaches each agency, choosing between direct selling and approved resellers or integrators, and back each choice with AI-assisted analysis of procurement routes. Grow live customers through renewals, upsells, and new use cases, using AI summaries of usage and call notes to spot expansion signals early. Bring customer and regulatory insight back to Product, Policy and Law Enforcement Relations so the next release matches how agencies in your region actually work. What we’re looking for: 6+ years selling SaaS, data intelligence or investigative solutions to government, law enforcement or regulators in Italy or Southern Europe, A record of closing six- and seven-figure deals and meeting quota, including experience running tenders, RFx responses or framework purchases. Working knowledge of Italian and EU public procurement, AML and digital asset regulation, and how investigators, budget holders and procurement teams buy. Hands-on use of AI for prospecting, account planning, and tender and call preparation, with clear examples of time or revenue gained. Experience building pipeline from scratch in a new territory, including working with resellers or integrators Credible, clear communication with senior officials and investigators, in person and virtually. Fluent Italian and English; Spanish, Portuguese or Greek is a strong plus. Based in Italy (Rome or Milan preferred), willingness to travel regularly across the region. You will work with Law Enforcement Relations, Solutions Architecture, Legal and Deal Desk, Partnerships, Product, and Policy, who move quickly to back your deals. title: Staff Product Manager - Platform
description: We're looking for a Staff Product Manager to take on the hardest problems in the data and integration platform that everything at Nelly runs on: how practice data gets into Nelly from dozens of practice management systems, how partners connect to us, and how that data becomes something every product can depend on. Just do not expect to stand still. A yearly learning and development budget , plus the coaching, feedback and internal knowledge that actually move you forward. Real investment in your learning. A front row seat while we build something big. We are building the financial operating system for European healthcare, with AI woven into how we build, sell and support. Real scope, real impact.
