title: Digital Operations & Systems Manager (m/w/d) – Tech Stack & AI
description: Jobbeschreibung Für den Maschinenraum suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt eine:n Digital Operations & Systems Manager (m/w/d). Der Maschinenraum ist das geteilte Innovationsökosystem deutscher Mittelstands- und Familienunternehmen, um gemeinsam Zukunftsthemen besser zu verstehen und mutiger zu gestalten. Gemeinsam mit den Mitgliedsunternehmen treibt der Maschinenraum die Transformation der Organisationen durch das Teilen von Erfahrungen, Wissen, Fähigkeiten und Ressourcen systematisch voran. Der Maschinenraum ist eine neutrale Plattform vom Mittelstand für den Mittelstand mit inzwischen mehr als 70 Familienunternehmen. Unser Netzwerk lebt von einer Systemlandschaft, die alle Maschinenraum Aktivitäten im Hintergrund trägt: Salesforce, Hivebrite, Zapier, Langdock und Google Workspace bilden das operative Rückgrat unserer täglichen Arbeit. Ein zentraler Baustein ist dabei unsere Maschinenraum Intelligence. Unsere Daten- und Wissensinfrastruktur, die Informationen aus verschiedenen Systemen zusammenführt, analysiert und für unsere Teams nutzbar macht. Was du bewirkst Du verantwortest unsere technische Systemlandschaft end-to-end und entwickelst sie kontinuierlich weiter. Dabei arbeitest du direkt mit der Geschäftsführung sowie eng mit allen Maschinenraum-Teams zusammen. Du durchdringst unsere Prozesse fachlich, steuerst sie technisch und entwickelst sie gemeinsam mit den Teams weiter. Das bedeutet konkret: Tech Stack, Prozesse & Automatisierung: Du bist Owner unseres Tech Stacks mit “Work Smart” als Leitmotiv. Du sorgst dafür, dass unsere Systeme Hand in Hand greifen. Du verknüpfst Tools, baust und betreust smarte Automatisierungen sowie Schnittstellen, hältst Prozesse schlank und erleichterst so den Alltag des gesamten Teams. Daten, CRM & Reporting: Du nutzt Salesforce als unser zentrales CRM und als verlässliche Datengrundlage. Du verstehst Datenmodelle, verknüpfst Daten sauber miteinander und baust übersichtliche Dashboards auf, die dem gesamten Team als Entscheidungsgrundlage dienen. KI & Wissensmanagement: Du arbeitest explorativ an KI-Lösungen im Rahmen des Maschinenraum Angebots und entwickelst unsere aktuelle Intelligence-Initiative weiter. Dein Ziel: KI verantwortungsvoll einsetzen, um das Wissen in unserem Ökosystem optimal nutzbar zu machen. Evaluation neuer Tools & Technologien: Du prüfst neue Lösungen auf ihren konkreten Nutzen für unsere Teams und begleitest deren Implementierung und Roll-Out. Dabei entwickelst du unseren Tech Stack kontinuierlich weiter. Stellenanforderungen Das bist du Du hast Spaß an der Arbeit in einem kleinen dynamischen Team, in dem jeder anpacken und mitdenken muss. Du hast Interesse an der Schnittstelle von Strategie, Daten und Technologie und Freude daran, dich in neue Systeme einzuarbeiten und Dinge praktisch umzusetzen. Außerdem bringst du folgende Qualifikationen mit: Du hast idealerweise 3-5 Jahre relevante Berufserfahrung in einem Startup-, Scale-up- oder vergleichbaren Umfeld, idealerweise in (Business) Operations, RevOps oder einer systemnahen Rolle. Du bringst eine ausgeprägte technische Affinität mit und kannst dich schnell in neue Systeme, Datenstrukturen und Tools einarbeiten. Du arbeitest eigenverantwortlich und hands-on : Du übersetzt zwischen Fachbereich und System, treibst Themen selbstständig sowie strukturiert voran und bringst sie zu Ende. Du arbeitest gern mit Tools und Automatisierungen und hast idealerweise bereits Erfahrung mit Salesforce, Zapier oder vergleichbaren Systemen. Du denkst ganzheitlich : Du erkennst Zusammenhänge zwischen Tools, Daten, Prozessen und Teams und kannst daraus pragmatische Lösungen entwickeln. Du hast erste Erfahrung mit Dashboards und Reporting-Strukturen und verstehst, wie Daten strukturiert und miteinander verknüpft sind. Du bist neugierig auf neue Technologien und AI-Tools und hast Lust, dich eigenständig in neue Systeme einzuarbeiten und Neues auszuprobieren. Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse . Ein Plus aber kein Muss : Erste Anknüpfungspunkte mit dem deutschen familiengeführten Mittelstand oder Community-Plattformen (z.B. Hivebrite). Auch wenn du nicht alle Punkte erfüllst, aber neugierig bist und Lust hast zu lernen, freuen wir uns über deine Bewerbung. Was dich erwartet Gestaltungsspielraum & Ownership: Viel Verantwortung und Freiraum, um unsere Systemlandschaft eigenständig zu gestalten, weiterzuentwickeln und nachhaltig zu prägen Direkter Draht & kurze Wege: Enge Zusammenarbeit mit der Geschäftsführung, direkter Austausch und schnelle Entscheidungen Hybrid Work: Flexible Arbeitszeiten mit einer ausgewogenen Mischung aus Präsenz in unserem Büro und der Möglichkeit, nach Bedarf mobil zu arbeiten Arbeitsplatz & Lage: Ein moderner Space im Herzen Berlins mit sehr guter Verkehrsanbindung Impact & Ökosystem: Ein purpose-getriebenes Unternehmen mit einer klaren Vision und einer inspirierenden Community aus Mittelstand, Start-ups und VCs Teamkultur: Eine wertschätzende Feedback-Kultur mit Mut zu neuen Ideen, regelmäßigen Teamevents (z.B. Sommerfest & Offsite), Teamtrainings und echtem Raum für persönliches Wachstum Benefits & Auszeit: 30 Urlaubstage, freie Brückentage sowie attraktive Corporate Benefits (z. B. Urban Sports Club, BVG, Aware by Aeon) Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung! Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Outcomes Architect Manager
description: WHO WE ARE Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion. Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work. ABOUT THE ROLE Notion is reimagining how customers adopt, expand, and realize value from software in an AI-native world. As a first-line leader directly managing a team of Outcomes Architects, you’ll own your team’s execution across workflow adoption, value realization, renewal readiness, expansion qualification, and at-risk account recovery — accountable for both the customer outcomes and the quality of execution that produces them. This isn’t a traditional Customer Success management role. The best OA Managers are coaches first: they know what great workflow discovery looks like, can review a mutual success plan and identify where value realization is breaking down, can inspect an executive business review and sharpen the value narrative, and can help an OA turn account activity into measurable customer and commercial outcomes. You’ll run an inspection cadence and cultivate a coaching culture that make consistent execution possible across the team. You’ll partner closely with Solutions Consultant leaders, Sales, Services, Support, Product, and RevOps to ensure customers move from workflow design to adoption, value realization, expansion, and renewal readiness. If you’re a builder who loves developing people as much as driving customer impact — and you want to lead a team in a post-sales motion that’s being redefined for the AI era — this is the role. WHAT YOU’LL ACHIEVE - Own the Net Revenue Growth performance of your team’s book of business, accountable for both headline outcomes and the quality of execution that drives workflow adoption, value realization, renewal readiness, and expansion. - Coach OAs on the OA builder motion: AI Transformation Plans, build-beside workshops, value reviews, use-case consultations, and renewal processes. - Build and run the operating cadence for the team: metrics reviews, account support sessions, adoption and renewal-risk reviews, call coaching against the OA quality rubric, and forecast calls with senior leadership. - Hire, onboard, and certify new OAs to the GTM builder motion, driving readiness from ramp through consistent execution and managing performance with clarity when expectations are not met. - Partner closely with Solutions Consultant managers and leaders on strategy for expansion and renewal across shared accounts, ensuring clear ownership for flat and at-risk renewals. - Partner with Services leadership to identify complex implementation needs early, create clear handoffs, and ensure Services delivery accelerates workflow adoption and measurable value. - Set the standard for product, AI, and workflow fluency across the team so OAs can help customers navigate new ways of working and build durable systems in Notion. - Represent your team or region in leadership forums with clear signal on what's working, what needs investment, and where execution is breaking down - Uphold excellence by coaching to the global OA methodology, quality rubric, and activity KPIs. SKILLS YOU’LL NEED TO BRING - Frontline management experience leading customer-facing GTM teams in B2B software, ideally across Customer Success, Solutions Consulting, Technical Account Management, Professional Services, Account Management, or post-sales strategy. - Direct experience coaching teams through customer discovery, workflow design, adoption planning, value realization, renewals, expansion, or technical/workflow implementation. - Strong coaching orientation: you can review a customer call, account plan, mutual success plan, or executive value narrative and identify specifically what needs to change — not just whether the outcome was good, but why and how to improve it. - Commercial instincts at the team level: able to read account health, renewal risk, adoption depth, expansion potential, and customer sentiment, then drive urgency without micromanaging every account. - Deep customer-facing discovery instincts, with the ability to understand business problems, map workflows, and translate goals into practical adoption and implementation plans. - Experience operating in a shared account ownership model with Sales, Solutions, Services, Support, or Implementation teams. - Operational rigor: you know how to build inspection cadences, coaching rituals, performance standards, and accountability systems that improve execution across a team. - Ability to develop talent from onboarding through consistent performance, including hiring to profile, setting clear expectations, coaching skill gaps, and managing performance with clarity. - Executive communication skills: able to synthesize account patterns, customer risks, team performance, and cross-functional asks into clear signal for leadership. - Technical fluency and presence as a trusted advisor. You do not need to build every workflow yourself, but you should be able to understand Notion systems, coach workflow design, and help your team troubleshoot adoption blockers. - You operate with agency, urgency, and customer empathy, bringing structure to ambiguous problems and helping teams move from ideas to working systems. - You don’t need to be an AI expert, but you’re curious, hands-on, and willing to adopt AI tools to work smarter, coach better, and help customers deliver better outcomes. NICE TO HAVES - Experience managing in a consumption, usage-based, or product-led business where adoption signals matter as much as renewal or expansion outcomes. - Track record building high-performing frontline teams from an early stage: hiring to profile, structured onboarding, certification, coaching, and performance management. - Experience leading teams through GTM motion changes, coverage-model shifts, or evolving commercial ownership. - Experience working with flat, at-risk, or complex renewal accounts and helping teams return customers to a clear value path. - Experience partnering closely with Solutions Consulting, Sales, Services, or Implementation teams in a shared customer lifecycle model. - Familiarity with AI transformation, workflow automation, agents, or collaboration/work management software. Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role's scope and complexity, and the candidate's experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. The estimated range for total on target earnings (including base salary and on target incentive pay) for this role is €123,000-€138,000 per year. By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550. https://dev.notion.so/a3ce416456924276a59de91bca740028?pvs=21 #LI-Onsite A NOTE ON AI You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on. EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. title: Senior Account Executive - Benelux
description: Help fix customer-centricity at scale Every company wants to become more customer-centric. At TheyDo, we make that ambition real. Our AI-powered journey management platform helps the world’s largest enterprises align around what matters most: their customers. By bringing scattered data and teams together, we empower smarter decisions and better experiences. Since 2019, global leaders across industries — including Ford, Cisco, Johnson & Johnson, Siemens, Home Depot, and Lufthansa — have trusted us to scale journey management and deliver measurable impact. Backed by $50M from top-tier investors, including Blossom and 20VC, we are building a category-defining company. Our fully remote team of 100+ TheyDoers represents 30+ nationalities across 27 countries, united by a customer-led, people-first culture. Our mission is clear: Make journey management the most powerful business tool in the world. If you’re looking for a place where your work shapes the future of how companies operate, join us. Let’s build it together. The role Journey management is becoming a must-have for the world's biggest companies, and TheyDo is the platform leading the category. Enterprises like Ford, Cisco, Vodafone and Pfizer already use TheyDo to understand their customers end to end and decide where to act. Now we're going after the rest of Europes biggest brands, and we want you leading the charge. As a Senior Account Executive, you'll take a greenfield territory of enterprise accounts, open the doors, and land the new logos that define TheyDo's next chapter. You'll be based in the Benelux, working remotely and reporting to Stephan . You'll join a team of 6 EU AEs, backed by SDR, Enablement and Customer Success colleagues across North America and Europe. Why this role, now The timing couldn't be better. Customer experience has moved into the boardroom, and enterprises want a way to turn it into decisions. TheyDo gives them that, and our customers are proving it. Europe is wide open. Your target list is full of companies that look just like the ones already buying from us, and most of them have never had a TheyDo conversation. We know what wins. Now we need someone to scale it and put their name on the logos that come next. This is the moment to join: early enough to shape how we win, with the proof that we do. What you'll do This is a role built around creating revenue that didn't exist before, not managing revenue that already does. Build your own pipeline. You'll start from a target list, not a book. Own a named list of Benelux enterprise accounts and decide where to focus, based on signal rather than hope Source most of your pipeline yourself through outbound, account-based plays with BDR and Marketing, events and executive networking Break into accounts with no existing relationship and find the senior person who owns the customer experience problem Win the first deal. You'll take a cold account all the way to signature. Run complex, multi-stakeholder cycles from first conversation through discovery, business case, procurement and close Sell on value to C-level and VP buyers across CX, Product and Digital: a business case a CFO will sign, not a feature tour Land mid-to-high six-figure first deals, structured to expand, and hand them to Customer Success with the context to grow them Shape how we win. You'll help write the European playbook. Refine our ICP, messaging and sales motion based on what you see in the field Share buyer insight with Product so they can act on it Forecast accurately and keep the team informed through clear async updates What this role isn't We'd rather be clear now than have the wrong person find out six months in. It isn't account management. You won't inherit renewals or an installed base to upsell. If most of your number has come from growing existing customers, this probably isn't your role. It isn't inbound-led. Marketing and SDR will support you, but you'll be expected to create most of your own pipeline. It isn't a finished machine. If you need fully built enablement, years of territory data and a playbook that tells you what to do next, you'll find this frustrating. If you want to help build those things, you'll find it energizing. What we're looking for 4+ years closing B2B SaaS deals, with most of that in enterprise new-business roles selling into enterprise organizations. A track record of exceeding annual quotas, where the majority of your closed revenue came from net-new logos you sourced yourself. Be ready to walk us through the numbers. Proven ability to land mid-to-high six-figure first deals with enterprises that weren't customers before. Experience selling a platform or new-category product, where you had to create the need rather than respond to an RFP. A value-selling methodology (MEDDPICC, Command of the Message or similar) you actually use, not just know. Confidence engaging C-level buyers, building consensus across stakeholders and navigating enterprise procurement, security and legal You'd rather start with a blank target list than a handed-over book, and you're energized by a scale-up where the product and playbook move fast Bonus points if you have experience selling to CX, Product, Digital or Design leaders What we offer our permanent employees: 💰 Competitive compensation and pre-IPO equity - we like to give our team members ownership with our stock package. When TheyDo succeeds, we all succeed! 🌍 Fully remote working with flexible hours - we're staunch advocates for autonomy and flexibility. 🩺 Health Insurance benefit - at TheyDo our team’s health and wellbeing are a priority. title: Deployment Strategist - German Speaking
description: About HappyRobot HappyRobot is the infrastructure for enterprises to build and orchestrate AI workforces. Our AI workers don't just communicate through voice and email - they make decisions, take action, and run operations autonomously across entire enterprise systems. Born in Y Combinator (S23) and backed by a16z, Base10, Prysm Capital and Eurazeo with over $200M raised, we power critical operations for global enterprises worldwide. Our platform is battle-tested in the most demanding environments, where AI has real consequences. We started in logistics, built our own voice stack, models, and orchestration layer from the ground up, and are now bringing that infrastructure to every enterprise that runs the real economy. Learn more about our vision in our manifesto. Role Overview We are looking for a Deployment Strategist to join our team. In this role, you'll partner with Forward Deployed Engineers (FDEs) across the full deployment lifecycle, from first discovery conversation to live production. You'll lead use case discovery and scoping with senior customer stakeholders, ship prototypes hands-on to prove value early, then stay close to the build through delivery to bring the strategic, business-value lens to every decision. You're the partner who keeps the work pointed at the highest-impact outcomes, ready to pick up the keyboard alongside the FDE when the moment calls for it. We're looking for engineers with strategic instincts: people who can write code, but whose deepest strength is the strategic, opinionated lens they bring across every phase of a deployment - spotting where value lives, scoping it realistically, and partnering with engineers to capture it from prototype to production. At HappyRobot, there's no role seniority or hierarchy. We operate as a team of builders. We execute, we build, we own, and we care deeply about our customers and their success. What You'll do Strategic Leadership and Use Case Discovery: Partner with Global and Regional C-Level executives and VPs to assess AI opportunities and prioritize the highest-impact use cases. Lead curiosity-driven discovery that surfaces the workflows where AI creates the most business value, well beyond what the customer thought to ask for. Build the trusted relationships that let you present findings and challenge assumptions at the most senior levels, keeping technical delivery aligned with their business priorities. Scoping : Frame impact versus effort with rigor on both axes. On business value, pressure-test the realistic upside, question whether the use case as posed will actually deliver the most impact, and explore whether reframing it or pivoting to an adjacent process would unlock more. The art is deeply understanding how to maximize value of this use case for the customer, not just delivering what was asked for. On technical effort, map integrations, data, and platform constraints, and surface the edge cases and dependencies that shape timelines. Land on a plan that's realistic on both. Prototyping : Build prototypes and demos hands-on. Use our platform and AI-powered coding tools to test ideas end-to-end at light scope. Prove value early, before the customer commits. Program Management : Coordinate work across the active deployments in an account. Be the escalation point for the customer and the watchout partner for the FDE. Stay close enough to the build that you both understand the use case deeply, spot opportunities to capture more value, and catch when work is drifting from the highest-impact path. Prioritization : Sequence use cases within an account so each deployment compounds the next. Make the call on what gets built when, what gets parked, and where to invest discovery and building time. Customer Partnership : Be the main business-side point of contact for the account. Build trust with operational and executive stakeholders day-to-day. Translate AI capabilities into language they can act on. Onsite Embedding : Travel onsite for kickoffs, mapping sessions, and key moments where being on the ground changes the outcome. Product Feedback Loop : Bring field signal back to Product and Engineering. Identify reusable patterns, common edge cases, and where the platform needs to evolve. Must Have Background that mixes technical depth with strategic instinct, and a real history of building things. Common paths include engineering (Computer Science, electrical, industrial, systems), data science, founding a tech startup, product management, or technical / strategic consulting. Comfortable coding -mostly Python- using LLMs and AI-powered tools like Claude Code to ship prototypes fast. Working understanding of APIs, integrations, and how AI agents sit inside enterprise workflows. Strategic instinct: ability to spot the business value behind a workflow and translate it into impact, effort, and prioritization terms a C-level can act on. Excellent communication skills with both executives and operators. Comfortable translating between business and technical without losing either side. Proven ability to prioritize ruthlessly across multiple workstreams and drive outcomes, not just activity. Founder mindset: highly independent, takes ownership, and thrives in a fast-paced environment. Why join us? Join a world-class team of engineers and builders. Backed by top investors including a16z, Y Combinator, Base10, Prysm Capital and Eurazeo. Have ownership and autonomy of projects and are encouraged to ship. Comprehensive Benefits including healthcare, dental, vision coverage. Competitive salary + equity in a high-growth startup. Our Operating Principles Extreme Ownership We take full responsibility for our work, outcomes, and team success. No excuses, no blame-shifting — if something needs fixing, we own it and make it better. This means stepping up, even when it’s not “your job.” If a ball is dropped, we pick it up. If a customer is unhappy, we fix it. If a process is broken, we redesign it. We don’t wait for someone else to solve it — we lead with accountability and expect the same from those around us. Craftsmanship Putting care and intention into every task, striving for excellence, and taking deep ownership of the quality and outcome of your work. Craftsmanship means never settling for “just fine.” We sweat the details because details compound. Whether it’s a product feature, an internal doc, or a sales call — we treat it as a reflection of our standards. We aim to deliver jaw-dropping customer experiences by being curious, meticulous, and proud of what we build — even when nobody’s watching. We are “majos” Be friendly & have fun with your coworkers. Always be genuine & honest, but kind. “Majo” is our way of saying: be a good human. Be approachable, helpful, and warm. We’re building something ambitious, and it’s easier (and more fun) when we enjoy the ride together. We give feedback with kindness, challenge each other with respect, and celebrate wins together without ego. Urgency with Focus Create the highest impact in the shortest amount of time. Move fast, but in the right direction. We operate with speed because time is our most limited resource. But speed without focus is chaos. We prioritize ruthlessly, act decisively, and stay aligned. We aim for high leverage: the biggest results from the simplest, smartest actions. We’re running a high-speed marathon — not a sprint with no strategy. Talent Density and Meritocracy Hire only people who can raise the average; ‘exceptional performance is the passing grade.’ Ability trumps seniority. We believe the best teams are built on talent density — every hire should raise the bar. We reward contribution, not titles or tenure. We give ownership to those who earn it, and we all hold each other to a high standard. A-players want to work with other A-players — that’s how we win. First-Principles Thinking Strip a problem to physics-level facts, ignore industry dogma, rebuild the solution from scratch. We don’t copy-paste solutions. We go back to basics, ask why things are the way they are, and rebuild from the ground up if needed. This mindset pushes us to innovate, challenge stale assumptions, and move faster than incumbents. By providing reliable and easy-to-use data as well as various data analytics products and services, we empower people worldwide to make fact-based decisions. title: Elektronik-Ingenieur
description: About pplwise pplwise is a recruiting consultancy for fast-growing technology companies across Europe. Through Recruiting as a Service and Executive Search, we fill key roles for our clients, from start-ups to publicly listed companies. We are filling this position for our client Filics. About our client: Filics Filics is reinventing intralogistics with autonomous mobile robots (AMRs) that change how material moves. Its double-runner system makes Filics the first and only AMR that can drive through load carriers such as Euro pallets. This breaks with forklift logic and sets a new standard for efficiency. Filics is a small, hands-on team that solves hard problems with engineering excellence. Leadership goes to those who take initiative and consistently deliver. As Senior Electrical Engineer (m/f/d) at Filics, you will design the electronics at the core of the next generation of robots. About the role This is an on-site/hybrid role in Munich, close to engineering and assembly. Filics doesn’t just use off-the-shelf components. It builds its own custom IP. The robots run on advanced boards that cover a wide range of electrical engineering. On one end is high power, such as battery and motor controllers. On the other end are high-speed interfaces like PCIe, USB and MIPI CSI. The real challenge is making all these subsystems work together as one system. Many of these problems have no textbook solution. Solving them takes solid experience, a deep understanding of the physics and a creative mind. The EE team is small, and the robot is far from finished. You’ll own your boards end to end : requirements, system design, schematic, layout, design review, sourcing, manufacturing, testing and validation. You’ll keep owning them for as long as they’re in production. You’ll work closely with Embedded Software, Mechanical Engineering, Software and the Production team. As Filics moves from prototypes to series production, your designs need to work reliably at scale , not just in the lab. What you’ll do Take full ownership of a complex PCB project and get it running in as few revisions as possible Design high-power and high-speed circuits and make sure they work together at system level Design for EMC, manufacturability and testability, and take boards through EMC testing and certification Bring new technical approaches to the team, for example a new converter architecture that enables higher charging power in a smaller package Introduce useful processes from your experience, such as simulation workflows that validate a layout before it goes to production Help with board bring-up and debugging together with Embedded Software, and support Production with clear documentation and training Take over ownership of existing boards so the team shares responsibility About you Several years designing electronics in an R&D environment at a smaller hardware company driven by innovation (e.g. robotics, e-mobility, aviation, autonomous vehicles, motion control) A proven record of taking PCBs within a larger system from requirements to a validated product Strong skills in schematic design and PCB layout (Altium, KiCad, OrCAD or similar) Hands-on debugging experience with an oscilloscope, logic analyzer, VNA or spectrum analyzer, plus soldering Experience with designs that went through EMC testing or CE certification An innovator’s mindset: you have built something new or significantly improved an existing concept Basic simulation know-how (e.g. LTspice, ANSYS, thermal/EM/tolerance analysis); deeper experience is a strong plus Basic experience with Linux and embedded software You work independently, take ownership and thrive without rigid structures What Filics offers Real ownership of your designs, from first draft to series production Space to innovate and a wide range of technical challenges, from power electronics to high-speed design A small, high-caliber team with close collaboration across disciplines Fast growth: one year at Filics teaches you what usually takes many years at a large company An on-site/hybrid role in Munich, close to Engineering and Assembly Sound like you? description: About pplwise pplwise is a recruiting consultancy for fast-growing technology companies across Europe. Through Recruiting as a Service and Executive Search, we fill key roles for our clients, from start-ups to publicly listed companies. We are filling this position for our client Filics. About our client: Filics Filics is reinventing intralogistics with autonomous mobile robots (AMRs) that change how material moves. Its double-runner system makes Filics the first and only AMR that can drive through load carriers such as Euro pallets. This breaks with forklift logic and sets a new standard for efficiency. Filics is a small, hands-on team that solves hard problems with engineering excellence. Leadership goes to those who take initiative and consistently deliver. As Senior Electrical Engineer (m/f/d) at Filics, you will design the electronics at the core of the next generation of robots. About the role This is an on-site/hybrid role in Munich, close to engineering and assembly. Filics doesn’t just use off-the-shelf components. It builds its own custom IP. The robots run on advanced boards that cover a wide range of electrical engineering. On one end is high power, such as battery and motor controllers. On the other end are high-speed interfaces like PCIe, USB and MIPI CSI. The real challenge is making all these subsystems work together as one system. Many of these problems have no textbook solution. Solving them takes solid experience, a deep understanding of the physics and a creative mind. The EE team is small, and the robot is far from finished. You’ll own your boards end to end : requirements, system design, schematic, layout, design review, sourcing, manufacturing, testing and validation. You’ll keep owning them for as long as they’re in production. You’ll work closely with Embedded Software, Mechanical Engineering, Software and the Production team. As Filics moves from prototypes to series production, your designs need to work reliably at scale , not just in the lab. What you’ll do Take full ownership of a complex PCB project and get it running in as few revisions as possible Design high-power and high-speed circuits and make sure they work together at system level Design for EMC, manufacturability and testability, and take boards through EMC testing and certification Bring new technical approaches to the team, for example a new converter architecture that enables higher charging power in a smaller package Introduce useful processes from your experience, such as simulation workflows that validate a layout before it goes to production Help with board bring-up and debugging together with Embedded Software, and support Production with clear documentation and training Take over ownership of existing boards so the team shares responsibility About you Several years designing electronics in an R&D environment at a smaller hardware company driven by innovation (e.g. robotics, e-mobility, aviation, autonomous vehicles, motion control) A proven record of taking PCBs within a larger system from requirements to a validated product Strong skills in schematic design and PCB layout (Altium, KiCad, OrCAD or similar) Hands-on debugging experience with an oscilloscope, logic analyzer, VNA or spectrum analyzer, plus soldering Experience with designs that went through EMC testing or CE certification An innovator’s mindset: you have built something new or significantly improved an existing concept Basic simulation know-how (e.g. LTspice, ANSYS, thermal/EM/tolerance analysis); deeper experience is a strong plus Basic experience with Linux and embedded software You work independently, take ownership and thrive without rigid structures What Filics offers Real ownership of your designs, from first draft to series production Space to innovate and a wide range of technical challenges, from power electronics to high-speed design A small, high-caliber team with close collaboration across disciplines Fast growth: one year at Filics teaches you what usually takes many years at a large company An on-site/hybrid role in Munich, close to Engineering and Assembly Sound like you? title: Senior Software Engineer, AI Training - NZ
description: Contract | Remote, worldwide | $100-$200/hour depending on experience and location | 10-20 hrs/week Please note that eligibility may vary depending on your location, as some regions may not be supported by the client. Check out this Loom video for more details: https://www.loom.com/share/b0d1b0bf24c44ae8b95dca84b9db60e5 We're looking for highly experienced software engineer (SR+) to help evaluate the quality of interactions with modern coding agents such as OpenAI Codex and Claude Code. This is not a traditional engineering role. You won't be writing production code. You'll be evaluating something harder: whether the model thinks like a great engineer. What this role actually is You will assess how AI coding agents behave in real-world scenarios, focusing on: • Whether the response makes sense • Whether the preamble and reasoning are useful • Whether the output reflects strong engineering judgment • Whether the interaction feels right to an experienced developer This role is about engineering taste. Syntax correctness is the easy part. What you'll be doing • Evaluate AI-generated coding interactions end to end • Judge whether outputs are useful, correct at a high level, and aligned with how a strong engineer would think • Assess the quality of explanations and reasoning, not just the code • Distinguish between levels of response quality (what makes something a 2 vs a 4) • Give clear, opinionated feedback in writing on what worked, what didn't, and what felt off or misleading • Help define what great looks like when working with tools like Cursor, Codex and Claude Code What we mean by "taste" We're looking for engineers who can answer questions like: • Does this feel like something a strong engineer would actually say? • Is this explanation helpful, or just technically correct? • Is the model guiding the user well, or just dumping output? • Would this interaction build or erode trust? You should be comfortable making subjective but rigorous judgments, and explaining them clearly. Who you are • Senior, Staff or Principal-level engineer (or equivalent experience) • Strong background in TypeScript/JavaScript or Python • Hands-on experience with at least one of OpenAI Codex, Claude Code or Cursor • Deep familiarity with modern AI-assisted dev workflows • Able to evaluate code without executing it or reviewing every line • Strong written and spoken English (B2 or above). You'll be writing detailed feedback and recording short video explanations, so this is a hard requirement • Comfortable giving direct, opinionated feedback • High bar for what good engineering looks like Nice to have • Prior exposure to prompt design or evaluation workflows • Experience mentoring senior engineers or defining engineering standards Engagement details • Rate: $100-$200/hour depending on experience and location • Hours: 10-20 hours/week, flexible • Duration: ongoing. Projects run from about two weeks to a few months each, and we offer new ones to evaluators who do well • Start: as soon as you clear the take-home and a project has an open seat • Process: one take-home evaluation exercise with a recorded Loom walkthrough. Dabei verbindest du datengetriebenes Experimentieren mit einem guten Gespür für UX/UI, überzeugenden Texten und einem tiefen Verständnis für das Verhalten unserer Kund:innen. Du übernimmst die Verantwortung für die Conversion-Rates, erkennst Wachstumspotenziale und setzt Erkenntnisse in konkrete Verbesserungen um. Außerdem wirkst du an der Entwicklung eines neuen Produktkonfigurators mit und gestaltest intuitive digitale Erlebnisse, die es unseren Kund:innen leichter machen, unsere Produkte zu entdecken, zu individualisieren und zu kaufen. Wir suchen jemanden, der analytisch denkt, schnell handelt und Freude daran hat, Ideen von der Erkenntnis bis zur Umsetzung zu bringen. Eigenständig führst du Kundenbefragungen und User Research durch, um Reibungspunkte und Wachstumschancen zu identifizieren. Produktentwicklung: Du wirkst am Aufbau eines neuen Produktkonfigurators mit und gestaltest das digitale Erlebnis rund um unsere Produkte. Erfahrung oder nachweisbares Potenzial in Digital Product Management, Growth, Conversion-Rate-Optimierung (CRO), Growth Design oder E-Commerce. Sehr gutes Verständnis von UX/UI-Prinzipien und ein ausgeprägtes ästhetisches Gespür für intuitive, ansprechende digitale Erlebnisse. Talent für klare, überzeugende Website-Texte und kommerzielle Botschaften, einschließlich Headlines, USPs und CTAs. Unternehmerisches Denken, ein ausgeprägtes Verantwortungsbewusstsein sowie die Fähigkeit, Prioritäten zu setzen, Initiative zu ergreifen und Ideen bis zur Umsetzung voranzutreiben. title: Robot Learning Engineer
description: Why this role is exciting Rohlik is the leading Central European e-grocer. More than a million customers buy their groceries from us through Rohlik.cz , Knuspr.de , Kifli.hu , Gurkerl.at and Sezamo.ro , choosing from over 17,000 items, delivered within a couple of hours in 15-minute windows. We are building the autonomous grocer. Maia, our AI assistant, already talks to customers and builds their orders; agents are moving into our buying and logistics; vision models are learning to watch quality. The next frontier is physical: robots taking over more and more of the work in our fulfilment centres, until fresh food moves from producers to households at a cost nobody else can match. We are setting out to record how our own people handle groceries and to turn those recordings into a training corpus for manipulation policies. Our warehouses already log what happened on every pick and every quality check, so the recordings can carry labels most datasets never get. Making that hold is part of the job. You decide what makes an hour of footage trainable — before we bank hundreds of them. What you will own and deliver The capture spec. Cameras, mounts, calibration, and what disqualifies an episode. You write it before we buy the fleet and enforce it after. When the spec and the floor disagree, you go to the floor and find out which one is wrong. Ground truth. Hand pose is the signal that transfers from human video to robot policies, and warehouse reality — work gloves, occlusion, cold halls — is exactly where the published models struggle. You own how we measure that and how we close the gap. The evaluation harness. The corpus only counts if a policy can train on it. You build the harness that decides which hours make the bank, and you hold the trainability bar as the volume grows. The first training runs. Once hours bank, you post-train open robot-learning models on our data and run the first task evaluations. Judgment before spend. The field moves monthly. You read what is published, reproduce the claims we depend on, and steer our capture before the money is spent, not after. The scope This is a seat on a small, newly created team: an operations lead who runs capture on the floor, a data engineer who owns the pipeline, and you: the machine-learning voice in the room. This is not a research-scientist role, and no publication record is required. The job is to make a corpus trainable and to train the first policies on it. What we are looking for PyTorch, and computer vision with real 3D geometry. Camera calibration, pose estimation, SLAM fundamentals. You have debugged an extrinsic calibration at least once in your life and know why it drifted. You can read a paper and reproduce it. Our pipeline is assembled from published work, and your job is knowing which claims survive contact with a chilled warehouse hall. You know what policies train on. Familiar with the current robot-learning stack and policy classes well enough to know what the training side will demand of the data before the data exists. Dataset instincts. You have trained on data you collected yourself, and you know the failure modes that only show up at training tim.. Comfortable as the only ML voice. You make the call, write it down, and revisit it when the pilot data says otherwise. AI is how work gets done here. Our engineers use Claude Code and Devin daily, and we expect you to direct agents for the unglamorous parts — harness code, data plumbing, reproduction scripts — while keeping the quality bar exactly where it was. Particularly relevant. Hand-pose estimation or egocentric video in production; multi-camera rigs and time sync; experience post-training robot-learning models; ROS 2. What success looks like in 90 days You have written the capture spec and we set up the first rigs against it. Your pilot gates have numbers, the first hours have passed your harness, and you can tell the people who sign the budget, with data, what the next hundred hours should look like. Are we a good fit? Take this role if you would rather own the spec that decides whether a dataset becomes an asset or a write-off than tune someone else's model on someone else's data, if a fulfilment centre at 6 a.m. sounds like a lab to you, and if you want the shortest possible line between your technical judgment and a capital decision. Read our culture code and are we a good fit? . What we offer The physical-AI side of the autonomous grocer, with the capture spec and the first training runs yours from day one A data asset few teams in the world get to build, in fresh groceries, a domain as hard as manipulation gets Off-the-shelf hardware, a managed cloud estate, and a mandate that has already started Benefits — see what we offer Are you in? Instead of a cover letter: pick a published human-video-to-robot-policy pipeline you rate, and tell us where it breaks on a warehouse floor where every hand wears a work glove. #LI-ML1 Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Senior DevOps/ Cloud Engineer (f/m/d)
description: Become a Part of ACCURIDS Join us and help shape the future of pharmaceutical data! At ACCURIDS, we’re building the data backbone behind life-science innovation — a system that identifies, links, and standardizes critical enterprise data in compliance with global standards such as ISO IDMP. We help global life-science companies launch products faster, more safely, and with better patient outcomes. At ACCURIDS, you’ll join a collaborative, growth-driven environment where your work makes a real impact from day one. How you’ll make an impact: You set up, maintain, and troubleshoot customer installations , managing both high-standard SaaS environments and restrictive customer on-premise deployments. You operate and scale our core AWS infrastructure , managing multi-account environments, EKS, RDS, S3, networking, and IAM. You support our development team with product operations , maintaining and extending GitLab CI/CD pipelines, driving declarative GitOps workflows (ArgoCD/Kargo), and managing incident response. You develop the Accurids SaaS platform stack , focusing on enhancing platform automation, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), identity management, and advanced observability. You drive our security operations , building out our compliance posture through log reviews, vulnerability scanning, active monitoring, alerting, and supporting ISO 27001 requirements. You ensure operational resilience and continuity , working as a key senior pillar to transition our infrastructure from a single-point-of-failure risk to a robust, well-documented architecture. What helps you succeed: Adaptability & Continuous Learning: A strong engineering mindset with a proven ability to pick up new tools, architectures, and methodologies rapidly as our ecosystem evolves. Cloud & Infrastructure Foundation: 3–5+ years of experience in DevOps, Cloud Engineering, or Platform Engineering, with production exposure to a major cloud provider (we use AWS, but Azure or GCP experience is just as welcome). Containerization Concepts: Solid foundational knowledge of the Kubernetes ecosystem, Docker containerization, and configuring CI/CD pipelines (such as GitLab CI). Modern Operations (Our Stack): Familiarity with—or a strong desire to learn—Infrastructure as Code (Terraform) and declarative GitOps workflows (ArgoCD/Kargo). Observability & Security Awareness: Observability & Security: Familiarity with cloud security tooling and monitoring/observability (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, Elasticsearch). Experience building a security posture is a strong plus. Core Competencies: Business fluency in English and an openness to integrating AI-assisted tools (like Cursor, Copilot, or ChatGPT) into your daily scripting and debugging workflows. (It’s a nice-to-have bonus if you have prior experience with Elasticsearch, Keycloak, Spring Boot, PostgreSQL, or compliance frameworks like ISO 27001!) Why you’ll love working here: Impactful Career Growth: Evolve into a Lead DevOps / Platform Lead role or deepen your specialization in Cloud Infrastructure, Kubernetes, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), and DevSecOps as we scale. Epic Office & Hybrid Work: Work from our brand-new office in the KölnTurm, featuring breathtaking views over the city (even higher than the view from the Cologne Cathedral!). Enjoy flexible hybrid options. (Note: On-site presence in Cologne/NRW is required; fully remote work is not offered). Community & Industry Events: Connect and grow your network through exclusive industry events hosted regularly right in our scenic office space. Competitive Compensation: Fixed salary package of €75,000 – €100,000 per year for a full-time, permanent position. Work-Life Balance & Perks: 30 days of paid vacation, a personal learning budget, hardware of your choice (Mac, Linux, Windows), and your choice between a subsidized Urban Sports Club membership or a €50/month City Plus Card. Empowered Culture: High trust, flat hierarchies, and an environment where your decisions directly shape the product. Not ticking every box? We encourage you to apply anyway! We know great talent doesn’t always follow a checklist and we care more about your potential, curiosity, and motivation to learn. At ACCURIDS, we’re committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We especially encourage women and people from underrepresented backgrounds in tech, science, and data to apply. title: Principal Engineer
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h3>Available Locations</h3> <ul> <li>Austin, US</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Role Summary</strong></p> <p>Work on our edge CDN proxy services and products focussing on our customer speed improvement products, our caching systems and our connectivity to customer origins. Work hands on and in a leadership role for small groups of engineers, building products and operating services to make Cloudflare the fastest place in the world to serve content from.</p> <p><strong>Role Requirements (Must-Have Skills)</strong></p> <p><strong>Must-Have Skills</strong></p> <ul> <li>At least 5 years experience as a hands-on engineer</li> <li>Experience of operating high performance and large scale software systems</li> <li>Experience leading teams of engineers to deliver projects</li> <li>Experience of working on multiple concurrent projects with competing priorities</li> <li>Detailed knowledge of HTTP and transport protocols</li> <li>Working with other teams, maintaining clear lines of communication across and upwards in an organisation</li> <li>Customer focussed experience - building what customers need</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. title: Senior Data Scientist, Trust & Safety
description: <div class="content-intro"><h2><strong>Brief info about Vinted </strong></h2> <p data-renderer-start-pos="1"><span data-sheets-root="1">Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third. <br>The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:<br><br><strong><a href="https://careers.vinted.com/marketplace" target="_blank">Vinted Marketplace</a></strong> is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.<br><br><a href="https://careers.vinted.com/vintedgo" target="_blank"><strong>Vinted Go</strong></a> enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.<br><br><a href="https://careers.vinted.com/vintedpay" target="_blank"><strong>Vinted Pay</strong></a> is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.<br><br>Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people. </span></p></div><h2><strong>Information about the position </strong></h2> <p>You’ll join Trust & Safety’s Actioning team, whose mission is to protect the Vinted community from harmful activities and content. The team owns critical mechanisms, including user reporting, moderation workflows, policy enforcement, and interventions against malicious users.</p> <p>You will leverage your expertise in machine learning to research, design and implement new models for report and appeals prioritization, advanced sanctioning based on users' suspicions, and automation of moderation decisions. This involves working closely with our engineering teams to develop robust pipelines for data handling, feature engineering, model training, deployment, and continuous improvement. </p> <p>As a Senior Data Scientist, you will utilize advanced machine learning techniques to analyze text, images, and other data formats, tackling complex challenges to identify and address content that poses potential risks. You will champion best practices and methodologies, significantly enhancing the team's effectiveness and safeguarding Vinted. You will mentor others, influence the strategic direction for model development, and facilitate cross-functional collaborations to drive impactful results.</p> <h2><strong>In this position, you’ll </strong></h2> <ul> <li>Lead the research, development, and end-to-end lifecycle of production machine learning models that prioritize and automate actions on harmful marketplace entities at scale.</li> <li>Play a crucial role in establishing and refining essential machine learning processes, such as data versioning, creating labeling pipelines, and ensuring high-quality data availability for effective model training.</li> <li>Actively collaborate across teams, particularly with Data Infrastructure and backend engineers, to develop and maintain scalable data pipelines and infrastructure, ensuring optimal performance and scalability of deployed models.</li> <li>Influence and contribute to the strategic roadmap for the Actioning team, collaborating with Decision Scientists to test, assess, and continuously improve new models.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>About you </strong></h2> <ul> <li>Proven track record in data science (4+ years of experience), with a strong foundation in machine learning, statistics, or computational mathematics.</li> <li>Proficiency in both classical and deep learning techniques, and an adeptness in leveraging the latest tools and methodologies to solve complex problems.</li> <li>Hands-on experience building and deploying agentic AI applications or LLM-powered workflows that handle large traffic, balancing quality, latency, and cost efficiency.</li> <li>Deep understanding of the challenges involved in deploying, maintaining, and scaling real-time ML models in production, with a proven ability to address these challenges effectively.</li> <li>Proven capability to work with engineering teams, designing and implementing efficient data ingestion, feature engineering, and model training pipelines that support robust and reliable model deployment.</li> <li>Excellent problem-solving abilities, with a commitment to staying at the forefront of developments in machine learning and data science, driving innovation and thought leadership within the team.</li> <li>Ability to clearly communicate complex ideas and technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders, ensuring that technical elements are properly understood and integrated to deliver business value.</li> <li>Past experience with fraud detection, harmful content detection or any other adversarial domain would be considered an advantage. </li> </ul> <h2><strong>Work perks  </strong></h2> <ul> <li>The opportunity to benefit from our share options programme</li> <li>25 days of paid annual leave</li> <li>Newest MacBook models</li> <li>Confidential Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for you and your family</li> <li>Frequent team-building events</li> <li>Home office support: we provide IT workstation equipment and a personal budget of up to €540 for home workplace furniture</li> <li>Lunch benefit per working day</li> <li>A personal monthly budget for shopping on Vinted</li> <li>Collective Defined Contribution Pension plan</li> <li>NS Business Card for your commute to the office by public transport</li> <li>Company bike leasing scheme</li> <li>Monthly budget for a flexible benefits platform</li> <li>Work from Home allowance</li> <li>A dog-friendly office</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Working at Vinted </strong></h2> <p><strong>Workation policy</strong></p> <p>Better balance holidays with workdays by working remotely! Up to 90 days per year in the EU, of these, 21 days can be spent globally. For non-EU citizens, it's 21 days worldwide. This can be combined with time off for vacation or personal time.</p> <p><strong>Individual learning budget</strong></p> <p>Each year, you’ll be given a learning budget (starting at €3,000), and a total of up to 10 working days over a 2-year period to support your personal and professional development.</p> <p><strong>Hybrid work</strong></p> <p>Our hybrid model, with 2 recommended office days a week, gives you and your team the flexibility to decide if and when you want to work from home, and when to catch up in person.</p> <p><strong>Equal opportunity</strong></p> <p>We welcome applications from everybody, regardless of your background, identity, or life experiences. Job openings come with guides, not checklists. If you’re excited about a role, but don’t identify with every point in the ‘About you’ section, apply anyway – you might still be the perfect match!</p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="title">The annual gross salary range for this position excluding 8% holiday pay is:</div><div class="pay-range"><span>€67.700</span><span class="divider">—</span><span>€91.500 EUR</span></div></div></div> Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

At Summit, we believe in building a team of world class professionals who are passionate about this mission, and it is our people who drive this mission to reality. Summit’s core values include integrity, passion for excellence, purposeful urgency, collaboration, and our commitment to people. Our employees are truly the heart and soul of our culture, and they are invaluable in shaping our journey toward excellence.</p> <p>Summit’s team is inspired to touch and help change lives through Summit’s clinical studies in the field of oncology. title: Engineering Manager
description: The company Smart Electric Vehicle Charging Solutions. That’s the business we are in! GreenFlux offers a cloud-based charge point management SaaS (Software as a Service) solution. This software platform enables Charge Point Operators (CPOs) and e-Mobility Service Providers (eMSPs) to successfully launch their respective businesses. With its offering, GreenFlux plays a pivotal role in facilitating the uptake of electric vehicles and the renewable energy revolution. Our Development department is responsible for the technical design of new features, owns the architecture, and does technical operation. We are organised in agile end-to-end teams, working with well-defined and transparent processes. Our tech stack is centred around Microsoft .NET on Azure. To keep up with the rapid market and business expansion and to support the company’s dynamic growth, we are looking to bring an Engineering Manager to the team. The job The Engineering Managers (internally referred to as Heads of Engineering) are responsible for the performance of our development teams and the quality of our platform. You will be responsible for line managing the engineers of up to three development teams, ensuring they have the right direction, skills, and support to deliver high-quality results. Besides this, you will contribute to improving our agile way of working and strengthening engineering practices throughout the Development department. Key result areas include: Leadership and accountability: You are the hierarchical manager of the engineers in your teams and are accountable for growing those teams to become autonomous and highly performing. You set clear expectations, provide regular feedback, and are accountable for individual and team performance. You actively identify and address performance issues and skill gaps, coaching and developing engineers to become more self-sufficient and effective. Delivery and execution: You take responsibility for ensuring your teams deliver high-quality software in a predictable and efficient manner. You proactively manage risks, dependencies, and impediments, taking action when delivery or quality is at risk and driving improvements where needed. Technical quality: You use your technical background to assess and challenge engineering decisions, ensuring that software solutions meet the required standards for quality, reliability, scalability, and maintainability. You work closely with engineers and technical leads to promote sound technical decisions and address technical debt Continuous improvement: You drive improvements in engineering processes, ways of working, and the adoption of modern technologies, practices, and tools. You identify opportunities to increase efficiency, improve delivery performance, and strengthen engineering quality across teams. Team development: You build and maintain high-performing teams by ensuring the right balance of skills, experience, and perspectives. You proactively identify development needs, support professional growth, and foster a culture of ownership, collaboration, and continuous learning. Quality and documentation: You promote strong engineering standards, effective quality control, and clear technical documentation to support the long-term stability and maintainability of our platform. Strategic contribution: You contribute to setting the strategic direction of the Development department, translating broader objectives into concrete improvements and actions within your teams. Requirements We are looking for a strong and accountable engineering leader who combines a people-oriented approach with a clear focus on delivery, technical quality, and results. You empower your teams and create an environment where people take ownership of their work. You have a strong agile mindset without being dogmatic about tools and frameworks, and you know when to coach, challenge, or take decisive action to improve performance. You have 3+ years of experience as an Engineering Manager, preferably in a tech scale-up or SaaS environment. A solid background in software engineering, with the technical expertise to evaluate engineering decisions and assess software quality, reliability, scalability, and maintainability. Proven experience in leading engineering teams, setting clear expectations, managing performance, and addressing skill gaps through coaching, feedback, and development. A strong focus on delivery and execution, with the ability to take ownership of results, proactively manage risks, and drive improvements. Extensive knowledge of software development processes, modern engineering practices, and agile ways of working. Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the confidence to challenge decisions, provide constructive feedback, and collaborate with different stakeholder groups. The ability to think and act strategically while also translating plans into concrete actions and measurable improvements. Fluency in English. Dutch is a plus. A drive for continuous learning and self-improvement. A sustainable mindset! Our offer Working at GreenFlux means working in a dynamic, innovative, and informal organization, where new ideas and developments move quickly, and each day brings new opportunities and challenges. At one of the most inspiring locations in Amsterdam, you will have the chance to actively contribute to a sustainable future! We are striving towards an international and inclusive team, so we also offer Visa sponsorship and relocation compensation to expats. Join our revolution in mobility and energy! title: Account Executive - Mid-market
description: about us Every 10 minutes, 18 million conversations happen between businesses and consumers around the world. For decades, the consumer side of those conversations sucked: long queues, robotic menus, repeated explanations, and advice that is often unhelpful. Most people today still cannot simply say what their problem is in natural language when communicating with businesses. AI changes that. For the first time, companies can have natural conversations with customers at massive scale. Every B2C company - from energy providers to telcos to insurers - will use AI agents to talk to their customers. The number of conversations businesses will handle is going to explode in the coming years. At telli, we are solving the challenges that come with that shift. Today, leading B2C companies like Sky are already using telli to deploy thousands of voice agents to provide their customers with a new experience. But building a first voice agent is easy, getting it to drive real outcomes for customers and businesses is the hard part. telli helps companies build, deploy, and improve consumer-facing AI voice agents at scale. This will become one of the most important software categories of the next decade, and we intend to win it. We are a small, AI-pilled team that likes to solve hard problems. Be it engineering, product, or GTM - we build, experiment, and move fast, while heavily leveraging the capabilities of AI models. All of us like to challenge ourselves and take real ownership over what we do, all while still staying humble and keeping a low-ego culture. Check out our principles to see how we work. Your mission You will be pivotal for telli's growth. Your mission is to drive revenue by building trusted relationships with mid-market customers and closing deals (30k-60k land deal size). You are one of the first to join this team and will be pivotal to shape our mid-market motion what you'll do: Own large enterprise deals end-to-end: Discovery, demos, security review, procurement, contract redlines, you carry the deal from the first call through signature uncovering telli’s value for the customer Generate the your own pipeline: Our BDR team supports you; they don't replace you. You target the accounts, you write the outbound, you make the calls Multi-thread complex buying committees: Heads of Sales, Operations, CX, Legal, IT, Security, Procurement, and CFOs at companies of 500 to 10,000+ employees. You build the relationships before procurement comes in to test them Own a quota and hit revenue targets: Close large deals that meaningfully contribute to telli’s growth Shape telli's enterprise playbook: qualification, multi-thread strategy, executive engagement, pricing. What works for you becomes the team standard Feed structured signal back into product, marketing, and strategy: You sit closest to the customer. Your input shapes what we build next what makes you a great fit: You have at least 1 year of experience closing mid-market deals: you’ve sold mid-five-figure contracts and consistently performed at the top of your team. You're an elite relationship builder: you know the difference between a contact and a champion, and you've won deals because of that distinction. Buyers trust you before they trust your product You're a hunter: you know how to manufacture pipeline without a warm inbound stream and you don't complain when it's hard You have executive presence: you can hold a room with a C-Suite from the first interaction. Your credibility is immediate and natural, not earned over multiple meetings You're obsessively prepared: you know more about the prospect's situation than they expect you to, every time You're low ego and high accountability: you're not above doing the grunt work. You're competitive with yourself first. You take feedback, you act on it, and you share credit when you win You speak business-level German and English You want to work on-site 5 days a week in Berlin you may not be a good fit if: You wait for pipeline to be handed to you. AE means you generate You need detailed instructions and shy away from taking responsibility You only show up for the "strategic" parts of the deal and skip the procurement/security-review grunt work You've never personally carried a quota or closed deals end-to-end You want to work remotely.
