title: Leiter Finanz- und Rechnungswesen (m/w/d)
description: Sie sind bilanzsicher, denken unternehmerisch und möchten mehr als Zahlen verwalten? Sie haben Freude daran, komplexe Zusammenhänge zu durchdringen, Verantwortung zu übernehmen und externe Experten fachlich auf Augenhöhe zu begleiten? Dann könnte diese Position genau das Richtige für Sie sein. Für die S-UBG-Gruppe in Aachen suchen wir zur Direkteinstellung einen Leiter Finanz- und Rechnungswesen (m/w/d) , der das Rechnungswesen von 13 Gesellschaften fachlich verantwortet, Jahresabschlüsse sicher beherrscht und die Zusammenarbeit mit Steuerberatern und Wirtschaftsprüfern aktiv gestaltet. Sie erwartet eine anspruchsvolle Aufgabe mit viel Eigenständigkeit, Einblicken in unterschiedliche Gesellschafts- und Beteiligungsstrukturen und der Verantwortung für die fachliche und disziplinarische Führung eines kleinen, erfahrenen Teams. Das erwartet Sie Jahresabschlüsse erstellen und prüfen: Sie betreuen das Rechnungswesen von 13 Kapital- und Personengesellschaften mit unterschiedlichen Größen und Anforderungen. Sie erstellen Jahresabschlüsse nach HGB eigenständig, prüfen extern erstellte Abschlüsse und kümmern sich um deren Veröffentlichung. Abschlussqualität sicherstellen: Sie sorgen für korrekte Abstimmungen, Abgrenzungen und Rückstellungen und begleiten die Wirtschaftsprüfung der fünf zu prüfenden Jahresabschlüsse als zentraler fachlicher Ansprechpartner. Steuerliche Themen koordinieren: Sie bearbeiten steuerliche Fragestellungen der Gesellschaften und begleiten die Erstellung der Steuererklärungen – je nach Gesellschaft eigenständig oder in Zusammenarbeit mit externen Steuerberatern. Auch Steuervorauszahlungen, E-Bilanzen, pauschale Lohnsteuern und die Begleitung von Betriebsprüfungen gehören zum Aufgabenfeld. Externe Partner und Gesellschafter begleiten: Sie steuern die Zusammenarbeit mit Steuerberatern und Wirtschaftsprüfern, hinterfragen Ergebnisse und klären steuerliche sowie wirtschaftliche Fragestellungen mit Gesellschaftern und internen Ansprechpartnern. Liquidität und Kapitalanlagen steuern: Sie übernehmen die Liquiditäts- und Festgelddisposition, erstellen Liquiditätsplanungen und Kapitalabrufe und bereiten Empfehlungen für finanzwirtschaftliche Entscheidungen vor. Planung und Reporting gestalten: Sie erstellen Wirtschaftspläne, Quartalsberichte und Ergebnishochrechnungen, bereiten Vorlagen für Aufsichtsrat und Hauptversammlung vor und koordinieren statistische Meldungen an Behörden und Verbände. Beteiligungsstrukturen begleiten: Sie beschäftigen sich mit den bilanziellen und steuerlichen Besonderheiten unterschiedlicher Gesellschafts- und Fondsstrukturen und übernehmen Aufgaben in der Nachbetreuung abgewickelter Fonds. Team führen: Sie übernehmen nach Ihrer Einarbeitung die fachliche und disziplinarische Führung eines eingespielten kleinen Teams. Dabei sorgen Sie für klare Abläufe, eine gute Zusammenarbeit und eine hohe Qualität der Arbeitsergebnisse. Das macht die Rolle besonders Bilanzierung mit fachlichem Anspruch: Unterschiedliche Gesellschaftsformen, Beteiligungsstrukturen und steuerliche Besonderheiten sorgen für abwechslungsreiche Aufgaben jenseits der klassischen Finanzbuchhaltung. Eigenständigkeit statt reiner Zuarbeit: Sie erstellen und prüfen Abschlüsse nicht nur, sondern beurteilen Sachverhalte selbstständig, hinterfragen externe Ergebnisse und bringen Ihre fachliche Einschätzung aktiv ein. Unternehmerischer Blick über die Buchhaltung hinaus: Sie beschäftigen sich auch mit Liquiditätsplanung, Kapitalanlagen und wirtschaftlichen Entscheidungen und können so über die klassische Bilanzbuchhaltung hinaus wirken. Fachliche Verantwortung und Führung vereint: Sie verbinden anspruchsvolle Bilanzierungsaufgaben mit der Führung eines kleinen, erfahrenen Teams. Dabei bleiben Sie selbst tief in den fachlichen Themen und gestalten gleichzeitig die Zusammenarbeit und Arbeitsabläufe. Raum für Weiterentwicklung: Sie haben Interesse daran, Prozesse zu verbessern, Abläufe zu automatisieren oder KI sinnvoll im Rechnungswesen und Reporting einzusetzen? Dann sind Ihre Ideen willkommen. Das bringen Sie mit – Must have Fundierte Erfahrung in der Bilanzbuchhaltung: Sie haben Jahresabschlüsse nach HGB bereits eigenständig erstellt und verfügen über sichere Kenntnisse in der Bilanzierung und Abschlusserstellung. Steuerliches Verständnis: Sie kennen die wesentlichen steuerlichen Zusammenhänge von Kapital- und Personengesellschaften und können steuerliche Sachverhalte fachlich einordnen. Bilanzsicherheit und analytisches Denken: Sie erkennen Unstimmigkeiten, hinterfragen Buchungen und Abschlüsse und können auch komplexe Sachverhalte strukturiert durchdringen. Sorgfalt und Verlässlichkeit: Sie arbeiten verantwortungsbewusst, eigenständig und termintreu – mit einem hohen Anspruch an die Qualität Ihrer Ergebnisse. Eigeninitiative und Lernbereitschaft: Sie beschäftigen sich aktiv mit neuen gesetzlichen Anforderungen, arbeiten sich selbstständig in unbekannte Themen ein und prüfen deren Auswirkungen auf die Gesellschaften. Unternehmerisches Verständnis: Sie betrachten Zahlen nicht isoliert, sondern verstehen ihre Bedeutung für wirtschaftliche Entscheidungen und entwickeln lösungsorientierte Ansätze. Führungskompetenz und Teamorientierung: Sie bringen die Fähigkeit und Bereitschaft mit, ein kleines Team fachlich und disziplinarisch zu führen. Erste Führungserfahrung ist willkommen, aber keine zwingende Voraussetzung. Das bringen Sie mit – Nice to have Eine Weiterbildung zum Bilanzbuchhalter (IHK), Steuerfachwirt oder ein einschlägiges betriebswirtschaftliches Studium. Entscheidend ist Ihre praktische Erfahrung – ein bestimmter formaler Abschluss ist keine Voraussetzung. Erfahrung im Rechnungswesen von Beteiligungsgesellschaften, vermögensverwaltenden Gesellschaften oder Venture-Capital-Fonds. Kenntnisse in der steuerlichen Behandlung komplexer Gesellschafter- und Beteiligungsstrukturen. Erfahrung in der Liquiditätsplanung, im Reporting oder in der finanzwirtschaftlichen Steuerung. Erste Erfahrung in der fachlichen Anleitung oder Koordination von Mitarbeitenden. Interesse an Digitalisierung, Prozessautomatisierung und dem Einsatz von KI im Rechnungswesen, Controlling oder Reporting. Gute Englischkenntnisse. Das wird Ihnen geboten Spannende Incentivierungsprogramme werden geboten. 30 Tage Urlaub pro Jahr. Mobiles Arbeiten: Bis zu zwei Tage pro Woche können Sie mobil arbeiten. 40-Stunden-Woche mit klar definierter vertraglicher Arbeitszeit. Gestaltungsmöglichkeiten: Ihre Ideen zur Weiterentwicklung von Prozessen, Digitalisierung und Automatisierung sind willkommen. Klingt interessant? Senden Sie uns Ihre Bewerbung, wir melden uns innerhalb von 48 Stunden bei Ihnen und stellen Ihnen die Position in einem kurzen Gespräch vor. Danach entscheiden Sie, ob Sie in den Auswahlprozess einsteigen möchten. Die HR-Werkstatt unterstützt unseren Kunden im Besetzungsprozess dieser Vakanz. Etwaige Unterlagen werden von uns entgegengenommen und erst im Rahmen des weiteren Bewerbungsprozesses – also nach dem Erstgespräch und mit Ihrer Zustimmung – an unseren Kunden weitergeleitet. title: Lead Manager Governance, Risk & Compliance (Interner ISB & DSB) (m/w/d)

Verantwortung für den Betrieb und die kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung unseres ISMS (z. B. nach ISO 27001 / TISAX®). title: Senior Named Account Executive, Saudi Arabia
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Strategically connect disparate needs to strengthen Cloudflare's platform sale, actively involving and influencing technical C-level minus one executives.</li> <li><strong>Virtual Team Leadership:</strong> Set clear direction and lead a virtual team of in-GEO specialists, Product Managers, Deal Desk, and Legal to collaboratively manage and close complex customer opportunities. Consistently provide clear, direct, and constructive feedback to team members, coaching them to improve communication, learn from mistakes, and enhance the quality of work. Share learnings proactively to build trust across the organization.</li> <li><strong>Organizational Impact & Leadership:</strong> Consistently focus on the long-term needs of the team and the business, understanding how decisions impact other teams and openly sharing these insights. Leverage company-wide learnings to improve department and team execution. Serve as a leader within Cloudflare, making significant contributions while elevating the work of others by bringing diverse perspectives and strategic long-term thinking.</li> </ul> title: Senior Systems Engineer, Cloudflare Tunnel

Kubernetes.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Role Requirements</strong></p> <ul> <li>8+ years of experience in backend software development with a focus on building  secure and highly available distributed title: Lead Software Engineer
description: Building the intelligence behind Solskin Are you a driven person who wants to make buildings come alive? What you will do This is a hands-on leadership position: you code every day. Own the full stack: You maintain and develop the whole software stack, from cloud and data management to user-facing applications, and from low-level embedded firmware to high-level AI controllers learning from users. You keep it reliable and keep making it better. Be the link between the teams: You build the software that runs on real buildings and support the hardware team. You also build the internal tools used by sales and the business team. Lead what comes next : With the CEO and CTO, you set the software direction and lead development of future products. Our stack: Backend: Python, FastAPI, PyTorch Frontend: React, TypeScript Hardware: C/C++, STM32 microcontrollers, Beckhoff PLCs Database: PostgreSQL (TimescaleDB) DevOps & Cloud: Linux, Docker, AWS, Grafana What we are looking for Required: Education : MSc or PhD in Computer Science, Robotics, Electrical or Mechanical Engineering, or similar. Python : This is a must. You write clean Python that runs in production, on real systems. Embedded & Hardware: Shipped C/C++ on microcontrollers running on physical hardware; comfortable working with sensors, actuators, and basic electronics. Applied AI & Control: Understanding of modern control and ML/RL methods, with hands-on PyTorch experience applied to physical or dynamic systems. Cloud & data : You are comfortable with PostgreSQL, Docker and AWS. Leadership attitude : You take ownership, make decisions, and want to grow as a leader. Languages : English. German is a big plus. Hybrid setting : You will be expected to be on-site at least three days per week, and sometimes at customers’ locations, to work on real products. Availability : 100%, as soon as possible. Work-permit: You need the right to work in Switzerland for this position. Preferred: Startup experience: You have worked in a startup before and know what that means. Building modeling and control: You have prior experience handling building data, modeling building dynamics, and developing building controllers; ideally with ML and RL tools. Frontend: React and TypeScript. Mindset: Hands-on: You lead, and you still do the hard work yourself. Fast: You are pragmatic and iterate quickly. Things break, and plans change, and that doesn't scare you. Purpose: You care about climate and want to make buildings smarter. Benefits Impact: Your code runs on real buildings. You see the result of your work. Ownership: A key role with a real say in our product and technology, and room to grow with the company. Flexibility: Hybrid work and flexible hours. We like being in the Zurich office together, so plan for regular office days. Team: A small, skilled, and down-to-earth team that helps each other out. The reality: We are a startup. It is often messy; things rarely work the first time, and the workload is real. In return, you get a lot of freedom and responsibility from day one. Sounds like you? Software meets hardware: Your experience where software and hardware come together. Juggeling many hats: You’ll rarely finish one thing from A to Z without interruptions: different stacks, different people, different projects, and on-site surprises. title: Senior Customer Reliability Engineer
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h2>Available Locations</h2><ul><li>Austin, US</li></ul><h2>About the Role</h2><p>Cloudflare built its reputation helping build a better Internet, defending millions of sites, giving away SSL and DDoS mitigation when the industry charged premium prices. In an acceleratingly dangerous world, the scope of that mission has changed. We are becoming something more: critical infrastructure. Banks run their payment rails on us. Governments run public services on us. Media companies depend on us during live events. Health systems depend on us to provide care. Reliability for these customers is no longer a feature of our product. It is a mission.</p><p>Serving that customer base demands a different operating model. Traditional support organizations route tickets. Traditional engineering organizations ship features. Neither alone is enough when the stakes are this high. We are pivoting to something different: a customer-facing engineering organization, directly engaged with our customers at scale. This is work a central dev team cannot do from the inside of the network.</p><p>The Customer Reliability Engineering function is the spine of that pivot. CRE is SRE applied outward, the same engineering discipline, applied to the reliability of the systems our customers run on Cloudflare. You are the engineer who owns the problems that matter most to the customers who matter most, and you contribute directly to our products and tooling, in partnership with Product Engineering, to hold that standard across the entire customer base.</p><p>CRE is a rapid response team and a proactive engineering team. You fix things at the edge as they come up, and you help build the product capabilities that identify customer issues before they become a crisis. Both modes are equally core.</p><p><strong>Rapid response.</strong> When a customer issue surfaces that is high-severity, cross-layer and complex, you are the engineer who answers. You reproduce the defect, isolate the root cause across Cloudflare's infrastructure and the customer's stack, drive the fix with Product Engineering, and confirm resolution. You hold on-call for high-severity incidents as part of a global shift rotation.</p><p><strong>Proactive engineering.</strong> When no fire is burning, you work with Product Engineering and our platform teams to build the capabilities that make the next fire cheaper or unnecessary: telemetry pipelines that correlate signals across the customer base, detectors that fire before a human notices, diagnostic tooling that scales across hundreds of customers, automation that reduces toil for Customer Support. Every incident you carry generates engineering output that reduces the cost of recurrence. The work compounds.</p><p>Cloudflare is building CRE as an AI-native function. You will work with and help build agents and tooling that pre-diagnose incidents, surface relevant logs and configuration, and propose fixes with cited evidence. Engineers who ship AI-assisted diagnostics are the ones defining this discipline.</p><h2>Responsibilities</h2><h3>Rapid response:</h3><ul><li>Own a Sev-1 incident where a large financial services customer sees asymmetric latency from a single POP. Trace it through BGP routing and origin configuration. Produce the fix upstream.</li><li>Diagnose a recurring WebSocket disconnect that a media customer has been fighting for weeks. Isolate it to a specific interaction between WAF and their origin load balancer. Drive the fix with Product Engineering.</li><li>Partner with a government customer's SRE team during an active DDoS event. Help them shape their Magic Transit and WAF configuration in real time.</li></ul><h3>Proactive engineering:</h3><ul><li>Build, with Product Engineering, a distributed tracing capability that correlates Cloudflare edge signals with customer origin metrics so a single query tells the story of a failing request end-to-end.</li><li>Ship a detector for a class of WAF false positives silently degrading several customers. Get it into production before the next renewal cycle.</li><li>Prototype an AI agent that takes a new customer case, pulls relevant logs and config, and proposes a root cause with linked evidence. Deploy it internally. Measure whether it makes engineers faster. Iterate.</li><li><strong>Rapid incident response and root cause analysis.</strong> Own the most complex, high-severity customer issues end-to-end, from first signal through confirmed resolution. Lead deep-dive debugging across the full stack: edge, network, DNS, transport, APIs, application, customer-side configuration. Reproduce defects, validate fixes with Engineering, and confirm customer-side resolution. Produce postmortems other engineers rely on. Hold on-call for high-severity incidents as part of a global rotation that includes weekends.</li><li><strong>Proactive reliability engineering.</strong> Analyze support and telemetry signals across the customer base to find systemic risks before they become incidents. Contribute monitoring, detection, and diagnostic capability to the core product and the engineering systems that give Customer Support early visibility into customer-affecting issues. Define customer-facing reliability metrics (error rates, resolution times, repeat-contact rates) and drive measurable improvement. Write automation that reduces mean-time-to-detect and mean-time-to-resolve.</li><li><strong>Cross-functional partnership.</strong> Manage the technical escalation lifecycle with clear ownership and timely communication. Partner with Product Engineering to drive fixes, workarounds, and configuration changes that address underlying gaps. Represent the customer reliability perspective in engineering syncs, incident reviews, and post-mortem processes.</li><li><strong>Technical leadership and enablement.</strong> Raise the technical floor of Customer Support through pair-debugging, structured knowledge transfer, and shared tooling. Document diagnostic procedures and resolution patterns in runbooks, internal knowledge bases, and AI skills. Share insights from customer-facing incidents to improve product documentation and operational readiness.</li><li><strong>Product and platform depth.</strong> Maintain deep, current expertise across Cloudflare's product portfolio: edge networking, DNS, CDN, WAF, DDoS mitigation, Zero Trust, Workers, and our developer platform. Anticipate customer impact from new releases and architecture changes. Serve as a go-to subject-matter expert in one or more domains.</li></ul><h2>Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</h2><ul><li>Minimum 5 years of hands-on experience in site reliability engineering, escalation engineering, systems engineering, or a comparable deeply technical support / operations role, with at least 2 years in customer-facing environments.</li><li>Strong foundation in networking and security:<ul><li>TCP/IP fundamentals: OSI model, IPv4/IPv6 addressing, subnetting, routing, switching.</li><li>Core protocols: DNS, HTTP/S, TLS/SSL, SMTP, SNMP, NTP.</li><li>Routing protocols: BGP, OSPF, including path selection and route propagation.</li><li>Firewall concepts: stateful/stateless inspection, rule sets, NAT, ACLs.</li><li>VPN and encryption: IPSec, SSL/TLS tunnels, GRE.</li><li>Zero Trust architecture, network segmentation, modern security models.</li></ul></li><li>Proficiency with observability and diagnostic tooling: packet capture and analysis (Wireshark, tcpdump), log aggregation (Kibana, Elasticsearch), metrics dashboards (Grafana), distributed tracing.</li><li>Strong scripting and automation skills (Bash, Python) with a track record of shipping tooling that improves reliability and reduces toil.</li><li>Experience with incident management, postmortem culture, and SLO/SLI-based reliability practices.</li><li>Excellent written and verbal communication. Able to convey complex technical information clearly to engineers, leadership, and customers.</li><li>Comfort owning ambiguous, cross-layer problems. Composure under pressure during high-severity incidents.</li><li>SRE, DevOps, or platform engineering experience with direct customer-facing accountability.</li><li>Deep expertise at both L3/L4 (network infrastructure) and L7 (application protocols, DNS, HTTP, WebSocket).</li><li>Expert-level proficiency with Linux command-line tools: curl, dig, git, traceroute, mtr, strace, ss.</li><li>Data-at-scale analysis using SQL, PromQL, or equivalent.</li><li>Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Pulumi), and container orchestration (Kubernetes, Docker).</li><li>Track record of building internal tooling or diagnostic utilities that measurably improved team efficiency.</li><li>Demonstrated technical leadership: mentoring engineers, driving cross-team initiatives, influencing outcomes without direct authority.</li><li>Experience applying AI/ML to production engineering or operational workflows.</li><li>Comfort engaging directly with enterprise customer engineering teams, including on calls during incidents.</li></ul><h2>Bonus Points</h2><ul><li>Active Cloudflare user who understands the platform as a practitioner.</li><li>Hands-on experience with Workers, Pages, R2, D1, or other developer platform services.</li><li>Cloud networking and security experience across AWS, Azure, or GCP.</li><li>Web programming (HTML, JavaScript) and regular expressions.</li><li>Chaos engineering or formal reliability frameworks (e.g., Google SRE principles).</li><li>Managing or configuring non-HTTP services: email, DNS authoritative/recursive

title: Werkstudent:in Projektmanagement & Business Development
description: Kein klassischer Werkstudentenjob: Du baust mit uns ein neues Team auf, vom ersten Kundengespräch bis zum laufenden Betrieb. Dein Einstieg bei der msp AG Wir sind ein Hamburger Softwareunternehmen für Prozessberatung, Systemintegration und Entwicklung im Handel. Kunden wie REWE, EDEKA, hagebau, Vitra und die JAKO AG digitalisieren mit uns ihre Marketing- und Produktprozesse. Wir sorgen dafür, dass Händler und Marken ihre Produktdaten und Bilder im Griff haben: einmal sauber gepflegt, überall richtig ausgespielt, vom Onlineshop bis zum Prospekt. Dafür bauen wir in unserer MarTech-Abteilung gerade ein neues Team auf. Statt Aufgaben abzuarbeiten, die sonst liegen bleiben, arbeitest Du als vollwertiger Teil des Teams mit. Du denkst Lösungen mit, setzt sie selbst um und bist mit beim Kunden. Und Du begleitest den ganzen Prozess: Du bist dabei, wenn wir neue Kunden gewinnen, planst und setzt ihre Projekte mit um und betreust sie danach im laufenden Betrieb. Du lernst, was das Studium nicht beibringt: wie man Projekte führt, Kunden berät und Lösungen bis zum Ende trägt. Im Gegenzug bringst Du frische Ideen aus Uni und Studienumfeld mit. Darauf sind wir neugierig. Ganz ehrlich: Vieles in unserem neuen Team ist noch nicht fertig. Abläufe, Vorlagen und die Art, wie wir zusammenarbeiten, entstehen gerade. Wer hier einsteigt, legt selbst Hand an und gestaltet mit. Deine Aufgaben Projektsteuerung: Du planst und steuerst gemeinsam mit unserer Projektleitung Kundenprojekte und behältst Fortschritt, Aufwände und Termine im Blick. Umsetzung mit KI: Du setzt selbst im System um: Du konfigurierst Lösungen und baust Prototypen, KI-gestützt und wo nötig mit Code. Team mitaufbauen: Du hilfst, Vorlagen und Projektstrukturen für unser wachsendes Team aufzubauen. Anforderungen: Du arbeitest im Anforderungsmanagement mit: Anforderungen aufnehmen, dokumentieren und priorisieren. Datenkonzepte: Du wirkst an Datenkonzepten mit: welche Produktdaten unsere Kunden führen, wie sie strukturiert sind und wer sie pflegt. Kundentermine & Workshops: Du bereitest Kundentermine und Workshops vor und hältst Ergebnisse und Entscheidungen nachvollziehbar fest. Zusammenarbeit: Du arbeitest mit unseren Teams aus Produktentwicklung, Vertrieb und Marketing zusammen. Das bringst Du mit Studium: Du studierst mit guten Noten, idealerweise im Master, gern mit IT- oder Wirtschaftsbezug wie Wirtschaftsinformatik oder Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen. Erste Praxiserfahrung aus Praktika, Jobs oder eigenen Projekten wäre von Vorteil. Lust auf KI: Du probierst neue KI-Tools aus, bevor jemand danach fragt, und willst herausfinden, wie man damit schneller und besser arbeitet. Selbst bauen: Du willst nicht nur verstehen, wie Systeme und Datenstrukturen zusammenspielen, sondern selbst Hand anlegen: konfigurieren, ausprobieren, auch mal Code schreiben und Deine Ergebnisse mit dem Kunden verproben. Erste Programmiererfahrung ist ein Plus. Anpacken: Dich reizt es, Dinge aufzubauen, die noch nicht fertig sind, statt Bestehendes zu verwalten. Offene Fragen motivieren Dich, statt Dich zu bremsen. Kundenkontakt: Du gehst gern auf Menschen zu und scheust kein Kundengespräch. Du drückst Dich klar aus, mündlich wie schriftlich, auf Deutsch und auf Englisch. Analytisches Denken: Du zerlegst komplexe Sachverhalte und erkennst, welche Frage zuerst zu klären ist. Du hast keine Angst, Datenstrukturen neu zu denken und zu gestalten. Verbindlichkeit: Zusagen und Termine hältst Du, und Du meldest früh, wenn etwas kippt. Das bieten wir Dir Verantwortung mit Rückendeckung: Du übernimmst als vollwertiges Teammitglied eigene Themen und Kundenaufgaben. Dabei arbeitest Du eng mit Deiner Projektleitung zusammen und lernst direkt im laufenden Kundenprojekt. Das ganze Bild: Vertrieb, Projekt und Kundenbetreuung in einer Rolle, statt nur ein Ausschnitt in einer Abteilung. Echte Businesswelt: Neben dem Studium erlebst Du, wie Kundenprojekte wirklich laufen: mit echten Kunden, echten Budgets und echten Entscheidungen. Gestaltungsraum: Du bist früh dabei in einem neuen Team und prägst mit, wie es arbeitet. Perspektive: Wir suchen nicht für ein Semester, sondern denken über Dein Studium hinaus. Werkzeuge: KI-gestütztes Arbeiten gehört bei uns zum Alltag, nicht zum Pilotprojekt. Flexibilität: 16-20 Std./Woche, mobiles Arbeiten und Rücksicht auf Deine Klausurphasen. Vertragsdetails: Vertragslaufzeit und Probezeit flexibel nach Absprache. Arbeitsplatz: Moderne Büros im Herzen Hamburgs mit MacBook, ergonomischem Arbeitsplatz, Obst, Getränken, Kicker und Dart. Gute S-Bahn-Anbindung und Parkplätze. Werde Teil unseres Teams und gestalte mit uns die digitale Zukunft unserer Kunden. Wir freuen uns auf Dich. description: <p><strong>Join the team rewriting the rules in private markets.</strong></p> <p>Moonfare delivers what few others can: the highly sought-after funds and hidden-gem investments that go beyond what most private banks offer. Every opportunity is subjected to a ruthless vetting process; the bar is unforgivingly high. The result? Institutional-quality portfolios for investors who demand more.</p> <p>Our team combines finance veterans with talent from tech, consulting, law and industries you’d never expect. Headquartered in Berlin, we operate from eight offices across Europe, the US and Asia.</p> <p>If you're ready to build what's next in private markets, let's talk.</p> <p><strong>Chief of Staff (m/f/d)</strong></p> <p>At Moonfare, we are leading a new era of private equity investing. We are seeking an exceptional Chief of Staff to join our executive team at a pivotal moment in our growth. Reporting directly to the co-CEO, this highly strategic role sits at the intersection of strategy, business management, and leadership, driving Moonfare’s most critical initiatives, from embedding AI across the business to guiding our transformation into a premier Asset Manager. This is a hands-on role: you’ll move from advising on strategy to delivering it yourself, rolling up your sleeves to make things happen.</p> <p><strong>You will:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead and coordinate high-priority, company-wide initiatives from conception to execution</li> <li>Prepare and orchestrate the bi-weekly ExCo run and change meetings</li> <li>Drive and project manage strategic priorities including Moonfare’s evolution into an Asset Manager</li> <li>Act as a trusted advisor to the co-CEOs and ExCo, applying first-principles thinking and analytical rigor to structure complex challenges and deliver actionable insights</li> <li>Shape and manage the executive operating rhythm: leadership offsites, board preparation, and critical business reviews</li> <li>Support board, investor, and partner engagements, ensuring clear, compelling communication of Moonfare’s strategy and progress</li> <li>Serve as a connector across departments and geographies, enabling alignment and seamless execution of Moonfare’s vision</li> </ul> <p><strong>The next Moonfarian:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Minimum of 3–4 years of significant experience in a top-tier management consulting firm or senior strategic leadership role</li> <li>Proven success leading large-scale, cross-functional initiatives in dynamic, complex environments</li> <li>Exceptional problem-solving skills, combining first-principles thinking with a highly analytical, data-driven approach</li> <li>Strong leadership and stakeholder management capabilities, with the gravitas to influence at all levels</li> <li>Background in financial services, asset management, or FinTech is advantageous but not required</li> </ul> <p><strong>If you feel you do not meet all of the requirements, we still encourage you to apply!</strong></p> <p><strong>Invest in yourself:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Ownership and Impact: </strong>You are empowered to bring ideas, make decisions, and see your work directly contribute to Moonfare's success.<br><strong>Transparent Environment: </strong>We believe in open communication. You will receive regular updates on company strategy, performance against our KPIs, and key business decisions.</li> <li><strong>Personal Growth: </strong>We support your development with an individual growth budget of €1,500 or 2% of your base salary (whichever is higher).</li> <li><strong>Invest in Your Future: </strong>We support your long-term financial goals with a company pension scheme, providing a 20% employer contribution.</li> <li><strong>Relax and Recharge: </strong>You start with 25 vacation days and you’ll receive one additional day for each year of tenure, up to a maximum of 30 days.</li> <li><strong>Daily Lunch: </strong>Enjoy a free lunch every day that you are in the Berlin office, with a weekly changing menu that includes salads, curries, pastas, and a variety of vegan and vegetarian options.</li> <li><strong>Subsidised Public Transport: </strong>We support your commute with a monthly subsidy for the Deutschland job ticket, making your travel easier and more affordable.</li> <li><strong>Fitness and Wellbeing:</strong> Stay active with a subsidised Urban Sports Club membership, giving you flexible access to a wide variety of sports and wellness activities across Germany.</li> <li><strong>A Culture of Excellence: </strong>Join a team of ambitious, smart, and committed professionals who are passionate about revolutionising private market investing.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Our Values:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Our clients come first, Moonfare comes second, and we prioritise ourselves third - Client-Centric Focus.</strong> Putting clients first means creating value for them is essential. Placing Moonfare second signifies that our individual professional future at Moonfare depends on the company's commercial success. Prioritising ourselves third reflects our humility in putting clients and Moonfare before personal interests.</li> <li><strong>We pursue excellence and honor our promises - Commitment to Excellence.</strong> We hold ourselves to the highest standards, taking responsibility for our failures, and celebrating our successes. We commit to deadlines and stick to them and we learn from our mistakes.</li> <li><strong>We are here to win and to celebrate our collective achievements - Win together. </strong>We are mission-focused and think and act like owners. We exemplify the attitude we expect and each of us commits to do what it takes to succeed.</li> <li><strong>We foster personal growth but each of us earns our place as a Moonfarian through merit - Growth and Merit. </strong>We hire, retain, and develop exceptional people and invest in empowering them to excel. We must all earn our place at the table every day.<br><br></li> </ul> <p>We understand the important role that diversity plays in our success. Different backgrounds, experiences and ideas push us further and raise the bar. We're committed to developing an inclusive and safe culture where everyone — regardless of colour, race, religion, sex, origin, sexuality, disability, marital status, citizenship or gender identity — knows that they are an integral part of the team and can bring their full potential to their work.</p> <p><strong>Apply now!</strong></p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Writer, Borrowing
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. The outcome of that will be world-leading writing for customers. They’ll trust us because our writing is clear, effective and works hard for them.</p> <p>You’ll get together with the other writers pretty regularly to review and showcase work, collect feedback and insights from one another and generally just raise the bar for words at Monzo. And as we hinted at already, you’ll live and breathe our tone of voice, which is propped up by 3 guiding principles: straightforward kindness, everyday magic and warm wit. </p> <p><strong>You’ll be covering our Borrowing Writer while they’re on caregiver leave</strong></p> <p>This is a 12-month fixed term contract covering for our Writer who’s based in the Borrowing collective. That means you’ll be focused on supporting teams working on things like loans, credit cards, overdrafts and other borrowing and credit related projects.</p> <p>You’ll work closely with cross-functional squads of engineers, designers, marketers, researchers and so on to make it an amazing experience for existing customers, and bring new people on board.</p> <p><strong>A typical day could see you</strong><strong><br></strong></p> <ul> <li>collaborating with a Product Designer on some in-app screens </li> <li>collaborating with a Product Marketer on positioning and building messaging toolkits for use across web, growth marketing or CRM</li> <li>sitting in on user research sessions led by the Research team</li> <li>writing error messages with input from engineers</li> <li>editing legal wording alongside our in-house lawyers </li> </ul> <p><strong>Your home will be in Writing<br><br></strong>Alongside the work you do in Borrowing, you’ll contribute to the Writing discipline. We’re always working on new resources, training and processes to make writing easier for everyone at Monzo.</p> <p>Writing is part of the wider Marketing team but this role isn’t only about marketing. In fact, that’s a small part of the job. Your remit will be to improve the quality of the writing that touches your part of the business, inside Monzo and out.</p> <p><strong>This is for you if</strong><strong><br></strong></p> <ul> <li>you understand borrowing and credit products well</li> <li>you’re a dab hand at ‘content design’, ‘UX writing’, ‘product writing’</li> <li>you’re allergic to useless jargon and over-complicated language </li> <li>you know how to use data and research to guide your approach </li> <li>you’re okay bouncing between tasks on a daily basis </li> <li>you’re comfortable questioning a brief and helping people understand why your approach is the right one </li> <li>you’ve done some training or coaching to help other people improve their writing, but this one’s not essential.</li> </ul> <p><strong>This isn’t for you if</strong><strong><br></strong></p> <ul> <li>it’s your first writing job – sorry, but we need someone to hit the ground running </li> <li>you’re a journalist or ad writer</li> <li>you’re only really excited by brand and marketing stuff – that isn’t the focus of this role</li> <li>you prefer to spend most of your time working solo – writing here is a team sport and you’ll need to collaborate with everyone across the company </li> <li>you like lots of top-down direction – you’ll be expected to decide which challenges you tackle with your team, and how to tackle them. </li> </ul> <p><strong>You’ll get</strong><strong><br></strong></p> <ul> <li>the chance to shape the role around what’s good for you, and us </li> <li>very flexible working – we care about what you do, not the minutes you work or where you do it (we love to see our teammates in the office but you don’t have to come in if you don’t want to) </li> <li>a whole load of benefits, including a personal training budget, health insurance, generous caregiving leave and more you can read about here: https://monzo.com/careers/ </li> </ul> <p><strong>Please make sure you give us both a CV and a cover letter. </strong>This is a writing job after all; you should want to show us what you can do. Please submit your application as soon as possible to make sure you don’t miss out.</strong> <br><br>#LI-JB1 #LI-REMOTE</p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.</p> <p>If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. We don't need full or birth names at application stage 😊</p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Chief Science Officer
description: Chief Science Officer @ Sereact 🦾 Chief Science Officer (m/f/d) · Zurich or Stuttgart, Boston possible · Reports to the CEO · Full-time Who we are Sereact builds the robot brain for physical work. Cortex , our vision-language-action foundation model, is hardware-agnostic: the same model runs single-arm and dual-arm systems, mobile manipulators and humanoids that pick, sort and handle returns in live production across Europe and the US. Customers include Zalando, IKEA, BMW, Rohlik and DHL. Founded in 2021 in Stuttgart, with an R&D hub in Zurich and a US office in Boston. We have raised more than $145 million, most recently a $116 million Series B led by Headline, with Zalando as a strategic investor. We work in small, senior teams with a flat structure; execution counts more than titles. Why this role, why now Our robots produce data no lab can stage. Our fleet has recorded more than 500 million manipulation interactions in live warehouse operations; Cortex 2.0 was trained on a curated 10 million of them and added a world model that plans before it acts ( arXiv 2604.20246 ). Cortex 2.5 learns a new task from a few demonstrations instead of a training run. Deployments are growing from single robots to fleets, and the research team is growing with them. We now want one scientific leader who owns the research behind Cortex end to end and turns what our fleet experiences every day into the next step change in what robots can do. The Real-World Learning Loop is your system Sereact is a frontier research lab and a production-grade robotics company in one. Our bet: general-purpose robotic intelligence “must be learned from live deployments” ( The Real-World Learning Loop , Feb 2026). Every stage of that loop is yours to raise: In-Situ Policy Execution. Every robot in production runs the current policy, and every shift is an experiment. You decide what the policies expose for learning. Continuous Data Acquisition. Robots annotate their own interactions while they work. You decide what is worth recording and which situations the fleet should go and find. Data Curation and Learning. Novelty, uncertainty, failures and distribution shift decide what we learn from. You own the curation and the training recipe. Evaluation and Policy Redeployment. Updated policies pass validation gates before they return to the fleet. You set the bar, and how fast we can clear it safely. Every deployment teaches the next one. Your job is to make that loop turn faster and teach more each time. Responsibilities Set the research agenda for Cortex: vision-language-action models, world models and planning, learning from interaction on real robots, and generalization across tasks and embodiments. Make the big bets: which directions get people and compute, and which ones we stop. Own the data strategy: the mix of deployment, teleoperation, open-source and synthetic data, and what the fleet collects next. Own the compute strategy, from large-scale training to real-time inference on the robot. Build the evaluation science: benchmarks that predict performance in a customer’s operation, not only on a leaderboard. Build and lead the research organisation in Zurich and Stuttgart: structure, leads, rhythm. Set the hiring bar and make Sereact the place the best people in robot learning want to join. Take research into production with engineering, so results reach the fleet in weeks and hold up in 24/7 operation. Decide with the founders what we publish, open-source or patent, and build our standing at CoRL, RSS, ICRA, NeurIPS and ICML. Be Sereact’s scientific voice with customers, partners, universities and investors, and build academic partnerships. Partner with the CTO, product and operations, so research, engineering and deployment pull in one direction. Not in scope, by design Software platform, hardware and field deployment engineering. They stay with the CTO and operations: the CTO owns how we build and ship, you own what we learn next. A research lab beside the business. Research at Sereact ends on a robot, ideally at a customer. Product roadmap and pricing. What makes this role hard Research and production compete for the same robots, people and compute. You make that trade-off every week, in the open. Cortex is not a blank page. It already runs in customer operations, and our founders are deeply technical. You raise the ceiling of a running system. A result counts when it holds up in a customer’s operation, not when the paper is accepted. Your first 12 months First 90 days: know the fleet, the data and the team; agree the research roadmap with the founders; one evaluation standard everyone uses. By month 6: a research organisation with clear ownership and a release rhythm from experiment to fleet. By month 12: a new generation of Cortex in customer operations with measurable gains, key senior hires made, and work that puts Sereact on the map of robot learning. What you bring You have led research in robot learning or embodied AI (VLA models, imitation or reinforcement learning, world models) and built a team around it. Your work runs on real robots, ideally outside the lab and for long stretches. You know what breaks first. Scientific standing: a strong record at the top venues and a network that great researchers want to join. You have made real calls on research bets, data and compute, and stopped what did not work. You explain science to engineers, customers and investors alike, and you enjoy it. PhD in machine learning, robotics or a related field, or an equivalent track record. Nice to have: large-scale pretraining of foundation models · fleet learning or data engines · industrial manipulation · experience in both academia and industry. Three questions we will ask you Tell us about a model you took from a paper to a robot that ran for weeks without you. What broke first? If you had our deployment data tomorrow, which bet would you make first, and what would you stop? How do you decide what to publish and what to keep? What we offer Robots in live production that learn every day, and the data that comes with them. A seat in the leadership team of a company scaling from Europe into the US, with meaningful equity. Large-scale compute and the freedom to build the research organisation you would want to work in. Teams in Stuttgart, Zurich and Boston; relocation support. How we hire Conversations with both founders, a research deep dive with the team, and a working session on a real problem from our deployments. We move fast. Here at the The Exploration Company we are developing, producing, and operating Nyx, a modular and reusable space orbital vehicle that can eventually be refuelled in orbit, and which carries cargo - and potentially humans in the longer run. We want you as a talented Composite CAD design engineer to help us in our mission by designing and developing our composite structures for our spacecraft. Mission As a Composite Design Engineer, you will: Drive the design, modelling, and integration of composite parts and assemblies, ensuring optimal performance, manufacturability, and compliance with mission requirements. Be a key contributor to the definition and maturation of the vehicle’s composite architecture, from concept to detailed design and industrialization. Support to the definition and maturation of the vehicle's metallic parts. Key Responsibilities: Composite CAD Modelling: Build and mature CAD models of composite structures and sub-systems using Siemens NX (Fibersim experience highly valued), including layup definition, ply book creation, and integration with metallic and non-metallic parts. Metallic CAD modelling: To support the design, modelling, and integration of metallic parts and assemblies, ensuring their compatibility and integration with the overall vehicle architecture. Design for Manufacturing: Collaborate with manufacturing and process engineers to ensure designs are producible, cost-effective, and meet quality standards. Propose layup sequences, manufacturing processes, and tolerances. Material & Process Selection: Collaborate with the mechanical engineers to select appropriate composite materials (e.g., CFRP, sandwich panels) and processes, considering mission environments, thermal and mechanical loads, and supplier capabilities. Analysis Integration: Work closely with structural and thermal analysts to iterate designs based on FEA results, trade-offs, and test feedback. Documentation & Reviews: Prepare and release technical drawings, ply books, and design documentation. Participate in design reviews and support the qualification of composite parts. Configuration & Mass Management: Ensure configuration control of composite models and contribute to the vehicle mass budget tracking. Continuous Improvement: Contribute to the development and improvement of composite design tools, databases, and best practices. Cross-functional Collaboration: Engage in co-engineering sessions with mission analysis, propulsion, avionics, GNC, and system teams to ensure robust, integrated solutions. What We Would Love to See from You Qualifications: Master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering or Manufacturing Engineering, Minimum 3 years’ experience in composite design for aerospace or high-performance applications. Experience in the design and development of metallic parts for aerospace or high-performance applications, including knowledge of relevant materials, manufacturing processes. Proficiency with Siemens NX (Fibersim or similar composite design modules preferred). Strong knowledge of aerospace vehicle design and associated challenges, Knowledge of composite materials, laminate theory, failure criteria, and manufacturing processes (e.g., RTM, pre-preg, sandwich construction). Experience with the design and verification of composite structures, including ply book creation and documentation. Fluent in English. German, French or Italian are an asset. Skills and Behaviors: Strong oral and written communication skills, Strong analysis and problem-solving skills, Strong organising and prioritisation of tasks, Positive and flexible attitude to get the job done, Demonstrates behaviours consistent with The Exploration Company’s core values of Vision, Mission, Teamwork, Integrity and Excellence. Why you should join us! What makes us special here at The Exploration Company and why we think you will enjoy working here is: We’re Agile - we make decisions fast whilst keeping our goals and systems in mind We’re Open and Collaborative - we are transparent about risks and obstacles, so that we can cooperate to overcome them We have a lot of Fun - we refuel our energy knowing we are democratising space. It’s a wonderful and rare opportunity, are YOU up for the challenge? We'd love to hear from you if you wish to be a part of our journey. title: Senior Documentation Specialist
description: About this position As the Senior Documentation Specialist, you ensure the effective management, quality, completeness, and inspection readiness of essential clinical trial documentation for assigned studies, programmes or documentation activities, including the sponsor TMF and oversight of CRO and laboratory TMFs. You acts as an experienced TMF specialist, working closely with Clinical Operations and cross-functional study teams to provide expert guidance on document processes, compliance, risk management and continuous improvement. Your tasks: Oversee documentation handling, filing and archival activities for assigned studies, programmes or documentation activities across relevant functional areas, ensuring that final documents are complete, accurate, traceable and maintained in the company document management system. Perform complex quality-control reviews and provide technical oversight of QC activities completed by TMF colleagues and external partners, in accordance with applicable SOPs, the CDISC TMF Reference Model, study-specific TMF Plans and regulatory requirements. Plan and conduct risk-based periodic oversight reviews of CRO and laboratory TMFs; identify quality or completeness issues, recommend remediation actions, monitor progress and escalate significant or recurring risks. Lead TMF inspection-readiness activities for assigned studies and coordinate documentation support during audits and regulatory inspections; develop and coordinate documentation-related corrective and preventive actions, monitor implementation and verify effective closure. Act as a TMF subject matter expert for study teams and external partners, providing practical guidance and escalating matters that require management direction or cross-functional decisions. Analyse and communicate TMF quality and performance metrics, identify trends and recommend improvements to processes, systems, templates and ways of working. Ensure assigned activities comply with company and CRO SOPs, ICH GCP, applicable regulations and relevant regulatory guidance. Represent Clinical Documentation in study meetings, provide input on TMF status and quality, and follow up on agreed documentation actions, decisions and risks. Prepare and deliver TMF guidance and training, and share expertise with study-team members and other TMF colleagues on compliant documentation practices. Role requirements Bachelor’s degree in a scientific, health-related or other relevant discipline. Minimum seven years of experience in TMF and documentation management within the pharmaceutical or CRO industry, including at least three years of experience in biotechnology or another fast-growing, dynamic environment. Advanced knowledge of eTMF solutions, such as Veeva Vault Clinical, PhlexTMF or comparable platforms, together with strong working knowledge of ICH GCP, applicable regulations and the CDISC TMF Reference Model. Demonstrated experience in TMF quality control, risk-based TMF reviews and CRO or vendor oversight. Demonstrated experience leading TMF inspection-readiness activities and managing documentation-related findings and corrective and preventive actions. Strong stakeholder-management and communication skills, with the ability to provide clear guidance, influence without direct authority and build effective working relationships across functions. Proactive and accountable approach, with sound judgement, analytical problem-solving skills and the ability to identify and implement pragmatic, GCP-compliant solutions. Excellent attention to detail, organisation and time management, with the ability to prioritise and manage multiple activities in a dynamic environment. Professional proficiency in written and spoken English. Work permit Candidate needs to hold a Swiss work permit or be an EU citizen eligible to work in Switzerland Your path forward If you meet most of these requirements and bring a strong dedication to technical documentation, we encourage you to apply. You will contribute directly to our mission of advancing new medicines for patients. Find Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

title: Ingénieur en mécanique des fluides
company: ECOLE NATIONALE SUPERIEURE DE TECHNIQUES AVANCEES
description: ENSTA, établissement d’enseignement supérieur et de recherche sous tutelle du ministère des Armées, développe des activités de formation, de recherche et d’innovation dans les domaines de la défense et de la sécurité, des transports, de l'énergie, des activités maritimes, du numérique et de la santé. L’école, présente sur deux campus, à Paris-Saclay et à Brest, est membre de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris. Classée dans le Top 10 des meilleures écoles d’ingénieurs en France, elle a pour mission : la formation d’élèves ingénieurs civils et militaires, de cadres et docteurs pour les secteurs public et privé, la recherche et l’innovation de haut niveau en relation étroite avec l’industrie des grands secteurs de souveraineté au sein de 6 unités de formation et de recherche (UFR). Le/la titulaire du poste sera affecté au sein de l’Unité de Formation et de Recherche (UFR) Mécanique. L’UFR de Mécanique a pour mission d’assurer la formation en mécanique des élèves du cursus ingénieur d’ENSTA, des élèves de masters de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris, et la formation par la recherche d’étudiants français et étrangers au niveau master et doctorat. L’Unité développe également des activités de recherche dans le domaine de la mécanique des matériaux et des structures, de la mécanique des fluides, des vibrations et de l’acoustique. Ces activités sont réalisées grâce à un important parc expérimental de haut niveau en mécanique des solides et des fluides, tant pour l’enseignement que la recherche. Sur le campus de Brest, l’UFR de Mécanique compte une cinquantaine d’enseignants chercheurs, une cinquantaine de doctorants/post-doctorants ainsi qu’une dizaine de personnels techniques (ingénieurs, techniciens). Les activités de recherche des membres de l’UFR de Mécanique du site de Brest sont menées au sein de l’Institut de Recherche Dupuy de Lôme (IRDL, CNRS UMR 6027, www.irdl.fr ). La personne recrutée travaillera en étroite collaboration avec les enseignants-chercheurs de l’ENSTA, pôle thématique de recherche « Structure Interaction Fluide (StIF) » de l’IRDL. Le recrutement s’inscrit dans le projet MULTIRIM, qui vise à développer des solutions innovantes en propulsion marine. Les propulseurs marins à entraînement circonférentiel constituent une alternative aux hélices classiques marines, en présentant plusieurs avantages : manoeuvrabilité, compacité, discrétion acoustique, amélioration de la traînée de la carène par l’absence de ligne d’arbre. Cependant, la présence d’une tuyère embarquant le moteur électrique d’entraînement pénalise le rendement. Une piste d’amélioration est d’adopter un propulseur à plusieurs étages à l’instar des moteurs d’avion, afin de regagner environ vingt points de rendement. La configuration même de l’entraînement extérieur, sans arbre, supprime la complexité mécanique rencontrée sur les hélices contrarotatives classiques. Or, il existe très peu de bancs d’essai pour les propulseurs à entraînement circonférentiel, pour une seule hélice, ainsi que très peu de données expérimentales de référence. Les difficultés sont de deux ordres. Du point de vue fonctionnement, le refroidissement du moteur électrique nécessite des échanges thermiques, et la liaison rotor/stator est assurée par un palier hydrodynamique. La mise ne eau dans une veine hydrodynamique est ainsi obligatoire. Par ailleurs, l’absence d’arbre d’entraînement empêche une mesure aisée du couple d’entraînement, valeur requise pour déterminer le rendement global du propulseur. Intégrer plusieurs étages propulsifs au sein d’un même propulseur au sein d’un banc d’essai expérimental n’a jamais été proposé au niveau international. Cependant, le mode de fonctionnement de l’entraînement circonférentiel le permet aisément. Disposer de résultats expérimentaux de référence, tant pour les efforts globaux que pour l’écoulement (champ de vitesse, de pression) présente un intérêt fort pour la communauté scientifique. En particulier, l'écoulement fortement tourbillonnaire, la présence d'éléments tournants rendent la simulation numérique particulièrement difficile et des résultats de référence permettront de valider les modèles numériques. Aussi, le premier objectif de ce projet est de développer un banc d’essais modulaire, afin de tester plusieurs configurations d’hélices, de vitesses d’entraînement différenciées, de formes de tuyère, et évaluer précisément le rendement global. D’autre part, le principe des moteurs à plusieurs étages est de récupérer la puissance perdue par le premier étage, en redressant l’écoulement, un propulseur idéal accélérant l’écoulement uniquement de manière axiale. Un second objectif du projet consiste à caractériser cette récupération d’énergie opérée par les étages supérieurs. Le projet associe les compétences en modélisation de machines électriques de l’IRENav et les compétences en modélisation hydrodynamique de l’ENSTA-IRDL (UMR CNRS 6027) et de l’IRENav. L’ENSTA met par ailleurs à disposition sa veine aérodynamique dédiée aux applications marines, et l’instrumentation associée. Ce projet s’inscrit dans un projet plus vaste financé par l’Agence Innovation Défense (Projet AID RD-PROP), visant à proposer des méthodologies de modélisation et de conception de propulseurs électriques navals intégrés à entrainement circonférentiel. La personne recrutée sera intégrée dans une équipe pluridisciplinaire de 3 enseignants-chercheurs, 1 doctorante et 2 post-doctorantes. Missions / Activités principales : La personne recrutée prendra en charge la conception et le test d’un banc d’essai multi-étages pour propulseur à entraînement circonférentiel, pour usage en veine aérodynamique. La caractérisation du rendement du propulseur sera réalisée par mesure directe des efforts, et mesure indirecte de la vorticité résiduelle dans le sillage aval à l’aide de mesures non intrusives du champ de vitesse (méthode PIV). La personne recrutée sera amenée à produire des rapports et présentations techniques, mettre en œuvre des essais (étalonnage, mesure d’efforts, velocimétrie laser), et travailler de manière collaborative avec l’ensemble des partenaires du projet RD-PROP. Les missions détaillées sont les suivantes : Tâche 1 : Conception et fabrication d’un banc moteur dédié La conception d’un banc d’essai propulseur s’appuiera sur les compétences de la plateforme de conception MASMECA de l’ENSTA, ainsi que sur l’expertise de l’IRENav sur les moteurs à entraînement circonférentiel. Le banc d’essai sera prévu pour être modulaire, et fonctionner dans une gamme de vitesses de rotation représentative d’un propulseur réel. Tâche 2 : Détermination du rendement maximal atteignable Parallèlement à la conception et la fabrication du banc moteur, un modèle semi-analytique (disque actuateur sous tuyère) sera développé, afin de proposer une estimation théorique du rendement maximal atteignable par un propulseur sous tuyère. Cette estimation prendra en compte la traînée de la tuyère, l’absence de flux transverse dans le sillage aval. La principale simplification concerne le frottement visqueux sur les pales, non pris en compte par ce type de modèle. Tâche 3 : Méthodologie de quantification de l’écoulement transverse Une méthodologie de détermination du champ de vitesses par technique PIV non intrusive dans un plan du sillage sera mise en œuvre, à l’aide d’un laser, d’une caméra rapide et d’un ensemencement de l’écoulement. L’influence de la position de la section transverse par rapport au corps étudié sera étudiée, ainsi que les paramètres numériques de l’algorithme PIV. Différents indicateurs de champ de vitesse intégré seront testés, pour qualifier au mieux la signature de perte de rendement lié à l’écoulement transverse. La méthodologie développée sera validée sur un écoulement classique de la littérature. Tâche 4 : Mise en œuvre d’un benchmark de référence dans la veine aérodynamique de l’ENSTA Le banc d’essai sera utilisé pour une première conception d’un jeu d’hélices contrarotatives (2 étages), adaptées au rim-driven, et d’une géométrie de tuyère simplifiée. Ces premiers tests exploratoires permettront de valider la chaîne complète de test (banc + instrumentation des efforts + post-traitement sillage aval) dans l’objectif de publier à terme un benchmark de référence au niveau international. Les résultats obtenus pourront mener à publication scientifique. Le recrutement s’inscrit dans le projet SUBPERF-AI, qui porte sur une démarche de réduction drastique du cycle de développement de nouveaux concepts sous-marins, en s’appuyant sur les progrès récents de l’intelligence artificielle (IA), et plus particulièrement le machine learning. Au contraire de l’existant en IA basé sur des modèles ininterprétables de type boîte noire, le projet vise à construire une méthodologie de construction de modèles physiques, de complexité adaptée à la physique sous-jacente, en ayant recours à l’expertise humaine et se plaçant comme un outil de conception complémentaire dans l’écosystème existant. Les objectifs principaux du projet sont : Développer une méthodologie de détermination automatisée du modèle d’efforts hydrodynamiques de corps sous-marin, avec utilisation de l’IA (machine learning), sur la base des données de la cinématique, des trajectoires, et des paramètres de contrôle, facilement accessibles, lors des essais maquette ou réel, ou lors d’une simulation numérique. Placer l’expert humain en capacité de contrôler la construction du modèle aux différents stades : qualité des données d’entrée, qualité de la phase d’apprentissage du modèle, et outils/règles de certification a posteriori. La personne recrutée sera intégrée dans une équipe pluridisciplinaire de 3 enseignants-chercheurs, un doctorant et un second post-doctorant. Missions / Activités principales : La personne recrutée prendra en charge la construction d’un modèle d’effort hydrodynamique « expert » et la génération de données expérimentales. Le modèle hydrodynamique expert sera déterminé en suivant la méthodologie classique de l’ITTC, à l’aide d’une campagne d’essais dans la veine aérodynamique pour la caractérisation des efforts (essais en modèle captif du type PMM (Planar Motion Mechanism)). Ce modèle sera implémenté dans un simulateur temporel, dont les résultats seront confrontés sur des manœuvres standards réalisées dans le bassin à drones de l’ENSTA. La confrontation des résultats de trajectoires expérimentales aux trajectoires simulées, obtenues sur la base des essais en modèle captif, pourra amener à questionner la méthodologie standard, en particulier lors de la présence de non-linéarités importantes ou de termes croisés non négligeables. Les essais en bassin fourniront par ailleurs les données de cinématique nécessaires au travail de thèse. Les missions détaillées sont les suivantes : Tâche 1 – conception et fabrication d’un drone sous-marin Conception d’un drone générique de géométrie simplifiée, et instrumenté. Le drone recevra un capotage extérieur, afin de tester plusieurs configurations : géométrie parallélépipédique typique d’un ROV d’exploration, et géométrie cylindrique de type drone torpille. Le drone sera instrumenté pour mesurer les paramètres de contrôle, la cinématique et les trajectoires, ainsi que les efforts propulsifs (poussée, couple) et les efforts de contrôle. Tâche 2 – essais statiques et dynamiques en modèle captif Réalisation d’essais de caractérisation dans la veine aérodynamique de l’ENSTA, en similitude complète de Reynolds, pour les vitesses envisagées d’utilisation en eau du drone. Mesure des efforts en statique, sur les 6 degrés de liberté. Caractérisation des efforts de plans porteurs et du propulseur. Mesure des efforts en dynamique, en mouvement forcé à l’aide de l’hexapode : masses et inerties ajoutées, termes liés aux vitesses angulaires. Tâche 3 – Identification dérivées hydrodynamiques Identification des dérivées hydrodynamiques (ou coefficients hydrodynamiques) à partir des essais en modèle captif. Tâche 4 – Adaptation du simulateur temporel Prise en main du simulateur temporel de l’ENSTA, et de l’environnement de développement. Adaptation du code de calcul pour intégrer des lois de commande issues de mesures expérimentales. Tâche 5 – Essais libres et standardisés, en bassin Réalisation d’essais aux trajectoires prédéfinies (zigzag horizontal ou vertical, accélération horizontale, …). Réalisation d’essais pour parcourir l’espace complet des 6 degrés de libertés. Enregistrement de l’historique des contrôles (vitesse hélice, angles plans porteurs, …), des trajectoires et des efforts des organes de contrôle. Tâche 6 – Rejeu trajectoires simulateur temporel Rejeu numérique des trajectoires, afin de valider si le modèle d’efforts est suffisamment complet pour prédire correctement les trajectoires mesurées expérimentalement. title: Growth & AI Marketing Operations Specialist
description: About Papers Papers AG is a Swiss cyber security engineering house and an incubator for our product portfolio. We build device-level alternatives to centralized cloud and trust. Our strategy is to grow our foundational decentralized network by building high-demand enterprise products directly on top of it. Your portfolio includes: Acurast: Decentralized confidential compute running on ordinary smartphones. Obsidio: A continuous, AI-assisted pentesting subscription. Incubated by Papers, Obsidio is built directly on Acurast, leveraging the decentralized network as a unique compute moat to battle-test networks. Hypergate: Enterprise mobile single sign-on for managed Android and iOS fleets. As an engineering-driven team, we work with autonomy and purpose. Our culture is built on meritocracy, long-term thinking, and a commitment to quality over buzz, innovation is in our DNA. We aim to collaborate with people who love tech for its own sake and want to help shape the future by solving real-world challenges. Your role We are seeking a tech-savvy, execution-oriented Growth & AI Marketing Operations Specialist to serve as the engine powering our growth campaigns, content infrastructure, and data analytics pipeline. Your main goal will be to communicate our stories across a portfolio of brands by bridging the gap between cutting-edge AI, data operations, and tactical growth marketing. You’ll be building automated content workflows, ensuring the highest quality across everything we generate, running multi-channel campaigns from start to finish, and maintaining rock-solid attribution tracking. If you are obsessed with efficiency, operational speed, and using AI to scale output without ever sacrificing quality and if you thrive when given a blank slate to write your own playbook, this role is for you. Success Metrics (First 90 Days) 30 Days: Take full ownership of the existing marketing tech stack and establish baseline performance metrics. 60 Days: Fully automate the core content generation pipeline and establish QA workflows. 90 Days: Launch at least two multi-channel growth experiments and demonstrate a measurable reduction in CAC or an increase in content throughput. Core Responsibilities 1. Storytelling That Converts Making Complexity Clear: Take complex, often highly technical capabilities and features and turn them into clear, digestible stories without losing accuracy. Audience-First Messaging: Understand who the campaigns speak to (developers, technical decision-makers, business stakeholders or end users) and frame each capability around what that audience cares about, at the right level of technical depth. Spark Curiosity & Action: Craft narratives that get audiences interested and excited, and that move them to the desired conversion. Product & Engineering Collaboration: Work closely with product and engineering teams to deeply understand what is being built, so every story is both compelling and technically correct. 2. Tactical Deployment & Agile Execution Multi-Channel Campaign Launch: Execute and launch integrated campaigns across communities, social channels, search, newsletters, loyalty programs, influencers, paid ads and landing pages. Where needed, bring in and coordinate additional third parties to support execution, such as external PR firms and campaign support providers. Marketing Automation: Maintain and scale lifecycle workflows, lead scoring mechanisms, drip sequences, and automated triggers to optimize lead conversion through the relevant funnel. Rapid A/B & Multivariate Testing: Design, set up, and evaluate rapid growth experiments (copy variants, landing page layouts, audience segmentation, offer positioning) on a weekly sprint cycle. 3. AI Pipeline Operation & Content QA Automated Workflow Orchestration: Build, maintain, and optimize AI-driven content pipelines to generate high-quality marketing assets at scale. Human-in-the-Loop Quality Assurance: Establish strict QA processes to review, refine, and approve AI-generated copy, visual assets, landing page content, and email sequences before deployment. Prompt Engineering & Template Optimization: Continuously iterate on, standardize, and version-control skills, design systems and context workflows to ensure output matches brand voice, compliance standards, and conversion best practices. Scale & Efficiency Metrics: Track content throughput, error rates, and time-to-market reduction, driving continuous improvement in pipeline efficiency. 4. Analytics, Attribution & Data Ops Tracking Infrastructure: Implementation and maintenance of event tracking, pixel setups, UTM parameters, and server-side tracking across all digital properties. Attribution Modeling: Own multi-touch attribution models to accurately trace pipeline generation, conversions, and revenue back to specific campaigns, channels, and AI-driven experiments. Data Integrity & Governance: Regularly audit marketing data across CRMs, marketing automation platforms, and internal databases to clean anomalies and maintain a single source of truth. Performance Reporting: Build and manage real-time dashboards providing actionable insights into CAC, LTV, conversion rates, and ROI across experiments. What We Are Looking For Essential Experience & Qualifications 3–5+ Years in Growth/Marketing Operations: Proven track record in a fast-paced B2B or B2C growth environment, managing campaign ops, marketing automation, and technical data pipelines. Passionate Builder: You deeply identify with our products. We are a fast-moving, mission-driven team, and this role requires intrinsic dedication rather than a standard 9-to-5 mentality. Hands-on AI Tooling Expertise: Demonstrated experience applying modern LLMs and generative AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Claude, Midjourney, Higgsfield) into real-world marketing workflows, beyond simple basic prompts. Technical Analytics Proficiency: Deep hands-on experience with Google Tag Manager (GTM), Google Analytics 4 (GA4), and data visualization tools. Automation Skills: Proficiency with automation platforms to connect API endpoints and pass payload data reliably. CRM & Automation Platforms: Direct administration experience with platforms like Zoho. Preferred Technical Skills Basic technical understanding of Python, JavaScript, HTML/CSS for lightweight API scripting, data manipulation and rapid landing page iterations Mindset & Soft Skills Systems Thinking: Ability to map out complex, multi-step processes and translate business requirements into efficient technical architecture. Agile Adaptability: Comfort operating in fast-paced sprint cycles with changing priorities and a bias toward continuous shipping and learning. Obsessive Attention to Detail: An eagle eye for QA; AI speeds up production, but your judgment ensures quality control and brand alignment. Working Environment & Expectations Execution Velocity: We prioritize shipping experiments quickly, learning from real-world data, and iterating fast. Tooling Ownership & Independence: You will have complete autonomy over our stack. We expect you to proactively recommend and implement the best modern automation and AI solutions. You define the tools you need to win. Asynchronous Communication: Clear documentation, meticulous task tracking, and transparent status updates are core to how we work, allowing you to manage your own time effectively. Why join Papers? Work with cutting-edge technology that actually matters with a team that is obsessed with redefining what cutting edge means. High ownership, low bureaucracy. Your voice drives the strategy, giving you the independence to define your own processes. Influence the Growth strategy from day one. Competitive compensation structure tied directly to your impact, with clear pathways for career growth. 25 days paid vacation per year. Regular team events and retreats (at least quarterly). Support for your ongoing learning and development.r Find more English Speaking Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

title: Social Media Manager (m/w/d)
description: Die ÖDP Bayern sucht idealerweise ab Dezember 2026 einen Social Media Manager (m/w/d) für 15 Stunden pro Woche. Die Stelle ist zunächst auf zwei Jahre befristet. Und wir reden nicht nur über politische Veränderungen. Mit Volksbegehren bringen wir sie selbst auf den Weg. Die ÖDP hat „Rettet die Bienen“ initiiert, das mit rund 1,7 Millionen Unterstützerinnen und Unterstützern zum erfolgreichsten Volksbegehren in der Geschichte Bayerns wurde. Auch beim konsequenten Nichtraucherschutz und bei der Abschaffung des Bayerischen Senats spielte die ÖDP als Initiatorin von Volksbegehren eine zentrale Rolle. Aktuell läuft mit „Macht auf Zeit“ das nächste Volksbegehren zur Begrenzung der Amtszeit des bayerischen Ministerpräsidenten auf zehn Jahre. Das bedeutet für Deinen Job: starke Themen, echte Kampagnen, politische Debatten und jede Menge Stoff für guten Content. Was Du bei uns machst Du arbeitest remote oder in der Landesgeschäftsstelle in Passau und kannst bei wichtigen Terminen, Drehs und Aktionen in Bayern vor Ort sein. Du entwickelst und produzierst Content für unsere Social-Media-Kanäle, insbesondere Instagram und TikTok. Du drehst und schneidest Videos, entwickelst neue Formate und bereitest politische Themen so auf, dass sie verständlich, relevant und interessant werden. Du erkennst, welche Themen und Geschichten Potenzial haben, reagierst auf aktuelle Debatten und entwickelst gemeinsam mit unserem Presse- und Kommunikationsteam Redaktionspläne und Kampagnen. Du betreust unsere Community, analysierst Reichweiten und Formate und nutzt die Ergebnisse, um unsere Kommunikation kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln. Und Du bekommst Gestaltungsspielraum: Wir suchen niemanden, der einfach nur Posts abarbeitet. Wir suchen jemanden, der Ideen entwickelt, Dinge ausprobiert und unsere Social-Media-Arbeit gemeinsam mit uns weiter aufbaut. Wen wir suchen Ein bestimmter Studienabschluss ist uns weniger wichtig als das, was Du kannst. Berufserfahrung, eigene Social-Media-Projekte, journalistische Arbeit, Agenturerfahrung oder ein überzeugendes Portfolio sind ausdrücklich willkommen. Du bewegst Dich sicher auf Instagram, TikTok und anderen relevanten Plattformen. Du kannst guten Content nicht nur erkennen, sondern selbst produzieren. Videoaufnahme und Videoschnitt gehören für Dich dazu. Du hast ein gutes Gespür für Sprache, Bilder, politische Themen und dafür, was Menschen im Feed tatsächlich interessiert. Du arbeitest eigenständig, zuverlässig und pragmatisch und kannst auch mit begrenzten Ressourcen gute Ideen umsetzen. Du interessierst Dich für Politik und kannst Dich mit den grundlegenden Zielen der ÖDP identifizieren. Was wir bieten 15 Stunden pro Woche, zunächst befristet auf zwei Jahre. description: Über uns CALIMA ist ein Berliner B2B-SaaS-Startup mit der Mission, Arbeitssicherheit durch digitale und innovative Lösungen einfacher, verlässlicher und wirksamer zu machen.
