title: Senior Umwelt- und Raumplaner (m/w/d)
description: Über uns Seit über 25 Jahren stehen wir von Terra Consulting GmbH für unabhängige und innovative Ingenieurdienstleistungen in den Bereichen Verkehr/Infrastruktur, Umwelt, Lagerstätten, Geotechnik, Flächenrecycling, Gebäudeschadstoffe und Altlasten für die Privatwirtschaft und für öffentliche Auftraggeber. Einen Schwerpunkt dabei bilden Projekte der Energiewende. An unseren Standorten in Dortmund und Bonn arbeiten wir mit über 30 Mitarbeitern. title: Principal Engineer - Quality Assurance
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>YOUR FUTURE, ON DEMAND</strong></p> <p>The ideal blend of stability and flexibility. It’s why they trust us and believe in what we do.</p></div><p> </p> <p><strong>THE ROLE</strong></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are looking for a Principal Engineer QA as a senior individual contributor. Raise effort where failure hurts most. Make coverage vs. speed and pre-release vs. production trade-offs explicit with product and eng.</li> <li><strong>Release constraints & quality gates</strong> - Define what “releasable” means for backend, middleware, and clients - including how continuous backend/middleware delivery is gated relative to client store cadences (web/TV/mobile). Keep gates fast, trustworthy, and hard to bypass.</li> <li><strong>Rollout practice (build with the teams)</strong> - Define and establish staged rollout, canary, and rollback strategies together with eng and SRE/ops. Own the definition; establish and operate them collaboratively.</li> <li><strong>Test architecture</strong> - Set the pyramid and ownership boundaries (unit through E2E, performance, playback/stream validation) so each layer has a clear home inside eng. Drive cross-stack design that exercises real policy and format decisions.</li> <li><strong>Incident & reliability partnership</strong> - Join major quality incidents with a quality lens; strengthen production feedback for streaming health; turn escapes into durable tests, monitors, gate changes, and rollout improvements.</li> <li><strong>Tooling & automation standards </strong>- Set practical standards for frameworks, CI integration, test data, environments, and reporting so teams share patterns with clear ownership and measurable ROI.</li> <li><strong>AI-enabled quality engineering</strong> - Define where AI raises quality leverage: test generation and maintenance, risk-based test selection, failure triage, and incident analysis. Set standards for AI-assisted testing and shape quality expectations for AI-authored code as delivery speed and change volume increase.</li> <li><strong>Mentoring & influence</strong> - Embed quality craft into eng: risk-based testing, quality in PRs, middleware policy and multi-platform client testing. Socialize lightweight, strong-default standards (definition of done, flake policy, critical-path coverage). Influence design reviews when quality risk is material.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>WHAT YOU’LL OWN</strong></p> <ul> <li>Org-wide quality strategy, risk model, and whole-stack standards</li> <li>Release constraints and quality gates; definition of “releasable”</li> <li>Definition of staged rollout/canary/rollback strategies (to be established with partners)</li> <li>Test architecture principles and automation norms</li> <li>Cross-stack escape analysis and quality debt for gates and tooling</li> <li>Embedding quality craft in engineering; influencing high-risk designs</li> <li>Standards for AI-assisted testing and quality expectations for AI-authored code</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>WHO YOU’LL PARTNER WITH</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Engineering</strong> - They implement and own tests/suites in services and clients; you set architecture, gates, and standards, and build quality practice into delivery.</li> <li><strong>Product</strong> - Journey and tenant/feature priority; acceptance of residual risk within the gates you define.</li> <li><strong>SRE / Ops</strong> - Establish and operate rollout strategies together; production signals, incident response, capacity/reliability.</li> <li><strong>Platform/tooling</strong> - CI, environments, shared frameworks, observability for quality signals.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>WHAT YOU’LL BRING</strong></p> <ul> <li>Track record as a senior IC in quality engineering (or equivalent) for complex, multi-service products - ideally streaming, media, or similarly high-availability consumer platforms</li> <li>Experience designing whole-stack quality strategy: backend services, configuration/policy layers, and multi-platform clients</li> <li>Ability to define and land <strong>test architecture</strong> (pyramid, ownership, cross-stack integration/contract/playback-style validation) that engineering teams can run and own</li> <li>Strong influence without authority: you raise the bar inside eng teams, socialize standards, and hold the line on gates without managing a QA org</li> <li>Strong software engineering skills at senior level or above; you write production-quality code, not just test scripts</li> <li>Designing and coding for testability, and building automation as a first-class engineering product</li> <li>Deep familiarity with CI/CD, with a track record of making pipelines faster and more reliable</li> <li>Hands-on experience applying AI to quality engineering, with judgment on where it reduces risk and where it adds noise</li> <li>Comfort partnering on incidents and turning production failure modes into durable quality improvements</li> <li>Practical judgment on automation: enough to protect risk, not so much that brittle suites block the org</li> <li>Bonus:<br> <ul> <li>Hands-on engineering background with video ingest, encoding/packaging, playback, or multi-tenant config/policy surfaces</li> <li>Work across web, TV, and mobile client quality risk (device/OS/store constraints)</li> </ul> </li> </ul> <p><strong><br>WHY JOIN US? </strong></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">At Zattoo, you’re always on firm ground with real freedom to explore. You’ll have the support and opportunity you need to go far, while you’re helping us create a sustainable and entertainment-filled future for all.<br><br></span></p> <p><strong>WHAT WE OFFER YOU</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Reward</strong>: strong market competitive salary</li> <li><strong>Recharge</strong>: 30 days vacation plus public holidays</li> <li><strong>Regulate</strong>:<span style="font-weight: 400;">trust based flexible working hours and the option for remote work worldwide for up to 8 weeks per year</span><em><span style="font-weight: 400;"> </span></em></li> </ul> <p><strong>Plus:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>We’re </strong><strong>sharing: </strong>Free access to the best streaming experience on the market</li> <li><strong>We're developing: </strong>Your own development budget, German classes and Zattoo all-company hack days</li> <li><strong>We’re inclusive: ‘</strong>Zattooies’ are a fun, engaged, and diverse team made up of 47 nationalities</li> <li><strong>We’re healthy:</strong> Health checks, mental wellbeing support, team sports and more!</li> <li><strong>We’re responsible:</strong> We are carbon neutral, an active employee Green team, discounted BVG tickets and free bike rentals</li> <li><strong>We’re sociable: </strong>A calendar of events with fireside chats, lunches, in-house bar, BBQ’s, monthly socials, summer party and an annual off-site event</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p>Zattoo enables our users to view indiscriminately and we reflect that in our team too. title: Junior Supply Chain Engineer - Operations (H/F)
description: Chez Withings, nous souhaitons redonner aux individus le contrôle de leur santé. Nous avons l’obsession de créer des produits beaux et intuitifs, afin que chacun puisse les utiliser facilement au quotidien; nos balances connectées, montres hybrides, tensiomètres, moniteurs de sommeil et tous les dispositifs de notre gamme sont aujourd’hui utilisés par des millions d’utilisateurs. Notre objectif : permettre la prévention, le dépistage et l’accompagnement d’un certain nombre de maladies chroniques via des produits et des services innovants, afin de révolutionner la manière dont on prend soin de notre santé . Au sein de l'équipe Supply Chain basée à Issy-les-Moulineaux, nous recherchons un·e Junior Supply Chain Engineer – Opérations en CDI. Vous serez le point de contact de nos entrepôts en France et aux États-Unis, et le référent des opérations physiques : rework, reconditionnement, opérations à valeur ajoutée et retours B2B et B2C. En collaboration avec les équipes ADV, Planning, Qualité et Service Client, ainsi qu'avec nos collègues aux États-Unis et en Chine, vous veillerez à la fiabilisation de ces flux, à l'évaluation de leur performance et de leurs coûts. Vos missions principales : 1. Entrepôts et stocks Être le point de contact de nos entrepôts en France, aux États-Unis et en Asie, et veiller au respect des process. Garantir la fiabilité des stocks : inventaires tournants et trimestriels, réconciliation 3PL / ERP, traitement du stock dormant. Mettre en place les opérations à valeur ajoutée : rework, kitting, personnalisation. 2. Retours et reconditionnement Gérer les retours B2B et B2C, et harmoniser les process entre l'Europe, les États-Unis et l'Asie. Piloter la chaîne de refurb (diagnostic, tests qualité, remise en stock) et le suivi des pièces détachées. 3. Performance et coûts Suivre les KPIs opérationnels (stocks, délais, retours, transporteurs) et produire le reporting mensuel. Analyser les coûts logistiques, contrôler la facturation des prestataires et identifier des leviers d'économie. 4. Automatisation et process Automatiser les flux de données avec nos prestataires (Python, API, Shopify Flow) et maintenir les tableaux de bord de l'équipe. Rédiger et tenir à jour les procédures opérationnelles (SOP). Requirements Vous êtes titulaire d'un Bac +5 spécialisé dans la Supply ou issu d’une école d’ingénieur ou équivalent. Une première expérience (stage, alternance ou 0 à 2 ans) en logistique, entreposage ou opérations. Vous maîtrisez Excel, savez travailler avec SQL et analyser des bases de données ; des connaissances en Python sont un vrai atout. Vous connaissez le fonctionnement d'un ERP et d'un WMS, et vous êtes à l'aise avec les outils informatiques (Pack Office, Google Suite, IA). Anglais professionnel courant : vous travaillerez au quotidien avec des prestataires et des collègues en Europe, aux États-Unis et en Asie. Rigueur, proactivité, autonomie, sens de l'organisation et adaptabilité : vous êtes force de proposition et d'amélioration. Vous avez une aisance relationnelle pour faire avancer des sujets avec des partenaires externes et des équipes internes variées. Benefits Rejoindre l’aventure Withings, c’est : Intégrer un des pionniers et leaders mondiaux de la santé connectée, plusieurs fois primé au Consumer Electronic Show Contribuer à des projets innovants et ambitieux pour la santé de demain dans un environnement agile et en constante évolution Intégrer une entreprise internationale, membre de la FrenchTech 120, dont les équipes sont basées à Issy-les-Moulineaux, Boston, Hong-Kong et Shenzhen Participer à l’amélioration continue de nos produits et services en les bêta-testant avant leur sortie, notamment lors de nos nombreuses sessions sportives entre collègues Bénéficier de nombreux avantages : Stock Options, smartphone et ordinateur de votre choix, réductions pour des activités culturelles et sportives, restaurant d’entreprise, et bien plus encore Participer à la Withings Med Academy en assistant à des conférences de professionnels de santé afin de renforcer ses connaissances dans le domaine médical Collaborer avec des collègues passionnés et célébrer ensemble chacune de nos réussites ! Toutes les candidatures reçues sont étudiées indépendamment de l’origine ethnique, des opinions, des croyances, de la religion, du genre, de l’orientation sexuelle ou de la santé des candidats. Withings aspire à offrir et garantir l’égalité des chances aux candidats et seules les personnes habilitées (RH et Management) auront accès aux informations concernant votre candidature. title: Software Engineer (Threat Intelligence), Cloudforce One
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h2>Available Locations</h2> <ul> <li>Austin, US</li> <li>London, UK</li> </ul> <h2>About the Role</h2> <p>Cloudforce One is Cloudflare’s threat operations and research team, responsible for identifying and disrupting cyber threats ranging from sophisticated cyber criminal activity to nation-state sponsored advanced persistent threats (APTs).  Cloudforce One works in close partnership with external organizations and internal Cloudflare teams, continuously developing operational tradecraft and expanding ever-growing sources of threat intelligence to enable expedited threat hunting and remediation.  Members of Cloudforce One are at the helm of leveraging an incredibly vast and varied set of data points that only one of the world’s largest global networks can provide.  The team is able to analyze these unique data points, at massive scale and efficiency, synthesizing findings into actionable threat intelligence to better protect our customers.</p> <p>As a Software Engineer on this team, you will own the entire software development lifecycle—from design and architecture to deployment and monitoring—for systems that serve both threat disruption and legal response efforts. You will be responsible for translating complex legal and security requirements into robust, scalable, and high-performance applications that have a direct impact on making the internet better, safer, and more powerful every day.</p> <h2>Responsibilities</h2> <ul> <li>While the majority of our services are now written in Golang and TypeScript, you will also work with technologies such as Rust, Kafka, Redis, Kubernetes, Terraform, Temporal and PostgresSQL. We also pride ourselves in dogfooding our own products and services so you will be extensively working with Cloudflare’s developer platform as well. We are looking for great engineers regardless of experience with any of these specific technologies.</li> <li>This role may require flexibility to be on-call outside of standard working hours to address technical issues as needed.</li> <li>Design, build, run, and scale distributed tools and services that support both cyber threat disruption and platform abuse efforts.</li> <li>Develop critical data pipelines and services to collect, analyze, and expose threat intelligence data for Cloudforce One analysts and Cloudflare customers, helping to identify Tactics, Techniques, and Procedures (TTPs) and Indicators of Compromise (IOCs).</li> <li>Collaborate closely with Threat Intelligence, Trust & Safety, Legal, and Product teams to understand goals and translate complex technical requirements into elegant, scalable solutions.</li> <li>Improve system design and architecture to ensure stability, performance, and maintainability of both internal and customer-facing compliance and security services.</li> <li>Analyze, communicate, and help prioritize complex technical concepts across teams.</li> <li>Ongoing monitoring and maintenance of production services, including participation in on-call rotations.</li> <li>Mentor and guide other developers in the team, helping to build collective technical expertise and promote best practices for writing well-tested, modular, and reusable code.</li> </ul> <h2>Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</h2> <ul> <li>Experience with AI-assisted development and agentic AI workflows</li> <li>At least 5 years of experience building large-scale software applications, preferably distributed systems</li> <li>At least 3 years of experience working with Threat Intelligence or in support of a Threat Intelligence platform</li> <li>Experience designing and integrating RESTful APIs and/or gRPC services</li> <li>Knowledge of SQL and common relational database systems such as PostgreSQL</li> <li>Prior experience writing production ready code in Go and/or Typescript</li> <li>Familiarity with Rust</li> <li>Excellent debugging and optimization skills</li> <li>Expertise in writing well tested code</li> <li>Interest in opportunities to be a technical mentor for teammates</li> </ul> <h2>Bonus Points</h2> <ul> <li>Deep understanding of DNS, TLS/SSL and HTTP</li> <li>Expertise in web security issues and industry standards for access control</li> <li>Experience with Kafka</li> <li>Experience building web applications using React</li> <li>Experience with Kubernetes</li> <li>Experience with Redis</li> </ul> <h3>Equity:</h3> <p>This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.</p> <p><strong>Benefits</strong></p> <p>Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family.  Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun!  The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S.</p> <p><strong>Health & Welfare Benefits</strong></p> <ul> <li>Medical/Rx Insurance</li> <li>Dental Insurance</li> <li>Vision Insurance</li> <li>Flexible Spending Accounts</li> <li>Commuter Spending Accounts</li> <li>Fertility & Family Forming Benefits</li> <li>On-demand mental health support and Employee Assistance Program</li> <li>Global Travel Medical Insurance</li> </ul> <p><strong>Financial Benefits</strong></p> <ul> <li>Short and Long Term Disability Insurance</li> <li>Life & Accident Insurance</li> <li>401(k) Retirement Savings Plan</li> <li>Employee Stock Participation Plan</li> </ul> <p><strong>Time Off</strong></p> <ul> <li>Flexible paid time off covering vacation and sick leave</li> <li>Leave programs, including parental, pregnancy health, medical, and bereavement leave</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. title: Lifecycle Marketing Manager
description: <h3>🧡 About Alma</h3> <p>At Alma, we believe sustainable commerce depends on fair, well-balanced trade. Because finance plays a pivotal role in business, our mission is to put it back in its rightful place, serving merchants and consumers.</p> <p>Our installment and deferred payment solutions help merchants boost sales by 20% or more, increase customer loyalty, and deliver a seamless shopping experience, without encouraging bad debt.</p> <p>As the buy now pay later leader in France and active in 10 European countries, we've empowered more than 25,000 merchants and 10 million consumers.</p> <p>With 380+ Almakers and €100M+ ARR, Alma is scaling rapidly across Europe as a member of the Next40, and we're just getting started!</p> <p> </p> <h3>👐 About the team</h3> <p>Growth is part of the Revenue team. We build Alma's merchant acquisition engine: which merchants we target, how we find, identify and qualify them, how fast a qualified merchant reaches the right salesperson and, with lifecycle, how we convert, activate and retain them, in France and in our international markets.</p> <p><strong>We work AI-native, by design.</strong> Everyone in Growth works in Claude Code with a shared library of skills and connectors, a common repository that holds our workflow spec, our decision log and our merchant context, and a simple delivery lifecycle (Research → Spec → Plan → Build) where each stage ends with a human decision. Claude does the legwork; a person decides. Correctness comes from automated verification (tests, adversarial agent review, live validation), and every production change goes through a pull request with a named reviewer from DevX or SRE.</p> <p><strong>We are rebuilding our GTM system</strong> around five layers: market definition, signals, data & enrichment, decision & routing, and activation. As part of it, we are moving our merchant lifecycle off HubSpot to a modern customer engagement platform. Braze leads, <a href="http://Customer.io">Customer.io</a> is in the running, and we want your view. You will lead that migration and the lifecycle programme built on top of it.</p> <p><strong>You will join a team of 6</strong> with a Growth Ops, a Growth Engineer, a Paid Acquisition Manager, a Senior GTM Engineer (hiring) and an Experimentation & Tracking Engineer (hiring), and you will report to Julian, Team Lead Growth.</p> <p> </p> <p><span class="notion-enable-hover" data-token-index="0">This position is a permanent contract (CDI) based in Paris, hybrid.</span></p> <h3>💼 About the job</h3> <p><strong>Own the B2B lifecycle, from lead to active merchant</strong></p> <ul> <li>Design and run the journeys that drive revenue: lead nurturing, onboarding, activating signed merchants who haven't taken a first payment, retention and win-back.</li> <li>Reach the right merchants at the right moment with the right message, using segments built on live data (industry, size, country, TPV, product usage).</li> <li>Run a yearly campaign calendar (seasonal moments, product launches, credit upsell) next to the always-on journeys, with clear pressure rules. Start with email, then add in-app, POS materials for in-store merchants, and new channels when the data supports them.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Help drive Alma's move towards consumers</strong></p> <ul> <li>Alma is opening up to B2C, with new consumer products on the way. You'll be the first lifecycle person to work on it, and you'll get to invent how Alma talks to consumers.</li> <li>It starts small next to the merchant work and is set to grow fast.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Lead the migration off HubSpot</strong></p> <ul> <li>Help pick the platform. Braze is the front-runner, and if you think <a href="http://Customer.io">Customer.io</a> or another tool fits better, make the case.</li> <li>Audit what runs today, decide what to rebuild, improve or drop, and plan the switch so no key communication stops along the way.</li> <li>With the Growth Engineer and Data, define the data model, consent management and deliverability setup, then switch off HubSpot marketing on schedule.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Measure what you ship</strong></p> <ul> <li>Use control groups and A/B tests by default. Report on activations, reactivations and influenced TPV rather than open rates.</li> <li>Build your own segments and analyses, and share what works with Sales, Account Management and Revenue Marketing.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Be the CRM project lead across Revenue</strong></p> <ul> <li>Align Sales, Account Management, Ops, Product Marketing, Brand and Legal on shared campaigns: you own the brief-to-delivery workflow, set the pace and arbitrate.</li> <li>Make other teams autonomous on simple communications (templates, tone of voice, golden rules), so you can focus on the programmes that move revenue.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <h3>🗓️ Your first months</h3> <ul> <li><strong>Months 1–3:</strong> you audit our current lifecycle (HubSpot workflows, onboarding emails, scattered tools), give your recommendation on the target platform and define its setup with the Growth Engineer, and keep priority campaigns running while you prepare the switch.</li> <li><strong>By month 6:</strong> onboarding, activation and retention journeys run on the new platform with control groups; HubSpot marketing is switched off; a yearly campaign calendar is shared with Sales, Account Management and Product Marketing.</li> </ul> <h3>🧰 You will work with</h3> <ul> <li><strong>Lifecycle:</strong> Braze, <a href="http://Customer.io">Customer.io</a> or equivalent (decision in progress). HubSpot until we switch it off.</li> <li><strong>Revenue systems & data:</strong> Salesforce (system of record), BigQuery, Looker</li> <li><strong>AI & delivery:</strong> Claude Code (skills, connectors), Notion, Linear</li> </ul> <p> </p> <h3>🧩 About you</h3> <p><strong>To succeed in this job</strong></p> <ul> <li>5+ years in lifecycle, CRM or marketing automation, across both B2B and B2C. On the B2B side, you have run programmes hand in hand with Sales or Account Management on large portfolios (1,000+ accounts). On the B2C side, you have built consumer activation and engagement journeys at scale.</li> <li>A campaign manager first: you turn a business goal into a segment, a timing and a message, and you can show the revenue impact of your past programmes.</li> <li>Hands-on with a modern customer engagement platform: Braze, <a href="http://Customer.io">Customer.io</a>, Iterable or equivalent. You build journeys, segments and personalisation yourself, and you have opinions on what each tool does well and where it falls short. Having led or contributed to a platform migration is a strong asset.</li> <li>Data autonomy: you pull your own segments and results from a BI tool (Looker or equivalent), design tests with control groups, and understand how data flows between a CRM, a warehouse and a marketing platform.</li> <li>Cross-functional leadership: you have owned projects involving several teams without formal authority, and you know how to prioritise when everyone needs your time.</li> <li>Excellent writing in native-level French (mandatory) and fluent English.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>And it will be nice if you also</strong></p> <ul> <li>Have set up Braze, <a href="http://Customer.io">Customer.io</a> or a similar platform from scratch, or helped choose one.</li> <li>Have set up email deliverability (sending domains, SPF/DKIM/DMARC, IP warm-up).</li> <li>Already use AI in your daily work for copy, QA or analysis.</li> <li>Have worked in fintech, payments, a card launch, or with retail merchant networks.</li> <li>Speak Spanish, Italian or German.</li> </ul> <p><em>Don't meet every single requirement? At Alma, we believe great hires come from diverse paths. If this role excites you, we encourage you to apply. We value potential, curiosity and the ability to grow as much as experience.</em></p> <p> </p> <h3>🧘 What's in it for you</h3> <ul> <li><strong>Impact</strong>: 26,000 merchants in 10 countries, thousands of signed merchants still to activate, and a consumer audience to build. Every journey you ship shows up in TPV.</li> <li><strong>A clean start</strong>: you join in time to weigh in on the platform and set it up properly (data model, deliverability, governance) instead of inheriting years of workflow debt.</li> <li><strong>Leverage</strong>: an AI-native team and engineers next to you for the data plumbing, so you spend your time on segments, messages and results.</li> <li><strong>Team</strong>: a Team Lead Growth who designed this way of working, and close partners in Sales, Account Management, Ops and Product Marketing.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <h3>🤑 Compensation & Benefits</h3> <ul> <li><strong>Competitive salary</strong> based on 12 months</li> <li><strong>Profit sharing and employee savings plan</strong></li> <li><strong>Health insurance</strong>: <strong>100%</strong> covered by Alma including family package</li> <li><strong>Disability insurance</strong>: <strong>100%</strong> covered by Alma</li> <li><strong>Sport</strong>: partnerships with <strong>Gymlib</strong> and <strong>Classpass</strong>, or <strong>€30/month</strong> reimbursement for your sports activities</li> <li><strong>Maternity/paternity leave</strong>: salary maintained at 100% during leave with no seniority requirement. Return to work at 4/5 schedule paid at 100% for 8 weeks.</li> <li><strong>Sustainable Mobility Package (FMD)</strong>: <strong>€544.80/year</strong> (excluding full remote contracts)</li> <li><strong>Meal vouchers</strong>: <strong>€10/day</strong>, 50% covered by Alma</li> <li><strong>Mental health</strong>: free access to MindDay platform</li> <li><strong>Paid time off</strong>: 25 days/year (+ additional paid leave granted for employees on executive contracts)</li> <li>Access to our <strong>Learning & Development Platform</strong></li> <li><strong>2 weeks of full remote possible</strong> per year in summer</li> </ul> <p> </p> <h3>🎯 Interview Process</h3> <ul> <li><strong>Video call with a Talent Acquisition team member</strong> to understand your path, motivation & present you the role.</li> <li><strong>Video call with your future manager</strong> to deep dive the role, the team, your profile and answer all your questions.&lt

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Banyan Software is the best permanent home for software businesses that serve specialized industries, their employees, and their customers. With a buy-grow-and-hold-for-life approach and a permanent capital base, Banyan acquires and grows companies worldwide, honoring founder legacies and helping portfolio companies modernize through shared AI expertise and operational discipline. Founded in 2016, Banyan operates more than 120 portfolio companies across North and South America, Europe, and APAC, and has appeared on the Inc. 5000 list for six consecutive years. The Banyan Software Foundation, endowed with $100 million in Banyan stock, leverages technology to build a greener and more equitable world.</p></div><h3><strong>Overview</strong></h3> <p>We are looking for an exceptional full-stack software engineer who will act as a <strong>Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE)</strong> to serve as the critical interface between the central AI Application Modernization Factory and our application teams. The FDE will be temporarily embedded within delivery teams to directly drive the modernization of key applications, ensuring technical success, <strong>accelerated adoption of AI-assisted SDLC practices</strong>, and lasting upskilling of team members. This is a high-impact, hybrid role requiring advanced software engineering skills, deep knowledge of cloud-native patterns, and proven expertise in consultation, change management, and building strong rapport with diverse teams.</p> <h3><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></h3> <ul> <li><strong>Application Modernization Execution:</strong> Embed with application teams to provide hands-on technical leadership, driving the design, development, and delivery of modernization efforts (re-platforming, microservices adoption) to AWS cloud-native architectures.</li> <li><strong>AI-First SDLC Adoption & Upskilling:</strong> Act as the subject matter expert on the AI Modernization Factory's tools and processes (e.g., Cursor, Claude Code). Drive the adoption and change management necessary to embed AI-assisted software development practices into the team’s daily workflow.</li> </ul> <ul> <li><strong>Consultative Engineering & Change Management:</strong> Build trust and rapport with new, diverse teams quickly. Identify team-specific technical and process bottlenecks, recommending and implementing solutions, and effectively managing the people/process side of technical change.</li> <li><strong>Hands-on Software Development:</strong> Make significant code contributions, focusing on setting up architectural scaffolding, CI/CD pipelines, IaC (Terraform), and solving complex, blocking integration challenges for the embedded team.</li> <li><strong>Feedback Loop:</strong> Serve as the primary feedback channel, relaying practical challenges, tool deficiencies, and necessary process adjustments back to the central Principal Engineer and Architect to continuously improve the factory's capabilities.</li> <li><strong>Standards & Quality:</strong> Ensure embedded teams adhere to the central factory's engineering standards, including Twelve-Factor App principles, DevSecOps practices, and high-quality coding standards.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Required Qualifications & Experience</strong></h3> <ul> <li><strong>Experience:</strong> <strong>5+ years</strong> of progressive experience in Software Engineering, with a focus on enterprise applications and application modernization.</li> <li><strong>Full Stack Proficiency:</strong> Strong hands-on experience across the full application stack (front-end, back-end, database, infrastructure). You will bring deep hands-on credibility in multi-agent systems, governance and safeguards, while setting reusable patterns and raising capability across teams.</p> <p>The role has particular focus on sovereign, compliant and production-grade agentic AI for regulated German, Dutch and European enterprises, with a primary focus on healthcare and life sciences (pharma, biotech, medtech and healthcare providers). Experience from other regulated sectors, such as financial services and insurance, automotive and manufacturing, energy and telecommunications, is equally welcome.</p> <p>Our delivery model is moving from large time-and-materials teams to small, AI-first, multidisciplinary pods accountable to a business outcome. You will anchor the agentic side of that work, pairing with our data, tech advisory and industry domain leads from presale through delivery.</p> <p>This is a client-facing, builder's leadership role. You will start with a small, senior team and grow it through technical depth, delivery excellence and thought leadership, rather than inheriting a large organisation.</p> </div> <h2 id="job-responsibilities">Job responsibilities</h2> <div class="job-responsibilities content"> <p><strong>Shaping and winning</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Agentic AI advisory and strategy:</strong> shape and solution complex German, Dutch and DACH pursuits with account, commercial and delivery leaders, translating client needs into differentiated propositions, credible architectures and executable delivery approaches that support regional pipeline conversion.</li> <li>Independently drive complex pursuits with technical and executive stakeholders, including shaping the commercial model (fixed-price, outcome-linked), trade-offs and risk.</li> <li>Act as a sparring partner to C-suite buyers (CEO, CIO, CDO, CISO, COO): frame business-outcome hypotheses, challenge assumptions and measurable business value and ROI.</li> <li>Represent Thoughtworks' agentic AI expertise in strategic client conversations, industry forums, partnerships and thought leadership where appropriate.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Designing and building</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Design and build engineering:</strong> set the architecture direction for complex, production-grade agentic AI systems, including multi-agent workflows, orchestration, tool use, memory, context strategy, retrieval, evaluation, observability and enterprise integration.</li> <li>Integrate agents with the German enterprise core: SAP (S/4HANA, BTP), LIMS, QMS and clinical systems, MES/PLM and industrial systems, and legacy back-office platforms, using open protocols such as MCP and A2A where they fit.</li> <li>Ensure agents the EU AI Act and GDPR; for healthcare and life sciences GxP, EU MDR/IVDR and the European Health Data Space; and for other sectors DORA, NIS2 and BaFin requirements where relevant.</li> <li>Guide teams in balancing rapid experimentation with robust production engineering, including evaluation-driven development, testing, CI/CD, reliability, cost and performance optimisation.</li> <li>Provide technical and delivery leadership for complex programmes, staying hands-on enough to validate architecture, unblock teams, manage technical risk and ensure successful execution.</li> <li>Partner with product, data, software engineering, enterprise architecture, governance and change specialists to design end-to-end solutions that deliver measurable business outcomes.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Governance and safeguards</strong></p> <ul> <li>Establish reusable patterns for observability, auditability, traceability and control of agentic systems, enabling teams to demonstrate safe engineering controls and evidence.</li> <li>Engage early with works councils (Betriebsrat, ondernemingsraad), data protection officers and information security, supporting DPIAs and co-determination processes so agentic solutions that touch employee workflows can go live.</li> <li>Anticipate technical, organisational and governance challenges in enterprise AI adoption and define practical approaches to address them.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Principal-level leadership and growing capability </strong></p> <ul> <li>Set reusable architecture patterns, engineering standards and governance practices across multiple teams and engagements, influencing the evolution of Thoughtworks' agentic AI capability beyond an individual programme.</li> <li>Set technical direction across multiple teams and initiatives, defining reusable patterns, frameworks and engineering standards for agentic AI delivery.</li> <li>Mentor senior engineers and technical leads, build the next generation of the German team, and raise AI fluency and agentic engineering standards across specialists and generalists.</li> <li>Evaluate emerging agentic AI technologies and frameworks and guide their responsible adoption based on client context, engineering quality and business value.</li> <li>Build our German and Dutch market presence through local-language points of view, ecosystem and partner initiatives (hyperscalers, SAP, European model providers) and community events.</li> </ul> </div> <h2 id="job-qualifications">Job qualifications</h2> <div class="job-qualifications content"> <h3 id="technical-skills">Technical Skills</h3> <div class="qualifications inner-content"> <ul> <li>Deep expertise in modern software engineering and Python, with a strong track record of setting standards for testing, CI/CD, observability, maintainability and production reliability.</li> <li>Recognised experience architecting and delivering complex GenAI and agentic AI systems at enterprise scale, from early discovery through production deployment.</li> <li>Deep knowledge of agentic architectures and frameworks such as LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI, LlamaIndex or equivalent, including tool use, orchestration, memory, multi-agent coordination and interoperability protocols (MCP, A2A).</li> <li>Strong expertise in Retrieval-Augmented Generation, advanced information retrieval, vector title: Partner Account Manager, Intégrateurs de solutions de gestion
description: Vous cherchez un environnement professionnel stimulant basé sur l'autonomie et la confiance ? Pennylane vous offre l'opportunité de grandir au sein d'une entreprise en pleine croissance. Ici, votre expertise contribuera directement à aider les entrepreneurs à reprendre le contrôle de leurs finances. Découvrez un lieu où vos compétences seront valorisées et où vous pourrez façonner l'avenir de la gestion financière. Notre vision Notre ambition est de devenir le logiciel de pilotage financier préféré des PMEs européennes. Nous aidons les entrepreneurs à se débarrasser des tâches chronophages liées à la comptabilité et à la finance, tout en leur donnant accès à des informations financières clés pour les aider à prendre les meilleures décisions pour leur entreprise. Parallèlement, nous aidons les cabinets d'expertise-comptable, en leur permettant de passer moins de temps sur des tâches redondantes et répétitives, et plus de temps sur la partie conseil et accompagnement de leurs clients. À propos de Pennylane Pennylane est une des FinTech à la plus forte croissance en France, et souhaite bientôt adresser le marché européen. En 5 ans d'existence, nous sommes parvenus à : 💻 Nous positionner sur le marché comme un éditeur de solution de comptabilité et de gestion financière innovant 💰 Lever un total de 350 millions d'euros, auprès d'investisseurs de renom, dont Sequoïa, le fonds phare de la Silicon Valley, connu pour avoir soutenu Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal et bien d'autres à leur début 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Passer de 7 cofondateurs à une équipe de 1000 collaborateurs, avec une note moyenne de 4,9/5 sur Glassdoor et 94% des évaluateurs Glassdoor qui recommanderaient PL à leurs proches! 🌍 Construire une équipe internationale composée de collaborateurs issus de 25 pays différents, avec une culture du télétravail très flexible 🤝 Gagner la confiance de milliers d'utilisateurs et obtenir d'excellents retours 🚀 Déjà plus de 1 000,000 TPE/PME et plus de 6000 cabinets d’expertise-comptable utilisent Pennylane en France ! Localisation et déplacements Poste basé à Paris , selon la politique hybride de Pennylane, avec des déplacements réguliers en France auprès des partenaires, de leurs équipes et lors d’événements professionnels. Le portefeuille pourra inclure des partenaires franciliens et nationaux ; son allocation définitive sera précisée avec le manager. Pourquoi ce rôle est-il important chez nous ? Les intégrateurs historiques disposent souvent d’une expertise métier reconnue, d’équipes commerciales et de conseil, ainsi que d’un parc de clients à accompagner. Ils peuvent contribuer fortement à la croissance de Pennylane, à la fois par la vente de nouvelles solutions et par le développement de leur parc existant. Pour transformer ce potentiel en résultats, il faut installer une dynamique commerciale durable : aligner les dirigeants et les équipes terrain, faire émerger des opportunités, améliorer la maîtrise du produit et faciliter la collaboration avec les équipes Pennylane. Tu aideras les partenaires à passer d’une relation de distribution ou de prescription à une collaboration active, structurée et créatrice de valeur. Comment vas-tu contribuer au projet ? Tu piloteras le développement d’un portefeuille de partenaires intégrateurs, de la stratégie de compte jusqu’à l’exécution des plans d’action : Développer les comptes partenaires , en alignant les dirigeants, responsables commerciaux et équipes opérationnelles autour d’objectifs communs. Accélérer le business Resell et Cosell , en animant les opportunités, en améliorant leur qualité et en aidant les partenaires à faire progresser leurs cycles de vente. Faire monter les équipes partenaires en compétence , grâce à des démonstrations, des formations et un accompagnement commercial concret. Créer une dynamique de croissance sur le parc existant , en identifiant les opportunités de déploiement, de migration et d’équipement des clients des intégrateurs. Faire rayonner les apprentissages du terrain , en partageant les résultats, les besoins partenaires et les leviers qui fonctionnent avec l’équipe Partnerships et les autres équipes internes. Quelles seront tes missions au quotidien ? 1. Construire et déployer les plans de croissance des partenaires Comprendre le modèle économique, l’organisation, les priorités et le potentiel de chaque intégrateur. Construire avec les dirigeants et responsables commerciaux des plans de compte ambitieux, assortis d’objectifs et d’étapes concrètes. Identifier les leviers de croissance adaptés à chaque partenaire : développement du parc, nouveaux projets, campagnes ciblées, événements ou actions conjointes. Mobiliser les sponsors et les équipes terrain pour ancrer le partenariat dans les pratiques commerciales et opérationnelles. Prioriser ton temps et les ressources internes en fonction du potentiel et de l’impact attendu. 2. Animer le business Resell et Cosell Créer et entretenir une relation de confiance avec les décideurs, les équipes commerciales et les consultants du partenaire. Suivre le pipeline Resell et Cosell, assurer la qualité des opportunités et rendre le forecast fiable. Aider le partenaire à qualifier les besoins, structurer les opportunités et mobiliser les bons interlocuteurs Pennylane. Coordonner les actions avec les Account Executives et clarifier les rôles sur les cycles de vente partagés. Détecter les risques, débloquer les situations et accélérer les opportunités pertinentes jusqu’à leur conclusion. 3. Développer le parc et les opportunités chez les clients des intégrateurs Identifier avec le partenaire les segments de clients et les cas d’usage prioritaires. Construire des plans d’action pour équiper ou faire migrer les clients du parc lorsqu’une opportunité pertinente existe. Aider le partenaire à organiser la prospection, la qualification et le suivi des projets issus de son réseau. Participer à des rendez-vous clients, démonstrations ou événements lorsque cela peut accélérer le business ou renforcer la relation. Suivre l’impact des actions engagées et capitaliser sur les approches qui produisent des résultats. 4. Former et rendre les équipes partenaires plus autonomes Maîtriser la proposition de valeur et les principaux cas d’usage de Pennylane afin de réaliser des démonstrations convaincantes. Former les équipes commerciales du partenaire à présenter la valeur de la solution, au-delà des seules fonctionnalités. Aider les consultants et équipes opérationnelles à comprendre les conditions d’un déploiement réussi et à orienter les clients vers les bons interlocuteurs. Préparer les partenaires à leurs rendez-vous, événements clients et temps forts commerciaux. Adapter ton accompagnement aux profils et au niveau de maturité des équipes du partenaire. 5. Être présent sur le terrain et faire vivre la relation Assurer une présence physique régulière auprès des partenaires prioritaires, notamment lors de revues d’activité, de rendez-vous dirigeants et d’actions commerciales. Préparer et animer des revues de partenariat qui débouchent sur des décisions, des responsables et des prochaines étapes claires. Entretenir un réseau de contacts au-delà de l’interlocuteur principal afin de sécuriser la continuité du partenariat. Identifier tôt les signaux de risque, les irritants et les sujets nécessitant un arbitrage. Représenter Pennylane auprès des partenaires avec exigence, réactivité et transparence. 6. Collaborer en interne et contribuer à la stratégie Partnerships Coordonner les plans partenaires avec les équipes AE, Marketing, Ops, Produit et les équipes d’accompagnement concernées. Faire remonter des retours terrain précis sur les besoins des intégrateurs, les objections, les évolutions de marché et les opportunités commerciales. Proposer des initiatives marketing, commerciales ou produit pour accélérer la croissance des partenaires. Partager les bonnes pratiques et les succès avec l’équipe afin de contribuer à la performance collective. Maintenir des informations fiables dans le CRM et respecter les processus de vente et de suivi partenaires. Profil recherché : Compétences incontournables : Tu as une expérience confirmée en vente indirecte B2B, gestion de comptes partenaires ou développement de réseaux de revendeurs et d’intégrateurs; Tu as idéalement au moins 5 ans d’expérience dans un environnement logiciel ou SaaS B2B ; une expérience plus senior sera appréciée pour gérer des partenaires stratégiques et des cycles complexes; Tu sais élaborer et piloter des plans de croissance avec des interlocuteurs de niveau direction et des équipes opérationnelles; Tu as une approche commerciale orientée résultats, sais piloter un pipeline et transformer les analyses en actions concrètes; Tu es à l’aise dans les rendez-vous terrain, les négociations, les présentations et les démonstrations produit; Tu sais engager plusieurs parties prenantes chez un partenaire et construire une relation de confiance dans la durée; Tu es proactif, créatif et résilient : tu sais prendre des initiatives et maintenir une dynamique même lorsque les résultats prennent du temps; Tu es rigoureux dans le suivi des opportunités, le forecast et l’utilisation du CRM; Tu apprécies le travail en équipe et sais collaborer avec des fonctions commerciales, marketing, produit et opérations; Tu maîtrises le français et peux participer à des échanges professionnels en anglais. Atouts appréciés Une connaissance des solutions de comptabilité, finance, gestion, ERP ou logiciels de gestion pour les PME; Une expérience auprès d’intégrateurs, de revendeurs, de VAR ou d’éditeurs logiciels B2B. Une bonne compréhension des écosystèmes de distribution logicielle et des enjeux de déploiement chez les clients; Une expérience de gestion de grands comptes partenaires, de plans de migration de parc ou de cycles Resell et Cosell. Ce que nous recherchons surtout : Au-delà de ton expérience, nous recherchons une personne qui : Sait créer rapidement de la confiance et de la crédibilité auprès de dirigeants et d’équipes terrain; Aime être au contact des partenaires et transforme cette proximité en actions commerciales mesurables; Sait conjuguer vision stratégique du compte et exécution opérationnelle au quotidien; Est à la fois autonome, coachable et généreuse dans le partage de ses apprentissages avec l’équipe; A envie de contribuer à la croissance d’un réseau historique tout en faisant évoluer ses pratiques. Process de recrutement : Screening Talent Acquisition — 45 min : motivation, expérience en partenariats logiciels, connaissance de l’écosystème et disponibilité pour les déplacements. Entretien Hiring Manager — 45 min : réalisations concrètes, gestion de portefeuille, activation et développement de partenaires, approche terrain et collaboration. Étude de cas — environ 1 h : analyse d’un portefeuille d’intégrateurs, proposition d’un plan de croissance, priorisation du pipeline Resell/Cosell et présentation d’une approche de démonstration ou d’enablement. Entretien final — environ 45 min : vision du canal, contribution stratégique, collaboration transverse et adéquation avec les ambitions de Pennylane. 🎁 Ce que l’on peut t'offrir : 🏥 Une mutuelle parmi les meilleures sur le marché (Alan Blue et Alan Mind) 🍜 Des tickets restaurants (Carte Swile) 🏝 Entre 6 et 12 jours de RTT supplémentaires aux 5 semaines de congés payés 🧑‍💻 Un budget dédié chaque mois pour tous nos Pennylaners, favorisant le travail depuis la maison ou en espace de coworking 🏢 Une facilité d’accès à nos bureaux, situés à quelques minutes de Saint Lazare en plein cœur de Paris 💵 Une enveloppe de BSPCE 🏃‍♀️ Un accès à 8000 salles de sport partout en France et plus de 300 activités de bien-être via notre partenaire Gymlib 💻 Un Mac 🎉 Nous pratiquons de nombreux sports ensemble et avons à cœur de nous réunir régulièrement autour d’événements d’entreprise tels que les Tech Days (qui permettent aux Pennylaners en remote de se réunir tous les 3 mois) ou notre séminaire d’en

Today, SkyCell operates at the intersection of hardware, software, data, and logistics - combining Swiss engineering excellence with a growing digital platform to shape the future of connected pharma supply chains. title: AI Engineer (Agentic AI)
description: Legal AI is only as good as the knowledge behind it. At Lefebvre Sdu, we’ve been building that knowledge for 200 years. Day in, day out. Law by law. Word by word. Other legal AI tools run on our data and software. As the Dutch heart of Lefebvre Group, the European leader in legal and tax knowledge, we’re also developing our own platform: GenIA-L, where lawyers and tax professionals don’t just get an answer, but an answer they’re willing to put their name to. More than 75,000 professionals use it every day, accounting for over €100 million ARR across Europe. We’re looking for a Medior AI Engineer to help shape how the intelligent core of that platform evolves. HOW YOU'LL MOVE US FORWARD GenIA-L is a research platform for legal professionals. A user asks a question. The platform searches our trusted sources and turns them into a useful answer. It does this with agents: specialised AI components that each handle part of the question and work together. In the legal domain, an answer can't just sound fluent. It has to be correct, and you must be able to see which source it comes from. This is not a pilot project: the platform runs in production and is used heavily every day. As a medior, your focus is on building. You work independently, on challenges that come from customers and on challenges we spot ourselves. You break down a legal process, translate it into a technical process and work out how to best connect the pieces. Stuck on something? You say so, and your colleagues think along with you. You build and improve the agents of GenIA-L and the way they work together. You build and maintain our knowledge packages: for each legal article, an expert-validated set of commentary, case law, parliamentary history and practical interpretation. You also work on the pipelines that create these packages and keep them up to date. You make quality measurable. With evaluation sets, observability and metrics, you show that answers, source attribution and reliability really improve. Not by gut feeling, but with evidence. You build features for customers, such as analysing their own documents and new ways to search case law. You work directly with editors and subject-matter experts, and check with them which parts of a legal question really matter. You come up with and test ideas to make the product sharper or faster, and alternate AI experiments with back-end development. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR You have a realistic view of LLMs. You see what they can do, but you also know their weak spots. You enjoy following new AI developments, but you don't just follow the herd: you stay critical. You think in a structured way and can break a complex problem into smaller pieces. You work independently, take initiative when things are unclear and are eager to learn fast. And you enjoy working with lawyers and editors, because they know what a good answer looks like. You have several years of experience in software or ML engineering. Depth in recent projects counts for more than years. Strong experience in agentic AI. You have good knowledge of Python and experience with relevant machine learning libraries. You have helped build an LLM application that runs in production. Not just prototypes, notebooks or courses. You have hands-on experience with agent frameworks such as LangGraph and LangChain, tool calling, MCP or comparable orchestration. Our entire product is built around this. Experience with only a simple search-and-answer (RAG) setup is not enough. You have measured the quality of an LLM system with evaluation sets or observability, and can give a concrete example. Experience with tools like MLflow and LiteLLM is a plus. You have back-end experience, including building REST APIs. You have experience in Kubernetes. Experience with Postgres is useful. Experience in a legal, tax or other knowledge-intensive domain is a plus. WHAT YOU'RE SIGNING UP FOR On Tuesdays and Thursdays, the team works together at the office. What colleagues value most here: mutual trust, room to experiment, and a team that helps each other out when someone gets stuck. A place where you have influence from day one: on the approach, the processes, and the direction. Colleagues who deliberately chose Lefebvre Sdu over big tech jobs because here, they're building something that doesn't exist yet. Base salary between €4,477 and €5,793 per month, based on a 36-hour week, since that's full-time for us. Plus a lot of extra allowances (see below). A bonus tied to company performance: a fixed year-end bonus of 4% and profit sharing of up to 6%. 23 vacation days and a personal choice budget of 12%, of which 8% is holiday pay and 4% is freely allocable. Want more vacation? Just buy it. A bonus of up to 10% of your salary, based on company performance and individual performance. A solid pension plan through PGB, including supplementary partner insurance. Collective insurance plans. A travel allowance of €0.25 per kilometer or a public transport reimbursement, plus an attractive bike plan. For employees with a commute of less than 10 km or more than 60 km, we have an adjusted arrangement. Two days a week in the office in The Hague, within walking distance of Voorburg station. The rest of the week, wherever you work best. Room to grow: in your craft, in your role, in the organization. WANT TO KNOW MORE? We'd love to tell you everything about the team and the role. Send us your CV and you'll hear from us within 2 working days. Any questions first? Text or call Nadine at 0628556265. A reference check and a VOG (certificate of good behaviour) are part of the selection process. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

description: Our mission We turn data into better healthcare. With our insights, we make healthcare more affordable and better, and we improve the patients’ and clinicians’ experience. title: Software Engineer, Agentic Commerce
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. description: <p>Artefact is an international consulting and engineering company specialising in data and AI, and a European leader in its field. Our headquarters is located in Paris. For the past 10 years, we have focused on designing and deploying artificial intelligence technologies and data-driven solutions.</p> <p>Headquartered in Paris, we are now present in 24 countries across all continents, with 1,700 employees worldwide.</p> <p>Our mission is to help businesses unlock the full potential of AI and data by developing bespoke solutions tailored to their specific business challenges. As pioneers in this domain, we combine technological expertise with operational excellence, working closely with leading players in the market. Our clients span all key sectors of the economy – including industry, retail, luxury, FMCG, healthcare, and finance – and include major international groups.</p> <p>Beyond consulting, we are strongly committed to promoting ethical and accessible AI. We have launched the School of Data to support career transitions into tech roles, and established an AI Research Centre in both Paris and Shanghai.</p> <p>In the context of Artefact’s accelerating growth, we are looking for a B2B Marketing Intern to join our Marketing team starting in <strong>January 2027</strong>.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>The role :</strong></p> <p>Are you passionate about B2B marketing in the Tech area and want to work in an environment where your impact on business growth is recognised?</p> <p>If this sounds like you, and you’re ready to step-up your career and level of responsibility, then you might just be our next <strong>B2B Marketing Assistant Intern.</strong></p> <p>The Marketing team at Artefact directly contributes to the business by engaging with existing clients and prospects to convert them as leads to generate sales. We do so by working closely with the heads of departments & consultant teams, as well as using KPI to make sure we create the right marketing deliverables and use the right channels to drive engagement, and ultimately leads and revenue.  </p> <p>We do this through <strong>demand generation campaigns</strong> and <strong>events/webinars’ organisation</strong>, combined with <strong>PPC </strong>and <strong>social advertising </strong>to ensure brand and lead-gen campaigns support business objectives.</p> <p>You’ll be working closely with the rest of the Artefact’s worldwide Marketing team, that’s why fluently speaking in English to share your best practices and train your peers is also required. You will be collaborating with the Marketing Specialists Global and France of the team, who report to the CMO of the Group, all based in Paris.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>What you will do:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Using our marketing automation tool (Pardot) to conceive and roll-out mailing and lead nurturing campaigns (mailings, newsletters, landing pages) to drive customer acquisition.</li> <li>Helping to organize events (webinars, business breakfasts, podcasts, participation in trade fairs & conferences with booths and speaking slots) and ensure a multi-channel attractive communications of these events through our website & landing pages, mailing series and social media (LinkedIn and Instagram).</li> <li>Managing LinkedIn advertising campaigns according to objectives (awareness, acquisition) mixing organic and paid approach, to support and generate leads for the management team. </li> <li>Copywriting for PPC ads (LinkedIn) and landing pages thanks to engaging and attractive communication</li> <li>Coordinating with our design team and briefing them to craft impactful and visually appealing assets that effectively communicate our key messages on social media every day.. </li> <li>Analyzing our Marketing Performance dashboards to understand and improve how our inbound marketing activity turns into and converts customers. </li> <li>Building effective stakeholder relationships (the Growth Tribe (Consulting Partners & Directors) freelancers, agencies, Tech Partners), ensuring all parties are kept informed throughout the campaigns and post activation.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Skills & Requirements</strong></p> <p>The candidate will be an enthusiastic and hardworking young professional, excited to join our fast paced marketing team. title: International Expansion
description: About Us At Axle Energy, we’re building the infrastructure that will underpin the decarbonised energy system. Our software moves energy usage to times when electricity is cheap and green, by controlling vehicle charging, heating systems, inverters and home batteries. We control hundreds of thousands of energy assets. We’re building in a legacy industry and moving gigawatt-hours of electrons in the real world, but we operate at lightning speed, and we’re growing the team to meet customer demand. We’re proud to be supported by world-leading investors, including Energize Capital and Accel. Read more about what we’re building here . We’re looking for a commercially sharp, highly autonomous operator to drive Axle’s commercial success in the Dutch market. Axle has quickly become the leader in our operational markets, and we’re now looking to expand our reach internationally. Our goal is to become the go-to platform for energy flexibility globally, and we’re hiring the person to make that happen. This role will assess Axle’s participation in Dutch markets and business models from first principles: diving deep into regulations, modelling revenue-per-asset, and trialling new propositions at pace. You speak Dutch and fluent English. Other European languages will also be an asset. What you will be doing Owning new customer acquisition end-to-end, from first conversation through to commercial close, setting our partners up to generate meaningful revenue. High-level strategy development, defining and executing Axle’s international expansion plans, and assessing the commercial value of Dutch markets and business models. Diving deep into policy and regulations, understanding how market access works and what needs doing to achieve it. Developing the zero-to-one of the business through partnerships with key stakeholders. You’ll be jumping on the phone (and eventually, getting on the ground) with grid operators, utilities/retailers and potential clients to create and disprove hypotheses as quickly as possible. Acting as a conduit between partners and engineering teams creating fast, structured feedback loops that help translate field insights into meaningful product enhancements. As such, we are looking for a “full-stack operator” who can process highly technical information, ramp up commercial value, and accelerate us into new markets. You might have previous experience in one or more of the activities above, but we are more interested in your growth potential than your domain-specific expertise. We are looking for people who have built things, developed new relationships, and helped get big projects over the line in complex environments. This is an opportunity to repeatedly deliver first-of-a-kind projects across the world, become a domain expert, and work at the bleeding edge of global electrification. What’s in it for you This is a 12 month fixed-term contract. Compensation is highly competitive and dependent on experience. We operate with a deliberately flat structure and aim to keep pay equitable across the company, with a 1:1 median ratio between founder and team compensation. Bi-annual retreats to strengthen team connection & shared purpose. You’ll be based in the Netherlands. To maximise collaboration, we ask that you spend ~1 week per month working from our London office. The opportunity to directly shape the future of energy markets and accelerate the transition to a low-carbon world. We are extremely keen to build a diverse team, and we’re particularly eager to hear from candidates who don't fit the traditional role stereotypes. If you’re motivated by our mission, please do reach out, even if you feel you might not ‘check all the boxes’. Interview process Initial interview Take-home exercise Final interview (in-person) Offer, references, and welcome to the team! Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Staff Software Engineer, Payments
description: About Airwallex Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own. We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific. We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles to see it in full. How you'll make impact You’ll define the technical direction for Airwallex’s Payments Platform, lead architecture decisions and build highly reliable, high-volume distributed systems that directly affect merchant experience and business outcomes. You’ll design and build scalable backend services, REST APIs, event-driven systems and integration components within a microservices architecture, connecting with our React frontend. You’ll drive complex initiatives across payment gateways, acquiring, issuing, card networks and local payment methods, while partnering with product, business, infrastructure and external engineering teams to turn merchant needs into technical solutions. You’ll raise the engineering bar through architectural reviews, thoughtful approaches to technical debt, strong design practices, code quality, testing, observability, reliability and mentorship. What we're looking for Essentials 10+ years of software engineering experience, including Staff-level technical leadership or equivalent ownership of complex backend systems. Strong experience designing and operating high-volume distributed systems, preferably in payments, fintech, commerce or financial infrastructure. Recent hands-on experience with Java or Kotlin and Spring or Spring Boot. Expert experience building REST APIs, backend microservices, Kafka-based event streams and distributed data stores such as Cassandra, Hazelcast, Oracle Coherence or similar. Experience with cloud platforms such as GCP or AWS, plus Docker and Kubernetes. Strong familiarity with observability and operational tooling such as New Relic, StatsD, ELK, Datadog, Prometheus or similar. A proven ability to lead projects from concept to production, with a focus on quality, testing, reliability and maintainability. Excellent communication skills and the ability to influence across engineering, product and business stakeholders. Preferred Experience building payment gateways, acquiring platforms, issuing platforms or payment acceptance infrastructure. Experience integrating major card networks such as Visa and Mastercard. Experience with local payment methods such as iDEAL, Klarna, Trustly or similar. Familiarity with authorisation, capture, refunds, chargebacks, settlement, reconciliation, fraud, risk or PCI/compliance workflows. Experience mentoring senior engineers and leading cross-team technical initiatives. You'll thrive here if You’re comfortable owning the roadmap yourself. You own the outcome and you don’t wait for permission to fix what’s broken. You’re comfortable with ambiguity. Give you a problem, not a prescription, and you’ll run with it. You communicate clearly and directly across cultures, and you’re thoughtful about how context shifts meaning across borders. You’re comfortable operating across time zones with a globally distributed team, including colleagues based in APAC and EMEA. Learn more about your team Payments Platform at Airwallex builds the infrastructure that turns global payment complexity into reliable, scalable payment experiences, helping businesses accept and process money across markets with less friction. The challenge is balancing performance, reliability, local complexity, and commercial outcomes in the same system, where small improvements can materially affect conversion and failures are immediately visible. You'll do well here if you're thoughtful, pragmatic, and motivated by making complex problems feel simple to customers. If you want to build the platform that makes payments work seamlessly for businesses around the world, this is the team at the center of that mission.
