title: Senior Commercial Account Executive
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h2><span style="color: rgb(230, 126, 35);">Available Locations</span></h2> <hr> <p>Switzerland</p> <h2><span style="color: rgb(230, 126, 35);">About the Role</span></h2> <hr> <p>We are seeking a highly accomplished and strategic Sr. Commercial Account Executive to join our <strong>Swiss Sales Team, specifically for the</strong> <strong>German speaking part of Switzerland</strong>. In this advanced role, you will be pivotal in driving significant growth by leading comprehensive sales cycles within a portfolio of assigned enterprise-level clients, and strategically acquiring new logos. The ideal candidate possesses a deep blend of advanced sales acumen and sophisticated technical understanding, enabling them to lead engagements at all levels, from the C-suite to technical leaders (e.g., Head of/VP of Networking or Security).</p> <p>As an Sr. Commercial Account Executive, you will consistently demonstrate advanced proficiency in all sales activities, ensuring highly accurate forecasting, proactive and strategic pipeline management, and consistently exceeding attainment targets. You will be a subject matter expert, speaking fluently about Cloudflare's products, features, benefits, and use cases across diverse customer segments. This role demands the ability to deeply understand complex customer IT Architectures, match them with relevant Cloudflare Reference Architectures, and orchestrate successful, large-scale platform sales. You will be a key driver of digital transformation for our customers, understanding their broader market trends and how Cloudflare uniquely enables their strategic initiatives. In line with Cloudflare's AI-native culture, you will be expected to leverage AI tools actively in your daily workflow — from account research and outreach to meeting preparation and pipeline management — using them as a genuine productivity multiplier, not an afterthought.</p> <h2><span style="color: rgb(230, 126, 35);">Responsibilities</span></h2> <hr> <ul> <li><strong>Strategic Revenue Generation:</strong> Architect and execute advanced territory and account plans to consistently exceed multi-million dollar sales targets and annual quotas, with a strong focus on new business acquisition and expansion within complex enterprise environments.</li> <li><strong>Expert Pipeline & Forecasting:</strong> Lead proactive and strategic pipeline management efforts, demonstrating a sophisticated understanding of sales cycles and customer buying processes. Deliver highly accurate forecasts, providing clear insights and strategic guidance to sales leadership.</li> <li><strong>AI-Powered Sales Execution:</strong> Leverage AI tools as a deliberate and consistent part of how you sell — applying them to account research, personalised outreach, executive meeting preparation, pipeline analysis, and follow-up drafting. Demonstrate the same AI-native mindset Cloudflare brings to its products in how you manage your own territory and time.</li> <li><strong>Deep Customer & IT Architecture Understanding:</strong> Develop a profound understanding of customers' IT architectures, including applications and third-party technologies. Architect and align Cloudflare Reference Architectures to customer environments, driving comprehensive platform solutions.</li> <li><strong>Multi-Engagement Leadership:</strong> Orchestrate and manage multiple complex customer engagements simultaneously across various business units within an organization. Strategically connect disparate needs to strengthen Cloudflare's platform sale, actively involving and influencing technical C-level minus one executives.</li> <li><strong>Virtual Team Leadership:</strong> Set clear direction and lead a virtual team of in-GEO specialists, Product Managers, Deal Desk, and Legal to collaboratively manage and close complex customer opportunities. Proactively identify and navigate through situations to address colleague and customer needs, escalating as appropriate to drive urgency and efficient delivery.</li> <li><strong>Digital Transformation Authority:</strong> Act as an authority on digital transformation, understanding key drivers (e.g., new offering development, enhanced customer capabilities) and the broader market trends influencing these decisions. Position Cloudflare as a critical enabler of these transformations.</li> <li><strong>Compelling Value Creation:</strong> Articulate highly compelling, strategic value propositions for Cloudflare's services, directly linking them to customer business outcomes and strategic objectives. Lead with a strong focus on the "why," communicating the whole picture to both internal and external stakeholders.</li> <li><strong>Advanced Negotiation & Closure:</strong> Expertly lead and navigate complex contract negotiations, driving win-win scenarios for all parties. Demonstrate advanced closing skills across new business and expansion opportunities.</li> <li><strong>Trusted Advisor & Coach:</strong> Build long-term, executive-level strategic relationships, ensuring deep customer adoption, retention, and expansion. Consistently provide clear, direct, and constructive feedback to team members, coaching them to improve communication, learn from mistakes, and enhance the quality of work. Share learnings proactively to build trust across the organization.</li> <li><strong>Organizational Impact & Leadership:</strong> Consistently focus on the long-term needs of the team and the business, understanding how decisions impact other teams and openly sharing these insights. Leverage company-wide learnings to improve department and team execution. Serve as a leader within Cloudflare, making significant contributions while elevating the work of others by bringing diverse perspectives and strategic long-term thinking.</li> </ul> <h2><span style="color: rgb(230, 126, 35);">Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</span></h2> <hr> <ul> <li><strong>5+ years of advanced experience selling complex technology solutions in a B2B enterprise model</strong>, with a significant track record of consistently exceeding multi-million dollar quota targets.</li> <li><strong>Deep expertise and fluency in Cloud Networking, Security, and Edge Computing technologies</strong>, with an exceptional ability to articulate features, benefits, and use cases across diverse customer segments (e.g., SMBs, enterprise, vertical markets).</li> <li><strong>Proven ability to deeply understand complex customer IT architectures</strong> and effectively map them to Cloudflare Reference Architectures for successful platform sales.</li> <li><strong>Demonstrated success leading and influencing virtual cross-functional teams</strong> (e.g., Solution Engineers, Product Managers, Legal) to drive complex deals to closure.</li> <li><strong>Exceptional strategic communication and presentation skills</strong>, with a focus on articulating the "why" and conveying the whole picture to executive leadership and technical decision-makers (C-level minus one).</li> <li><strong>Demonstrated use of AI tools in a sales context</strong> — account intelligence, outreach personalisation, pipeline management, or meeting preparation. You can speak specifically to how AI has made you faster, sharper, or more effective in a previous role.</li> <li><strong>Advanced negotiation skills</strong> with a track record of closing large, complex, six-figure and multi-million dollar deals.</li> <li><strong>Expert-level sales acumen:</strong> unparalleled proficiency in discovery, positioning, competitive selling, negotiation, closing, and expansion strategies within enterprise accounts.</li> <li><strong>Authority on digital transformation trends</strong> and their impact on enterprise customers, with the ability to position Cloudflare as a key enabler of strategic business outcomes.</li> <li><strong>Strong coaching and mentorship abilities</strong>, with a passion for helping colleagues grow and improve.</li> <li><strong>Highly self-motivated, entrepreneurial, and resilient</strong>, thriving in a fast-paced, high-growth environment with a consistent focus on long-term goals.</li> <li><strong>Proficiency in advanced sales and business intelligence platforms</strong> (e.g., Salesforce, Tableau, G-suite, MSFT suite, MEDDPICC framework application).</li> <li><strong>Bachelor's degree required</strong>, with a technical background (e.g., engineering, computer science, MIS) highly preferred.</li> <li><strong>Ability to travel</strong> as required to engage with key customers and internal teams.</li> <li><strong>Language Skills: German OR French & English</strong></li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p>

description: Data Engineer Shiftbase is building the self-driving assistant for shift-based businesses across Europe. Ask every day whether the whole company can trust and reuse it. Make the data flow reliably. Build ELT and ETL with incremental, idempotent loads, orchestration, and retries, so pipelines run on time without anyone watching them. Ship monitored pipelines that hold up in production. Take the transform layer. Own the Dataform model-building and transform layer, taking full responsibility for the transformation layer and freeing up capacity for semantic modeling and business definitions. This unblocks the whole team. Build trust into the data. Make validation, freshness monitoring, alerting, and lineage the default. Diagnose failures at the root cause. leadscorev2 is the outcome this role exists to prevent. Serve the whole company. title: Account Executive - NL Region

Bedrijven die vaak nog met Excel of een verouderd systeem werken en waarbij jij in één demo laat zien hoeveel tijd ze terugkrijgen. De use case is herkenbaar, de waarde is snel duidelijk en dat maakt je verkoopcycli lekker kort. Het grootste deel van je pipeline is warm. Je werkt met tempo en volume, en je weet wanneer een deal aandacht verdient en wanneer je hem moet laten gaan. Je wacht niet tot de telefoon gaat: als je een account in gedachten hebt, vind je zelf een weg naar binnen. Engels is een pre. Profielen die ons aanspreken: je komt uit de SaaS-wereld en hebt ervaring met snelle funnels en hoge volumes. Denk aan omgevingen zoals Lightspeed, Zenchef of vergelijkbare SME-gerichte hospitality- of retailtech. Of je hebt een leidinggevende achtergrond in de horeca, bent tech-savvy en hebt slimme techoplossingen geïmplementeerd in die rol, en je wilt nu de overstap maken naar software sales aan onder andere de horeca. In beide gevallen: je snapt de wereld van onze klanten als geen ander. Wat bieden wij jou? Een rol waarin je een SaaS-oplossing verkoopt die bedrijven écht vooruit helpt, in een omgeving waar resultaat en plezier hand in hand gaan. Groei is hier geen loze belofte. We investeren serieus in je ontwikkeling vanaf dag één. Je start met een gedegen 30-60-90-dagen-onboardingprogramma met duidelijke milestones, zodat je precies weet waar je staat en waar je naartoe werkt. Je wordt daarnaast getraind en gecertificeerd via Winning by Design, hét toonaangevende salestrainingsprogramma voor SaaS, inclusief SPICED-certificering. Daarbovenop krijg je een persoonlijk ontwikkelbudget van €1.000 per jaar om te investeren in wat jou verder brengt: cursussen, conferenties, boeken of coaching. Jij kiest. Verder bieden we een brutojaarsalaris van €55.000 tot €75.000 inclusief vakantiegeld op basis van 40 uur per week, afhankelijk van je ervaring. Daarnaast 25 vakantiedagen, een flexibele regeling voor thuis en op kantoor werken, een goede pensioenregeling en reiskostenvergoeding (NS Business Card of kilometervergoeding). De werksfeer? Ontspannen, met gratis lunch, bootcamp op donderdag, vrijdagmiddagborrels en kwartaal-BBQ's. Hoe werken we samen? De eerste 3 maanden verwachten we een hogere aanwezigheid op kantoor in Zoetermeer. Logisch: je wilt het team, het product en de klant snel doorgronden, en dat gaat nu eenmaal sneller als je er bent. Na je onboarding werken we meer hybride. Woon je op maximaal anderhalf uur reisafstand? Dan verwachten we je minimaal één keer per week op kantoor, op dinsdag of donderdag. In de praktijk gaan we hier flexibel mee om zodra het vertrouwen er is. Woon je dichterbij of heb je geen probleem met wat meer reistijd? Elke dag op kantoor is natuurlijk ook gewoon mogelijk. Daarnaast is er de hub in Amsterdam waar je terecht kunt. Waarom Shiftbase? Je verkoopt geen vaag platform dat niemand begrijpt. Shiftbase is marktleider in Nederland en groeit hard in Duitsland. Een product dat 10.000+ bedrijven dagelijks gebruiken omdat het hun werk simpelweg makkelijker maakt. Dat merk je in elk salesgesprek: klanten snappen de waarde, de use case is herkenbaar en de feedback is positief. Tegelijkertijd zijn we geen logge olietanker. Met 85+ collega's ben je geen nummer, want wat jij doet heeft directe impact op de koers van het bedrijf. Maar we zijn wél groot en stabiel genoeg om je een serieuze carrière te bieden. Geen start-up-roulette, maar een bewezen business met internationale groeiambities waar jij onderdeel van wordt. Interesse? We're looking for someone genuinely channel agnostic: you don't wake up thinking about Google Ads or SEO; you wake up thinking about where the next valuable Talk360 user is. What you’ll do Own the acquisition portfolio: Continuously evaluate and reallocate investment across paid channels (Google Ads, Apple Search Ads, Meta, TikTok) and organic channels (SEO, ASO, content), based on where the next euro or hour of effort returns the most. Run segment-led acquisition: Adapt proposition, creative, keywords, landing pages, and app store presence for our three core segments, Calling Home, Calling for Work, and Calling When It Counts, and learn which segment performs best in which channel, market, and corridor. Connect acquisition to LTV: Track performance past the click or install, through registration, first purchase, calling behaviour, and retention, so decisions get made on CAC and LTV together, not platform ROAS alone. Build our AI discovery presence: Develop Talk360's approach to discovery as more of our future users start their search inside AI tools instead of Google. Run a continuous experimentation pipeline: Turn acquisition hypotheses (a new high-intent search category, a different proposition, an underserved corridor, a new distribution channel) into small, fast tests, and turn the results into investment decisions. No big silos or layers of approval: You’ll work directly with product, data and creative to turn an insight into a live experiment quickly. What you’ll bring Strong experience running paid acquisition on Google Ads, Meta, and/or Apple Search Ads, with real budget ownership and results to show for it. Working knowledge of SEO and ASO, and a track record of building organic acquisition that compounds rather than resetting every quarter. Fluency in CAC, ROAS, conversion, ARPU, and LTV, and the ability to build one framework that lets you compare channels that have never been compared before. Comfort moving between data, creative, content, and technology to shorten the distance between an idea and a live experiment. Active, current use of AI in your own marketing workflow, for research, analysis, content variation, and speeding up execution, not just openness to using it. Who you are Channel agnostic and opportunity driven, you're motivated by finding the next valuable user, not by defending a particular channel or discipline. Comfortable moving investment away from something that isn't working anymore, even if you're the one who built it. Genuinely curious about how AI is reshaping search and discovery and energised by figuring out a playbook that doesn't exist yet rather than waiting for one. Analytical: You can find the meaningful signal inside a pile of noisy performance data and act on it. Understand the limits of attribution and don't let an imperfect model stop you from making a call. About Talk360 Talk360 was founded with a clear purpose: to become the most accessible and reliable calling app for African diaspora communities, both within Africa and abroad. For our users, calls are not transactional, they are emotional lifelines to family, friends, and essential support networks. When service quality drops, they feel it immediately. That responsibility drives everything we build. Over the past years, Talk360 has grown into a global communications platform connecting more than 6 million people worldwide last year. We successfully spun off our payments arm into NjiaPay, stepped into the gap left by the discontinuation of Skype, and achieved profitable growth from 2025 onwards, marking our transition from early-stage scale-up to a disciplined, sustainable business. title: Lead Analytics Engineer
description: Do you love turning messy business questions into data people can trust? Can you connect the customer journey from the first marketing touch through sales conversion, revenue, retention, and product usage and explain the numbers equally clearly to an engineer, a CMO, and a CFO? AIHR is looking for a Lead Agentic Analytics Engineer to become the hands-on functional lead of our two-person Data & Analytics team. You will own the translation of cross-functional business questions into trusted metrics, governed semantic models, and decision-ready agentic analytics; set the analytical direction; and build the most critical models yourself. You are transforming raw data into governed products that drive decision-making for our business partners. About AIHR Founded in 2016 with the mission to future-proof HR, the Academy to Innovate HR (AIHR) has become the global market leader in online training for HR professionals. We support customers in more than 140 countries, including organizations such as Unilever, Reckitt, Goldman Sachs, Philips, Deloitte, Nike, Heineken, and UBS. Our goal is to continuously upskill and empower one million HR professionals. Today, we are an international team of more than 100 people representing over 30 nationalities. We are driven by excellence, innovation, and a hunger to grow, while staying friendly, enthusiastic, and committed to helping each other succeed. Working at AIHR means taking real responsibility, improving how we operate, and getting the freedom to develop in new areas and shape your role as the company grows. Role and Responsibilities AIHR's Data & Analytics team is part of Business Operations. You will work alongside Vahid, our Senior Data Engineer, and report to Leo, our VP of Business Operations. Our ingestion and warehouse foundation is largely established: data from systems such as HubSpot and our own LMS moves through ETL pipelines into Snowflake. Through special Projects, we are building governed semantic layers on top so the business can self-serve trusted analytics through Power BI, Metabase, and AI tools. Your role owns the step that matters most: translating a business question into a clear definition, a well-designed model, and conversational/agentic analytics that your leadership trusts. You will set the analytical architecture, dbt standards, and roadmap, while Vahid focuses on ingestion, warehouse reliability, and engineering implementation. You will both build: you will personally deliver the most critical business models, review implementations, and ensure the outputs are usable by the business. This role has no direct reports. Your colleague, Vahid, remains managed by the VP of Business Operations, while you have clear functional decision rights over metric definitions, semantic-model design, analytical quality, dbt standards, and technical priorities. It is designed for someone who wants to lead through expertise while remaining close to the work. What You'll Own Own and execute a rolling one-year Data & Analytics roadmap, balancing urgent business needs with foundational work. Guide Vahid through clear priorities, design reviews, code review, and reusable modeling patterns. Lead discovery across Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, Product, and Finance to uncover the decision behind a request and translate it into agreed metric definitions, governed semantic layers, and data models that connect the full customer lifecycle. Set the analytical architecture and dbt standards; design, build, test, and document the most critical governed models yourself using SQL and dbt. Own the full-funnel measurement framework—from marketing reach, demand generation, attribution, and customer acquisition cost through lead and pipeline conversion, sales cycle, bookings, and revenue to onboarding, product adoption, expansion, renewal, churn, and customer lifetime value. Keep core recurring-revenue definitions finance-grade and reconciled while showing how upstream activity drives downstream customer outcomes. Own the logic and quality behind executive dashboards and self-service analytics across Power BI, Metabase, and AI-enabled interfaces. Present the results to senior leaders, explain every assumption, and respond constructively to challenge. Partner closely with Vahid on warehouse and pipeline requirements, resolve conflicting numbers at the source, and raise the technical quality of the team. Apply AI where it improves development speed or data access, while using sound judgment around privacy, governance, validation, and trust. A Typical Week This is a hands-on lead role. The exact balance will shift with business priorities, but you should expect roughly half your time to remain close to the data—building, reviewing, and investigating—and the rest to be split across discovery, functional leadership, and decision support. Design or improve a dbt model that connects data across HubSpot, our LMS, billing, or other source systems; write the SQL, tests, documentation, and metric logic needed to put it into production. Run discovery sessions with leaders in Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, Product, or Finance to clarify the decision they need to make, challenge the requested metric, and agree on the definition. Work side by side with Vahid on source-data requirements, architecture choices, and implementation; review code and unblock delivery without handing off all of the technical work. Investigate a commercial or customer-lifecycle question, improve an executive or functional dashboard, and present the conclusion—including assumptions and limitations—to the relevant leadership team. Reprioritize the Data & Analytics roadmap, resolve competing requests, and invest in the semantic layer, governance, and reusable modeling foundations that reduce future ad hoc work. What Success Looks Like Within your first three months, you have established a clear operating model with Vahid, mapped ownership of the most important metrics, agreed the Data & Analytics roadmap, and resolved at least one material conflicting-number problem. Within six months, AIHR has a governed customer-lifecycle domain in dbt and an executive view connecting acquisition and pipeline to revenue, retention, and product usage, and has launched the first MVP of our agentic analytics platform to drive self-serve adoption. The underlying definitions are documented, reconciled where relevant, and trusted across Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, Product, and Finance. Within twelve months, two or three priority business domains are governed end to end, leadership can trace performance from acquisition through lifetime value using consistent numbers, self-service adoption is growing, and Vahid can independently implement the modeling patterns and quality standards you established. Throughout, you remain hands-on in SQL, dbt, Snowflake, and analytics while setting direction, coaching through the work, and earning leadership's trust in both the numbers and the roadmap. We offer A high-impact role as the functional lead of a small Data & Analytics team, with end-to-end ownership of the semantic layer behind company-wide decisions. Competitive, benchmarked compensation. Substantial autonomy to shape your day-to-day work, with regular growth conversations and support for your career goals. Flexible working hours and work-from-home arrangements after onboarding. 26 paid holidays per year, plus one extra day for each of your first five years at AIHR. The option to exchange any two public holidays for two days of your choice. A work-from-anywhere policy that lets you work abroad for up to 20 days per calendar year. A pension plan, four Trust Days for ad hoc recovery, and access to the OpenUp mental health platform. A personal development budget, training opportunities, and the books you need to keep learning. All public-transport expenses covered through an NS Business Card, plus a MacBook and the equipment you need. A beautiful office opposite Rotterdam Central Station, a satellite office in Amsterdam, daily chef-prepared lunch, regular drinks, team activities, and free access to the office gym. Get a taste of working at AIHR in our AIHR Benefits Guide . Apply for the Job Are you excited to become our Lead Analytics Engineer? We would love to hear from you. We are aiming for a start date in December 2026 or January 2027. P.S. If this role excites you but you do not meet every point, we still encourage you to apply. We care about the evidence behind your experience and your potential to grow—not a perfect checklist. Who you are You are a hands-on technical leader: commercially sharp, calm under challenge, and confident enough to defend your numbers in any room. You also have the patience to build data foundations properly and raise the quality of the work around you. You bring 5+ years of experience across analytics engineering, BI, data engineering, or business-facing analytics roles, including substantial recent hands-on analytics engineering and evidence of leading work beyond your own delivery. You have a proven track record of building semantic layers or governed dimensional models end-to-end—from business discovery and metric definition to production models and adoption—not only dashboards. You have expert SQL and data modeling skills, strong production experience with dbt, and hands-on experience with Snowflake or a comparable warehouse, along with a BI tool such as Power BI, Looker, Omni, or Metabase. You bring strong financial acumen, but your analytical experience extends across the full customer lifecycle. You can connect marketing acquisition and attribution, sales pipeline and conversion, revenue and unit economics, customer retention and expansion, and product adoption into one coherent model. You also look at the process behind the work — reducing overdue balances, improving follow-up, and finding ways to make order-to-cash more effective over time. Working AI-first. You actively use AI and automation where they can make the work more efficient or improve the quality of the outcome. That might mean analyzing patterns in Sales data, speeding up vendor registration, improving a recurring workflow, or removing repetitive administrative work. As part of RevOps, you are expected to try new approaches, keep what works, and share useful ways of working with the wider team. Connecting the dots across teams. Many commercial processes cross Sales, Finance, Customer Experience, Marketing, Operations, and other parts of the business. You help create clarity around ownership, bring the right people together, and make sure decisions turn into action. You’ll work with tools including HubSpot, Gong, Atlassian, QuotaPath, Zapier, Google Workspace , and a growing set of AI tools and internal AI workflows. We do not expect you to arrive as an expert in every system. We do expect you to be comfortable learning how they fit together and questioning whether we are using them in the best way. During the RevOps stand-up with the RevOps team, you talk through priorities. An Account Executive is working on an enterprise opportunity where the customer's procurement team needs AIHR registered as a vendor. Several invoices need follow-up. You have also noticed a group of deals spending longer than expected in one stage of the pipeline. The vendor registration comes first. You use one of our existing AI workflows to help complete the documentation, gather any missing information internally, and get the process moving. While doing that, you notice that part of the information the workflow relies on is out of date. Rather than working around it, you fix the source and make sure the next registration is easier. The answer may not be “Sales needs to update HubSpot more.” You look at why the information is not being captured in the first place and whether the workflow can be made easier for reps while still giving Marketing and leadership the information they need. Her clients keep running into the same problem: the new system goes live, and the HR team lacks the skills to get the most out of it. Next you work on an enablement session for consultants, covering what they need to know about our courses, how they bring AIHR into a client conversation, what a first joint win could look like, and you brief Marketing on the materials their consultants will need. title: Data Engineer
description: De wereld om ons heen verandert razendsnel. Wat vandaag nieuw is, kan morgen alweer achterhaald zijn. Bij PuurData krijg je de kans om samen met collega’s te werken aan slimme oplossingen voor onze klanten. Zo kun je bijvoorbeeld bedrijven helpen met het inzichtelijk maken van hun data of meedenken over hoe ze veiliger met hun data om kunnen gaan. Je helpt onze klanten vooruit door ze mee te nemen in nieuwe technologieën en te laten zien waar bijvoorbeeld AI daadwerkelijk waarde toevoegt. Op deze manier kun je zowel kleine, maar ook grote en veeleisende bedrijven helpen met oplossingen die kritisch zijn voor hun bedrijfsvoering. Tenslotte zorgen wij er samen voor dat jij continu blijft groeien en op de hoogte bent van de nieuwste ontwikkelingen. Wat ga je doen? Als Data Engineer bij PuurData ben je meer dan een technicus. Je bent een consultant die klanten helpt om meer waarde uit hun data te halen. PuurData werkt met platformen zoals Elastic en AWS, en bedient klanten op het gebied van zoektechnologie, observability, security en AI. Jij bent degene die die oplossingen tot leven brengt. Je start bij de klant. Je inventariseert de vraag: wat willen ze met hun data? Gaat het om betere zoekfunctionaliteit, real-time inzicht in systemen, of security en threat detection? Klanten weten vaak dat er iets niet klopt. Data is traag, er is geen inzicht, of er zijn performance problemen. Maar ze weten niet altijd hoe ze het moeten oplossen. Jij helpt dat helder te maken. Vervolgens ga je samen met de klant naar de juiste oplossing toe. Je vertaalt de behoefte naar een concrete aanpak en implementeert die van A tot Z: van het inrichten van de datastroom tot het opleveren van dashboards en inzichten. Geen dag is hetzelfde. De use cases lopen uiteen van zoekoplossingen en business process monitoring tot SIEM-implementaties en data engineering-pipelines. Dat geeft je veel vrijheid in de invulling van je werk. Continu leren is geen optie, maar de norm Technologie staat niet stil, en jij ook niet. Bij PuurData is training verplicht. Je blijft op de hoogte van de laatste ontwikkelingen, denk aan Elastic, AI-integraties en nieuwe dataplatformen, en past die kennis direct toe in klantprojecten. Wie ben jij? Je bent een ondernemende professional die weinig sturing nodig heeft. Je denkt vanuit de eindgebruiker en streeft naar maximale klanttevredenheid zonder kwaliteit en veiligheid uit het oog te verliezen. Dankzij jouw analytisch vermogen zie je snel de kern van een probleem en kom je met creatieve, structurele oplo ssingen. title: wo-stage economie: Nowcasting Model voor BBP
description: wo- praktijkstage, start in overleg Krijg jij energie van het bouwen van slimme datamodellen die economische groei voorspellen nog voordat alle cijfers binnen zijn? Duik jij graag in data, ontdek je nieuwe databronnen en wil je met jouw analyses échte impact maken op officiële bbp-ramingen? Dan is deze stage in nowcasting en econometrie precies wat je zoekt. Dit is jouw uitdaging Bij het ramen van de kwartaalcijfers van het bbp (economische groei) gebruiken we voor een aantal bedrijfstakken momenteel een relatief eenvoudige methode: de ontwikkeling van het aantal banen dient als benadering voor de economische activiteit. Dit gebeurt omdat directe en tijdige broninformatie ontbreekt. Een belangrijk gevolg hiervan is dat we de eerste ramingen later vaak moeten bijstellen wanneer er meer volledige data beschikbaar komt bij de definitieve raming (ongeveer anderhalf jaar later). Het is aan jou om deze methodiek te verbeteren. Je gaat een geavanceerder model ontwikkelen waarmee we de economische activiteit van deze bedrijfstakken kort na afloop van de verslagperiode nauwkeuriger kunnen inschatten. Dit wordt ook wel “nowcasting” genoemd. Het doel is om dichter bij de uiteindelijke realisatie te zitten en daarmee het aantal en de omvang van latere bijstellingen te verkleinen. Een belangrijk onderdeel van jouw opdracht is om te onderzoeken welke databronnen tijdig beschikbaar zijn en we kunnen gebruiken als input voor dit model. Vervolgens ga je met behulp van historische data eerdere verslagperiodes simuleren. Zo kun je analyseren of jouw voorgestelde methode daadwerkelijk beter presteert dan de huidige aanpak, bijvoorbeeld door te kijken naar kleinere bijstellingen. Tot slot ontwikkel je een werkende productiestraat in R, zodat de nieuwe methode praktisch toepasbaar wordt binnen het ramingproces. Dit is jouw stageplek, bij CBS Den Haag We verwelkomen je binnen de sector Nationale Rekeningen, bij het team Aanbod- en gebruiktabellen, dat bestaat uit ruim 25 mensen. Het team maakt de kwartaal- en jaarramingen van het bruto binnenlands product (bbp), en de economische groei. We zijn gedreven onderzoekers en producenten van cruciale informatie, waaronder de economische groei, en continu op zoek naar verbeteringen. De nationale rekeningen vormen de officiële overzichtsstatistiek van de nationale economie. Het nationaal inkomen, de economische groei, het overheidstekort en het beschikbaar inkomen van huishoudens zijn enkele belangrijke macro-economische indicatoren die aan de hand van de nationale rekeningen worden vastgesteld. Binnen ons team heerst een open, betrokken en collegiale sfeer. Twee ervaren teamleden zullen je begeleiden bij deze stageopdracht. Dit breng jij mee Je volgt een economische wo-opleiding met een duidelijke kwantitatieve component. Je hebt kennis van – en bij voorkeur al enige ervaring met – softwareontwikkeling en programmeren in R. Je werkt nauwkeurig en gestructureerd, zowel met data als met code en documentatie. Je bent analytisch sterk en weet complexe vraagstukken te doorgronden en data kritisch te interpreteren. Je denkt proactief mee over het verbeteren van bestaande methoden en staat open voor het verkennen van nieuwe ideeën en technieken. Je neemt verantwoordelijkheid voor je eigen werk: je plant, organiseert en bewaakt je voortgang gedurende de stage. Omdat tijdens de stage alle communicatie – zowel mondeling als schriftelijk – in het Nederlands plaatsvindt, is een goede beheersing van de Nederlandse taal noodzakelijk. Dit kun je van ons verwachten Een fijne leeromgeving waarin je: Jouw programmeer- en analysevaardigheden inzet in een praktijkgerichte omgeving; Jouw vakkennis vergroot door samen te werken met ervaren collega's; Jouw kennis over econometrische en statistische modellen o.b.v. economische indicatoren in de praktijk gaat toepassen; Waardevolle werkervaring opdoet voor een toekomstige carrière in data analyse of onderzoek. Voor jouw inzet ontvang je een stagevergoeding van € 800,- bruto per maand (op basis van 40 uur per week). Daarnaast is het vaak verstandig om überhaupt niet voor te veel achtergrondkenmerken te corrigeren, omdat dit een negatieve invloed heeft op de marges van de schattingen voor de doelvariabelen van een onderzoek. Ook is er een relatie met de doelvariabelen in het onderzoek: op het moment dat er een samenhang is tussen een achtergrondkenmerk en de doelvariabelen van een onderzoek, is het wenselijk om wél voor dat achtergrondkenmerk te corrigeren als dat kenmerk scheef in de respons zit. Het is daarom vaak verstandig om toch zo veel mogelijk te corrigeren voor scheefheid in achtergrondkenmerken. Het CBS heeft een reguliere werkwijze voor het opstellen en uitvoeren van wegingen voor reguliere onderzoeken. Een optie die nog niet wordt gebruikt, maar wel interessant lijkt, is het uitvoeren van een zogenaamde voorweging. Hierbij wordt de weging min of meer in twee stappen uitgevoerd, waardoor er mogelijk voor meer en/of andere achtergrondkenmerken gecorrigeerd kan worden. Wellicht is het mogelijk om eerst een correctie uit te voeren voor non-respons en vervolgens een verdere weging uit te voeren die meer focust op de doelvariabelen van het onderzoek en de achtergrondkenmerken die daarmee correleren. Dit soort vragen speelt zowel bij de reguliere steekproeven die bij het CBS worden uitgevoerd als bij potentiële nieuwe toepassingen. Afhankelijk van de resultaten zouden weegmethoden aangepast kunnen worden, met directe impact op de statistieken van het CBS. title: Software Engineer gebouwautomatisering
description: Software Engineer Gebouwautomatisering (Niagara N4) Voor deze functie zijn wij op zoek naar een Software Engineer Gebouwautomatisering die techniek, software en innovatie op een natuurlijke manier weet te verbinden. Jij krijgt energie van het ontwikkelen van intelligente gebouwsoftware, het optimaliseren van systemen en het samenwerken met collega’s en klanten. Samen werken jullie aan kwalitatief hoogwaardige projecten én een inspirerende werkomgeving. Wat bieden wij jou? Als Software Engineer Gebouwautomatisering kom je terecht in een prettige werkomgeving met betrokken collega’s, waar samenwerken en werkplezier centraal staan. Daarnaast mag je rekenen op: Een uitdagende functie waarin softwareontwikkeling, techniek en gebouwautomatisering samenkomen; Werken binnen een professionele organisatie met korte communicatielijnen en een sterke focus op vakmanschap; Mogelijkheden om je verder te specialiseren in Niagara N4, integraties, visualisaties en automatisering; Vakgerichte opleidingen en cursussen, volledig gefaciliteerd door Building Technology; Een werkomgeving waarin jouw technische kennis, talent en creativiteit worden gewaardeerd en actief gestimuleerd. Wat ga je doen? Als Software Engineer Gebouwautomatisering bij BUILDING technology ben je verantwoordelijk voor het ontwikkelen, programmeren en testen van regeltechnische software en visualisaties voor onze gebouwautomatiseringsprojecten. Je werkt intensief samen met projectleiders, field service engineers en in sommige gevallen direct met klanten om systemen optimaal te laten functioneren. Deze rol biedt bovendien volop ruimte om je technische expertise verder te verdiepen en innovatieve softwareoplossingen te realiseren voor onze klanten. Concreet bestaan jouw werkzaamheden uit: Ontwikkelen en produceren van programmatuur met behulp van beschikbare engineeringtools; Opbouwen van softwareapplicaties op basis van regeltechnische omschrijvingen, in nauwe samenwerking met projectleiders en/of klanten; Ontwikkelen van standaard- en procesgerichte regelstrategieën voor gebouwgebonden installaties; Integreren van gebouwgebonden installaties (HVAC, WKO, verlichting, energie); Ontwerpen en configureren van Niagara N4-stations en -architecturen; Ontwerpen en realiseren van dashboards, webapplicaties en HTML5-gebaseerde visualisaties; Implementeren van communicatieprotocollen zoals BACnet, Modbus, DALI en KNX; Ontwikkelen van klantspecifieke softwareoplossingen; Softwaretechnische ondersteuning bieden aan projectleiders en field service engineers; Actief volgen van technische marktontwikkelingen en nieuwe procestechnologieën. Wat breng jij mee? Je bent een enthousiaste en technisch onderlegde professional met een sterke affiniteit voor software en gebouwautomatisering. Daarnaast beschik je over: Afgeronde technische MBO (niveau 4) of hbo-opleiding. Bij voorkeur technische informatica, Meet- en Regeltechniek of gebouwgebonden installaties; Kennis van het Tridium Niagara N4 framework; Aantoonbare ervaring met Niagara N4 in projecten is een pré (certificering zoals TCP, Advanced, Integration of Specialist is een plus); Kennis van HVAC-systemen en gebouwbeheerprocessen; Basiskennis van netwerken (IP, VLAN, VPN en cybersecurity); Ervaring met programmeren van GBS- en DDC-systemen, waaronder Javascript, SQL, XML en/of JSON; Analytisch denkvermogen en ervaring met het ontwerpen en implementeren van complexe integraties; Stressbestendigheid, bijvoorbeeld tijdens commissioning en live situaties; Sterke communicatieve vaardigheden, verantwoordelijkheidsgevoel en het vermogen om zowel zelfstandig als in teamverband te werken; Een leergierige en praktische instelling. Waar ga je het doen? BUILDING technology is een gespecialiseerd en professioneel technisch bedrijf dat gebouwen slimmer, energiezuiniger en gebruiksvriendelijker maakt. Binnen onze organisatie staat een cultuur van vakmanschap, betrouwbaarheid en samenwerking centraal. Korte lijnen, inhoudelijke technische discussies en verantwoordelijkheid nemen: dát kenmerkt ons als organisatie. Wij maken deel uit van de VDK Installatiegroep, waardoor de voordelen van een grote organisatie worden gecombineerd met de flexibiliteit en dynamiek van een zelfstandig bedrijf. VDK Installatiegroep, de razendsnel groeiende Topwerkgever van Nederland BUILDING technology is onderdeel van de VDK Installatiegroep (110 bedrijven, 5.500 medewerkers) en is uitgeroepen tot Topwerkgever van Nederland. Als Software Engineer Gebouwautomatisering profiteer je van uitgebreide opleidingsmogelijkheden, aantrekkelijke arbeidsvoorwaarden en een stabiele basis. Tegelijkertijd werk je binnen een zelfstandige organisatie waar vrijheid, ondernemerschap en betrokkenheid centraal staan. Zo brengen we het beste van twee werelden samen. title: Scios scope 8 en/of 10 Inspecteur
description: Werk zelfstandig aan veilige en betrouwbare elektrotechnische installaties bij EPM Bij EPM bouwen we aan de toekomst van elektrotechniek. Jij krijgt energie van het ontwikkelen, programmeren en inbedrijfstellen van software voor gebouwbeheersystemen. Met jouw kennis van regeltechniek zorg je ervoor dat installaties juist functioneren én voldoen aan de wensen van de klant. Wat bieden wij jou? Daarnaast bieden wij jou: • Een zelfstandige en afwisselende functie waarin je softwareontwikkeling, inbedrijfstelling en klantcontact combineert; • Werken binnen een professionele organisatie met korte communicatielijnen en een sterke focus op vakmanschap; • Ruimte en mogelijkheden om je verder te ontwikkelen binnen jouw vakgebied; • Opleidingen en cursussen, volledig verzorgd door V en M Regeltechniek; • Een werkomgeving waarin jouw technische expertise wordt gewaardeerd en waar je langdurige klantrelaties kunt opbouwen; • Een prima salaris op basis van kennis en ervaring; • 25 vakantiedagen + 13 ADV-dagen (bij een fulltime werkweek); • Een goede pensioenregeling. Je ontwikkelt, test en implementeert programmeeroplossingen en brengt deze in bedrijf bij de klant. Je vertaalt regeltechnische omschrijvingen naar software- en besturingsprogramma’s, test deze uitvoerig en zorgt dat ze voldoen aan de functionele eisen. Je bent betrokken bij zowel de ontwikkeling als de inbedrijfstelling en levert service, op afstand én op locatie. Concreet houd je je bezig met: Het programmeren van complexe installaties en systemen; Het zelfstandig inbedrijfstellen van regeltechnische installaties en gebouwbeheersystemen; Serviceverlening aan klanten zowel op afstand als op locatie; Het uitvoeren van functionele testen en kwaliteitscontroles; Het vastleggen van jouw oplossingen en bevindingen in duidelijke documentatie; Het meedenken over verbeteringen en efficiëntieverbeterende oplossingen binnen systemen. Daarnaast beschik je over: Een afgeronde mbo- of hbo-opleiding in een technische richting; Aantoonbare ervaring met softwareontwikkeling en inbedrijfstelling van HVAC/regeltechnische systemen; Ervaring met Priva-systemen is een pré; Kennis van procesinstallaties is een pré; Affiniteit met regeltechniek en automatisering; Goede communicatieve vaardigheden zowel intern als extern; Een positieve instelling en flexibiliteit om snel te kunnen schakelen. Waar ga je het doen? V&M Regeltechniek is een vooruitstrevend en dynamisch bedrijf binnen de gebouwautomatisering. Wij leveren slimme en innovatieve regeltechniekoplossingen voor gebouwen en technische installaties, van ontwerp en realisatie tot beheer en onderhoud. Onze projecten bevinden zich onder andere in ziekenhuizen, kantoorgebouwen, datacenters en universiteiten, waar comfort, veiligheid en energie-efficiëntie centraal staan. Binnen V&M werken we met korte lijnen, een platte organisatiestructuur en een hands-on mentaliteit. Kantoor, werkplaats en magazijn bevinden zich op één locatie, wat zorgt voor snelle afstemming en een prettige samenwerking. Successen vieren we samen en er is volop ruimte voor eigen initiatief en verantwoordelijkheid. description: Ben jij een leergierige mbo-verpleegkunde student die stevig in zijn of haar schoenen staat en graag werkt met mensen met complexe psychiatrische problematiek? Dan zijn wij op zoek naar jou! Binnen onze GGZ-organisatie bieden wij diverse stageplaatsen aan voor studenten MBO Verpleegkunde in de regio Amsterdam, Amstelveen, Haarlem en Bennebroek. Voor welke studenten? Wij bieden stageplaatsen aan voor studenten van alle leerjaren van de opleiding MBO-Verpleegkunde. De omvang van de stages varieert, afhankelijk van de opleidingseisen, van 16 tot 32 uur per week. Onze afdelingen Het aanbod aan stageplaatsen bevindt zich binnen de klinische zorg. Wij bieden zorg aan: Volwassenen (18 tot 65 jaar); Ouderen (65+); Daarnaast kun je ervaring opdoen binnen zowel: Open afdelingen; Gesloten afdelingen. Wie zoeken wij? Wij zoeken studenten die: Leergierig en nieuwsgierig zijn; Zelfstandig kunnen werken; Communicatief sterk zijn; Stevig in hun schoenen staan; Een uitdaging niet uit de weg gaan; Affiniteit hebben met de geestelijke gezondheidszorg. Interesse? De meeste stageplaatsen starten in februari of september. Samen kijken we naar jouw leerjaar, leerdoelen en interesses om een passende stageplek te vinden. Wij ontvangen graag jouw sollicitatie en denken met je mee over een geschikte stageplaats binnen onze organisatie. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

Een afgeronde hbo-opleiding in de richting van financiële administratie, finance & control of vergelijkbaar. Ervaring met debiteurenadministratie en projectadministratie. Bij voorkeur ervaring met de financiële administratie en verantwoording van subsidieprojecten en samenwerkingsprojecten. Kennis van financiële verslaglegging en het controleren van financiële gegevens. Een nauwkeurige en analytische werkwijze, met oog voor detail en deadlines. Het vermogen om zelfstandig financiële afwijkingen te onderzoeken en op te lossen. Goede communicatieve vaardigheden en een servicegerichte instelling. Een proactieve houding en de drive om financiële processen continu te verbeteren. Ook belangrijk Je komt in het team Financiële Administratie op de Overschiestraat in Amsterdam. Een afgeronde HBO-opleiding richting financiële administratie is vereist. De functie is ingeschaald in FWG45 conform CAO GGZ. title: Senior PHP/Go Developer
description: In today’s world, cybersecurity is an integral part of everyday life. Companies need to be prepared for anything; at any moment a threatening situation can arise. Together with your colleagues (currently 8 developers and testers), you build small projects in containers. Those projects together form the software solution on which ON2IT’s entire business runs. We mainly use PHP and Go, but it doesn’t actually matter which language you use. As long as it works and is simple. Keep it simple, fail fast. And we have hefty demands of our own work quality, so we have CI and CD fully set up. Code styling is automatically checked and corrected, security checks are performed and of course our unit tests and functional tests (Cypress and Codeception) run before we roll out. You put your changes into production yourself after a code review and functional test. What you tell others you’re doing: I build software that keeps our customers from getting hacked. Cybersecurity, yes, something with computers. No, that doesn’t mean I can fix your printer. What will your work week look like: As expected, you will mostly be writing code, which you will be doing from home and, at least 2 days a week, from our Zaltbommel office. We start the day with a (remote) stand up. There, we discuss the progress of the work. Do you need help? There are always colleagues ready to help you. The work consists of fixing bugs and implementing small feature requests or new projects. We record all these things in Gitlab. Sometime around noon, we have lunch together (unless you work from home of course) in our cozy canteen. Everything is completely taken care of; we just ask you to put away your plate in the dishwasher after. Every two weeks, we have a general team meeting and we do a retrospective as a team, that way we keep improving. Is this you? You have excellent knowledge of PHP, Go, Java, Python or a similar language; You have a completed IT degree or you have demonstrable college level of thinking and working; In your code, you don’t risk an XSS exploit. Never. What do we offer you? We offer ample opportunity to continue to develop yourself by aiding you in furthering your education and encouraging you to follow training courses. A varied and well catered lunch will be available at the office every afternoon. You will also receive: 24 vacation days, with the possibility to buy extra Mobility allowance Opportunities to work from home Advancement opportunities Unlimited learning: access to training and education What does our job application procedure look like? title: Traineeship Cybersecurity
description: Have you ever thought about working in one of the fastest growing industries in the world? You may have, but what if you don’t have qualifications? For ON2IT, it doesn’t matter. We hire our people on intrinsic motivation for cybersecurity. We're looking for people who are genuinely driven to make the digital world safer. People who are curious about how a digital network works (and how they can be improved), who think like a hacker, and who won’t stop until they’ve figured things out. We will help you become the top 10%. How do we do this? Get ready for our Cybersecurity Traineeship. What to expect: Our traineeship is a training program, where you will start working in our SOC. We have experts in our SOC who will support you in learning and obtaining various certificates. Cases enter our SOC via our own eventflow. Our SOC Specialists investigate these cases to protect the environment of our customers. You will learn how to recognize and detect threats and how to protect and guide our customers. We will guide you with various trainings. This does not only include technical trainings. As customer contact is an important aspect of the role, we also offer trainings focused on improving your soft-skills. The duration: 1 year The working hours: Our SOC works in shifts to ensure 24/7 security for our customers. This means you’ll work in rotating shifts: - Two morning shifts ( 06:00 - 14:30 ) - Two afternoon shifts ( 14:00 - 22:30 ) - Two night shifts ( 22:00 - 06:30 ) - Followed by 4 days off What do we offer you? Besides an entry opportunity to become an expert SOC Engineer, we offer you a total starting package of € 3.750,00 . Depending on the obtained certifications, this can be increased by € 400,00 within the first year. What distinguishes our traineeship from a regular position? Our traineeship is designed for people who want to become the top 10% in Cybersecurity. This means that your development is our top priority. We have an unlimited development budget and you'll be surrounded by top experts in cybersecurity who are eager to share their knowledge. Are there any prerequisites? You hold an European passport to pass the security screening and you have a driver’s license and the possession of a car (because public transport isn’t sufficient for the shift times). Can I study for CCNA while applying? Yes. You don’t have to have your CCNA-certificate at the moment you apply. But you have to obtain it before you start in the traineeship. What kind of person thrives in this traineeship? People who are: Naturally curious Calm under pressure Communicating clearly Motivated to continuously learn Comfortable with dynamic environments and working in shifts What’s after the traineeship? You’ve finished the traineeship and wrapped up the first year. What’s next? There’s a wide variety of paths you could choose. Think of certifications in: Cloud Security Networking End point protection Threat Intelligence Most importantly: there’s no cap on your development. We would like to see you become the top 10%. Practical criteria summary In summary. To be able to join our SOC, you have to tick off the following boxes: You hold a CCNA-certification You hold a European passport to pass the security screening You have a driver’s license and the possession of a car (because public transport isn’t sufficient for the shift times) Your home address is located within a 50-minute drive from our office in Zaltbommel You are open to work in 24/7 shifts Want to become the top 10%? About the role As a Forward Deployed AI Engineer, you start by understanding the customer’s business: how people work, what they’re trying to achieve, and where they get stuck. You work alongside them to turn that understanding into AI workflows and agents that make a meaningful difference. You stay involved from technical presales through implementation and daily use. Customer environments can be complex, from on-premise ERPs to undocumented processes. You enjoy thinking on your feet, testing ideas, and working through business and technical challenges together. You’ll join our FDE team, working closely with sales, project managers, and product engineering. Success means building something people trust, use, and benefit from. What you will do Understand the customer: Work with end users and decision-makers to understand their processes, exceptions, and priorities. Help identify what’s worth solving and what a useful outcome looks like. Technical presales: Help sales shape solutions, assess feasibility, and uncover dependencies. Build focused demos or experiments to explore possibilities with customers. Build workflows and agents: Combine prompts, tools, data, and business logic on Lleverage to handle real customer tasks, with human review where needed. Solve integration challenges: Connect solutions to customer systems, including on-premise ERPs. Work with customer IT teams to investigate interfaces, troubleshoot issues, and write custom code. Find practical alternatives when the first approach doesn’t work, and support fellow FDEs with integration challenges. Improve what you ship: Evaluate solutions against real scenarios, improve reliability and quality, and bring customer insights back to our product and engineering teams. What you bring Customer empathy and curiosity: You listen carefully, question assumptions, and care about how people work. You build trust and translate between business needs and technical possibilities. Applied AI experience: You’ve built LLM-powered workflows, agents, or applications and understand prompts, context, tool use, and evaluation. You can judge where AI adds value and where straightforward logic works better. Practical engineering skills: You’re comfortable with APIs, authentication, data transformations, and coding in a language such as TypeScript or Python. You can investigate unfamiliar systems and troubleshoot complex integrations. Resourcefulness and ownership: You break down unclear problems, test ideas, and adapt as you learn. You take responsibility for delivery, balancing creative solutions with reliability and knowing when to bring in help. Nice to haves Experience in technical presales or a customer-facing engineering role. Experience integrating ERP systems, on-premise software, or other complex business systems. Familiarity with low-code/no-code platforms. A carry-on ice cream bar. It’s becoming our thing. We offer A salary of €65,000–€85,000 and a share package. Hands-on work solving real business problems with AI. An experienced, collaborative team working together in Amsterdam. The opportunity to shape our platform and how our FDE team works. . title: Senior Performance Creative Strategist (gn) @ Female Health Consumer Startup, London
description: About DITTO DITTO is a science-led brand redefining menstrual health. As a fast-growing, VC-backed business, we're scaling a new standard in menstrual wellbeing — empowering anyone with cycle symptoms to understand, support and optimise their health every day, not just during their period. Developed by female scientists and powered by biotechnology, the Cycle Supplement is backed by over 100 clinical trials and validated in its own clinical trial. Beyond the capsule, DITTO is building a movement — combining credible science, thoughtful design, and inclusive storytelling to change how menstrual health is perceived and supported. As we grow, performance creative will be central to how we convert attention into action. About the role You will sit at the intersection of data and creativity — turning science into content that stops the scroll and drives sales. This is a hands-on, high-ownership role. You will define what makes a potential customer stop, engage, and convert — and then build the systems to do it at scale. You are not just briefing others. You are embedded in the work from the first concept through to post-production feedback and the next iteration. If you are equally energised by diving into data and dreaming up ideas, this role was built for you. Develop creative frameworks that harness DITTO's scientific credibility to build trust and drive purchase decisions. Analyse performance data to surface winning signals, identify trends and shape the next generation of assets. Build and own a structured testing roadmap — challenging creative hypotheses, running experiments and scaling what works. Track and report on hook rate, watch time, CTR, CVR, and ROAS — using data to drive every creative decision. Hands-on execution Lead end-to-end creative development: concepting, scripting, storyboarding, briefing, and post-production feedback. Develop high-performing short-form content with a relentless focus on hooks, retention and shareability. Identify repeatable formats and frameworks that can be systematically tested and scaled. Ensure all output balances performance intent with DITTO's brand identity — science-led, design-forward and inclusive. What we're looking for Extensive experience in performance marketing or creative strategy, ideally within D2C or the wellness space. Thinks in data and dreams in concepts — equally comfortable interpreting performance metrics as developing bold creative ideas. Deep understanding of Meta & TikTok — the nuances, the algorithms and what actually makes content perform. Can translate complex science into consumer messaging that earns trust and drives action. Proactive, highly organised and thrives in a fast-moving environment where you own your output. Cares about purpose-led brands, women's health and reshaping the conversation around menstrual wellbeing. Bonus points if you: Have experience in a high-growth startup environment. title: Data Scientist
description: Do you want to work out how you actually measure whether an AI system is doing a good job, and then make it better? We're looking for a sharp, analytical data scientist to own the evaluation and quality loop of our AutoQA product. You can be early in your career (recent graduates with strong LLM fundamentals are welcome), we have room and a clear path for you to grow. In a nutshell Join a fast-growing SaaS company in an international environment (steep learning curve guaranteed). Own a high-impact problem: making LLM-powered quality assurance measurably accurate at scale. Sit at the intersection of AI and CX, working directly with enterprise customers and their real-world QA rubrics. Grow into a Senior Data Scientist, AI Engineer, or ML Engineer role. We invest in progression. Enjoy the perks: flexible hours, open holiday policy, an office in the heart of Amsterdam with hybrid flexibility, visa sponsorship, great gear, workations, and team events. About Kaizo At Kaizo, we build a performance development and quality platform for customer support teams. Our AutoQA product uses LLMs to review support conversations against each customer's own quality rubric, automatically and at scale. Behind it sits a microservices-based stream processing platform handling over 200 million events per day (Kafka, Kubernetes on Google Cloud, ElasticSearch, MongoDB, BigQuery), and an LLMOps stack built around LangSmith for experimentation, prompt management, and tracing. The hard part isn't calling an LLM. It's knowing, with evidence, how well the system performs on every customer's unique rubric, and having a reliable, repeatable way to improve it. That's where you come in. What you'll focus on Translate customer rubrics into AutoQA instructions. Work with real customer quality criteria and turn them into precise, testable instructions that LLMs can score reliably. Run experiments that move accuracy. Design and execute evaluation experiments on large, representative datasets using LangSmith and BigQuery, and track quality with our performance metrics. Build the datasets that make evaluation possible. Curate raw production data into golden datasets with balanced coverage, and generate synthetic data to cover the rare cases that matter most. QA is a discipline of rare occurrences: distributions are skewed, positives are scarce, and resourcefulness beats volume. Build LLM-as-a-judge pipelines to assess system quality internally and make evaluation repeatable. Make results actionable. Your experiments should end in a decision: change a prompt, adjust which tools the system uses, surface context the AI is missing, or flag where new capabilities are needed. You'll work with the AI team to ship those decisions. Evaluate across the full stack. Beyond scoring quality, you'll help validate retrieval (RAG/IR), tool calling, and speech pipelines (transcription and diarization quality). Join customer calls with the team to understand how QA leaders define quality, and feed what you learn back into the product. What you'll grow into Shaping how customers monitor quality themselves, catch drift, and keep their AutoQA setup improving over time. Smarter categorization and routing of conversations to power analytics and get the right tickets to the right evaluation. A solid understanding of how LLMs work and hands-on experience prompting them for accuracy (coursework, thesis, internships, or side projects all count; production experience is a bonus). Good applied statistics: experiment design, classifier evaluation, precision/recall trade-offs, and working with heavily imbalanced data. Strong Python skills and fluency with the standard data toolkit (Pandas, NumPy, Jupyter). SQL is a plus. An analytical, evidence-first mindset: you'd rather measure than assume. Product sense and empathy for end users. You'll be building for QA managers and support agents, not just for benchmarks. Excellent written and verbal communication. You'll present findings to the team and join customer conversations. 0 to 2 years of industry experience. Recent graduates with strong relevant work are encouraged to apply. A team player who's comfortable wearing multiple hats. We're an early-stage company and things move fast. Bonus points for: Experience with LangSmith or similar LLMOps/evaluation tooling Google Cloud Platform, BigQuery, Docker, or Kubernetes Speech/audio processing or ASR evaluation Fine-tuning or building synthetic datasets for LLMs Who you'll work with You'll join our AI team (two data scientists, an AI engineer, and an ML engineer) and collaborate closely with our data engineers, frontend engineers, designer, product manager, and CX teams. You'll have mentorship from day one and real ownership fast. What's in it for you? An office in the heart of Amsterdam, with the flexibility of hybrid working Visa sponsorship available for eligible candidates Great office gear: MacBook, tools, desk, chair, whatever you need Flexible working schedule and an open holiday policy Fun workations and team events A clear growth path into Senior Data Scientist, AI Engineer, or ML Engineer roles Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Marketing Specialist
description: Senior Marketing Manager Location: Europe, Amsterdam preferred (hybrid or remote possible) Competitive salary Start date: as soon as possible Let’s be blunt: Kaizo doesn’t have a real marketing engine yet. We’ve had marketers before, but the company we are today is a different company. Over the past 18 months we’ve signed enterprise customers like Canva, Instacart, UiPath and Indeed. We’ve also rebuilt our product around a new reality: support teams now run on a mix of human agents and AI agents, and someone has to check the quality of both. Kaizo is the independent Agentic QA layer for that hybrid workforce. We work across helpdesks and Customer Service platforms, and we don’t build AI agents of our own, so we have no reason to mark our own homework. The problem is that the market doesn’t know this yet. We’re the customer service industry’s best-kept secret. The website architecture has just been rebuilt, but the content is outdated and doesn’t tell today’s story. We have strong enterprise customer stories that nobody has written up. Inbound is no longer enough. AI search has changed how buyers find vendors, so pipeline now has to come from outbound, partners, events and reputation. We’re going to the field and starting to attend international events. Sales doesn’t have all the decks, battlecards and collateral it needs. Outbound has started, and it needs content behind it. That’s where you come in. What this role really is We need a senior marketer who wants to build from scratch, and who sees a blank page as an opportunity, not a threat. You’ll be the one who: Brings the website to life so it reflects who we are today and gets found, by people and by AI search. Turns our enterprise wins into case studies and references that open new doors. Owns our review and analyst presence : a proper G2 strategy, competitor and comparison pages that convert, and support for analyst relations. Gives Sales and CS the content, one-pagers, battlecards and decks that win deals and renewals. Starts product marketing : positioning, launches, and clear messaging on AutoQA, Agentic QA, Insights and AI Coaching for customers and prospects. Builds our brand through thought leadership , PR and executive content on the future of CX quality in an AI-agent world. Owns our social channels and online reputation . Defines and runs a field marketing plan, so Kaizo shows up at the international events that matter to our enterprise ICP. Works with Sales on outbound and partner campaigns , including our helpdesk and Customer Service ecosystem partners. You won’t inherit a polished machine. You’ll be the architect, the builder and the driver of Kaizo’s marketing. The deal Location: Amsterdam preferred, flexible across Europe, hybrid or remote possible. Reporting: directly to Thibaud, Co-CEO, as part of the commercial leadership team. Real ownership, a fast feedback loop with Sales and Product, and a seat at the table where positioning gets decided. Why this matters Marketing is the missing piece in Kaizo’s growth engine. The product is there, the enterprise customers are there and the deals are there. Now the market needs to know it, and we need demand that scales. If you succeed, your fingerprints will be all over Kaizo’s next growth chapter: From a handful of enterprise logos → recognised category voice From inbound dependency → repeatable, multi-channel pipeline From scrappy content → thought leadership → If you’re looking for a comfortable role with a big team, a big budget and playbooks already written, this isn’t it. → If you want to build the marketing engine that takes Kaizo from great product to visible market leader, let’s talk. Who you are A content-first marketer. Storytelling is your edge, not growth hacks. You’ve marketed complex B2B SaaS, ideally to enterprise buyers with long sales cycles and buying committees. You’re hands-on: you write, edit, brief designers, manage freelancers and run campaigns yourself. You know what good marketing ops looks like, and you can get by with lean tools (we run on HubSpot). You understand how AI search is changing B2B discovery, and you know how to adapt SEO and content to it. Your English is native or near-native. Everything we publish has to read sharp and professional. Bonus: AI, QA and CX excite you, and acronyms don’t scare you. You’re keen to learn our product, our customers’ pain points and the trends on both the CX and QA sides. Bonus: experience with field events, G2 or analyst relations, or partner and ecosystem marketing. Equal opportunities At Kaizo, we believe diversity drives innovation. We’re committed to an inclusive environment where everyone feels respected, supported and able to do their best work. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, regardless of age, gender identity, race, sexual orientation, disability, religion or beliefs. title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer
description: Help Build the Future of Secure Personal Data Sharing At Ockto, our mission is to set the benchmark for simple, secure, and ethical personal data sharing. Already a vital part of digital journeys like mortgage applications, rental agreements, and private lease processes, we enable people to control and share their sensitive data with confidence. As our platform grows, reliability, scalability and security become increasingly important. As a Senior Site Reliability Engineer, you help build and operate the platform that keeps Ockto available, secure and performant across millions of transactions — and you keep it that way as we scale into new markets. We are a team of curious, highly skilled engineers who value ownership, trust and continuous improvement. You’ll have the freedom to make a real impact while working in a collaborative environment with short decision-making lines. The Opportunity: Senior Site Reliability Engineer We are growing rapidly and pushing boundaries in secure, cloud-native digital services. We’re seeking a Senior Site Reliability Engineer who thrives on impact and innovation. You’ll be part of a collaborative and diverse team, contributing directly to our SaaS platform built with TypeScript and .NET technologies in a public cloud environment. At Ockto, you’ll find: A dynamic, ambitious engineering culture that values trust, autonomy, and ownership. A team of smart, friendly colleagues who share knowledge and challenge each other to grow. A product with real societal value-empowering users to take control of their personal data securely and effortlessly. What You’ll Do You’ll work across engineering to continuously improve the reliability, resilience and security of the Ockto platform. Design, build and automate secure, scalable AWS infrastructure and deployment pipelines using Infrastructure as Code and CI/CD. Drive reliability and resilience through observability (monitoring, logging, alerting), incident response, root cause analysis, and disaster recovery / business continuity. Strengthen our cloud security posture and operate the controls behind our SOC 2 and ISO 27001 commitments — IAM, secrets management, hardening, and native tooling such as GuardDuty, Security Hub and CloudTrail. Keep cloud cost efficient, balancing performance and resilience against spend. Drive structured adoption of AI-assisted development workflows (code assistants, automated testing, spec-to-code pipelines). Uphold privacy and ethical standards, recognising the responsibility that comes with managing people’s most personal data. About the Ockto Platform The Ockto platform enables consumers to securely collect and share personal data: such as identity, income, assets, and spending from trusted sources like government agencies and financial institutions. Trusted by many organisations and financial service providers, Ockto replaces outdated manual data sharing with a streamlined, digital-first experience that benefits both consumers and businesses. With Ockto, users are in control. No paperwork, no emails, just secure, verified data sharing at the click of a button. About yourself What we are looking for: 5+ years of experience in Site Reliability Engineering, Platform Engineering, Cloud Engineering or DevOps. Strong hands-on experience with AWS. Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, AWS CDK or CloudFormation). Experience with Linux, networking and cloud-native architectures. Experience with CI/CD, monitoring and observability. Experience securing cloud platforms using IAM, secrets management and infrastructure hardening. Experience with scripting or programming (Python, Go, Bash or PowerShell). Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills. A passion for automation, reliability and continuous improvement. Will be a plus: Experience with AWS security tooling (Security Hub, GuardDuty, Inspector or CloudTrail). Experience with SOC 2, ISO 27001 or other security frameworks. Experience in fintech or another regulated environment. Experience introducing AI-assisted tooling responsibly in a regulated or data-sensitive environment (data-leakage awareness, prompt and secrets hygiene). Experience with Kubernetes and container orchestration. Serverless architectures (AWS Lambda, API Gateway, EventBridge). Experience with Docker. Familiarity with operational-resilience requirements such as DORA. You can grow and broaden your professional skills. We respect a good work/life balance. We have an eye for your unique person & talents and allow you to apply them. Also, Ockto will provide: A good salary; Room and budget for investing in your personal and professional development; A MacBook Pro and smartphone of choice; Phone- and travel-allowance; Great home/remote working facilities; Lunch fee; Loads of activities like weekend trips, regular drinks and exciting team activities. You will join a team that strongly values diversity and cooperation and you will experience a friendly, ambitious and innovative atmosphere. Do you see yourself as the next Ocktonian? Then apply!
