title: Senior AI Engineer
description: Maybe you call yourself an AI Engineer, an LLM wrangler, a "does it actually work outside the demo" specialist… or maybe you just call yourself Alex. Whatever you call yourself: you'll build and ship the AI that All Your BI puts in front of real clients, and own it end to end. Not demos. Production systems that survive contact with real clients — and when something breaks, you're the one who fixes it. What you get A salary between €81,000-€91,000 including holiday allowance, based on your experience. €5,000 a year for your own growth, with a real say in how you spend it. 25 vacation days + the option to buy up to 10 more + local public holidays + the option of a sabbatical up to 4 months. Two trips abroad a year with the whole team + occasional drinks and team outings. €500 home-office budget and a great laptop. A well-earned "Hey, well done Buddy!", so now and then. Hybrid in the Netherlands: flexibility to work from home with office visits and occasional client meetings. Benefits across the EU: the perks above are AYBI's and go to everyone, everywhere. Statutory benefits (pension, health, social security, leave, sick pay, notice) follow the hire's country via their local contract or EOR. About us All Your BI is a remote-first data agency based in Rotterdam. Since 2019 we've grown from a boutique consultancy into an international data team of more than 60 data heroes spread across Europe. We deliver managed BI services for logistics and industrial companies, helping reduce data waste and move businesses forward. We live for the WOW moment, that sparkle in users' eyes when they gain new insights and discover opportunities. What the job looks like Build and ship the AI behind our products and client solutions: LLM applications, RAG over messy real-world data, agents and tool-calling. You take these from demo-grade to production-grade. Own production end to end: when something breaks, you're the one who fixes it. You implement evals, observability and tracing, and guardrails against hallucination and prompt injection, so problems surface fast and get resolved faster. Keep AI affordable: track cost and latency per task, and use caching, routing, and the right model for the job rather than the biggest one. Work within the architectural guidelines set by our Lead AI Engineer, and flag early when something in that direction isn't holding up in practice. Translate AI capability into real client value and push back on anything that's AI for AI's sake. What you bring Attitude and execution: energy, curiosity, and a strong bias to fix things yourself. When something breaks in production, you dig in and resolve it, you don't wait for direction. You can be trusted to own a production system without close supervision. AI/ML engineering, in production: you've built and shipped LLM/GenAI systems that real people use, RAG, agents, tool-calling, not notebooks and demos. Strong Python, and you know the modern AI stack (LLM APIs across providers like Anthropic / OpenAI / open models, vector databases, an orchestration framework) well enough to know where it breaks. Reliability & LLMOps: you make AI dependable, evals, observability and tracing, guardrails, prompt and version control, cost and latency budgets. Client & business sense: you can tell AI that creates client value from AI that's just hype and explain which is which to a non-technical client, in strong English. Nice to have: data or BI background or consultancy experience; cloud + deployment muscle (AWS / Azure / GCP, Docker, CI/CD); model distillation, structured outputs, and multimodal pipelines. We're a growing team across Europe, and we hire to widen that mix, not narrow it. What matters is what you can do and the perspective you bring, not your age, gender, ethnicity, orientation, disability, background, or where you studied. If the role excites you and you bring most of it, apply: the people who add the most rarely tick every box. Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Senior C/C++ Low Latency Engineer
description: Your job This role is crucial for our organization. Our Technology team is small and therefore you get a lot of responsibilities and freedom! You are triggered by being faster than the competitors and you like to focus on quality. As you can imagine in a small team, there is a flat hierarchy and everybody is really hands-on to be the best in what we do! We are looking for senior C/C++ Engineers with extensive knowledge and experience in building, testing, monitoring and maintaining large scale parallel applications and databases. As a C/C++ Engineer at Mathrix in the low latency environment, your focus will be on the code which facilitates the automated trades on various exchanges worldwide. Our companies’ performance is highly dependent on the performance of our data processing pipelines. You will regularly need to appeal to all aspects of your developers’ skillset to find new and innovative ways to optimize your code. Some examples: low-latency networking code for fast communication with exchanges context-switch-free code design and implement custom data storage structures with minimalistic footprint data pipelines using a streaming paradigm complex trading logic for the decision engine with the lowest possible compute time re-implement existing code using advanced features of the CPU (SIMD) To accommodate the growth of the company, we spend increasing efforts on the maintainability and manageability of our large, highly optimized and multithreaded codebases while preserving its main purpose (low latency). You will have to maneuver yourself between these worlds to get the best results. In addition to writing code, the Technology team builds and maintains the global (hardware) infrastructure to facilitate the trading. In your job you will be regularly involved in all aspects of the pipeline and different tech stacks; from hardware compositions, network design to data logging pipelines for the traders and quants. Who are you Due to the growth of our organization, we are looking for more than one C/C++ Engineer. As the new team member, you bring the following skillset: extensive and thorough knowledge of C and C++ in Linux an understanding of – and the ability to verify - the assembly the compiler will produce from the code you write understanding what (GNU/Linux) system calls you invoke will do and cost knowledge of x64 hardware and how to use it efficiently understanding what storage structures to select or implement given their use (time complexity) ability to work with debuggers and profilers operative coding (git, documentation) ability to absorb from and provide knowledge to the team pro-active, a self-starter, honest, flexible and stress resistant In addition to the above, having a background in one of the specializations below are nice to have: experience with network engineering; either (low latency) networking hardware deployment or networking protocol implementations experience with Big Data engineering and knowledge of Big Data best practices and implementations best suited for different use cases What we offer Excellent remuneration (including discretionary bonus) Fun and inspiring work environment Experienced and knowledgeable colleagues 25 vacation days Additional benefits: going out for dinner regularly, Friday afternoon drinks, yearly office trip(s), weekly massages, monthly meal allowance Find Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

title: Haskell Software Engineer - Creatives Team
description: What’s in it for you (to start with): Gross monthly salary ranging from € 4.000 to € 5.700 based on a 40-hour work week. This salary range reflects our career framework. Your final role level will be determined throughout the recruitment process, based on alignment with this framework 8% holiday allowance - 8% of your yearly salary, which is paid together with your May salary Saving for old age - we have a savings scheme for old age, which can accrue up to 5% of your monthly salary, or you can get an additional +2.5% to your monthly base salary. And many more benefits that you can read about at the bottom of the job description! Your challenges: The Creatives team works on and is responsible for our Image Editor and related image-processing features. You will be working on the backend and sometimes a little bit on the frontend of a complex distributed web application. Our tool provides several different services, written in Haskell, Python, and Rust. In this position, you will be responsible for the architecture, development, and maintenance of new and old image-related features in our application. An important aspect of our work is scaling our services to the next level, so we can handle another order of magnitude increase in throughput while keeping our app fast and responsive. To give you a sense of scale: a couple hundred millions of images are inspected, transformed and created by our services every day. Plan and shape the future of the Creatives suite of features with our tight-knit team Design, develop, and test new product features Collaborate with and review PRs of other team members Improve the reliability and robustness of our application Work on scalability and performance improvements Collaborate with our other product and platform teams to integrate image-manipulating features with other parts of our tool. Our Stack includes: Haskell, Python, Rust, PostgreSQL, TypeScript, React, Ansible, Terraform, Prometheus. And we run all of our infrastructure on Google Cloud Platform. Who are you? You have good programming skills in Haskell (or a similar typed functional language) You are familiar with other programming languages and polyglot programming: we regularly need to make modifications in services written in other languages (especially Python and Rust) as well You have approximately 4-5 years of professional software engineering experience You have experience in tuning and scaling a big application You have experience with web development, web technologies, and APIs Familiarity with SQL and relational databases, preferably Postgres Good working knowledge of Linux, git, and the command line. Nice to have: Knowledge of Haskell libraries like warp, conduit, async, servant, aeson, effectful Knowledge of Rust and its ecosystem Prior experience in image processing Some knowledge of TypeScript/React, which we use in our WYSIWYG Image Editor A passion to provide value to customers and figuring out the 'question behind the question'. Practical requirements: EU citizenship or a valid work permit for the Netherlands; you are preferably already living in the Netherlands Available for at least 32 hours a week, with two days spent at the Utrecht office. Important note: we understand that studies show women may only apply for roles when they feel they meet 100% of the requirements; therefore, we strongly encourage you to apply even if you don't check every box, as we are looking for passionate individuals with potential and a willingness to grow. The team: You will join the Creatives team, consisting of five more Backend engineers, two Frontend engineers, a Product Manager, and a UI/UX designer. Who are we? Channable was founded in 2014 in the heart of Utrecht and is a fast-growing B2B SaaS platform that offers a fully integrated way to market your products online. We empower marketers and online businesses to manage, scale, and optimize their marketing. We are now a strong team of 320+ diverse individuals from more than 40+ nationalities. Joining Channable means you’re looking for a bit more than just a job. Diverse as we are, we all share our love for growth, helping, taking ownership, and creating an awesome journey together. Feel free to take a further look at who we are here and on our Instagram or LinkedIn! Wanna get to know us even more? Give our Culture Playbook a read. Why Channable? At Channable, you’ll find a culture that values openness, craftsmanship, and collaboration. We invest in our people and give them the autonomy to drive meaningful change. You'll work on technical challenges that matter, with colleagues who care deeply about the product and each other. Want to read more about our development adventures? Then visit our inspiring tech blog: https://tech.channable.com/ And if this makes you enthusiastic, you can also take a look at some of our open-source work at https://github.com/channable to get a feeling of how we work together and what our code looks like. More benefits: Annual L&D budget of €1000 to spend on your professional growth. Company-wide performance bonus, up to 10% of your annual salary, determined yearly by our founders based on financial planning and targets. Stock Appreciation Rights: senior employees can financially profit from Channable’s success. 26 vacation days + 2 reload days based on 40 hours, with the possibility of buying up to 5 extra vacation days per year Are you going to become a parent? Enjoy 5 weeks of 100% paid partner leave! Commuting to our office? Choose between an NS Business Card or a €0.25/km travel allowance for alternative transport. Work from our office in central Utrecht at least 2 days a week, and from home for the rest (we'll provide the gear and a budget for extra supplies). Plus, enjoy flexible working hours with a morning start window between 8:00 AM and 10:00 AM. We offer a 3-week-long workcation; and an additional 3 weeks if you live as an expat in the Netherlands! Your well-being matters: we offer a discounted Urban Sports Club subscription and anonymous access to OpenUp psychologists and resources. Fresh daily lunch: enjoy fresh meals prepared Monday to Thursday by our in-house Chef (fully catering to vegan, vegetarian, and gluten-free diets). On Fridays, we switch it up by ordering in tasty sandwiches and salads. Additional working conditions include massages, even personal training sessions at our Channagym, video games, an in-office bar, and many more! Channaweek & Channaweekend: connect with your global colleagues at our annual team gathering in Utrecht, and pack your bags for Channaweekend, our annual company-wide getaway. How can you introduce yourself to us? Are you interested? To ensure your application reaches the right team quickly, please submit it in English directly through our careers page by clicking the “Apply” button. Applications submitted via email won’t be considered. We look forward to hearing from you as soon as possible! Interview steps: If it's a match, Ioana (Tech Talent Acquisition Partner) will get in touch with you for an introductory call (25 minutes) Then you are going to have a tech interview with the team members (1h) For senior candidates, we schedule a system design as well (1h) After that, we will schedule a culture and role fit interview with the Creative Team Lead and one more colleague (1h) When we don’t have enough information, we might ask you to work on a short assignment before your tech interview. Please note that after the interviews and before the offer stage, we’ll conduct reference checks. Important note: We know that in the current AI era, it's tempting to use technology to polish your interview performance. title: ML Platform Engineer
description: About us Bleu Robotics is an AI company developing universal AI software for the deployment of advanced robots , humanoids, mobile manipulators, and industrial arms, in real factories. The convergence of humanoid robotics and modern AI is one of the most significant technical opportunities of the decade, and most of the work today still happens in research settings. We are building the software layer required to bring it into operational use. We have a strong ambition to become the next Microsoft to run on every industrial humanoid. We have closed our pre-seed round with Top-tier fund to deploy our robot in Tier 1 manufacturing facilities. We are looking for deeply passionate scientists who can help us push the frontier and build a major lab in physical AI. Our vision To enable a robot to learn a new industrial task from a few demonstrations and operate autonomously, with under one hour between the start of the demonstration and the start of deployment. This objective shapes our roadmap and every technical decision we make. THE ROLE We are hiring an ML Platform Engineer to put our robot learning stack in the cloud and own the full stack. The platform will let customers run our learning pipelines on their own data as a hosted service; its exact scope will evolve with the product. You will be the first engineer at Bleu Robotics with cloud expertise. The scope covers infrastructure, training and inference services, the web front end, security, and cost. title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description: About the Role We’re looking for a top-tier Forward Deployed Engineer to join Linkup and work hand-in-hand with our founders, customers, and partners. You'll be part of the founding FDE team at Linkup Your mission: help leading AI companies, developers, and enterprises integrate Linkup’s AI-ready search APIs into their products - and shape how the next generation of AI agents connects to the web. This is a highly cross-functional role. You’ll operate at the intersection of engineering, GTM, and customer success , turning technical integrations into insights that drive our product roadmap, marketing narratives, and outbound strategy. You’ll be the connective bridge between what customers build with Linkup and how we tell that story to the world. What You’ll Do Work directly with customers and partners to design, prototype, and deploy integrations of Linkup’s APIs into real-world agentic systems. Participate in pre-sales efforts - technical discovery, proof-of-concept design, demo environments. Collaborate cross-functionally with backend, ML, and product teams to ensure performance and reliability at scale. Identify and implement technical integrations with our other partners in the value chain (workflow orchestration, AI frameworks, etc.) Translate complex technical concepts into clear explanations for both developers and business audiences. Why This Role Matters Every integration you build helps define how AI systems connect to live, trusted information . You’ll operate on the frontier between customers and product - bringing the voice of the field into everything we build and say. Your work will inform: The stories we tell in marketing. The use cases we automate in our GTM systems. The features we prioritize in our roadmap. If you love blending engineering with impact - building things users actually depend on: this role is for you. You’re a Great Fit If You 2+ years in technical support engineering , software engineering , or solutions engineering , with direct application development experience. Strong API integration skills - able to design and debug REST/JSON payloads, manage auth flows, and optimize latency. Understand web infrastructure, distributed systems, or retrieval pipelines. Are comfortable debugging integrations and solving ambiguous technical challenges in customer environments. Communicate clearly and empathetically with both technical and business audiences. Are curious about AI infrastructure, retrieval, and the emerging agentic ecosystem. Thrive in a fast-paced, high-ownership startup environment. Example Projects Help a partner integrate Linkup’s /search endpoint into their multi-agent workflow. Build a proof-of-concept combining a customer’s private data with Linkup’s real-time web results. Collaborate with the backend team to improve SDK telemetry and enterprise deployment reliability. Work with the GTM team to turn successful integrations into published use cases and reference architectures. Identify recurring customer needs that can become productized templates or automation. About Linkup Our Vision We believe in a future of AI agents and the agentic web . These digital entities can create more value for humanity than we ever could alone, but they depend on the internet to operate, collaborate, take action, and gather information. AI agents need web search . To perform well, they require information that is current, reliable, and context‑specific—not the diffuse, steadily aging knowledge frozen at their last training cut‑off. Modern web search is built for humans, not AIs . Instead of trusted facts, it serves links, ads, and click‑bait. People want visually engaging pages; AI systems need structured truth. An AI can absorb oceans of data, while human attention barely skims the surface. Humans think visually and intuitively; AI reasons in latent space. Web 2.0 is sunsetting . The deck is being reshuffled, and the Bing‑Google search oligopoly is crumbling. Indexing ever more pages is no longer the goal; semantically organizing facts for AI systems is. In the coming agentic web, Google’s ad‑driven model has no natural home. Search for AI must be rebuilt from the ground up . We are reconstructing the web as a rigorously structured knowledge layer, mapping every concept, entity, and claim into a coherent semantic graph. This foundation delivers verified facts and rich context to AI instantly, unlocking faster reasoning, higher accuracy, and radically more useful answers for everyone. Humans search Google; AI searches Linkup. Our Mission Reality never stands still, and neither should intelligence. Linkup reconnects language models to a living stream of verified facts, ensuring AIs remain as current and insightful as the world they serve. Our mission is to deliver the world’s freshest, most trusted knowledge to AIs. Our Culture Our culture is built on the following values: Mission . We believe we play a critical role in building the agentic web. We are 100% committed to our mission of bringing the reality of the world to AI agents. Speed . We build fast, we build to last. We get things done, well. Ownership . We empower every team member to take ownership of their projects, ensuring they see them through to successful completion. Teamwork . Our strength lies in our unity. We rely on one another and embrace our diversity as a core asset. Humility . We maintain low egos, showing respect for others and continuously learning from their insights and experiences. We expect all team member to take an active role in shaping our company culture. Our Team We are small technical team, working shoulder to shoulder to build the web of agents. title: Robot Transporter (C Driver)
description: We're a growing team of engineers, operators and technicians from diverse backgrounds, including consumer tech, finance and media, and companies like Dyson, Shopify, Meta and Tesla. You’ll be the first person dedicated to getting our robots, equipment and materials where they need to be, helping more teams build more homes. Your day could take you from the workshop to several active construction sites, delivering robots, collecting systems for repair and getting equipment to the next crew. Plan the day’s transport. Work with the deployment team on the day’s plan: what goes in which vehicle, and the order of drop-offs and pick-ups across sites, our Groningen hub and our Amsterdam locations. Over time, more of this becomes yours to own. Load and secure. Robots, hoisting cages, scaffolding, inventory kits, equipment. You know weight limits, lashing and what it takes to get a 400+ kg system in and out of a vehicle safely. Run deployment logistics. Systems, kits and operational tools out to a new site before the team arrives, back to the workshop when a build wraps, and everything in between. Keep the fleet where it's useful. Move idle systems from one site to another that needs them, and bring systems back for repair so that a broken robot swapped today is a wall going up tomorrow. Own the vehicles. Servicing, inspections, cleaning, fuel, damage reporting and fines. Vehicles are always road-ready. Log every move. Each transport is recorded in our fleet tooling so deployment managers see when their request is planned and the company always knows where every system and kit is. Improve the process. Feed what you see on the road back to the inventory team (packing standards), deployment team (equipment ratios per site) and the team building our transport tooling. Help with inventory in downtime. When there's nothing to move, you work with the inventory team to prepare kits, organise stock and check returned equipment back in. What we're looking for A valid C licence with Code 95 and a driver card (bestuurderskaart) (required). Professional driving and load securing experience (required). Trucks, ideally box trucks with tail lift, with real responsibility for what was in the back: lashing, weight distribution, awkward loads. Equipment rental, construction logistics, removals or last-mile delivery are all good backgrounds. Comfortable with physical work. Loading heavy systems with the right equipment, early starts, all weather, construction site conditions. You don’t need a robotics or construction background, but you should want to know how the systems you’re moving work. Organised in chaos. You can hold a day with five drop-offs in your head, re-sequence it when a site calls, and still log everything at the end. Reliable and careful. A damaged robot costs a build day. You check straps twice and say no to an overloaded vehicle. Clear communication. You deal with deployment managers, site crews and the workshop every day, in person and on Slack. You raise problems early. Based in the Netherlands. Able to work from Amsterdam and drive to sites nationwide. We can't support relocation or visa sponsorship for this role. English required; Dutch is a plus. Nice to have Forklift certificate (heftruckcertificaat) VCA safety certificate (we can arrange it) Basic mechanical sense: you notice when something on a vehicle or a system doesn't look right Experience planning for more than one driver or vehicle Comfortable with simple apps and forms for logging work Why Monumental? title: Strategic Account Executive - Switzerland
description: About ElevenLabs ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology. We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always. We have expanded from voice into three main platforms: ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale. ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages. ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models. Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you. How we work High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy. Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you. AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations. Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models. Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location. What we offer Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities. Learning & development : ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend. Social travel : We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose. Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy. Co-working : If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend. About the role We're looking for an experienced, driven Strategic Account Executive to drive ElevenLabs' growth across Switzerland's largest enterprises. Our ideal candidate has a well-established network and a proven track record of selling to C-level and senior decision-makers at major Swiss brands and is passionate about the transformative possibilities of AI voice technology. In this role you'll act as a strategic partner and trusted advisor, enabling clients to leverage our industry-leading models and ElevenAgents — our end-to-end platform for building and deploying AI voice agents — to reimagine their customer experience, internal workflows, and monetization strategies. In this role you will: Build and manage a growing portfolio of strategic accounts across Switzerland to help ElevenLabs meet its revenue goals. Identify new business opportunities where ElevenLabs' conversational AI capabilities, including ElevenAgents, can drive customer engagement, contact center automation, and operational efficiency for consumer and retail brands. Lead consultative, multi-stakeholder sales cycles, building compelling business cases that translate AI voice technology into measurable business value for senior executives and economic buyers. Develop and maintain a deep understanding of the conversational AI landscape, including customer use cases, competitive solutions, and emerging trends, particularly as they apply to Swiss consumer and retail organizations operating at scale. Demonstrate expertise, or a strong willingness to learn, about conversational AI and how ElevenLabs' voice technology can unlock value across customer support, virtual agents, IVR modernization, and in-app assistants. Develop and execute account strategies to expand ElevenLabs' presence within the Swiss consumer and retail sector, navigating complex procurement and organizational structures. Partner closely with Customer Success, FDEs and Solutions Engineering to ensure smooth onboarding, deployment, and expansion of accounts. Serve as a trusted advisor to clients, educating C-suite and senior operations leaders on emerging trends in generative AI, voice interfaces, and conversational agents. Requirements 7+ years of quota-carrying strategic sales experience in SaaS or technology, ideally with exposure to AI, generative AI, LLM-based products, or API-driven platforms. Proven success closing deals and managing long, complex sales cycles with multiple stakeholders across business, IT, legal, and procurement. Well-connected in the Swiss consumer and retail landscape, with an existing network of senior individuals and strong executive presence and ability to build relationships at the C-suite and board level. Experience selling technical solutions to product and engineering leaders; ability to translate complex technology into business value. Deep understanding of enterprise procurement and legal processes in Switzerland, with the ability to accelerate deal velocity within complex organizational structures. Comfort operating in an early-stage, high-growth environment, including building new playbooks and iterating quickly. Passion for voice and audio AI and how it can unlock transformative value for customers. A hybrid of customer and product-driven mentality that prioritizes client satisfaction and scale. Swiss German is the preferred default language for this role; fluency in both Swiss German and French is a strong plus given Switzerland's multilingual market. Strong English is also required for internal collaboration. Location This is an in-country role based in Zurich. title: Gestionnaire Ressources Humaines
description: L’humain au cœur de la Maison, contribuez à faire vivre l’expérience Beau-Rivage de l’intérieur. Niché au cœur de Genève, notre palace emblématique incarne l’élégance, le raffinement et l’excellence du service hôtelier de luxe. Engagé dans un ambitieux projet de rénovation visant à sublimer son héritage tout en redéfinissant les standards contemporains du luxe, l’établissement ouvre un nouveau chapitre de son histoire. Pour accompagner cette transformation et soutenir nos équipes au quotidien, nous recherchons notre futur(e) Gestionnaire Ressources Humaines H/F . Votre mission : Rattaché(e) à la Directrice des Ressources Humaines, vous assurez la gestion RH quotidienne et accompagnez les collaborateurs tout au long de leur parcours au sein de la Maison. Véritable interlocuteur(trice) de proximité, vous intervenez sur l’ensemble des sujets liés à l’administration du personnel, à la paie, au recrutement et à l’expérience collaborateur. Polyvalent(e), autonome et organisé(e), vous évoluez au sein d’une équipe RH à taille humaine et contribuez activement à garantir une gestion fiable et rigoureuse, tout en maintenant une relation de proximité avec les collaborateurs et les équipes opérationnelles. Vos responsabilités principales : Administration du personnel : Assurer la gestion administrative des collaborateurs, de leur entrée à leur sortie : contrats, avenants, attestations, certificats de travail, permis de travail et autres documents RH. Suivi des collaborateurs : Garantir la bonne tenue des dossiers collaborateurs, la fiabilité des données administratives et leur mise à jour régulière. Gestion des absences : Assurer le suivi des absences, vacances, congés et certificats médicaux. Accompagnement RH : Être un point de contact privilégié pour les collaborateurs et répondre à leurs questions relatives aux différents sujets RH. Onboarding & Offboarding : Coordonner les différentes étapes d’intégration et de départ des collaborateurs, en collaboration avec la Direction des Ressources Humaines et les départements concernés. Paie & Gestion des temps : Assurer le processus mensuel des salaires, le suivi des temps de travail et des éléments variables de paie jusqu’à la clôture. Recrutement : Participer à l’ensemble du processus de recrutement selon les besoins : publication des annonces, suivi des candidatures, entretiens et accompagnement jusqu’à l’engagement définitif. Relations Écoles : Contribuer au développement et au suivi des partenariats avec les écoles hôtelières afin de renforcer notre attractivité auprès des futurs talents. Communication & Événements internes : Participer à la communication RH ainsi qu’à l’organisation des événements destinés aux collaborateurs. Projets RH & Expérience Collaborateur : Contribuer aux différents projets RH et proposer des initiatives visant à améliorer continuellement l’expérience collaborateur. Profil : Formation : Vous êtes diplômé(e) d’une école hôtelière (Bachelor ou équivalent) et avez complété votre parcours par une formation en Ressources Humaines . Expérience : Vous disposez d’une expérience d’au minimum 3 ans dans une fonction RH similaire , obligatoirement acquise dans le secteur de l’hôtellerie-restauration . Paie : Vous maîtrisez les processus de paie, le suivi des temps de travail et la gestion des éléments variables de salaire. Connaissances RH : Vous disposez idéalement de bonnes connaissances du droit du travail suisse et des assurances sociales . Outils : Vous êtes à l’aise avec les outils informatiques et les systèmes d’information RH. Organisation : Rigoureux(se) et organisé(e), vous savez gérer plusieurs priorités simultanément et assurer un suivi précis de vos dossiers. Relationnel : Vous appréciez le contact humain et savez instaurer une relation de confiance avec vos interlocuteurs, tout en respectant la stricte confidentialité inhérente à la fonction RH. Posture : Autonome, dynamique et polyvalent(e), vous appréciez de travailler au sein d’une petite équipe où l’entraide, la réactivité et l’autonomie sont essentielles. Langues : Vous maîtrisez parfaitement le français, à l’oral comme à l’écrit . La maîtrise de l’anglais constitue un réel atout. Personnalité : Vous êtes force de proposition, orienté(e) solutions et aimez contribuer à une ambiance de travail positive. Pourquoi rejoindre la Maison Beau-Rivage ? Une fonction RH polyvalente et proche du terrain , au cœur de la vie de la Maison. L’opportunité d’accompagner les collaborateurs à chaque étape de leur parcours. Une participation active à la transformation d’un établissement emblématique en pleine rénovation. Des missions variées associant administration RH, paie, recrutement, relations écoles et expérience collaborateur . Un environnement de travail stimulant et exigeant au cœur de Genève. La possibilité de contribuer concrètement aux projets RH qui accompagneront le nouveau chapitre de Beau-Rivage. Rejoignez Beau-Rivage et contribuez à faire vivre une expérience collaborateur à la hauteur de l’excellence de notre Maison. Nos offres d’emploi s’adressent autant aux femmes qu’aux hommes. title: Senior Software Engineer, Agentic Discovery
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h3><strong>Available Locations: Lisbon, or London (Hybrid)</strong></h3> <div class="container"> <div id="model-response-message-contentr_ccb59069932b9a6f" class="markdown markdown-main-panel md-content enable-luminous-fast-follows enable-updated-hr-color stronger tutor-markdown-rendering"> <h3>About the Department</h3> <p>Emerging Technologies & Incubation (ETI) is where new and bold products are built and released within Cloudflare. Rather than being constrained by the structures which make Cloudflare a hugely successful business, we are able to leverage them to deliver entirely new tools and products to our customers. Cloudflare’s edge and network make it possible to solve problems at massive scale and efficiency which would be impossible for almost any other organization.</p> <h3>About the Team</h3> <p>We build the products that enable the next era of the Internet: making domains <strong>Readable</strong>, <strong>Discoverable</strong>, and <strong>Callable</strong> for autonomous AI agents.</p> <p>Here at Cloudflare, agentic discovery is a core part of our vision for the <a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/the-agentic-internet/">Agentic Internet</a>. As AI agents change how humans and machines find, evaluate, and act on information, businesses need tools to control how they are represented and reached. We build capabilities that enable website owners to prepare their sites for agent interaction, test and observe how agents read their content, establish open interaction standards (like WebMCP and MCP), and create entirely new channels to reach agentic audiences.</p> <p>We are a cross functional group that communicates and collaborates regularly. We celebrate our achievements, support each other when we make mistakes, and hold each other and our work to a high standard.</p> <h3>About the Role</h3> <p>We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to serve as a technical anchor and become a subject matter expert on our Agentic Discovery team. In this role, you will define the architecture, core protocols, and multi-team standards powering the next generation of agent-web interactions.</p> <p>As a senior technical leader, you will shape product roadmaps, mentor engineers across Cloudflare, and write technical specifications that drive execution across multiple teams. You will drive engineering excellence across edge infrastructure, data pipelines, protocol layers, and developer tooling, ensuring systems are resilient and complexity is reduced for your peers.</p> <h3>What You'll Do</h3> <ul> <li><strong>Architect and ship high-throughput, resilient production services </strong>that make web properties Readable (structured content transformation), Discoverable (indexing and AEO), and Callable (WebMCP, tool-calling APIs, Generative UI) for autonomous agents.</li> <li><strong>Define emerging agent protocols and integrations</strong> (MCP, MCP Apps, UCP, MPP, WebMCP). Author architectural specifications and technical designs that guide engineering work both within and outside the ETI team.</li> <li><strong>Partner directly with Product Management, customers and stakeholders</strong> to translate customer needs into technical requirements, clarify KPIs, and shape engineering roadmaps.</li> <li><strong>Drive improvements in system health and observability. </strong>Lead complex incident responses, conduct post-incident retrospectives, and rearchitect systems to eliminate failure modes and minimize customer-escalation issues.</li> <li><strong>Elevate the engineering process across Cloudflare</strong> through code reviews, technical mentorship, architectural governance, and candidate evaluation for engineering hiring.</li> </ul> <h3>Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</h3> <ul> <li>Experience designing scalable system architecture and setting performance metrics in a distributed environment.</li> <li>Experience writing technical specifications and leading cross-functional technical initiatives to completion.</li> <li>Deep understanding of HTTP, APIs, proxies, caching, web security, and performance bottlenecks spanning multi-service architectures.</li> <li>Hands-on experience and deep conceptual understanding of AI agents, tool calling, Model Context Protocol (MCP), or agent harnesses.</li> <li>Ability to partner with product managers and customers to navigate ambiguous problem spaces and iteratively deliver large-scale architecture.</li> <li>Experience mentoring junior and mid-level engineers, contributing to hiring, and driving improvements to engineering processes and incident response workflows.</li> </ul> <h3>Bonus Points</h3> <ul> <li>Fluency in async Rust or TypeScript/JavaScript edge runtimes (e.g., Cloudflare Workers) at scale.</li> <li>Active contributions to or leadership in open-source agent frameworks, protocols (e.g., MCP), web standards bodies, browser engines, or network proxies.</li> <li>Track record of resolving complex, multi-team production incidents and driving post-mortem recommendations to completion.</li> <li>Background in search engines, Answer Engine Optimization (AEO), web crawling at scale, or RAG platform engineering.</li> <li>Expertise in cryptographic protocols (public-key encryption, digital signatures) or privacy-preserving web architectures.</li> </ul> </div> </div> <h3><strong>Compensation</strong></h3> <p><strong>Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.</strong></p> <p data-path-to-node="1">● For Portugal based hires: Estimated annual salary is between €66,000 - €91,000.</p> <ul data-path-to-node="2"> <li> <p data-path-to-node="2,0,0">The final offer will be inclusive of time exemption, in alignment with the applicable law and collective bargaining agreements.</p> </li> </ul> <h3 data-path-to-node="3"><strong data-path-to-node="3" data-index-in-node="0">Equity</strong></h3> <p data-path-to-node="4">This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.</p> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. title: ML Intern: Optimization Quality & Monitoring
description: Our common vision Our mission is to help marketing teams unlock their full growth potential with AI. Our AI-powered attribution creates real transparency, showing how digital advertising investments perform across channels. On that foundation, we optimize budgets so our customers can sustainably grow their bottom line. We support leading European brands across e-commerce, telco, banking, insurance & energy, and many other industries in making their marketing smarter, more efficient, and more impactful. About the role Nexoya runs fully automated, AI-driven budget optimizations and simulations for enterprise marketing portfolios across many ad channels. Every result that reaches a customer must be correct, explainable and on time. As our ML Intern, you make sure it is: you monitor pipeline health, check the quality of predictions, optimizations and simulations, investigate anomalies and turn recurring manual checks into reliable tooling. You work closely with our ML engineers and Customer Success, and you see directly how your work shapes our customers' budget decisions. Your responsibilities Monitor the automation and assure result quality Monitor the automated prediction, optimization and simulation pipelines across customer portfolios and track run health, completeness and timeliness. Verify that predictions, optimization proposals and simulation results meet our quality standards before they reach customers: budget shifts, expected KPI changes, channel constraints and funnel-level effects. Investigate failed or unexpected runs, identify the root cause (data, configuration or model) and resolve it or escalate it with a clear diagnosis. Assure the quality of results over time Define and maintain plausibility checks for optimization and simulation results, for example for budget planning, seasonal shifts or new channel tests. Make sure results are consistent and explainable, so that customers and account managers can trust them without manual checks. Compare optimized and simulated outcomes with realized performance, document deviations and feed the findings back to the ML team. Safeguard data and model quality Monitor input data for gaps, anomalies and tracking changes that affect optimization quality. Track model fit and prediction accuracy per portfolio and flag degradation early. Maintain portfolio configurations such as funnel steps, constraints and target definitions together with the responsible teams. Automate the operational workflow Replace manual checks with Python scripts, validation rules and alerts. Build and maintain dashboards that show run status, data health and model performance across portfolios. Write runbooks so that operational knowledge is shared, not held by one person. The impact you will have Customers receive optimization proposals and simulations that are correct and delivered on time. Issues are caught before customers see them, not after. The time the ML team spends on operational work goes down measurably, because recurring steps are automated. Customer Success can trust automated optimization and simulation results without checking them by hand. Your experience and skills Recently completed Master's degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering or a related field. Solid Python skills, including pandas and NumPy, and comfort working with SQL. Good understanding of statistics and basic machine learning concepts such as regression, model evaluation and overfitting. A careful, structured way of working: you check results before you share them and you document what you do. Ability to explain technical findings clearly to non-technical colleagues. Fluent English, spoken and written, is a must. Bonus points Experience with optimization methods, for example constrained or non-convex optimization. Familiarity with Marketing Mix Modeling, attribution or digital advertising metrics. Experience with data pipelines, scheduled jobs or monitoring tools. Experience with Git, Docker and cloud environments. Fluent in German or Italian. Your future work life Purpose: Your work directly influences how enterprise marketers allocate their budgets. Responsibility: You own the quality of a defined part of our automation from day one, with a personal development roadmap and regular feedback. Learning: You work alongside experienced ML and data engineers on production systems, not on side projects. Culture: A transparent company culture at eye level, where every person is valued and supported. Strategy: You take part in shaping company strategy and culture during our quarterly Strategy Days. Events: Regular team events, on-site and off-site. Application process Profile review and short phone screen Take-home case study Case discussion with the ML team On-site interview and team evaluation Find Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

title: CDD - Responsable de la communication
description: LA COMMUNAUTÉ Avec 110 000 entreprises membres, Les entreprises s’engagent fédère un collectif d’entreprises et de dirigeants partout en France et les accompagne dans la mise en œuvre d’actions concrètes sur les grands enjeux sociaux, sociétaux et environnementaux. lesentreprises-sengagent.gouv.fr LE POSTE Dans le cadre d’un remplacement de congé maternité, "Les entreprises s’engagent" recherche son/sa Responsable de la communication en CDD, de décembre (début janvier au plus tard) à fin juin 2027. Rattachée à la direction générale, la personne recrutée aura pour mission d’assurer la continuité, le pilotage et la déclinaison opérationnelle de la stratégie de communication de la Communauté pendant cette période, en lien avec l’équipe, les partenaires et les prestataires. La personne recrutée évoluera au sein d’une équipe agile et engagée, et aura l’opportunité de porter et de faire connaître les enjeux de l’engagement des entreprises au service de l’intérêt général. LES MISSIONS Stratégie & marque Déployer la stratégie de communication et veiller à sa cohérence avec les objectifs de la Communauté. Piloter le renouvellement de la communication du projet « Les entreprises s’engagent ». Événementiel Contribuer à la préparation et à la réussite du Sommet des leaders engagés, prévu à Lille le 4 février 2027. Assurer la valorisation de l’événement et faire vivre ses contenus et ses temps forts dans les semaines qui suivent. Éditorial & digital Superviser la stratégie éditoriale et digitale de la Communauté. Veiller à sa mise en œuvre en lien étroit avec la chargée de communication. Piloter la production et la diffusion des contenus sur les réseaux sociaux, les newsletters et les différents supports de communication. Marketing & communication de l’offre B2B Définir le positionnement marketing de l’offre B2B et sa proposition de valeur. Piloter la stratégie d’acquisition et de fidélisation d’entreprises engagées. Concevoir les supports et les contenus permettant de présenter l’offre de manière claire et attractive. Identifier les cibles prioritaires et adapter les messages aux différents publics. Relations presse & influence Développer, en lien avec l’agence de relations presse, les relations avec les médias nationaux, spécialisés et territoriaux. Identifier les sujets et les opportunités de prise de parole permettant de renforcer la visibilité et l’influence de la Communauté. Management & pilotage Encadrer l’équipe communication, composée d’une chargée de communication et d’un stagiaire. Piloter les agences et les prestataires externes. Travailler en étroite collaboration avec l’ensemble des équipes afin de recueillir les informations, les contenus et les documents nécessaires aux actions de communication. PROFIL RECHERCHÉ Formation supérieure en communication ou domaine équivalent. Expérience significative en communication (minimum 5-8 ans). Une expérience en marketing stratégique, positionnement d’offre ou communication B2B, avec la connaissance des outils marketing (tableaux de bord, outils de mailing, SEA, SEO). Excellentes capacités rédactionnelles et relationnelles. Capacité à concevoir et mettre en œuvre une stratégie de communication multicanale. Pragmatisme, créativité, capacité d’innovation. Autonomie, sens stratégique, réactivité et capacité à gérer plusieurs projets simultanément. Une connaissance du sujet ou du secteur de l’engagement des entreprises et/ou de la RSE serait un plus. title: Account Executive - Lyon
description: <p><strong>About OpenTable:</strong></p> <p>With millions of diners, 70,000+ restaurant partners and 25+ years of experience, OpenTable, part of Booking Holdings, Inc. (NASDAQ: BKNG), is an industry leader with a passion for helping restaurants thrive. Our world-class technology empowers restaurants to focus on what matters most – their team, their guests, and their bottom line – while enabling diners to discover and book the perfect restaurant for every occasion. </p> <p>Every employee at OpenTable has a tangible impact on what we do and how we do it. You’ll also be part of a global team and its portfolio of metasearch brands. Hospitality is all about taking care of others, and it defines our culture and inclusive environment, and get the benefits, flexibility, and support you need to succeed.</p> <hr> <p><strong>The Role</strong></p> <p>The Account Executive is responsible for bringing new restaurants onto our dining network through a consultative sales approach.</p> <p>OpenTable’s Account Executive team is dedicated to improving restaurants’ revenue potential by applying best-in-brand front-of-house management and online reservation technology. We are looking for sales professionals who are passionate about the restaurant industry and enjoy working with industry-leading technology.</p> <p><strong>We don't have an office in France so you'll spend much of your week meeting restaurant operators face-to-face across your territory, helping build trusted relationships and close new business.This field-based role combines home working with regular travel across your territory. </strong></p> <hr> <p><strong>In this role, you will:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own and grow your assigned territory by proactively identifying, targeting and winning new restaurant partners through strategic outbound activity and thoughtful market mapping.</li> <li>Build trusted adviser relationships with top and elite restaurants, strengthening long-term partnerships and expanding revenue opportunities within your market.</li> <li>Deliver high-quality, tailored product demos, both virtual and in-person, using data-driven insights to diagnose needs and position OpenTable solutions effectively.</li> <li>Drive sustainable revenue growth by creating compelling commercial opportunities that generate measurable value for restaurateurs and OpenTable alike.</li> <li>Act as a market expert by educating operators on industry trends, competitive insights and performance data, while challenging them to think differently about their business.<br>Develop and execute strategic territory and account plans, confidently overcoming objections and navigating competitive environments.</li> <li>Consistently exceed monthly and quarterly acquisition and revenue targets while maintaining accurate forecasting and disciplined pipeline management through Salesforce.</li> <li>Capture and translate customer insights into action by sharing structured feedback with Product and Marketing teams to continuously refine the value proposition.</li> <li>Represent OpenTable within the hospitality community through industry events, networking and active market engagement to strengthen brand presence and credibility.</li> </ul> <hr> <p><strong>Please apply if:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Significant B2B sales experience, with a consistent track record of meeting or exceeding targets in fast-paced environments.</li> <li>Native French speaker with professional fluency in English, able to build trust and influence stakeholders across markets.</li> <li>A tenacious, goal-oriented self-starter who leads from the front — proactive in outbound activity, resilient in follow-up, and professionally persistent in driving opportunities forward.</li> <li>Strong discovery and consultative selling skills — confident asking the right questions, uncovering needs, and reframing how customers think about their business.</li> <li>Skilled at negotiation and value-based selling, able to articulate ROI and drive meaningful commercial outcomes during sales engagements.</li> <li>Comfortable using data and analytics to inform decisions, build compelling business cases, and strengthen customer conversations.</li> <li>Excellent time management, presentation and organisational skills, with confidence handling administrative responsibilities alongside pipeline management. Proficient in Google Workspace and Salesforce CRM.</li> <li>A collaborative, insight-driven team player who thrives on feedback, learning and shared success, as much as closing deals.</li> <li>Passionate about hospitality and technology. Experience in restaurant management and/or food & beverage sales is strongly preferred but not essential.</li> </ul> <hr> <p><strong>A few of the benefits you get at OpenTable—</strong></p> <ul> <li>Our Account Executive's are rewarded with uncapped commission</li> <li>Vacation: you accrue 25 days a year + RTTs</li> <li>Wedding days: 4 days off for your own wedding and 1 day for your child’s wedding</li> <li>Health and Life Insurance Scheme with Malakoff Humanis.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Occupational Health Service with the occupational health provider of your region.<br></strong></p> <hr> <p><strong>Work Environment & Flexibility</strong></p> <p>At OpenTable, we pride ourselves on fostering a global and dynamic work environment. As a team member with us, you will benefit from a schedule tailored to accommodate a global workforce operating across multiple time zones. While the majority of your responsibilities may align with conventional business hours, there will be instances where you are expected to manage communications - via calls, Slack messages, or emails - outside of regular working hours to effectively collaborate with international colleagues, respond to restaurant partners, and/or address urgent matters. OpenTable will always abide by and consider local laws and regulations.</p> <hr> <p><strong>Inclusion</strong></p> <p>We’re committed to creating a workplace where everyone feels they belong and can thrive. We know the best ideas come when we bring different voices to the table, so we're building a team as dynamic as the diners and restaurants we serve—and fostering a culture where everyone feels welcome to be themselves.</p> <p>If you need accommodations during the application or interview process, or on the job, we’re here to support you. Please reach out to your recruiter to request any accommodations.</p> <p>#LI-hybrid</p> Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Engineering Internships 2027
description: About Nabla Nabla delivers a unified clinical AI platform used by healthcare organizations across specialties and care settings. The platform includes: Ambient AI documentation that captures clinical conversations and generates structured notes. AI-powered dictation and clinical workflow tools embedded directly within EHR systems. Agentic AI capabilities that support multi-step clinical and administrative tasks. Enterprise-grade infrastructure built for secure deployment across health systems. Early Careers: Software Engineering & Machine Learning We’re looking for early-career engineers who want to learn fast, work with experienced mentors, and make a real impact from day one. You’ll join a collaborative, mission-driven team where technical curiosity and humility matter as much as skill. Location: Paris (Hybrid) Start Date: 2027 (or as early as possible) Commitment: Internship-to-hire What we Offer Real Impact from Day One: You won’t be stuck with small tasks: you’ll contribute to real features and products. Learning Everywhere: We believe in mentorship, pair programming, and leveling up together. Lean, Ambitious Team: Be part of a fast-moving, deeply technical culture where your contributions matter. Healthcare Mission: Help doctors, nurses, and care teams spend more time with Patients Career Launchpad: Many interns convert to full-time, and early engineers grow quickly. We work across multiple domains: Apps: Web app, frontend logic, UI/UX Platform: Backend services, infrastructure, APIs Core (ML): Algorithms, models, data systems Your DNA Currently pursuing or recently graduated in Computer Science, Engineering, Applied Math, or a related field . Comfortable coding in at least one: Java, Kotlin, Python, or TypeScript . Passionate about AI, data, or building meaningful product features. Curious, collaborative, and excited to learn. Humble and resilient — you ask questions, take feedback, and grow. Nice-to-Haves (but not required) Internship or personal projects in AI, full-stack, or backend systems. Experience with React, GraphQL, or cloud infrastructure. Knowledge of CI/CD, Docker, or automated testing. You’ll see us on campus at: Télécom Paris Forum Trium ENSIMAG CentraleSupélec École Polytechnique EPFL Forum Organisation Meet us there and tell us what excites you. Life at Nabla When you join Nabla, you join a team that is driven by excellence, curiousity, and kindness. Together, we’re committed to making clinicians’ lives easier and improving healthcare experiences for everyone. We believe clinicians should be able to focus on what they were trained to do, caring for their patients, and that no patient should feel their visit was rushed. We work hard and make time to have fun, too. Our #nablabla channel is just as active as #feature-show-off . We support well-being with workday activities at least three times a week; choose from yoga, running, Pilates, or HIIT. We also host regular off-sites, meet up across New York, Paris, San Francisco, and other cities, and keep the chocolate and nuts well stocked. If this sounds like an environment where you’ll thrive, we look forward to reading your application. Our Values at Nabla Joining Nabla means being part of a team that shares a commitment to excellence, humility, growth, and inclusion. Every day is a new chance to excel We aim for nothing less than the best and are willing to put in the effort and dedication required to exceed standards. We learn from yesterday’s failures and do better every day. Stay humble There’s no place for ego in our team. Our collective success is more important than individual achievements. We see humility as wisdom — keeping focus on the bigger picture. Feedback is a gift We embrace feedback and foster a culture of trust and respect that helps everyone grow. We communicate openly about both achievements and challenges, and we actively involve each other in finding solutions. Committed to diversity We recognize the ongoing challenge of diversity in tech. Our responsibility starts with fostering an inclusive environment where everyone feels empowered to be their authentic selves and do their best work. Diversity & Inclusion Diversity and inclusivity are fundamental values at Nabla. We embrace individuals from various backgrounds, including race, gender, educational history, sexual orientation, and beyond. As an equal opportunity employer, we actively seek out and welcome applicants from diverse backgrounds, believing that a wide range of perspectives enriches our team and enhances our ability to innovate and thrive. Avoid recruitment scams: Stay safe and informed There is an active employment and financial scam which uses Nabla to collect personal information. If you’re contacted by a Nabla recruiter, please ensure they are utilizing a nabla.com email address. We will never ask for the exchange of any money or credit card details during the recruitment process. Nabla utilizes a hiring platform for all applications; please be aware of any suspicious email activity. You can find more information following this link . Nabla does not accept unsolicited CVs from recruiters or employment agencies in response to the Nabla Careers page or a Nabla social media post. Any unsolicited CVs, including those submitted directly to hiring managers, are deemed to be the property of Nabla. Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: R&D Formulation Scientist Intern - 6 Month Internship
description: Our Mission Prose is truly custom hair and skin care made-to-order—just for you. Our line of custom products are made by an in-house, Paris-based R&D team of gifted chemists who combine natural ingredients in innovative ways alongside dermatologists, giving consumers clean skin care, hair care and impeccable results. At the heart of Prose’s success is Singular, its proprietary AI-powered beauty-tech platform, which has revolutionized personalized beauty at scale. Marrying a technology-driven approach with an apothecary-style concept, all Prose hair and skin care products are personalized to your one-of-a-kind hair, skin, goals and environment. We’re a company that wants to change beauty practices, so we’re changing the way beauty companies practice. As a certified B Corporation, a Public Benefit Corporation and Climate Neutral , we’re proving that good business is always sustainable. With Prose, there’s nothing sacrificed to bring you great products—not trees, materials, wages, or performance. Prose & Singular in Numbers Founded in 2017 , with hubs in Paris, New York, and Los Angeles 10M+ consultations completed 2M customers and 350K active subscribers 21M custom products made, with 1M+ unique formulas 350+ team members across disciplines $600M+ in lifetime sales, with $165M+ revenue in 2024 Profitable since 2024 Discover our Company Culture on Welcome to the Jungle here Discover our Company Mission & Vision in video here At Prose, we don’t believe in “one-size-fits-most.” We create custom hair care that’s inclusive to all hair types, needs, and preferences. Each of our hair care products is customized to a person’s hair needs based on the results from an online consultation. The individual data is processed through a proprietary algorithm and made-to-order in the Prose lab using natural active ingredients. Marrying emerging technologies with the best in beauty, Prose is truly creating something special. This is the opportunity to join a fast-growing startup and an energetic team that works together to deliver creative solutions that are transforming the way people think about and shop for hair and skin care. We’re looking for talented problem solvers who lead with passion and who face any task with a positive mindset. Position Summary We are seeking a Formulation Scientist Intern to join our R&D team in Paris and support the development of personalized cosmetic products. You will report to the R&D Project Leader and collaborate closely with other R&D experts (product development, scientific affairs, product evaluation) as well as cross-functional teams (manufacturing operations, brand marketing, etc.). Key Responsibilities Identify and assess innovative new ingredients that comply with Prose’s formulation charter Develop and optimize formula prototypes that meet consumer needs and technical constraints Conduct formula characterization and performance evaluation (in vitro & in vivo) Key Candidate Requirements Currently enrolled in a Master’s Degree (Chemistry, Biology, Food Science) First experience in formulation within a beauty company is a plus. Knowledge of the cosmetics industry is also appreciated Creativity and curiosity Ability to work autonomously, with minimal administrative support Fluent in French and English Strong interpersonal skills and cross-cultural sensitivity Start date and duration : Jan-2027 for 6 months Prose Values Intentional Inclusivity We know the best ideas come from open minds and willingness to listen. While our products cater to the individual, an invitation into our process is always open to our community. We value our differences and diverse backgrounds by communicating openly, managing with transparency and striving to understand one another’s perspective. It’s a key ingredient to our innovation. Connected Collaboration Our strength as a group will outlast our efforts as individual contributors. With offices across countries, staying inventive and agile deepens our clear vision and consistent communication. We stay in a spirit of entrepreneurial collaboration: We do not have consensus at all times, but we trust one another to work toward our common goals. Our success is an expression and result of our progressive and gratifying teamwork. Driven, Together We value ownership and coaching that encourages employees to think constructively and creatively about the business. We view employees as leaders and individuals who are accountable, resourceful and responsible. Anyone and everyone is encouraged to lead. We recognize that in order to continue thinking one step ahead, we will need to try new things. We strive to provide an open environment that accepts this truth, making space for new ideas to emerge. Humanity Always We assume good intentions in every interaction, keeping ourselves accountable for the climate we create.
