title: Customer Success Manager, Southern Europe
description: <div class="content-intro"><h2><strong>About Anthropic</strong></h2> <p>Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.</p></div><h1><strong>À propos du poste</strong></h1> <p>Rejoignez l'équipe Customer Success d'Anthropic en tant que Customer Success Manager basé(e) dans la région EMEA, alors que nous façonnons l'avenir de l'adoption de l'IA en entreprise. En tant que Customer Success Manager chez Anthropic, vous serez partenaire stratégique et conseiller de confiance de nos clients les plus complexes dans la zone EMEA, les aidant à exploiter pleinement le potentiel de toutes nos fonctionnalités Claude : API, Claude for Enterprise et Claude Code.</p> <p>Vous développerez de véritables partenariats avec les clients, acquérant une compréhension approfondie de leurs objectifs commerciaux, de leur orientation stratégique, de leur vision en IA et de leurs besoins techniques. Vous ferez appel à la fois à votre sens des affaires et à votre expertise technique pour agir comme conseiller stratégique tout au long de leur parcours chez nous.</p> <p>En partenariat avec l'ensemble de l'équipe chargée des comptes, vous aiderez les clients à identifier les fonctionnalités Claude les mieux adaptées à leurs objectifs commerciaux spécifiques, en travaillant en étroite collaboration avec eux pour leur fournir les meilleures pratiques et des conseils, tout en les aidant dans la croissance et l'évolution de leur utilisation (consommation et base) sur le siège.</p> <p>Votre rôle consiste à aider les clients à adapter efficacement leur utilisation, à mettre en œuvre des stratégies de gestion du changement, à optimiser les cas d'utilisation et à maximiser la valeur de leur investissement en élargissant les cas d'utilisation à l'ensemble de leur organisation. Les informations que vous recueillerez auprès de vos clients serviront directement à définir nos priorités en matière de recherche, de développement et</p> <p>de stratégies de commercialisation, vous permettant de jouer un rôle clé dans la manière dont nous créons et fournissons de la valeur en continu en tant qu'entreprise.</p> <p>En tant que l'un de nos premiers CSM dans la région EMEA, vous serez une pionnière en aidant à mettre en place des processus régionaux, à établir de nouvelles relations avec les clients et en représentant la marque Anthropic dans un</p> <p>marché en forte croissance. Vous travaillerez avec une grande autonomie tout en maintenant un alignement fort avec les équipes mondiales, ce qui requiert une personne qui s'épanouit dans des environnements ambigus et peut travailler efficacement dans différents fuseaux horaires.</p> <h2><strong> </strong></h2> <h1><strong>Responsabilités :</strong></h1> <ul> <li>Établir des relations de confiance et stratégiques avec les décideurs clés des clients EMEA afin de comprendre leurs activités et leurs objectifs, en identifiant des opportunités d'optimisation et d'expansion</li> <li>Devenir expert des produits Anthropic via API, Claude for Enterprise et Claude Code, en comprenant les nuances techniques et les meilleures pratiques de chacun afin d'orienter les clients vers les bonnes solutions</li> <li>Tirer parti de votre connaissance approfondie du client et des spécificités régionales pour piloter de manière proactive la planification de l'utilisation, en cernant les tendances actuelles et futures en matière de consommation et d'adoption, ainsi que la manière dont celles-ci se traduisent en valeur ajoutée pour le client</li> <li>Surveiller les schémas d'utilisation et identifiez les opportunités d'optimisation, en traitant de manière proactive la sous-utilisation des produits basés sur la consommation (API) et par abonnement (Claude for Enterprise / Claude Code) pour tirer pleinement parti des engagements contractuels</li> <li>Jouer le rôle de partenaire stratégique auprès des clients, en enrichissant leur connaissance des produits Claude grâce à la diffusion de la feuille de route des produits d'Anthropic, en faisant connaître les nouveaux produits et en impliquant les chefs de produit pour qu'ils se fassent le porte-parole des clients de la région EMEA</li> <li>Documenter et quantifier la valeur client réalisée grâce aux résultats commerciaux, au ROI et aux indicateurs d'impact afin de constituer des arguments commerciaux internes convaincants en vue de poursuivre et d'accroître les investissements</li> <li>Identifier les cas d'utilisation potentiels et les secteurs d'activité qui ne sont pas encore exploités, en collaborant avec les clients pour découvrir de nouvelles applications pour Claude au sein des différents services, équipes et flux de travail</li> <li>Élaborer et mettre en œuvre des stratégies de gestion du changement pour favoriser l'adoption par les utilisateurs finaux et maximiser la valeur au sein des organisations clientes, y compris des programmes de formation des formateurs, le développement de centres d'excellence et l'accompagnement organisationnel</li> <li>Gérer l'expérience client tout au long de son cycle de vie : gérer des comptes complets et des plans de réussite fondés sur les objectifs commerciaux du client, réaliser des bilans commerciaux trimestriels et servir de principal intermédiaire entre le client et Anthropic</li> <li>Contribuer au développement de la marque Anthropic et des relations avec la clientèle en tant que membre de la première équipe de service client de la région, en élaborant, si nécessaire, des processus, des guides opérationnels et des bonnes pratiques adaptés à la zone EMEA et tenant compte des cultures d'entreprise régionales</li> </ul> <h2><strong><br><br></strong></h2> <h1><strong>Profil recherché :</strong></h1> <ul> <li>Vous avez plus de 6 ans d'expérience dans des fonctions en contact avec la clientèle (Customer Success, Consulting, Solutions Architect, Solutions/ Functional Consultant, Success Engineer ou similaire)</li> <li>Expérience avérée en matière de réussite dans les modèles commerciaux basés sur la consommation et sur la location de places, avec une bonne compréhension des différents leviers de croissance et des indicateurs de performance associés</li> <li>Maîtrise technique et capacité à comprendre et à articuler les concepts d'IA/ML, les intégrations d'API et les modèles de mise en œuvre logicielle</li> <li>Expérience dans la présentation et la démonstration de produits techniques auprès de publics variés</li> <li>Mentalité stratégique pour identifier les opportunités de croissance et les traduire en plans d'expansion concrets</li> <li>Collaborateur polyvalent qui représente le client avec positivité et proactivité, en mobilisant l'ensemble de l'équipe autour de solutions permettant de répondre aux besoins du client</li> <li>Solides compétences en gestion de projet et capacité à gérer plusieurs relations clients</li> <li>Passion pour l'IA et intérêt pour le développement responsable de systèmes avancés</li> <li>Acquérir de l'expérience en travaillant et en contribuant au développement d'une région en pleine croissance, tout en jonglant avec les fuseaux horaires depuis le siège social situé aux États-Unis</li> <li>Un talent pour mettre de l'ordre dans le chaos et une mentalité enthousiaste de « retrousser ses manches ». Vous avez l'esprit d'équipe</li> <li>(Bonus) Maîtrise du français, de l'allemand, de l'espagnol ou de l'italien</li> </ul> <p> </p> <hr> <h2><strong>About the role</strong></h2> <p>Join Anthropic's Customer Success team as an EMEA based Customer Success Manager as we pioneer the future of enterprise AI adoption. As a Customer Success Manager at Anthropic, you'll be the strategic partner and trusted advisor to our most complex customers across EMEA helping them harness the full potential of all our Claude capabilities - API, Claude for Enterprise, and Claude Code.</p> <p>You'll develop genuine partnerships with customers, gaining a deep understanding of their business objectives, strategic direction, AI vision, and technical needs. You'll draw on both your business acumen and technical expertise to serve as a strategic advisor throughout their journey with us. </p> <p>In partnership with the broader account team you will help customers identify the right Claude capabilities for their specific business objectives, working closely with them to provide best practices and guidance while supporting them as their usage (consumption & seat based) grows and evolves.</p> <p>Your role focuses on helping customers scale their usage effectively, implement change management strategies, optimize use cases, and maximize the value of their investment through expanded use cases across their organization.  The insights you gather from your customers will directly inform our research priorities, product development, and go-to-market strategies — making you a key voice in shaping how we build and deliver ongoing value as a business. </p> <p>As one of our early CSMs in EMEA, you'll be a pioneer - helping to build regional processes, establishing new customer relationships, and representing Anthropic's brand in a high-growth market. You'll operate with significant autonomy while maintaining strong alignment with global teams, requiring someone who thrives in ambiguous environments and can work effectively across time zones.</p> <h2><strong>Responsibilities:</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Build trusting, strategic relationships with key EMEA customer decision makers to understand their business and objectives, identifying opportunities for optimization and expansion</li> <li>Become an expert in Anthropic's products across API, Claude for Enterprise, and Claude Code, understanding the technical nuances and best practices for each to guide customers to the right solutions</li> <li>Leverage your deep knowledge of the customer and regional nuances to proactively drive usage planning, understanding current and future consumption/ adoption and how it creates realized value for the customer</li> <li>Monitor usage patterns and identify optimization opportunities, proactively addressing underutilization across both consumption-based (API) and seat-based (Claude for Enterprise / Claude Code) products to drive full value from contracted commitments</li> <li>Serve as the customer’s thought partner, enhancing their knowledge of Claude products by socializing Anthropic’s product roadmap, driving awareness on new products and engaging Product PMs as the voice of EMEA customers</li> <li>Document and quantify customer value realized through business outcomes, ROI, and impact metrics to build compelling internal business cases for continued and expanded investment</li> <li>Identify potential use cases and lines of business not currently onboarded, partnering with customers to discover new applications for Claude across different departments, teams, and workflows</li> <li>Develop and execute change management strategies to drive end-user adoption and maximize value withi

title: Senior iOS Engineer (KMP) - POS
description: <h3><strong>Team description</strong></h3> <p>The Order Taking squad owns core ordering experiences within SumUp’s Point of Sale app, including the shopping bag, checkout, the catalog experience within ordering, open orders, table management and printer integrations. These capabilities help thousands of hospitality merchants manage orders reliably during daily service.</p> <p>As a Senior iOS Engineer, you’ll build new hospitality workflows and evolve established ordering experiences across iOS and Android. You’ll work with SwiftUI on the platform-specific UI and contribute to shared Kotlin Multiplatform business logic. The role involves complex mobile engineering across multi-device synchronisation, shared order state and a large, established application.</p> <p>You’ll join a small, experienced and fast-moving squad that works collaboratively through technical refinement, code reviews and pair programming. The team values engineers who communicate directly, challenge assumptions and proactively shape solutions rather than simply execute predefined tasks.</p> <h3><strong>What you'll do</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Design and build new ordering experiences in SwiftUI, while evolving established capabilities such as table management, kitchen workflows and printer integrations</li> <li>Contribute to shared Kotlin Multiplatform business logic and help shape the architecture of the ordering domain</li> <li>Improve the reliability and usability of ordering features used daily by hospitality merchants across phones, tablets and POS devices</li> <li>Collaborate closely with Android engineers and platform teams to maintain consistent cross-platform behaviour and reliable multi-device order synchronisation</li> <li>Take part in code reviews, pair programming and collaborative testing to maintain a high quality bar</li> <li>Help refine and scope upcoming work, bringing technical judgement to product and architectural trade-offs</li> <li>Contribute to Mobile Chapter and KMP platform initiatives across the wider POS tribe</li> </ul> <h3><strong>You'll be great for this role if...</strong></h3> <ul> <li>5+ years of experience building production iOS applications in Swift, with strong SwiftUI knowledge</li> <li>Experience working in a large, established codebase and making pragmatic improvements without requiring a full rewrite</li> <li>Openness to learning and contributing to Kotlin and Kotlin Multiplatform; previous hands-on KMP experience is welcome but not required</li> <li>Ability to work independently, challenge assumptions, propose solutions proactively and communicate clearly and directly</li> <li>Experience collaborating closely with Android engineers or other cross-platform partners to align product behaviour</li> <li>Sound technical judgement and the ability to balance product delivery, code quality and long-term maintainability</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Why you should join SumUp</strong></h3> <p>🌎 Opportunity to work with a truly global, multicultural team from our Paris location. This involves an office-first setup<br>🌈 Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion: be part of a workplace that values and promotes diversity, fostering an inclusive environment where everyone's perspectives are respected and embraced<br>🚀 Enrolment onto our Virtual Stock Option programme: you will own a stake in SumUp's future success<br>📚 A dedicated annual L&D budget of €2000 for your individual development, which can be used to attend conferences and/or advance your career through further education<br>💼 Financial security: corporate pension contributions that support your long-term future<br>🏥 Healthcare support: we cover 50% of the monthly cost of your health insurance for your Mutuelle and Prévoyance<br>🚌 Extra allowances: we offer restaurant tickets (Swile) and cover transportation costs<br>🌴 Break4me: 1-month sabbatical after 3 years of service<br>🔗 Referral Bonus: earn additional rewards by referring talented individuals to join the SumUp team</p> <h3><strong>About SumUp</strong></h3> <p>Be empowered to do more that matters.</p> <p>At SumUp, we're on a mission to empower small businesses across the globe by providing simple and affordable tools that allow them to thrive. Today, over 4 million businesses in 39 markets rely on SumUp as their financial partner to manage payments, finance and customer relationships.</p> <p>Our commitment to small businesses is reflected in<a href="https://youtu.be/9DG64C3moeQ?si=YpcWuBNBTOQPzeLI"> our diverse team</a> of over 4,000 SumUppers from over 90 nationalities, united by global collaboration and an innovative mindset.<a href="https://www.sumup.com/careers/culture/"> Our core values</a> lay the foundation for who we are and what we stand for, shaping our work culture and driving our success. We foster inclusivity and a continuous learning culture, providing a safe space for personal and professional growth. Our differences make us unique and strong as we strive to create an environment where everyone belongs and feels supported, no matter how they identify.</p> <p>SumUp is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer, actively seeking and embracing diversity in our workforce. We don't make hiring or employment decisions based on race, colour, religion or religious belief, ethnic or national origin, nationality, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, age or any other basis protected by applicable laws or prohibited by company policy. Our commitment extends beyond recruitment to creating a safe and respectful workplace where harassment of any form is strictly prohibited. Discover more about our culture and opportunities on our<a href="https://www.sumup.com/careers/"> careers website</a>, and follow our journey on<a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/sumup/"> LinkedIn</a>,<a href="https://www.instagram.com/insidesumup/"> Instagram</a>, and<a href="https://www.tiktok.com/@insidesumup"> TikTok</a>.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Job Application Tip</strong></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We recognise that candidates feel they need to meet 100% of the job criteria in order to apply for a job. title: Legal Engineer | French Market (Paris)
description: Lexroom is building the AI platform where legal work gets done. In just over two years, we've grown from zero to €25M ARR, and today more than 20,000 legal professionals across Italy, Spain, Germany, France, and Bulgaria rely on Lexroom . We're backed by $73M from Left Lane Capital, Base10 Partners, and Eurazeo, and we're a team of around 300 builders who move fast, say things straight, and own each outcome. Our next goal? Become Europe's most-used legal product. Why Lexroom ? Shape the Standard: Be part of the team setting the benchmark for legal AI in Europe. Work with the Best: Collaborate with exceptional colleagues in a culture that values competence, curiosity, and ambition. Deliver Meaningful Results: Your contribution will directly influence how legal professionals work—faster, clearer, and more efficiently. At Lexroom , we leave buzzwords behind. Here, you’ll build something that lasts: a trusted platform, a strong reputation, a new standard for the legal world. Role As a Legal Engineer , you will own the construction, maintenance, and strategic development of our Proprietary Database — the single most important asset behind the reliability our users trust. You'll sit at the intersection of law, product, and AI, acting as the legal mind that: (i) keeps our data accurate, relevant, and defensible; (ii) shapes new product features; (iii) collaborates with AI engineers on improving the AI system's reasoning capability. YOU WILL Be part of the product team and act as the first expert to shape new features, test and validate the product, applying your legal judgment to verify outputs for accuracy, consistency, and real-world usefulness. Establish and own the processes that keep the database always updated, relevant, and internally consistent as laws, case law, and regulations evolve. Be the voice of the user: collect and synthesize feedback from practicing lawyers and translate it into actionable input that steers product development in the right direction. Collaborate with data annotators and AI Engineers to define and create high-quality validation and training datasets for our AI algorithms, bridging legal substance and technical execution. Propose and develop with AI Engineers the mechanisms to improve the AI system's ability to analyse a legal request and produce a structured output. Analyse strategic partnerships to enhance the data included in the product and its features. Work closely with partners and law firms to define data acquisition priorities and identify the most relevant and authoritative sources for each practice area. Take ownership of legal domains (e.g. civil, commercial, labour, privacy, banking), becoming the internal subject-matter reference and setting the quality standard for that area. Set the tone for the team: as one of the first hires in this function, you'll shape how we work, define best practices, and grow and scale with the company while leading by example. WHO YOU ARE French law degree (Master 2 or equivalent). 3+ years of experience as a practicing lawyer, preferably in civil law. Fluent in French and English. A genuine desire to pursue an alternative and challenging career path outside traditional practice, in a fast-growing, high-ownership environment. Strong analytical rigor and attention to detail. Outstanding problem-solving skills. Clear communicator, comfortable acting as a "translator" between legal requirements and technical teams. Curiosity about AI and legal technology, and the drive to learn how LLMs and legal data work together (no prior technical/AI experience required). Strong plus: experience in Legal Engineering, Product or Program Management; master's in Law & Tech. WHAT SETS US APART An Exceptional Team At Lexroom, you'll work alongside top talent in tech and legal AI. Our focused teams operate with purpose and autonomy, so every contribution delivers visible results. title: Quantum Applications Engineer
description: Quandela is a global leader in quantum computing, designing, building, and delivering cutting-edge quantum solutions for research and industry. Its offerings include very energy-efficient quantum computers for data centers, full-stack quantum computing solutions accessible via the cloud, and algorithm access services for academic and industrial customers. Following a pragmatic, step-by-step roadmap, Quandela has been deploying industrial-grade systems since 2023 while developing future generations of fault-tolerant quantum computers capable of scaling through the integration of thousands of photonic components. Quandela is committed to making quantum computing accessible to all in order to address the most complex industrial and societal challenges. Learn more at: Quandela | Leading Photonic Quantum Computing Solutions Description of the Project As a Quantum Applications Engineer , you will work at the intersection of quantum algorithms, real-world applications and customer projects . Your mission will be to identify relevant problems that can be addressed using Quandela's quantum computing technology, assess their feasibility and define how meaningful performance should be measured. Working directly with industrial and academic partners, you will translate real-world challenges into quantum computing problems, evaluate potential approaches and establish the appropriate benchmarks against classical methods. This is a highly technical role with strong exposure to customers and partners. It is particularly suited to someone with a background in quantum algorithms who wants to apply that expertise to practical use cases rather than focus exclusively on theoretical research. Your Key Responsibilities Identify and assess quantum use cases by working with customers, industrial partners and internal teams to understand their challenges and translate them into relevant computational problems. Perform feasibility studies to determine whether and how these problems can be addressed using current and near-term quantum computing technologies, with a particular focus on NISQ approaches. Define meaningful benchmarks , including relevant problem instances, expected outputs, accuracy targets and classical baselines to objectively evaluate quantum approaches. Explore promising application domains and contribute to application roadmaps, from near-term demonstrations to longer-term utility-scale applications. Evaluate scientific, industrial and economic value to help prioritize the applications where quantum computing can have the greatest impact. Design and maintain strategic demonstrations and Proofs of Concept , working with internal teams or external software partners depending on the project. Follow customer projects throughout their lifecycle , including projects where algorithm development is performed by external partners. Present technical work to customers and partners , explaining quantum approaches, results, limitations and opportunities to both technical and non-specialist audiences. Collaborate closely with Quandela's algorithm, machine learning, product, project management, sales and engineering teams. Depending on the strategic interest of a project, you may also contribute directly to the development and implementation of quantum algorithms in Python. What will make you successful You do not need to know every possible quantum application from day one. What matters is your ability to approach an unfamiliar problem, ask the right questions, understand its computational structure and determine whether quantum computing provides an interesting direction to explore. You are comfortable navigating between research and practical applications : scientifically rigorous enough to challenge an algorithmic approach, pragmatic enough to assess its real-world relevance, and comfortable enough with people to discuss your conclusions directly with customers. Requirements You have a strong technical background in quantum computing and quantum algorithms , combined with the curiosity and communication skills required to explore real-world applications. You ideally bring: A PhD in quantum computing, quantum information, physics, applied mathematics, computer science or a related field , or a Master's degree combined with relevant professional experience. A first professional experience in a similar environment is strongly preferred. Strong understanding of quantum algorithms , particularly approaches applicable to current or near-term quantum computers. Knowledge of NISQ algorithms and variational quantum algorithms . Good programming skills, particularly in Python . The ability to understand a complex industrial or scientific problem and translate it into a computational and algorithmic framework. A rigorous approach to benchmarking quantum and classical methods . Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Excellent communication skills and the confidence to present technical topics directly to customers, partners and broader audiences. Professional proficiency in English . Previous experience working on customer-facing technical projects, quantum application projects, consulting, pre-sales, collaborative R&D projects or industrial partnerships would be a strong plus. Experience with Agile ways of working and tools such as Jira is appreciated but not essential. Benefits Competitive salary, flexible based on your experience Profit-sharing & company savings plan 100% health coverage (Alan) 50% transport reimbursement or sustainable mobility bonus Meal vouchers (Swile), Gymlib fitness support Childcare assistance & referral bonuses (€1,000–€2,000) What we offer: A role at the intersection of cutting-edge quantum research and real-world industrial applications. Direct exposure to a wide variety of quantum computing use cases and industries. The opportunity to work with leading researchers, engineers, industrial partners and customers. Significant ownership in shaping Quandela's application portfolio and identifying the problems quantum computing should address next. The opportunity to work across the full quantum stack, from algorithms and software to Quandela's photonic quantum computing technology. A hybrid work model (3-4 days/week onsite in Massy, 1 day in Paris or 1 to 2 days remotely). Process Talent Acquisition Interview (30' - 45') Hiring Managers Interview (45') Use Case (a live use case or one to be prepared at home and presented afterward) Meeting with the teams 2 to 3 reference check Offer (This process is provided for guidance only and may evolve depending on the roles) At Quandela, we believe that the strength of our team is the plurality of experiences, perspectives, and journeys. We are committed to building a respectful, inclusive, and welcoming work environment. All applications are welcome. Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Platform Architect - Banking
description: About us EggAI is a fast-growing AI consulting and development startup. We build agentic AI solutions for enterprise clients. We are growing in several European markets. The role You will own the design of a shared AI platform for our clients. The platform has two parts. An AI Control Plane governs what agents may do, through identity and delegated permissions, policy enforcement, approvals, budgets and durable audit records. A managed AI Runtime is where the agents run. Both integrate with the client's identity, security, delivery and audit services. You will set the architecture, define how services and controls fit together, and make sure what the team builds is sound, assured and ready for production. The role reaches across engineering, security, audit, risk and the client's architecture function. You will take designs through their governance, record the decisions, and give the engineers a design they can build and the client a design they can approve. You will be EggAI's accountable architecture lead on the engagement, leading design for a delivery team of platform engineers. You make the technical decisions within the team's remit, recommend on the rest, and secure the client's approval where their architecture or risk governance requires it. What you will do - Own the architecture of the AI Control Plane and AI Runtime and keep it aligned with the client's architecture standards, cloud substrate, API gateway, identity provider and audit services. - Define service interfaces and contracts. Decide where each security and policy control is enforced: in the gateway, the control plane, the runtime or the client's own services. - Keep the design record. Write architecture decision records (ADRs) and record every deviation from the client's standards or our reference designs for a client decision. - Take designs through the client's architecture and risk forums. Secure approvals in time for dependent work, so that design precedes implementation. - Lead design and quality review across all platform services. Review engineers' changes, cross-service tests and fault exercises with the CTO. - Define how the architecture will be proven. Agree acceptance criteria with engineers and client control owners for each interface, control and infrastructure contract, including behaviour when a dependency fails, and review the test evidence showing they are met. - Hold the build to the design's principles: policy enforced outside the agent, decisions recorded before actions take effect, fail closed with stop always available, and audit evidence that is administered independently of the people who build and run the platform, reconciled against what actually happened, and readable with the client's own tools. - Maintain the inventory of platform controls. Record for each one whether it is enforced or only monitored, whether it is implemented, tested or still open, and what evidence it produces, so acceptance reviews work from a current record and coverage gaps are visible. - Assess proposed technology, scope and dependency changes for their effect on the design, controls, effort and running costs, and give the programme lead a clear basis for plan and cost decisions. - Evaluate new runtimes and managed services against the platform's control requirements. Compare shared controls with provider-native ones on integration effort, operating cost and assurance gaps, separate what is verified from what is assumed, and recommend whether to adopt, change the design or hold scope. - Lead the technical assessment of production readiness. Review recovery, containment and fault-exercise evidence, and give the programme lead a clear view of what is ready and what is not. - Stay with the platform through go-live and the support period after it. Resolve the architectural issues that production exposes, and decide when a fix is a design change rather than a defect. - Prepare the client's receiving engineers to maintain the design. Lead the architecture parts of training and handover, and leave documentation, decision records and guidance they can extend without you. Essential experience - You have been the accountable solution or platform architect for systems that went into production, and have led engineers through building them. - You have delivered cloud platforms into production in a regulated environment and taken designs through formal architecture and risk governance. - You know a major cloud platform in depth: networking, identity, secrets, Kubernetes and managed services. Azure is strongly preferred. - You have hands-on experience with API gateways, identity and delegation using OAuth and OIDC, and policy as code. - You work with infrastructure as code, GitOps and software supply-chain controls, and understand how they underpin reproducible environments, conformance tests and release assurance. - You have designed systems that must produce audit evidence and fail safely: durable records, immutable storage, separation of duties and deny-by-default access. You have sound judgement about retries, partial failure, idempotency, identity propagation and recovery. - You write clear architecture decision records and can explain and defend a design to senior architects, risk owners and engineers. Nice to have - Delivery in financial services or banking. - LLM or agent platforms in production, including model gateways, agent orchestration and protocols such as MCP and A2A. - Audit, evidence retention or AI risk controls, including EU AI Act, PRA or FCA expectations. - Products in this space such as Kong, Open Policy Agent or Microsoft Foundry. Practical details - Hybrid working and client-site attendance will depend on the engagement. - You will need to complete the background and security checks required by the client. title: Assistant·e Chef de Projet Marketing - alternance
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>Our Global Structure</strong></p> <p><br>Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.</p></div><p><strong>Pourquoi Deliveroo ?</strong></p> <p>Lorsque l'on vous dit Deliveroo, vous imaginez sans doute d'abord les bons petits plats livrés chez vous en moins d'une demi-heure. Plutôt sympa non ? Mais c'est en coulisses que l'histoire est la plus intéressante. Nous opérons désormais à travers le monde et travaillons avec plus de 176 000 restaurants partenaires et commerces en tous genres en France. Nous collaborons avec des milliers de livreurs et de livreuses partenaires pour le plus grand bonheur de nos millions de personnes clientes.</p> <p>Nous recherchons un·e Assistant·e Chef de Projet Marketing Merchant en alternance pour rejoindre notre équipe Marketing à Paris, pour une durée de 12 mois. Aux côtés de l'équipe Merchant, vous contribuerez au développement de la croissance de nos partenaires, au déploiement de nos campagnes nationales 360° et en accompagnerez des projets à fort impact sur l'acquisition, la rétention et la fidélisation de nos restaurants partenaires.</p> <p><strong>Descriptif du poste :</strong></p> <p>En tant qu’Apprenti(e) dans l’équipe Marketing Merchant Restaurant, vous travaillerez au quotidien avec l'équipe marketing chargée de mettre en avant toute la sélection de restaurants et de partenaires de Deliveroo. Vous serez également amené(e) à <strong>interagir régulièrement avec les autres départements marketing </strong>tels que l’équipe média, l’équipe créative, le CRM ainsi qu’avec l’<strong>équipe commerciale. </strong></p> <p><strong>Vos missions consisteront à:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Mettre en avant sur l’application les restaurants et partenaires disponibles sur l’app.</li> <li>Soutenir l’équipe commerciale dans la création et l’exécution de plans marketing destinés à mettre en avant les partenaires présents sur Deliveroo.  </li> <li>Collaborer étroitement avec l'équipe commerciale et les équipes marketing transversales (marque, réseaux sociaux, CRM et influenceurs) pour développer et exécuter des plans partenaires basés sur les priorités commerciales (par exemple, objectifs régionaux, accords d'exclusivité, renégociations).</li> <li>Préparer des présentations et des supports pour appuyer les discussions de l'équipe commerciale avec les partenaires, en veillant à l'alignement et à la clarté.</li> <li>Contribuer à l’exécution des points forts des partenaires en collaboration avec le CRM et le Commercial (communications mensuelles d'exclusivité / bannières dédiées sur l’application / notifications push...).</li> <li>Gérer le budget alloué pour le plan de chaque partenaire, en optimisant les ressources locales pour obtenir un impact maximal. </li> <li>Analyser l’impact de nos campagnes pour en tirer des recommandations pour les équipes commerciales</li> </ul> <p>Cette alternance vous permettra d'appréhender de nombreux sujets marketing (création de campagne, analyse, sensibilité client) et vous permettra d'acquérir une bonne connaissance des enjeux marketing et de la gestion de projets complexes grâce à la collaboration transverse que vous aurez avec les autres pôles. </p> <p><strong>Ce qui vous permettra de réussir</strong></p> <p>Vous préparez un diplôme de niveau Bac+4 ou Bac+5 en école de commerce, université ou équivalent, avec une spécialisation en marketing, communication ou digital et recherchez une alternance d'une durée d'un an à partir de Décembre 2026 / Janvier 2027.</p> <p><strong>Vous Vous Reconnaissez Dans Les Points Suivants</strong></p> <ul> <li>Vous êtes organisé·e, rigoureux·se et savez gérer plusieurs projets en parallèle en respectant les délais</li> <li>Vous avez une excellente communication écrite et orale en français ainsi qu'un bon niveau d'anglais.</li> <li>Vous êtes à l'aise avec les chiffres et aimez analyser les performances pour en tirer des recommandations.</li> <li>Vous appréciez le travail en équipe et la coordination de nombreux interlocuteurs.</li> <li>Vous êtes curieux·se, proactif·ve et souhaitez évoluer dans un environnement dynamique et en forte croissance.</li> </ul> <p>Voici un<a href="https://sites.google.com/deliveroo.co.uk/biz-interview-guide/home?authuser=0"> lien</a> avec de la documentation pour vous préparer aux entretiens.</p> <p>Nous offrons un environnement de travail dynamique et stimulant, où vous aurez l'opportunité de développer vos compétences et de contribuer activement à notre mission. Rejoignez notre équipe exceptionnelle dès maintenant et faites partie de cette aventure passionnante !</p> <p><strong>La vie chez Deliveroo :</strong></p> <p>Notre équipe est en forte croissance, notre impact très important, et nous cherchons à répondre aux questions les plus stimulantes du moment. Nous progressons rapidement, nous explorons toujours de nouvelles idées et nous sommes très transparents quant aux décisions que nous prenons et à ce qui motive nos choix.</p> <p>Il y a tellement de questions que nous souhaitons résoudre, et encore plus que nous n'avons pas encore rencontrées. Comment les données et la technologie peuvent-elles aider les restaurants à développer leur activité à mesure que les habitudes des consommateurs évoluent ? Comment pouvons-nous prédire ce qu'une personne souhaitera pour dîner avant même que l'idée ne lui vienne à l'esprit ? Chez Deliveroo, ces questions ne sont que quelques-uns des défis ambitieux auxquels nous nous efforçons de répondre – et il n'y a aucun projet qui ne peut pas devenir le vôtre. Aucune solution n'appartient à une équipe en particulier, ce qui vous ouvre d'extraordinaires possibilités en termes de développement et d'impact personnel.</p> <p><em>À compétences égales, ce poste est ouvert aux travailleurs et travailleuses en situation de handicap ou assimilés au sens de l’article L5212-13 du Code du travail. Deliveroo s’engage en faveur de la diversité, l’égalité professionnelle, l’emploi des personnes en situation de handicap.</em></p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Diversity, Equity and Inclusion</strong><br><br>At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We are looking for a Senior AI Engineer to transform the way our internal teams work, and to have a significant impact on the agentic side of our Saas products. Enable AI agents to interact with systems such as CRM, data platform, Drive, Jira, support tools, and internal knowledge bases. Design robust orchestration layers between models, APIs, tools, retrieval systems, and business workflows. Ensure reliability, observability, scalability, and maintainability across the entire AI stack. 3. Iterate for Impact Partner with end users, business teams, Product Managers, and Engineers to identify high-value opportunities for AI. Run pilots and experiments, gather qualitative and quantitative feedback, and measure business impact. Analyze usage patterns, failure modes, costs, latency, and performance metrics. Continuously improve accuracy, reliability, adoption, and user experience through data-driven iteration. 4. Ensure Quality, Security & Reliability Implement evaluation frameworks, guardrails, validation layers, and monitoring systems. Design AI systems that are secure, explainable, and production-ready. Ensure compliance with data security, governance, and access control requirements. Document architectures, capabilities, limitations, KPIs, and operational best practices. 5. Drive Adoption & Enablement Build a scalable ecosystem of AI systems and agents that empower both internal teams and customers. Support teams in adopting AI-powered workflows and integrating AI into their daily operations. Contribute to AI engineering standards, reusable frameworks, and best practices across the company. Act as a champion for AI-driven ways of working and help shape Mirakl's transition toward Agentic Commerce. Our stack and tools Languages: Python and SQL AI Stack: OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Mistral and Open-source models Agentic & Retrieval: LangGraph, LangChain, LlamaIndex, MCP and Vector Databases Infrastructure: AWS or GCP, Docker and Kubernetes What Makes You Successful Strong engineering mindset: able to design reliable and scalable systems Strong AI expertise: able to translate the latest AI capabilities into production products Strong product mindset: able to balance technical excellence with business impact Focus on measurable outcomes, not technical complexity Success Metrics Product adoption and business impact Performance and reliability of AI systems Quality of AI outputs and evaluation metrics You'll Love This Job If you have 5+ years of experience in Software Engineering, ML Engineering, Applied AI, or related fields Strong Python and software engineering fundamentals Hands-on experience building production AI systems using LLMs, RAG, and AI Agents Experience designing multi-step agentic workflows and retrieval systems Experience evaluating AI systems and improving model performance Experience deploying and operating production services in cloud environments Strong communication skills in English Curiosity, pragmatism, and passion for building AI products Feel free to add a link to your GitHub in your CV so we can understand what you have worked on! Want to join us? Here is our process A 30-40 min phone conversation with one of our Tech recruiters. This will be an opportunity to discuss your background, expectations, and discover what Mirakl can offer you in return. An initial 1h30 technical discussion with a member of the Data Science team and Engineering Team, which will allow you to delve into the more specific aspects of your expertise and discover how your skills can be integrated into our projects. 2 x 45-minute "STAR" interviews with future Mirakl colleagues to discuss our values and company culture. We welcome collaborators with their diverse perspectives and experiences to power us forward. These often far exceed conventional job requirements and help us create a culture of continuous learning. If you're ready to join a global leader powering digital transformation for 450+ of the world's most innovative retailers and B2B organizations. For more information about how we process your personal data and your rights, please consult our Recruitment Privacy Notice, here in English and here in French. We may use Artificial Intelligence (AI) solutions to help streamline our hiring process, including screening applications, analyzing resumes, and assessing responses. Alors que nous nous préparons à nous développer en Europe, 2 choses déterminent notre succès : nos équipes et notre mission. Aujourd'hui, plus de 150 personnes travaillent depuis nos bureaux et à distance pour libérer le potentiel des données de santé. Nous avons connecté 800 hôpitaux et 150 000 professionnels de santé, et nous ne faisons que commencer. Nous recherchons des personnes qui embrassent la complexité, veulent résoudre des problèmes difficiles et sont prêtes à construire le futur de la collaboration en santé. ⚡ Notre équipe Customer Operations L’équipe Customer Operations accompagne les établissements de santé dans le déploiement et l’usage des solutions Lifen. Son travail conditionne une adoption durable : comprendre l’organisation de chaque client, coordonner les parties prenantes et faire avancer les projets jusqu’à leur mise en service. En tant que Project Manager, tu piloteras des déploiements auprès de grands comptes, notamment des groupements hospitaliers de territoire (GHT). Tu seras le point de repère côté Lifen pour structurer le projet, donner de la visibilité aux clients et lever les obstacles avec les équipes internes. 🎯 Ce que tu feras chez nous Cartographier les établissements, les services concernés et leurs besoins pour cadrer chaque déploiement. Tenir la documentation projet à jour et contribuer à faire évoluer les méthodes et processus de l’équipe. ⭐️ Ce que nous recherchons Must-have Une solide expérience dans la gestion de projets, idéalement dans le déploiement de logiciels ou de solutions numériques. Soft skills Tu sais organiser ton travail sans attendre qu’on te donne chaque prochaine étape, tout en signalant rapidement les risques ou les dépendances. Lors de la restitution, tu présenteras ton raisonnement et la façon dont tu cadres un déploiement sur le plan fonctionnel. Entretien Cultural Alignement avec Raphaël, VP ops - 30 min. description: Chez Lifen, nous pensons que les données médicales ont le potentiel de transformer le système de santé. Mais seulement si elles sont accessibles. Sa mission : faire en sorte que les professionnels de santé utilisent Lifen au bon niveau, dans la durée, et qu’ils en tirent un bénéfice concret au quotidien. Ce poste n’est pas un rôle d’Account Manager ou de CSM orienté renouvellement, upsell ou gestion contractuelle. Il ne s’agit pas non plus de piloter le déploiement technique ou de prendre en charge le support. Ton terrain de jeu commence une fois les solutions en place : comprendre comment elles sont réellement utilisées, identifier ce qui limite leur adoption et construire les actions permettant de faire évoluer durablement les usages. Tu rejoindras l’équipe en charge des établissements publics les plus stratégiques. Ton portefeuille regroupera des organisations aux tailles, configurations, pratiques et contraintes très différentes. Tu devras être capable de comprendre rapidement ce qui se passe chez chaque client, de distinguer les symptômes des causes et de mobiliser les bons leviers, côté client comme chez Lifen. Le poste couvre les trois produits Lifen Care déjà déployés chez nos clients. Ta mission peut se résumer simplement : comprendre pourquoi nos solutions ne sont pas encore utilisées à leur plein potentiel dans certains établissements et faire évoluer durablement ces usages. 🎯 Ce que tu feras chez nous Prendre en main un portefeuille d’environ 35 hôpitaux et cliniques et construire, pour chacun, une lecture précise des usages, des interlocuteurs clés, du contexte organisationnel, des points de blocage et des opportunités. Construire une véritable stratégie de portefeuille. Tu ne pourras pas accompagner 35 établissements avec le même niveau d’intensité : à toi d’identifier où ton intervention aura le plus d’impact, quels comptes nécessitent une attention immédiate et lesquels peuvent être accompagnés de manière plus scalable. Diagnostiquer les freins à l’adoption à partir des données d’usage, des échanges avec les clients et de ta compréhension de leur environnement. Une baisse d’usage peut avoir des causes très différentes : configuration, organisation, processus internes, compréhension du produit, changement d’interlocuteur ou inadéquation entre l’usage réel et l’objectif initial. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Locations: </strong>Austin, TX; San Francisco, CA; New York City</p> <p><strong>About the role</strong></p> <p>Cloudflare’s Strategic Partnerships team operates at the intersection of technology, media, and emergent AI business models. We sit at the tip of the spear—bridging what Cloudflare builds with executive market needs, navigating complex ecosystem shifts, and driving "zero-to-one" commercial and strategic initiatives.</p> <p>We are seeking a <strong>Strategic Partnerships Operations Manager</strong> to bring structural rigor, operational efficiency, and scalable execution to our team. In this role, you will be the connective tissue between Strategic Partnerships and core internal functions like Product Management, Engineering, Sales, and Product Marketing.</p> <h4><strong>What you'll do</strong></h4> <p>You will design and run the team's operational backbone, build mechanisms to synthesize and scale external feedback back into our product roadmaps, and craft high-impact collateral for new solutions we bring to market. The ideal candidate possesses deep technical fluency, operates with high autonomy, and leverages modern AI tools to scale their impact.</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities</strong></p> <p><strong>1. Operational Infrastructure & Rhythm</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Design & Scale Team Cadences:</strong> Establish project management frameworks, tracking systems, and operational rhythms for the Strategic Partnerships organization to ensure visibility across high-stakes initiatives.</li> <li><strong>Workflow Automation:</strong> Utilize modern AI tools and automated workflows to centralize partner data, streamline pipeline management, and reduce manual reporting overhead.</li> <li><strong>Resource & Initiative Management:</strong> Serve as the central point of operational contact, tracking partner milestones, pilot launches, and cross-functional commitments.</li> </ul> <p><strong>2. Cross-Functional Feedback Loops</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Synthesize Market Signals:</strong> Capture, structure, and synthesize qualitative and quantitative insights gathered from key executive partners, publishers, and AI platforms.</li> <li><strong>Bridge Strategy, Product, & Sales:</strong> Build repeatable feedback loops with Product Management and Engineering to inform product roadmaps based on partner requirements and emerging ecosystem trends.</li> <li><strong>Field & Enablement Alignment:</strong> Partner with Sales and Go-To-Market teams to ensure partner learnings, tactical objection handling, and market narratives are operationalized across customer-facing teams.</li> </ul> <p><strong>3. Product Collateral & Go-To-Market Execution</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Collateral Architecture:</strong> Create executive-ready product collateral—such as message houses, solution one-sheets, presentation decks, and enablement briefs—to commercialize strategic initiatives.</li> <li><strong>Technical Storytelling:</strong> Translate complex technical infrastructure, AI Gateway mechanisms, crawler policies, and edge-computing capabilities into clear, compelling narratives for external partners and internal leaders.</li> <li><strong>Launch & Pilot Enablement:</strong> Coordinate pilot rollouts and partnership launches, ensuring marketing, product documentation, and collateral are aligned for external execution.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Who You Are</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Execution-Driven & Structured:</strong> You bring order to ambiguous environment. You can comfortably engage with product managers and engineers on technical nuances.</li> <li><strong>AI-Native Mindset:</strong> You actively use AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, workflow automation agents) in your daily work to multiply your output, synthesize data, and automate routine tasks.</li> <li><strong>Master Communicator:</strong> You possess exceptional written and visual storytelling skills. You can distill dense technical details into crisp, polished executive collateral.</li> <li><strong>Collaborative & Proactive:</strong> You thrive in cross-functional matrixed environments. You don't wait for a playbook—you build it while collaborating seamlessly across teams.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience:</strong></h4> <ul> <li><strong>Experience:</strong> 5+ years of experience in Business Operations, Strategic Partnerships, Product Marketing, Management Consulting, or Program Management within a high-growth tech environment.</li> <li><strong>Technical Aptitude:</strong> Demonstrated ability to comprehend complex technical products, platform infrastructure, or developer tools.</li> <li><strong>Track Record:</strong> Proven success in establishing cross-functional operating models and authoring external customer/partner collateral.</li> <li><strong>AI Tooling Proficiency:</strong> Experience leveraging AI platforms and automation tools to scale personal and team workflows.</li> <li><strong>Location:</strong> Based in or willing to work hybrid from Cloudflare’s <strong>San Francisco, CA,</strong> <strong>New York, NY </strong>or <strong>Austin, TX</strong> offices.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Compensation</strong></p> <p>Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.</p> <ul> <li><span data-sheets-root="1">For San Francisco based hires: Estimated annual salary of $189,000 - description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. The organization brings together engineering, operations, hardware and logistics teams that plan, deploy, operate and maintain our footprint in hundreds of cities worldwide. In this role, you'll help extend that footprint with a new generation of data center sites across the United States.</p> <h3>About the Role</h3> <p>We're looking for an experienced Data Center Operations manager to build and run the team that brings these new sites online and keeps them running around the clock.</p> <p>You will build a distributed team of Data Center Engineers from the ground up. You'll own sites across their full lifecycle: delivering greenfield builds through third-party vendors and colocation partners, running them in production, and retiring hardware securely at end of life. You'll be accountable for production hardware availability, 24x7 on-site response, and the operating model that lets this footprint scale.</p> <p>The role means balancing competing demands every day: build deadlines against build quality, dependence on partners against high standards, and fast incident response against careful compliance. You need to keep both sides of each in view.</p> <p>This role covers the physical layer: hardware, cabling, and Layer 1/Layer 2 connectivity. It works closely with network engineering and server provisioning teams but does not own them.</p> <h3>What You'll Do</h3> <p>Team Leadership</p> <ul> <li> <p>Hire, develop and manage Data Center Engineers based on-site at data centers across the US. Set clear expectations, career paths and a culture of ownership across a team spread over many sites.</p> </li> <li> <p>Build and take part in a 24x7 on-call rotation with your team. Define coverage models, handover protocols and incident SLAs that hold up as the footprint grows.</p> </li> <li> <p>Serve as the escalation point for on-site incidents. Coordinate engineers, colocation providers and vendors to restore service quickly, and lead root-cause analysis after major incidents so the same problem doesn't happen again.</p> </li> </ul> <p>Site Delivery</p> <ul> <li> <p>Own build timelines from site readiness through hardware delivery, rack-and-stack, cabling, validation and handoff to production.</p> </li> <li> <p>Run greenfield builds as multi-workstream programs. Coordinate third-party integrators, contractors and colocation providers to hit dates without cutting corners.</p> </li> <li> <p>Be on-site during key build phases to oversee vendor work, verify quality and make sure sites are production-ready.</p> </li> </ul> <p>Production Operations</p> <ul> <li> <p>Be accountable for availability targets for production hardware at your sites. Run break/fix, repairs, RMAs and spares strategy so that availability is measured, reported and improving.</p> </li> <li> <p>Manage colocation providers and vendors day to day: escalations, remote-hands quality, power and cooling issues, and performance against contractual commitments.</p> </li> </ul> <p>Documentation and DCIM</p> <ul> <li> <p>Make sure every site is fully documented in DCIM from day one. That covers rack elevations, power and cabling, asset location, and lifecycle status, all recorded as hardware arrives rather than filled in later.</p> </li> <li> <p>Treat infrastructure records as a source of truth that both operations and dependent teams rely on, giving them accurate, current visibility into where hardware is and what state it's in.</p> </li> <li> <p>Partner with tooling teams to bring DCIM online at new sites, and define documentation standards that hold up as the footprint grows.</p> </li> </ul> <p>Decommissioning and Hardware Lifecycle</p> <ul> <li> <p>Own on-site decommissioning end to end: unracking, physical collections, serial number verification, chain of custody, and handoff for secure destruction.</p> </li> <li> <p>Partner with vendor management on IT asset disposition (ITAD) vendors. Make sure destruction certificates and compliance evidence are filed and audit-ready.</p> </li> </ul> <p>Security and Compliance</p> <ul> <li> <p>Make sure your sites and team meet Cloudflare's physical security, access control, chain-of-custody and compliance obligations.</p> </li> <li> <p>Follow established physical access procedures, and work with security and compliance teams to develop new ones where these sites need them.</p> </li> <li> <p>Support audits with accurate, timely evidence. Treat audit readiness as a continuous standard, not something you prepare for once per audit cycle.</p> </li> </ul> <p>Automation and Operational Efficiency</p> <ul> <li> <p>Find manual, repetitive work in build, break/fix, decommissioning and evidence collection. Influence tooling and automation teams to remove it.</p> </li> <li> <p>Evaluate and adopt AI-assisted workflows for incident triage, root-cause analysis, documentation and compliance evidence generation.</p> </li> <li> <p>Scale the operation through tooling, not just headcount.</p> </li> </ul> <p>Business Reporting</p> <ul> <li> <p>Own weekly business reviews and monthly and quarterly reporting on availability, build progress, incidents and operational health to the Director and peer leaders.</p> </li> <li> <p>Partner with network, systems, hardware, supply chain and infrastructure engineering teams to make sure physical operations support what runs on top of them.</p> </li> </ul> <h3>Who You Are</h3> <p><strong>A builder who stays to operate.</strong> You've stood up sites and teams, and you take ownership of what happens after go-live. Delivering a build is where your job starts. If it isn't documented, it isn't done.</p> <p><strong>A leader of distributed teams.</strong> You've hired and built trust with on-site engineers spread across many locations, most of whom you won't see day to day. You know how to create accountability, consistent standards and a shared culture across sites, both remotely and in person.</p> <p><strong>Firm with partners.</strong> You hold colocation providers and vendors to high standards without becoming adversarial. You know the contract, you track performance, and you escalate when it's warranted.</p> <p><strong>Compliance-minded without being a compliance specialist.</strong> You understand why access controls and decommissioning chain of custody are audit controls. You treat compliance as part of doing the work well, not as overhead.</p> <p><strong>Automation-first.</strong> When something hurts, your first instinct is to fix the process or the tooling, not add people. You can turn an operational pain point into requirements engineering teams can act on.</p> <h3>Required Experience</h3> <ul> <li> <p>6+ years in data center operations, including 3+ years directly managing on-site technical teams. At least part of that time should be leading geographically distributed teams.</p> </li> <li> <p>A track record of operating multi-site data center fleets at hyperscale or large-cloud scale.</p> </li> <li> <p>Hands-on experience with IT hardware, including servers, network devices, optics and cabling, not only facilities infrastructure.</p> </li> <li> <p>Enough hands-on depth to coach engineers on technical work and to judge the quality of vendor and contractor work.</p> </li> <li> <p>Experience owning sites across the full lifecycle: delivering greenfield data center or cage builds through third-party vendors, running them in steady state, and decommissioning hardware.</p> </li> <li> <p>Experience managing providers in Tier III+ colocation facilities and holding them accountable to commitments.</p> </li> <li> <p>Experience managing 24x7 on-call operations and incident escalation.</p> </li> <li> <p>Strong Layer 1 and Layer 2 fundamentals: structured cabling, fiber and optics, patching standards, switching basics, and troubleshooting physical connectivity for network and server hardware.</p> </li> <li> <p>Solid knowledge of data center power and cooling, rack design, high-density deployments and hardware lifecycle management.</p> </li> <li> <p>Strong understanding of DCIM and asset management systems. You should have a track record of keeping documentation accurate from day one, including rack, power, cabling and asset records maintained from hardware arrival through decommissioning.</p> </li> <li> <p>Working knowledge of the security and compliance frameworks common in enterprise-grade data centers. You should understand them well enough to run operations under them; auditor-level expertise isn't required.</p> </li> <li> <p>Strong program management skills across multiple vendors, sites and time-bound workstreams.</p> </li> <li> <p>A track record of reducing toil through tooling or process redesign.</p> </li> <li> <p>Excellent written and verbal communication, including regular business reviews and status, risk and avai

comfortable working in Jupyter notebooks as a day-to-day analysis environment</p> <p>- Comfort working with large infrastructure datasets and translating them into decisions</p> <p>- Clear written and verbal communication — you can explain a capacity recommendation to a finance partner or a network engineer without losing either of them</p> <p>- Demonstrated ability to own a workstream end-to-end with light supervision</p> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. You will bridge the gap between technical strategy and business value—guiding enterprise clients from initial pre-sales technical validation through onboarding, deployment architecture, and full lifecycle expansion. Sitting within the GTM organization and reporting to a Customer Engineering Leader, you will not hand off your customers once an initial agreement is reached. Instead, you will operate as a quota-carrying technologist, leveraging AI-augmented workflows to eliminate administrative toil so you can focus on high-value architectural design and driving measurable business outcomes across the entire customer journey.</p> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Technical Validation: </strong>Partner closely with Account Executives to lead technical deep-dive discovery, capture business requirements, and map complex customer infrastructure - DNS, CDN, Zero Trust, Network Security, Workers - to fit-for-purpose Cloudflare architectures and bespoke solutions. . Proactively monitor customer health scores and telemetry to ensure rapid time-to-value, resolve integration bottlenecks, and reduce deployment risk.</li> <li><strong>Commercial Accountability & Expansion: </strong>Carry a variable quota tied directly to new business acquisition and/or ongoing account growth. Lead technical Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) to translate platform capabilities into return on investment for C-level executives.</li> <li><strong>Trusted Advisory: </strong>Act as a trusted technical advisor throughout the entire customer lifecycle, maintaining a continuous, deep relationship with key stakeholders from initial onboarding through maturity, renewal, and expansion. title: DCSC Automation Specialist
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Locations: </strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Austin, TX</strong></li> <li><strong>Atlanta, GA</strong></li> <li><strong>Denver, CO</strong></li> <li><strong>Seattle, WA</strong></li> <li><strong>Washington, DC </strong></li> </ul> <p><strong></strong></p> <p><strong>Application Deadline: December 16, 2026</strong></p> <p><strong></strong></p> <p><strong>Position Overview</strong></p> <p>Cloudflare is looking for an Automation Specialist to transform how our global Data Center Security Compliance (DCSC) team operates. This critical role is part of the Infrastructure Operations organization, which is responsible for building, scaling, and running Cloudflare's data center and network infrastructure across 700+ sites worldwide.</p> <p>The DCSC team manages physical access control and compliance auditing across one of the most complex and distributed infrastructure footprints in the industry, spanning more than 105 vendor portals, hundreds of non-portal carrier-neutral and edge partner sites, and multiple regulatory frameworks including SOC 2, ISO 27001, FedRAMP, ISMAP, and IRAP. The operational burden of this work is substantial and largely manual: user lists are pulled by hand, access control lists are reconciled by eye, evidence packages are assembled ticket by ticket, and attestation cycles consume weeks of coordinator time every quarter.</p> <p>This role exists to change that. The DCSC Automation -Specialist will design, build, and operate AI-assisted and automated workflows that eliminate the most time-consuming manual work in the DCSC operating model, freeing compliance coordinators to focus on exception handling, stakeholder relationships, and regulatory judgment rather than data gathering and reconciliation.</p> <p>This is a builder role. You will interview the team to understand each workflow, identify the highest-leverage automation targets, and ship tooling that demonstrably reduces the time it takes to close a QAR cycle, produce an audit evidence package, or manage a batch of access provisioning requests. You will work in close partnership with the DCSC coordinators, and existing automation developers, and will own the DCSC operational tooling roadmap.</p> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></p> <ol> <li><strong> Portal Automation & User List Extraction</strong></li> </ol> <ul> <li>Browser Automation: Design and maintain automated scripts (Playwright, Puppeteer, or equivalent) that log into vendor data center portals, extract user access lists, and feed structured output into the DCSC Portal and comparison pipelines replacing manual portal-by-portal data collection across 105+ portals covering 338+ sites.</li> <li>Resilience & Coverage: Build fallback handling for portals that block or rate-limit automated access; document exceptions and maintain a coverage registry tracking automation status per portal.</li> <li>Scheduled Execution: Operationalize extraction jobs on a recurring cadence aligned to QAR and MAR cycles, with alerting for failures and drift.</li> </ul> <ol> <li><strong> ACL Reconciliation & Diff Engine</strong></li> </ol> <ul> <li>Automated Comparison: Build tooling that ingests portal-extracted user lists and compares them against the master Access Control List (ACL), automatically surfacing discrepancies: users present in a portal but absent from the ACL, users on the ACL without active portal access, and role or access-level mismatches.</li> <li>Exception-Only Output: Route confirmed discrepancies directly to pre-populated Jira tickets for human review and action, eliminating the need for coordinators to perform full manual review of every user record each quarter.</li> <li>Audit Trail: Ensure all comparison runs produce immutable, timestamped records suitable for SOC 2, ISO 27001, and FedRAMP evidence requirements.</li> </ul> <ol> <li><strong> Attestation & Evidence Automation</strong></li> </ol> <ul> <li>Attestation Module: Own and extend the attestation workflow within the DCSC Portal, including automated cycle triggering, manager notification, time-stamped confirmation capture, and exception escalation, replacing manual screenshot-based evidence gathering.</li> <li>Evidence Package Builder: Build automated pipelines that compile audit-ready evidence packages for SOC 2, ISO 27001, FedRAMP, ISMAP, and IRAP control cycles, pulling attestation logs, portal extraction results, diff reports, and correspondence into structured packages keyed to specific control IDs.</li> <li>GRC Alignment: Work directly with GRC counterparts to validate that automated evidence formats meet auditor and regulatory requirements before deployment.</li> </ul> <ol> <li><strong> AI-Assisted Anomaly Detection & Triage</strong></li> </ol> <ul> <li>Access Pattern Analysis: Implement LLM-based review passes over QAR cycle output to surface patterns warranting human escalation: former employees retaining access, access creep over time, dormant accounts, and anomalous role assignments across sites.</li> <li>Ticket Intelligence: Build automation that reads incoming Jira onboarding and offboarding tickets and generates structured, portal-specific action checklists reducing coordinator cognitive load and preventing missed steps across multi-portal provisioning workflows.</li> <li>Continuous Improvement: Monitor automation output quality over time, retrain or recalibrate models as portal structures change, and maintain a feedback loop with coordinators on false positives and missed detections.</li> </ul> <ol> <li><strong> DCSC Portal Ownership & Tooling Roadmap</strong></li> </ol> <ul> <li>Platform Stewardship: Own the DCSC Portal as the operational runtime for all automation and workflow tooling ensuring it remains stable, documented, and usable by coordinators without engineering support for day-to-day tasks.</li> <li>Roadmap Management: Maintain a prioritized backlog of automation opportunities, assessed by time savings, compliance impact, and implementation complexity; present quarterly progress and priorities to DCSC leadership.</li> <li>Documentation: Produce runbooks for every automation, ensuring that no operational capability lives only in one person's head or on a local machine.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Desirable skills / Experience:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Automation Engineering: Demonstrated experience building browser automation (Playwright, Puppeteer, Selenium, or equivalent) against real-world web applications, including handling authentication flows, dynamic content, and anti-bot mitigations.</li> <li>TypeScript Proficiency: Strong skills for scripting, data wrangling, structured file I/O, and API integration. Ability to write maintainable, documented code that non-engineers can operate.</li> <li>LLM Integration: Hands-on experience integrating LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, or equivalent) into production workflows for classification, drafting, summarization, or anomaly detection tasks.</li> <li>Data Engineering Fundamentals: Comfort working with structured and semi-structured data at scale, diffing datasets, normalizing inconsistent formats, and producing clean outputs for downstream audit use.</li> <li>API & Workflow Integration: Experience building integrations with ticketing or ITSM systems (Jira preferred) via REST API, including automated ticket creation, status updates, and attachment handling.</li> <li>Systems Thinking: Ability to map an end-to-end manual workflow, identify the highest-leverage automation insertion points, and ship incrementally without waiting for a perfect solution.</li> <li>Workflow Archaeology: Comfortable extracting process knowledge from subject-matter experts through structured interviews turning tribal knowledge into documented, automatable workflows.</li> <li>Bias Toward Simplicity: Strong product intuition for the minimum viable automation that delivers real time savings, rather than over-engineering for edge cases.</li> <li>Compliance Awareness: Appreciation for the stakes of accuracy in a compliance context, understanding that an incorrect ACL diff or a missing evidence artifact has real audit consequences.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Soft Skills:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Communication: Able to explain automation design decisions and tradeoffs clearly to non-technical stakeholders including compliance coordinators and GRC partners.</li> <li>Ambiguity Tolerance: Vendor portals don't come with documentation. Workflows are passed down verbally. You need to be energized by figuring things out from scratch.</li> <li>Preferred Qualifications</li> <li>Experience with Cloudflare Workers or similar edge compute platforms</li> <li>Familiarity with GRC/compliance frameworks (SOC 2, FedRAMP, ISO 27001) at an operational level — not as an auditor, but enough to understand why evidence integrity matters</li> <li>RPA tooling experience (UiPath, Power Automate) as fallback for portals that defeat headless browsers</li> <li>Prior work in infrastructure operations, data center, or physical security environments</li> <li>Experience building internal tooling or developer-facing portals (not just scripts)</li> </ul> <p></p> <h3 data-path-to-node="0"><strong data-path-to-node="0" data-index-in-node="0">Compensation</strong></h3> <ul data-path-to-node="1
